title: Head of Agent Network
description:
Who we are:

Mama Money is a growth-stage fintech on a mission to improve the financial lives of migrants and underserved communities across Africa and beyond. What started in 2015 as a cross-border payments service has grown into a multi-product financial platform. We give people the tools to send, save, and manage money — on their own terms, at a socially fair price.

Mama HQ is in beautiful Cape Town, South Africa. We're 157 people strong (and counting), representing 19 countries across Africa, Asia, the UK, and Europe. From remittances to a growing range of financial products, everything we build is in service of people who deserve better. Our culture reflects that same commitment. We look after our team the way we want them to look after our customers. "Just be lekker!" means we trust our talented, diverse people to do what's right and make it happen — simply and with heart.

We've earned a few accolades, built lasting partnerships, and grown our reach in ways we're proud of. We've had good times and tough times, but our focus has never shifted. People over profit, always.

Mama Money is looking for a Head of Agent Network to lead the engine behind our growth. You'll take the reins of our 1,500+ strong field agent network across regions, driving sales strategy, agent performance, and commercial results that directly power our mission, helping migrants and underserved communities move money on their own terms, at a fair price. If you're data-driven, commercially and product-sharp, and know how to get the best out of large distribution teams, this is your chance to lead impact at scale from our Cape Town HQ.

As our Head of Agent Network, you will:

  • Lead and develop the sales team with a focus on driving high performance through our extensive field agent network (1,500+ agents).
  • Develop and execute data-driven strategies that align with company targets for customer acquisition, retention, and cross-selling our full suite of products and services.
  • Own and manage the commercial budget, focusing on controlling customer acquisition costs, improving gross margins, and enhancing customer lifetime value. Measure the results of deployed capital to drive strategy.
  • Oversee and mentor regional managers, ensuring they effectively manage their agents, meet performance targets, and drive sales in their regions.
  • Use data and performance metrics to track, analyse, and improve the efficiency of the agent network, ensuring strategies are refined and optimised for maximum impact. Be able to wrangle numbers and find opportunities.
  • Take over target setting for the team.
  • Review the existing commission structure to drive performance across the agent network, ensuring agents are incentivised and motivated to achieve their sales targets.
  • Collaborate closely with the product teams to ensure the agent network has the tools, products, and support needed to maximise sales potential.
  • Constantly use the product and suggest improvements based on that and feedback from the agent network. Work with the Product team to estimate the impact and cost of these improvements.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to ensure the Agent Network is on brand and is a strong brand ambassador. Provide Feedback on areas that can be branded to drive demand to in-field agents.
  • Ensure alignment with the company’s values and foster a collaborative, respectful, and high-performance culture within the sales team.
  • Have fun while driving our business growth and impact!

In your first 90 days, you will:

  • Deeply familiarise yourself with our agent network, customers, and sales processes.
  • Develop a detailed, data-backed sales strategy to drive customer acquisition, retention and cross-product usage through the agent network, with an emphasis on measurable performance.
  • Begin managing and building strong relationships with regional managers, identifying areas for improvement and growth within each region.
  • Track and monitor the performance of the network at each level, identifying strengths, weaknesses and general areas to improve
  • Start implementing improvements and make decisions
  • Start the process to collaborate with Product and Marketing to improve the Agent experience

About you:

  • You have experience leading a national sales team within an insurance, retail, financial services, or similar industry, focusing on managing large agent or distribution networks.
  • You are data-literate and comfortable doing data analysis to drive decisions, improve sales efficiency, and optimise performance.
  • You have worked with Product and Marketing before to collaborate and drive change. You can lean on their expertise but also provide them with insight from the field.
  • You are skilled at managing regional managers and sales teams, setting clear targets, and holding them accountable for meeting sales goals.
  • You have a strong commercial mindset with proven success in driving customer acquisition, retention, and cross-product usage.
  • You are target-driven, performance-oriented, and always looking for ways to improve operational efficiency.
  • You have a strong interest in social impact and are motivated by contributing to a mission that uplifts people.
  • It would be a bonus if: You have experience working in the fintech space or at a rapidly growing startup.

Why Mama Money?

At Mama Money, we’re here to make it easy—for our customers, our communities, and for each other. Simplicity is at the heart of what we do, whether it's creating a seamless and stress-free customer journey or removing barriers that stand in the way of progress; our work is all about delivering impact, minimising complexity, and ensuring every experience with Mama Money is easy.

We’re a team that isn’t afraid to give it a go. We value taking action, making bold steps, embracing innovation, solving problems, doing the hard things, and thinking smartly. Mistakes and failures don’t stop us—they teach us. Every challenge is a chance to grow, do better, and push boundaries.

And we just own it. Whether it’s delivering results, collaborating across teams, driving urgency, or taking accountability for our actions, we approach every task with integrity and purpose. We make company goals our own, showing up for each other, our customers, and our mission to create lasting change.

Mama’s Values

These aren’t just words—they’re how we show up every day:

  • Make it easy for customers

  • Give it a go

title: Staff Analog Engineer (f/m/d)
description:
• Design and verify CMOS major analog blocks for custom ASICs to meet performance, area, power and timescale constraints.
  • Take technical leadership of full-chip or major system level blocks and drive projects from specification to production ramp.
  • Collaborate with analogue and digital leads to achieve system and design strategy for custom ASICs and drive layout team to high quality physical implementation.
  • Produce high quality documentation for designed circuits.
  • Work closely with DFT engineers to ensure alignment to DFT strategy and implementation.
  • Drive silicon debugging and design characterisation.
  • Work with test and product engineers to support test development and ramp to production.
  • Take a proactive approach to driving own development plan, utilising team members and internal development opportunities.
  • Maintain technical project involvement at principal level and drive consistent methodology engagement across the team.
  • Design and verify analog block-level, sub-system and chip-level circuits to meet the functional and performance specifications of custom mixed-signal ASICs.
  • Lead a group of engineers technically to deliver a given block on time.
  • Translate customer requirements into design specifications and design solutions.
  • Degree level qualification in Electronics/Microelectronics Engineering or a related discipline is required
  • 8+ years of relevant analog circuit design experience.
  • Hands-on experience in the design and verification of a wide number of analogue circuit blocks such as amplifiers, oscillators, LDOs, comparators, reference/biasing circuits, PMIC and audio sub-blocks
  • Experience in leading the development of switching converter or audio systems.
  • Ability to lead a team and deliver chip level solutions through collaboration with analogue, digital, verification, layout, applications and test teams.
  • Experience of chip-level verification including AMS and DMS.
  • Strong competence with EDA design tools and the Cadence design environment.
  • Enforce common methodology across whole team.
  • Ability to make good judgement in selecting method and techniques for obtaining solutions.
  • Able to confidently share own expertise and work with others.
  • Ability to propose innovative solutions.
  • Ability to make significant contributions to projects, programs and business initiatives with creativity and ingenuity.
  • Ability to support and mentor less experienced team members.
  • Cross cultural awareness and sensitivity.
  • Results-oriented and able to deliver on-time under tight schedule.
  • Ability to work both independently and part of a team.
  • Flexibility to undertake occasional international travel at short notice.
  • Excellent command of verbal and written English.
  • Concise and precise communication and presentation skills within multi-site and multi-cultural environment.

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity & Inclusion Statement.

title: Starszy/a specjalista/ka ds. sztucznej inteligencji
description:
Poszukujemy kandydatów do pracy w Zespole Architektury i Wdrożeń Rozwiązań SI, w Centrum Nowych Technologii dla Polityk Publicznych. W związku z prowadzonymi licznymi projektami, wykorzystującymi sztuczną inteligencję w systemach teleinformatycznych, poszerzamy nasz zespół. Nasze rozwiązania oparte są głównie o przetwarzanie języka naturalnego i wizję komputerową. Tworzymy, wdrażamy, utrzymujemy i rozwijamy. Identyfikujemy również nowe obszary, w których SI byłaby pomocna.
  • Wykształcenie wyższe (informatyka, matematyka, data science, sztuczna inteligencja lub kierunki pokrewne).
  • Minimum 4 letnie doświadczenie zawodowe w projektowaniu, tworzeniu i wdrażaniu rozwiązań z obszaru sztucznej inteligencji.
  • Ugruntowana wiedza teoretyczna i praktyczna z zakresu uczenia maszynowego oraz głębokiego uczenia.
  • Doświadczenie w pracy z modelami AI/ML, w tym modelami językowymi LLM oraz technikami NLP.
  • Umiejętność doboru algorytmów do problemów biznesowych i analitycznych oraz oceny ich skuteczności.
  • Doświadczenie w trenowaniu, dostrajaniu (fine tuning), ewaluacji i optymalizacji modeli.
  • Znajomość zagadnień związanych z etyką AI, zarządzaniem ryzykiem oraz ograniczeniami modeli.
  • Bardzo dobra znajomość języka Python oraz bibliotek i frameworków AI/ML
  • Doświadczenie w projektowaniu i wdrażaniu potoków uczenia maszynowego (ML pipelines).
  • Umiejętność integracji rozwiązań AI z systemami informatycznymi poprzez API.
  • Doświadczenie w projektowaniu architektury systemów wykorzystujących AI w środowiskach produkcyjnych.
  • Umiejętność pracy z systemami rozproszonymi i architekturą mikroserwisową.
  • Zdolność do analizy wymagań i przekładania ich na rozwiązania techniczne.
  • Umiejętność samodzielnej pracy oraz pełnienia roli eksperta/doradcy technicznego.
  • Doświadczenie we współpracy z zespołami interdyscyplinarnymi (IT, biznes, analitycy).
  • Zdolność jasnego komunikowania złożonych zagadnień technicznych osobom nietechnicznym.

Mile widziane

  • Znajomość zagadnień MLOps/LLMOps (automatyzacja, wersjonowanie modeli, monitoring, wdrożenia produkcyjne).
  • Znajomość pracy z bazami danych, w tym wektorowymi (mile widziane).
  • Znajomość środowisk chmurowych lub platform kontenerowych (np. Kubernetes).
  • Doświadczenie w pracy z danymi wrażliwymi oraz w środowiskach o podwyższonych wymaganiach regulacyjnych.

title: Functioneel Applicatiebeheerder
location: Nieuwerkerk aan den IJssel, Zuid-Holland, Nederland
description:
Aantal uur: 32-36 uur per week
Salaris: tussen €3.568,- en de € 5.096,- bruto per maand o.b.v. 36 uur (schaal 9)
Contract: 1 jaar met uitzicht op vast dienstverband
Reageren vóór: 15 september

Achter de schermen onmisbaar. Zichtbaar door resultaat. Altijd in dienst van de organisatie.”

Applicaties spelen een cruciale rol in het dagelijks werk van onze collega's. Van samenwerken in Microsoft Teams tot het ondersteunen van gemeentelijke processen: zonder goed ingerichte applicaties staat het werk stil.

Ben jij de schakel tussen gebruikers, processen en techniek? Krijg je energie van het oplossen van vraagstukken, het verbeteren van applicaties en het begeleiden van collega's in het gebruik daarvan? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou.

Maak het verschil bij Zuidplas!

Werken bij gemeente Zuidplas betekent werken in een omgeving waar vertrouwen, flexibiliteit en ruimte centraal staan. In onze groeiende gemeente, met dorpen als Moerkapelle, Moordrecht, Nieuwerkerk aan den IJssel en Zevenhuizen én het nieuwe Cortelande, werk je aan vraagstukken die er echt toe doen. Hier denk je groots en doe je het samen.

Je krijgt de vrijheid om te experimenteren, initiatief te nemen en jouw ideeën tot leven te brengen.
Samen met betrokken collega’s werk je open, verbindend en met energie aan meerdere opgaven tegelijk. Dat vraagt om lef, eigenaarschap en de wil om te blijven groeien. Want hier maak jij het verschil – elke dag opnieuw.

Groots denken, samen doen! Maak er jouw werk van.

Over de rol

Als Functioneel Applicatiebeheerder ben je verantwoordelijk voor het functioneel beheer van een breed pakket aan gemeentelijke applicaties. Je zorgt ervoor dat applicaties optimaal aansluiten op de behoeften van de organisatie en gebruikers.

Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor functionele vragen, wijzigingen en verbeteringen. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met collega's, leveranciers, informatiemanagement en ICT.

Binnen jouw applicatieportfolio vallen onder andere Microsoft Teams en diverse applicaties die de gemeentelijke bedrijfsvoering en dienstverlening ondersteunen.

Dit ga je doen

  • Beheren, optimaliseren en verder ontwikkelen van diverse gemeentelijke applicaties; je bent achtervang en denkt mee met andere applicatiebeheerders

  • Functioneel beheer van Microsoft Teams en andere Microsoft 365-toepassingen binnen jouw aandachtsgebied;

  • Vertalen van gebruikerswensen naar praktische oplossingen en verbeteringen;

  • Inrichten, testen en implementeren van nieuwe functionaliteiten;

  • Begeleiden van updates, releases en wijzigingen;

  • Signaleren van verbeterkansen in processen, systemen en informatievoorziening;

  • Beheren van gebruikersrechten en autorisaties;

  • Ondersteunen en adviseren van gebruikers bij vragen en incidenten;

  • Opstellen van handleidingen, werkinstructies en gebruikersdocumentatie;

  • Verzorgen van trainingen en kennisdeling binnen de organisatie;

  • Afstemmen met leveranciers en interne stakeholders over wijzigingen en ontwikkelingen;

  • Bewaken van koppelingen tussen applicaties en de kwaliteit van gegevens;

  • Deelnemen aan projecten op het gebied van digitalisering, informatievoorziening en procesverbetering;

  • Je adviseert collega's en management over mogelijkheden binnen applicaties en informatievoorziening.


Dit breng je mee

Je bent nieuwsgierig, analytisch en servicegericht. Je vindt het leuk om processen te doorgronden en gebruikers verder te helpen. Daarbij schakel je gemakkelijk tussen verschillende niveaus binnen de organisatie.

Je bent iemand die eigenaarschap toont, zelfstandig werkt en tegelijkertijd de verbinding zoekt met collega's en leveranciers.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau;

  • Ervaring als Functioneel Applicatiebeheerder of in een vergelijkbare functie;

  • Ervaring met Microsoft 365 suite, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint en OneDrive. Bij voorkeur heb je al eerder gewerkt met diverse gemeentelijke applicaties;

  • Affiniteit met informatievoorziening, digitalisering en procesverbetering;

  • Kennis van BiSL of een vergelijkbare beheermethodiek is een pré;

  • Goede communicatieve en adviesvaardigheden;

  • Een proactieve en oplossingsgerichte instelling.

Wat je krijgt

Als je komt werken bij Zuidplas ben je verzekerd van goede primaire en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, namelijk:

  • Een uitdagende rol in een ambitieuze gemeente waar je werkt in een omgeving die energie geeft en ruimte biedt om het verschil te maken.

  • Een salaris tussen de €3.568,- en de €5.096,- bruto per maand o.b.v. 36 uur (schaal 9). Je wordt ingeschaald op basis van je ervaring;

  • Een Individueel Keuze Budget van 17.05% van het bruto jaarsalaris dat je helemaal naar eigen wens kan inzetten. Denk hierbij aan de mogelijkheid van het laten uitbetalen of het kopen van extra vakantiedagen;

  • Een goede werk- privébalans en 5 weken vakantie bij een fulltime werkweek zodat je even goed tot rust kunt komen;

  • Benieuwd naar al onze arbeidsvoorwaarden? Bekijk deze dan hier:

Jij straks ook?

Wil jij jouw kennis van functioneel beheer inzetten binnen een gemeente waar je echt impact kunt maken? Dan maken wij graag kennis met je. Solliciteer vóór 15 september.

Heb je vragen over de functie? Neem gerust contact op met de Clustermanager Saskia Kuhlmann. Heb je vragen over de procedure? Bel dan gerust met onze Corporate Recruiter, Sandhia Sheombar. Beiden zijn bereikbaar op 0180-330300.

De eerste kennismakingsgesprekken worden gevoerd op vrijdag 18 september, de tweede gesprekken op vrijdag 25 september. Een eventuele arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek staat gepland op maandag 28 september. Het streven is om de procedure in september af te ronden.

Bijzonderheden:
Een ontwikkelassessment kan onderdeel uitmaken van deze sollicitatieprocedure zodat wij goed kunnen inschatten of jij met onze gemeente mee kunt groeien. Wij vragen altijd referenties op en vragen standaard een VOG aan.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze of andere vacatures wordt niet op prijs gesteld. Als we hulp nodig hebben, gebruiken wij onze eigen middelen of bureaus met wie we al een samenwerkingsverband hebben.

title: Strategy Consultant, Crimson RISE
description:
Crimson Education is the world’s leading college admissions consulting firm, with over 1,490 Ivy League offers and 2,410 to the US Top 15. We help ambitious students gain admission to the world’s top universities through expert-led guidance and proven, data-driven strategies. Crimson students are 7x more likely to get into the Ivy League than their peers. We were recently featured on the front page of the Wall Street Journal.

Crimson is the only college admissions consultancy that brings together:

  • Former Ivy League and Top 20 admissions officers to rigorously review and refine applications

  • Professors and PhD teaching fellows from leading universities to guide students through original, independent research — with pathways to selective peer-reviewed publication or conference presentation

  • Past ISEF winners and judges who coach students to compete for state, national, and international science fair awards

  • Capstone project mentors who help students design and scale leadership initiatives with real-world impact, measurable outcomes, and credible external validation


We’re backed by leading VC firms, including Tiger Global, Heal Partners, IceHouse Ventures, and Movac, and recently closed a USD $40M Series D funding round at a USD $640M valuation. We now operate across 21 markets worldwide, including the US, Canada, UK, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, Australia, and New Zealand.

With university admissions rates on a continued decline, Crimson is proud to have built the world’s first and only global program featuring strategic mentorship, extracurricular development, and academic support for students aged 11-14- Crimson Rise.

This is a full-time, fully remote position with an immediate start.

What You’ll Be Responsible For

As a Crimson Rise Strategy Consultant, you will work directly with young students (typically ages 10-14, occasionally younger) and their parents to develop and execute academic, extracurricular, and personal growth goals in line with desired academic or professional pathways. You’ll be responsible for

  • Creating, maintaining, and ensuring execution on strategic roadmaps

  • Leading a team of experts to support execution of these roadmaps

  • Identifying age-appropriate, interest-aligned competitions and activities

  • Communicating the latest university admissions trends

  • Partnering with parents to ensure a quality service experience and tangible growth

Services You’ll Provide

  • Guide students in pre-college academic strategy, including:

    • Assessing academic performance and proposing improvement/growth solutions

    • Advising on grade improvement

    • Advising on pros/cons of public, private, boarding, online, and homeschool

    • Advising on curriculum selection

    • Selecting courses, activities, summer programs, and super-curricular programs

    • Ideating advanced capstone projects that can scale throughout high school

    • Building advanced competitions plans that span high school

    • Optimizing recommendations for university admissions based on shifting trends and student’s location, background, resources, and strengths

  • Provide holistic, consultant-led coaching to students 1:1, including

    • Organization, time management, goal-setting, and study skills

    • Guided interest identification and career research

    • Guided project brainstorming and activities selection

    • Tailored reading lists and guidance on vocabulary improvement

    • Introduction to university admissions and expectations

    • Reflections on priorities, interests, motivators, strengths, and stress management

    • Helping students become healthy, clear-minded thinkers confident in inherent value and able to engage passionately with their interests and the world around

  • Support sales and marketing teams across Crimson in understanding / presenting the Rise program to prospective clients.

Required Qualifications

  • Undergraduate degree from a Top 30 US or Top 20 UK university

  • 2+ years professional working experience

  • 1+ years experience educating, coaching, or working with 11-14 year-olds

  • Entrepreneurial/competitions experience at high school/college level strongly preferred

  • Track record of acceptances to top universities/private schools preferred

Required Skills

  • Research and analysis

  • Creative thinking under pressure

  • Global awareness and cross-cultural communication

  • Solution orientation

  • Collaborative mindset

Why work for Crimson?

  • Competitive salary with growth opportunities in a student-focused, team-driven environment, housed within one of the world’s most exciting and rapidly growing startups

  • Individualized mentoring and development opportunities with members of Crimson’s leadership team

  • Flexible work hours, 100% remote

  • Learning and development budget

  • Commission available for those who wish to upskill in sales

If you're passionate about education and people and looking for a fast-paced, collaborative environment, and want to work with cutting-edge technology then we'd love to hear from you!

Please keep an eye on your spam / junk email folder for correspondence from Team Tailor.

title: Full Stack Developer (Remote)
description:
Who are we at DAppNode?

DAppNode develops and maintains open source software and hardware to make web3 infrastructure accessible for all. DAppNode’s software transforms any machine where it’s installed into a personal web3 server where deploying new blockchains and DApps is a matter of two clicks.

We abstract the technical complexity and the devops tasks and provide a simple user experience with the objective of 1) allow users to run their own nodes and be sovereign with their access to nodes, validators, etc. And 2) allow DApps and networks to become more decentralized by increasing the number of independent node runners.

Currently Eth2.0, Gnosis Chain and Avalanche validators are the most used DApps from our users.

Who are we looking for?

We need a Full Stack Developer fluent in Typescript, React and Docker, able to shift between building the back‑end and implementing the user interactions according to DAppNode UI’s principles. We value experience in back‑end development, Docker and also in blockchain, Web3, and cryptocurrency technology. We need a team member with innovative ideas and effective communication skills to increase value, efficiency, and quality in our organization. To succeed in this role you must:

  • Have a deep love of NodeJS, Typescript, and Web 3.
  • Be well-versed in Docker, Docker networking and data hosting servers.
  • Write squeaky clean and maintainable code
  • Enjoy connecting frontend and backend development.
  • Adore end-to-end development and guide the project to completion. Have an intuitively analytical and abstract mind with high organizational skills.
  • Be comfortable with accepting, giving and applying constructive criticism.
  • Excellent communication and teamwork skills; emphasizing accurate listening and compassionate speaking.
  • Maintain a flexible schedule, as our team navigates time zones all over the world.
  • Be fluent in written and verbal English.
  • Crypto-curious! Crypto experience preferred.

Job Responsibilities

  • Prioritize development tasks into sprints that efficiently stay on or ahead of schedule.
  • Troubleshoot any “bugs” that pop up.
  • Staying current development trends in web applications and programming languages.
  • Work with development teams, designers, and product managers to co-create software solutions
  • Continually look for ways to improve the UX/UI of the website to support a better user experience, speed, and effective data storage.
  • Design client-side and server-side architecture
  • Co-create front‑end of applications through visually appealing design
  • Ensure cross-platform optimization for mobile phones
  • Build visually‑appealing, easy‑to‑use components that fit in with the theme of the site.

Who you are

  • Professional experience both as frontend and backend developer
  • 4+ years of experience
  • Knowledge of Typescript, NodeJS, React and Docker.

We value your proactive contribution, methodology expertise and keen ability of effective prioritization. To acknowledge your exceptional value to the team, and to also sweeten the deal, we offer these incentives:

Pay and Perks

  • Competitive salary, with higher salary available for those with corporate experience.
  • Freedom of a flexible work schedule.
  • Work in the remote location of your choice; ideally between Europe, North America, and South America.
  • Crypto payment possible
  • Additional compensation package of tokens - reap the rewards of what you help create!
  • Flexible vacation time, because personal/work life balance matters.
  • Paid conference attendance - where the ideas can brew and we get the pulse of the ecosystem
  • Paid team retreats - where the team meets and gets to know each other offline.

The ecosystem of decentralized technology is quickly expanding in Blockchain, Web3, Open Source, and future unknown tools. If you value exponential professional growth and learning about new technologies initiatives everyday while contributing to the greater good; this position is for you. We look forward to meeting you and creating the new world of decentralized infrastructure together.

We don’t care about your race, your gender, your sexual orientation, ethnicity, or who knows what. We want to empower our people to accomplish their potential, we welcome variety as a source of inspiration, and we regard it as a value-added.

title: Hardware Engineer
description:

Veoneer exists to Protect Everyone in Every Crash. We design, manufacture, and sell the world's best automotive safety electronics.

Veoneer is a world leader, and almost every 4th car produced today has Veoneer's automotive safety electronics. Veoneer has delivered more than 1.1 billion electronic control units and crash sensors to car manufacturers globally.

title: Gastvrije Officemanager
description:
Officemanager

Ben jij gastvrij, praktisch en iemand die zelf ziet wat er moet gebeuren? Als Officemanager zorg je dat ons kantoor goed draait en een fijne plek is voor collega’s, klanten en partners.

Wat ga je doen?

Je bent het centrale aanspreekpunt op ons kantoor in Amsterdam en zorgt dat alles goed geregeld is. Van een representatief kantoor en een verzorgde lunch tot een warm welkom voor bezoekers.

Je houdt je onder andere bezig met:

  • de dagelijkse lunch en voorraad van eten, drinken en koffie;

  • een schoon, verzorgd en goed functionerend kantoor;

  • ontvangst van klanten, partners en andere bezoekers;

  • contact en afspraken met leveranciers en onze schoonmaakdienst;

  • voorbereiding van onze wekelijkse personeelsborrel;

  • organisatie van evenementen en personeelsactiviteiten;

  • inboeken van inkoopfacturen en andere lichte administratie.

Je wacht daarbij niet op instructies. Je merkt zelf op dat iets ontbreekt, niet goed werkt of beter kan en onderneemt actie.

Ook sociaal speel je een belangrijke rol. Je kent je collega’s, draagt bij aan een warme sfeer en weet goed wanneer je aandacht geeft en wanneer je mensen juist rustig laat werken.

Wie zoeken we?

We zoeken een zelfstandige doener met goede sociale antennes. Iemand die gastvrijheid vanzelfsprekend vindt, overzicht houdt en het leuk vindt om uiteindelijk grotendeels zelfstandig het kantoor te bestieren.

Jij:

  • bent praktisch, georganiseerd en zelfstartend;

  • communiceert gemakkelijk met collega’s, gasten en leveranciers;

  • hebt oog voor detail en representativiteit;

  • pakt problemen zelfstandig op;

  • spreekt goed Nederlands en Engels.

Een mbo Hotelschool of vergelijkbare hospitalityopleiding in combinatie met horeca-ervaring is voor deze functie een sterke pré.

Wat bieden we jou?

Je krijgt een zelfstandige en afwisselende functie met veel ruimte voor initiatief. Daarnaast bieden we onder andere 25 vakantiedagen, volledige reiskostenvergoeding, een opleidingsbudget, pensioenregeling, fietsplan, telefoon- en internetvergoeding en virtuele aandelen.

Je werkt vanuit ons kantoor direct naast Amsterdam Centraal, met uitzicht over het IJ.

Over Copernica

Copernica ontwikkelt software voor e-mail en marketing automation. We werken met korte lijnen en veel zelfstandigheid. Mensen krijgen de ruimte om verantwoordelijkheid te nemen en hun werk steeds slimmer te organiseren.

Lijkt het je leuk om het hart van ons kantoor te vormen? Dan maken we graag kennis met je.

Szukamy osoby, która łączy myślenie produktowe z silną analizą systemową. Jeśli lubisz analizować złożone procesy, pracować z danymi, identyfikować problemy i przekładać potrzeby biznesowe na konkretne rozwiązania dla zespołów technologicznych- ta rola może być dla Ciebie.

  • Masz minimum 3 lata doświadczenia jako Product Owner, Analityk Systemowy lub w innej roli łączącej analizę systemową z odpowiedzialnością za rozwój produktu.
  • Masz doświadczenie w analizowaniu złożonych procesów i systemów, szczególnie związanych z rejestracją, onboardingiem, finansami, płatnościami lub weryfikacją klientów.
  • Masz praktyczne doświadczenie w projektach integracyjnych oraz rozumiesz komunikację między systemami, przepływ danych i obsługę błędów.
  • Potrafisz modelować procesy, reguły biznesowe, zależności systemowe i przypadki brzegowe.
  • Potrafisz definiować problemy, hipotezy, wymagania, kryteria akceptacji oraz mierzalne kryteria sukcesu.
  • Umiesz tworzyć czytelną dokumentację funkcjonalną i systemową, dostosowaną do potrzeb zespołów technologicznych i interesariuszy biznesowych.
  • Swobodnie poruszasz się w dokumentacji technicznej systemów, aplikacji i integracji.
  • Masz doświadczenie we współpracy z zespołami deweloperskimi i QA.
  • Potrafisz priorytetyzować backlog, uwzględniając wartość biznesową, potrzeby klientów, ryzyko, koszt i możliwości zespołu.
  • Bardzo dobrze komunikujesz się i potrafisz sprawnie poruszać się pomiędzy biznesem, technologią i innymi interesariuszami.
  • Znasz dobre praktyki cyklu wytwarzania oprogramowania i masz doświadczenie w pracy w środowisku zwinnym.
  • Jesteś osobą samodzielną, odpowiedzialną i dobrze zorganizowaną.
  • Znasz język angielski na poziomie co najmniej B2.

Mile widziane:

  • Znajomość branży fintech, regtech, bankowości lub płatności.
  • Znajomość procesów KYC, KYB, AML, fraud lub identity verification.
  • Doświadczenie w realizacji integracji z dostawcami usług weryfikacyjnych.
  • Doświadczenie w pracy z risk scoringiem lub rules engine.
  • Doświadczenie z procesami manual review.
  • Znajomość SQL lub narzędzi self-service BI.
  • Podstawowa znajomość narzędzi do komunikacji przez API, np. Postman.
  • Doświadczenie w prowadzeniu eksperymentów produktowych i optymalizacji lejka.
  • Doświadczenie z produktami platformowymi wykorzystywanymi przez kilka zespołów.
  • Doświadczenie w środowisku regulowanym.
  • Doświadczenie w pracy z danymi wrażliwymi i zagadnieniami RODO.
  • Wykorzystywanie narzędzi AI w codziennej pracy.

title: Process Quality Analyst
description:
Purpose of Job

The Process Quality Analyst will support all Quality Assurance activities on all the manufacturing lines, reporting to the Quality Manager of the Wisbech Plant. The role is part of the overall Quality team onsite.

To understand customer quality requirements and manufacturing specifications and thereby provide sound and prompt advice to team members, managers, and site leadership team via analysis of quality data and trends. This ensures that the product remains within critical control parameters. The work input is critical in continuous improvement initiatives and adherence to quality control systems and standards.

Principal Accountabilities

  • Responsible for all shift quality control activities. Fully understanding and promoting customer product Quality standards across all lines and shifts.
  • Stop production and isolate product if customer’s requirements are not being met.
  • Provide the link between shift production teams and the quality team by communicating quality and hygiene requirements throughout the shift.
  • Plan and control all shift quality and hygiene activities to ensure compliance with all 3rd party management standards as well as all Sonoco Quality requirements.
  • Ensure a thorough, accurate and documented shift hand over of all quality and hygiene issues.
  • Ensure that shift crews work to the protocols defined and are fully engaged in quality activities throughout the shift.
  • Ensure quality control and hygiene incidents are handled in accordance with defined procedures, instructions, and standards.
  • Ensure that all logbooks are completed fully and accurately.
  • Ensure all quality measurement gauging is maintained, within calibration and to provide initial fault diagnosis on suspect equipment.
  • Ensure all vision inspection systems are maintained, scans are verified, performance is correct and to provide initial fault diagnosis on suspect equipment.
  • To be fully capable of using and interpreting statistical data and ensuring their use to improve processes.
  • Ensure sound and timely decision making online and to positively audit finished packs for release to the customer.
  • Ensure all operator quality system checks are reviewed for completeness and that corrective actions are taken or reported as outstanding at shift hand over.
  • Ensure that non-conforming raw materials are properly controlled through the DRM system.
  • Prepare regular shift quality reports to be used in daily production meetings.
  • Attend daily production meetings and/or to represent the plant during customer audits and at customer sites as appropriate.
  • Manage other shift quality control duties as defined from time to time.
  • Ensure that all critical process control parameters are maintained within specification.
  • Ensure that all appropriate actions are taken to supply a quality finished product to the customer.
  • Identify high-risk activities, events, and trends.
  • Work pro-actively with the manufacturing team and use your own initiative based on data and information available.
  • Complete all Internal audits assigned to you within the defined time frame with any issues resolved at the time if feasible to do so.
  • Work flexibly in any work area as far as safety and capability permit.

H&S & Environment

  • Comply with Sonoco EHS policy and statutory requirements at all times.
  • Ensure that all activities are carried out in accordance with all applicable safety procedures.
  • Practice safe working techniques in all that you do.
  • Support and engage the business with any safety related initiatives and programs.
  • Support the business with carrying out safety observations and discussions with others, finding any fixes or improvements which can be proposed to the site.

Knowledge & Experience

  • Quality related background is essential
  • Internal Auditor trained
  • HACCP knowledge
  • Problem Solving (4c, DMAIC, 5Y etc)
  • Working knowledge of the can making process. Is advantageous
  • Experience and knowledge of SPC.
  • Computer/IT literate
  • Communication skills – written and verbal

title: Platform Engineer (Azure)
description:
About Us:

ClearRoute is an engineering consultancy bridging Quality Engineering, Cloud Platforms and Developer Experience. We help enterprises reliably bring high-impact digital products to market faster, cheaper, and safer, working with technology leaders facing complex business challenges.

We take as much pride in our people, culture and work-life balance as we do in making better software. We’re not just making better software. We’re making the making of software better. Collaborative, entrepreneurial and dedicated to problem solving, we bring the step change our customer need to sustain innovation. Our values challenge us to do the best we can for ClearRoute, our customers and most importantly our team. This is an opportunity for you to build the organisation from the ground up, use your voice to drive change and help transform organisations and problem domains.

Role:

We’re hiring a talented Engineer who will initially join one of our clients core platform team, building and operating the shared platforms and tooling that support engineering across their entire organisation. You will focus on creating scalable, secure and automated infrastructure, enabling delivery teams to build, test and release software quickly and consistently. This is a hands-on role with real impact across cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines and developer experience.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain shared cloud platforms and services (primarily Azure)

  • Develop reusable infrastructure and automation using Terraform and scripting

  • Create CI/CD frameworks using tools such as GitHub Actions and Octopus Deploy

  • Enable self-service capabilities so teams can deploy and manage workloads independently

  • Support Kubernetes clusters, container platforms, networking and identity integrations

  • Implement guardrails and policies to support security, compliance and scalability

  • Maintain monitoring, logging, alerting and performance standards across the platform

  • Identify and resolve bottlenecks in engineering workflows and deployment pipelines

  • Work closely with engineering teams to improve tooling, reliability and speed of delivery

  • Support incident triage, including security-related tickets

Required Experience:

  • Experience working with cloud platforms, ideally Azure

  • Experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform preferred)

  • Exposure to scripting (e.g. Bash or similar)

  • Experience building or maintaining CI/CD pipelines

  • Understanding of modern application stacks (e.g. .NET, C#, React)

  • Experience monitoring systems, applications and cloud environments

  • Ability to support and guide development teams on DevOps practices

Desirable Experience:

  • Familiarity with tools such as GitHub Actions, Octopus Deploy or similar

  • Azure

  • AI (there is some work to complete on some skills for generating terraform code, tests, consuming modules, creating diagrams / documentation)

Working at ClearRoute


We have grown from six founders to 200+ people across five countries in three years, and what sets us apart isn't the pace, it's how we grow.

  • Real flexibility, in practice. We trust you to perform at your best and still have a life outside of work, with genuine hybrid working, a home office budget, an open feedback culture where your voice shapes decisions, and time off when life needs it (birthday included).

  • When ClearRoute wins, you win. We offer profit share so success is shared, meaningful recognition for great work, and benefits that look after you and your family, including private healthcare, competitive salary benchmarking, and a confidential employee assistance program covering counselling, mental health support, and financial wellbeing.

  • A community you'll genuinely want to be part of. Interest based communities like running and book clubs, Women in Tech group, monthly socials, and cross regional events bring people together across the company. An inclusive, collaborative culture where you don't need to conform to succeed, where people support one another and feel comfortable being themselves.

  • Where meaningful work meets real growth. You will tackle complex, real world problems at the forefront of platform engineering, AI, security, and scalable systems. Your growth is supported by learning budgets, Udemy access, a clear career framework, internal mobility, and thought leadership opportunities that take your impact beyond ClearRoute.

At ClearRoute, we believe diverse perspectives lead to better outcomes, and inclusion creates the conditions for everyone to thrive. We are proud to have built a family friendly working environment and have many employees who have caring responsibilities alongside work. We welcome applications from people who require flexibility and will be happy to discuss needs on an individual basis.

We are committed to fostering a culture where all team members feel respected, supported, and empowered to do their best work. We celebrate individuality and our differences and understand that some differences may mean that you require changes made to the interview process. We are happy to cater to your needs to make the interview accessible, if this is something you require please let us know by emailing us at join@clearroute.io

title: Nattreceptionist
description:
Om oss

Mitt emot Stadsparken i centrala Luleå ligger vårt anrika Stadshotell från 1903. Med ståtlig entré och vacker festsal i fransk renässansstil erbjuder vi erbjuder 159 smakfullt inredda rum, fest- och konferenslokaler samt en av Luleås mest populära gastropub, The Bishops Arms.

Om tjänsten Detta är ett perfekt jobb för dig som har en väl utvecklad känsla för förstklassig service, är en naturlig lagspelare och som gillar ordning och reda!

Arbetet i receptionen är varierande och med stort fokus på gästkontakt. Förutom traditionellt receptionsarbete som in- och utcheckning kommer du bland annat att arbeta med merförsäljning, kassahantering, fakturering, bokning av rum, svara på mail och i telefon, vara våra gäster behjälplig med allehanda service samt att säkerställa att lobby och reception håller hög standard och alltid upplevs som välkomnande.

Receptionen har en viktig roll i att vara spindeln i nätet för att säkerställa ett fint flöde mellan avdelningarna och skapa en högklassig gästupplevelse.

På vårt hotell är vi oerhört noga med att alltid hjälpas åt. Det innebär en prestigelös miljö där vi håller fokus på gästen, lösningar och samarbete. Dina arbetsuppgifter är i första hand att tillsammans med teamet skapa den bästa upplevelsen för gästen.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som vill arbeta i vår bransch för att du brinner för att ge alla gäster den bästa upplevelsen. Vi ser att du har en outtröttlig förmåga att bemöta varje gäst lika professionellt och varmt och som behåller fokus och glädjen även under högt tempo.

Du bör ha erfarenhet av tidigare lindande arbete. Ett stort plus är om du har kunskaper i bokningssystemet Infor HMS. Vi tror dock att man kan lära sig allt om man har rätt inställning och personlighet. Mycket goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift är en förutsättning, ytterligare språk är meriterade.

För att bli framgångsrik i rollen som receptionist hos oss, behöver du vara nyfiken, modig och engagerad i ditt arbete.

Vi erbjuder

  • Avtalsenlig lön

  • Personalförmåner som t.ex. personalpriser inom Elite Hotels

  • En utpräglad företagskultur

  • Teamaktiviteter och utbildning

  • Goda karriärmöjligheter

Praktikaliteter:

  • Arbetstider: cirka 22.00-07.00, vardagar och helger

  • Omfattning: 75% med möjlighet till mer

  • Start: Omgående

  • Lön: Enligt kollektivavtal

  • För frågor om tjänsten: Malin Araya Frostfalk, Receptionschef (receptionsansvarig@elite.se)

  • Sista ansökningsdag: Urval kommer ske löpande, vi rekommenderar därför att du inte väntar med din ansökan!

title: HEOR Senior Consultant
description:
Acumetis is a global expert commercialisation partner purposefully built to help life sciences win in the age of connectivity. With an integrated model spanning the entire asset lifecycle, deep functional and therapeutic-area expertise, and rigorous, outcome-driven thinking, Acumetis reframes complex problems and shapes solutions that are both imaginative and achievable. With more than 350 experts globally and experience across 50+ geographic markets, Acumetis helps clients unlock value, accelerate performance, and deliver better outcomes for patients.

Acumetis. Reframe what’s possible.

As a Senior Consultant within the Global Value & Access team, you will take a leading role in shaping project strategy, driving high-quality delivery, and serving as a trusted partner to clients across the pharmaceutical and biotech sectors. You will apply deep expertise in Market Access, HEOR, pricing and reimbursement, and evidence strategy to guide decision-making in complex and fast-moving environments.

You will lead multiple workstreams with confidence, ensuring methodological rigour, well-structured narratives, and impactful recommendations. You will be responsible for steering teams, maintaining strong client engagement, and overseeing high-quality outputs across diverse project types, from HTA and pricing strategy to evidence synthesis, qualitative research, and landscape analysis.

Senior Consultants are influential contributors to client relationships. You will proactively identify opportunities, steer conversations, manage complex discussions, and help guide cross-functional alignment both internally and externally. You will also play a key role in developing junior team members, coaching others, reviewing work to ensure quality and consistency, and creating an environment where teams perform at their best.

This role builds the strategic leadership and commercial capability required for progression towards a Manager, where ownership of full client accounts, multi-project oversight, and thought leadership become central responsibilities.

ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES AND EXPECTATIONS

Core Knowledge

  • Apply advanced HEOR frameworks, economic evaluation methods, and HTA principles to guide strategy discussions with clients.

  • Lead pricing and access strategy thinking across countries and therapeutic areas.

  • Demonstrate mastery of Excel, PowerPoint, and Word to produce or review complex, client-ready materials.

  • Guide teams in applying appropriate methodologies, frameworks, and analytical approaches to diverse project types.

How You Work

Critical Thinking & Attention to Detail

  • Evaluate complex data and evidence to support strategy, commercial interpretation, and decision-making.

  • Review and improve others’ work, ensuring tone, clarity, logic, and consistency across deliverables.

  • Identify strategic implications and trade-offs, helping clients understand the impact of evidence, policy shifts, or competitive context.

  • Establish internal QC standards and champion rigorous review processes across projects.

Time Management & Collaboration

  • Balance multiple timelines and priorities across several projects, ensuring clarity and structure for teams.

  • Manage cross-project workload for yourself and others; forecast resource needs and plan ahead.

  • Foster a high-trust, collaborative environment; support to resolve conflicts and support positive team culture.

  • Coach team members at all levels, encouraging feedback, development, and high performance.

Communication & Client Engagement

  • Lead client presentations, workshops, and strategic discussions with confidence and clarity.

  • Manage sensitive, complex, or high-stakes client conversations independently.

  • Provide structured, persuasive communication in emails, presentations, and deliverables.

  • Serve as the day-to-day lead for client interactions, ensuring alignment, responsiveness, and relationship strength.

Project Management

  • Lead full projects or major components, managing timelines, budgets, work allocation, and quality.

  • Oversee project coordination, internal communication, and stakeholder management across functions.

  • Anticipate project risks, identify solutions early, and ensure smooth execution from scoping to delivery.

  • Ensure team adherence to CMAP processes, forecasting requirements, and project controls.

Client Management

  • Lead client management tasks with minimal oversight

  • Proactively flag issues/changes in scope and/or timelines and support team problem-solving

What You Do

Research & Evidence

  • Design, oversee, and review structured literature reviews with strong methodological rationale.

  • Drive evidence synthesis approaches for complex evidence packages, HTA submissions, or multi-country assessments.

  • Guide qualitative study design, moderate interviews or advisory boards, and provide oversight of thematic analysis.

  • Lead survey design, complex quantitative analysis, or model interpretation with commercial insight.

Data Analysis & Evidence Interpretation

  • Validate analytical outputs and integrate insights into strategic narratives.

  • Guide teams in selecting quantitative or qualitative methodologies that align with project objectives.

  • Ensure that data-driven insights clearly support strategic recommendations and client decision needs.

Writing & Storytelling

  • Write or review full reports, including pricing/access strategy, HEOR narratives, HTA-facing content, and strategic recommendations.

  • Create persuasive slide decks with compelling storylines tailored to client objectives.

  • Ensure that outputs reflect strategic coherence, clarity, a high standard of consulting communication and meet client objectives.

Presentation & Business Development

  • Lead sections of client presentations, confidently handling Q&A and guiding discussions.

  • Deliver strategic workshops, advisory boards, or cross-functional client sessions.

  • Shape proposals, including objectives, frameworks, timelines, budgeting, and methodological approaches.

  • Identify opportunities for follow-on work and contribute to broader business development and internal initiative activities.

Career Development

As a Senior Consultant, you will refine your leadership, deepen your technical expertise, and expand your client-facing responsibilities. Progression at this level typically involves:

  • Leading full projects or multi-country workstreams independently

  • Guiding strategic client conversations and owning key relationships

  • Designing and overseeing evidence, pricing, and access approaches across project types

  • Coaching and developing team members to deliver high-quality work

  • Influencing internal processes, methodologies, and best practices

  • Contributing to commercial growth through BD involvement and client engagement

  • Acting as a thought partner to Managers and Senior Managers in shaping complex strategies

Strong performance at this level prepares you for progression to the Manager role, where broader account leadership, strategic ownership, business development, and cross-project oversight become central.

Education

  • Degree-level qualification (2.1 or above preferred) in a health-related, analytical, or numerical scientific discipline, such as:

    • Health Economics, Public Health

    • Maths, Statistics, Econometrics

    • Biochemistry, Natural Sciences, Life Sciences

    • Engineering, Operational Research, MORSE

  • Advanced degree (MSc, MRes, MBA, PhD) strongly preferred in:

    • Health Economics

    • Biostatistics / Medical Statistics

    • Epidemiology

    • Mathematics / Econometrics

    • Other analytical, quantitative, or health-related disciplines

Skills & Capabilities

  • Extensive experience delivering Market Access, HEOR, pricing and reimbursement, evidence synthesis, or analytical consulting work, including leading workstreams or full project components.

  • Proven ability to design, justify, and lead quantitative and qualitative research approaches, ensuring methodological rigour and alignment to client needs.

  • Ability to interpret complex data, integrate multiple evidence sources, and translate insights into commercially relevant recommendations.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with excellent command of English (CEFR C1/C2), including the ability to lead client-facing discussions and provide high-quality written outputs.

  • High proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including advanced Excel functions for data analysis and model interpretation.

  • Experience with reference management software (e.g., EndNote, Zotero) and/or analytical/statistical tools (e.g., R, SPSS, Stata, Python) is advantageous and increasingly expected at this level.

  • Strong organisational, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities across multiple projects.

  • Demonstrated leadership capability, including coaching colleagues, reviewing others’ work, and supporting high-quality delivery across teams.

  • Ability to work with professional maturity and independence, managing complex client interactions and contributing to strategic discussions.

VALUE FRAMEWORK

At Acumetis, our values are built upon four essential values that define the competencies and behaviours needed for each role within our organisation: business, self, team, and client. These values are represented by:

  • Entrepreneurial – we have an entrepreneurial mindset towards work, we are solutions oriented and we accept challenges that come our way

  • Integrity - We are responsible and accountable, we treat everyone with respect, generosity and care

  • Collaboration – We listen to one another and tap into knowledge, wisdom and perspectives of our colleagues and we foster a supportive inclusive environment

  • Achievement – We make a difference of driving company and personal growth and we thrive on achievement and recognition of ourselves, our team and our company

DIVERSITY, EQUITY AND INCLUSION

Acumetis is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where every team member feels valued and empowered to contribute their best work. Internally, we strive to create an environment where diversity of thought and experience enhances collaboration, drives innovation, and supports personal and professional growth. By championing inclusivity, we ensure that all team members can thrive and achieve success together.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter) based in Belgium.

This is an opportunity to join an established digital product and contribute to a mobile experience used by a global community.
You’ll work on core product journeys including registration, discovery, profiles, messaging, engagement, and monetization.
The role combines hands-on Flutter development with a strong focus on analytics, performance, and measurable product outcomes.
You’ll help evolve a production mobile application across both iOS and Android while supporting multiple brands and configurations.
The environment is remote-first and internationally distributed, with experienced professionals collaborating across cultures and time zones.
You’ll work with modern Flutter architecture and tooling while contributing to a product where mobile quality and user engagement directly matter.
This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership, technical depth, and building scalable mobile experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and maintain core mobile product experiences across authentication and registration, search and discovery, profiles, photos, messaging, matching, and user engagement.
  • Analyze and improve key product funnels, including registration, upgrades, monetization, messaging engagement, and match or interest conversion.
  • Own and contribute to analytics for core mobile journeys, helping teams understand user behavior and identify opportunities for product improvement.
  • Monitor and improve platform-specific capabilities such as push notifications, deep links, and real-time features.
  • Analyze mobile advertising and in-app purchase revenue metrics and support initiatives designed to improve monetization performance.
  • Support compliance-related analytics and functionality, including consent management, age verification, and user verification.
  • Build and evolve production Flutter applications for both iOS and Android using maintainable, scalable architecture.
  • Contribute to multi-flavor and white-label application delivery, including brand-specific configurations, assets, store identifiers, and Firebase environments.
  • Develop automated tests across unit and widget levels and help maintain high standards of reliability and code quality.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, analytics, and other cross-functional stakeholders in a fully remote international environment.

    • Requirements

    • Strong professional experience with Flutter and Dart 3.x, including experience delivering and maintaining production applications for both iOS and Android.
    • Solid understanding of layered mobile architecture, including separation between UI, domain/use cases and repositories, and framework layers.
    • Hands-on experience with BLoC and Provider, as well as GetIt for dependency injection and GoRouter for navigation.
    • Experience working with Dio for networking and immutable data models using code generation tools such as built_value or similar technologies.
    • Experience building and shipping multi-flavor or white-label mobile applications, including per-brand configurations, assets, store IDs, and Firebase setups.
    • Practical experience writing automated tests, particularly unit and widget tests; familiarity with bloc_test or BDD-style testing is an advantage.
    • Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, performance, maintainability, and production development practices.
    • Analytical mindset with an interest in using product data and user behavior to improve mobile experiences and business outcomes.
    • Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a distributed team.
    • Fluent Russian and B2-level English communication skills.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote, full-time working opportunity.
      • Competitive compensation, with the initial salary level or range shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before employment begins.
      • 28 calendar days of vacation per year.
      • 7 wellness days annually for personal needs, recovery, or household matters without requiring sick leave.
      • Employee referral bonuses of up to $5,000 for successful recommendations.
      • 50% reimbursement for professional training, international conferences, and industry events.
      • Corporate discounts for English language lessons.
      • Health support of up to $1,000 gross per year per employee where corporate medical insurance is unavailable, which can be used toward private health insurance or eligible medical expenses for employees and close relatives.
      • Workplace support, including equipment and coworking resources; employees working outside company-supported locations can receive up to $1,000 gross every three years toward home-office or coworking expenses.
      • Internal gamified recognition program where colleagues can award bonuses redeemable for merchandise, team-building activities, massage certificates, and other rewards.

title: Lähihoitaja (keikkatyö), Onnikoti Silmu sekä työ- ja päivätoiminta Mylly, Voikkaa
description:
Lähihoitaja (keikkatyö), Onnikoti Silmu sekä työ- ja päivätoiminta Mylly, Voikkaa

Tule tekemään kehitysvammaisten ohjaustyötä Onnikoti Silmuun sekä työ- ja päivätoiminta Myllyyn, Voikkaan keskustan läheisyyteen!

Haemme nyt lähihoitajia keikkatyöhön.


Mihin tulet töihin?

Onnikoti Silmu sijaitsee Kuusankosken Voikkaalla. Kotimme tilat ovat ajanmukaiset ja suunniteltu vastaamaan asukkaidemme tarpeita. Tilat koostuvat kolmesta ryhmäkodista sisältäen asunnot yhteensä 18 asukkaalle. Tilojen suunnittelussa on huomioitu esteettömyys ja viihtyvyys. Oma keittiömme ja kokki luovat monipuolisia ja ravitsevia aterioita, jotka tukevat asukkaidemme aktiivista ja onnellista arkea.

Työ- ja päivätoiminta Mylly tuottaa päivätoimintaa 15 kehitysvammaiselle henkilölle sekä työtoimintaa viidelle kehitysvammaiselle henkilölle. Toiminnan tarkoituksena on ylläpitää ja kehittää asiakkaiden olemassa olevia taitoja sekä ohjata heitä kehittämään uusia valmiuksia päivittäisissä toiminnoissa, aikuisena olemisessa ja oman elämän hallinnassa. Toiminnassa huomioidaan asiakkaiden vahvuudet ja kiinnostuksen kohteet. Jokaiselle asiakkaalle luodaan omat henkilökohtaiset tavoitteet, joiden toteutumista seurataan päivittäin.

Toimintaa suunnitellaan yhdessä asiakkaan, läheisten ja tilaajan kanssa, hyödyntäen kaikkien tietoja ja tuntemusta asiakkaasta. Asiakkaiden erilaiset tuen tarpeet huomioidaan toiminnassa, kiinnitämme huomiota vuorovaikutuksen tukemiseen, ja meillä huomioidaan fyysiset ja psyykkiset tuen tarpeet.

Mitä pääset tekemään?

Onnikoti Silmussa pääset tekemään työtä, jossa läsnäolo, kohtaaminen ja pienetkin onnistumiset merkitsevät paljon. Tässä työssä pääset olemaan aidosti läsnä ja tukemaan asukkaiden arkea. Mahdollistamaan yksilöllistä, kuntouttavaa ja turvallista elämää.

Työ- ja päivätoiminta Myllyssä toiminnan sisällön suunnitteluun osallistuvat sekä asiakkaat että henkilökunta. Jokaiseen päivää kuuluu ulkoilua ja rentoutumisharjoituksia. Viikoittain päiviin kuuluu myös musiikki (mm. kuuntelu, laulu), liikunta (mm. lenkkeily, jumppa, venyttely, tanssi), kädentaidot (mm. käsityöt, askartelu, maalaus, piirtäminen), tietoisuus- ja ilmaisutaidot mm. tunnetaidot, kirjallisuus ja viestintä (kuuntelu, kirjoitus, some).

Toiminnassa hyödynnetään lähialueen ulkoilu- ja liikuntapaikkoja, alueellista kulttuuritarjontaa sekä muita lähialueen tapahtumia ja yhteistyöverkostoja. Toiminnan sisällön tarkoitus on vahvistaa asiakkaan osallisuutta omaan elämäänsä sekä tukea osallisuutta yhteiskuntaan. Arjen osallisuutta harjoitellaan asioimalla kaupassa ja harjoittelemalla ruuanlaittoa, siivousta ja muita kodinhoidollisia tehtäviä, huomioiden jokaisen toimintakyvyn ja tuen tarpeen määrän. Toimintaa järjestetään arkipäivisin asiakkaiden tarpeen mukaisesti klo 6.30-16.30 välillä.

Kuka sinä olet?

Olet koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja tai loppuvaiheen opiskelija. Tarvittavat lääkehoitokoulutukset tulee olla suoritettuna ja lääkeluvat tulee suorittaa heti työsuhteen alkaessa. Työkielenä meillä on suomi. Hoitotyön tehtävien hoitaminen edellyttää vähintään B1 tai vastaavaa suomen kielen kielitaitotasoa, sekä sitoutumista kielitaidon ylläpitämiseen.

Joukossamme viihtyy parhaiten positiivisesti asioihin suhtautuva ja oma-aloitteinen henkilö, joka on aidosti kiinnostunut ohjauksesta kehitysvammaisten parissa. Odotamme sinulta vammaistyön osaamista.

Miksi tulisit meille töihin?

Onnikoti Silmussa sekä työ- ja päivätoiminta Myllyssä pääset osaksi yhteen hiileen puhaltavaa työyhteisöä, jossa töitä tehdään hymy huulilla. Olemme positiivinen, yhteistyökykyinen ja hyvinvoiva yhteisö, jossa jokainen jäsen, niin työntekijä kuin asukas ja asiakas, tuntee tulevansa kuulluksi ja arvostetuksi. Kohtaamme asukkaamme ja asiakkaamme aina niin, että kaikille jää hyvä fiilis. Kunnioitamme ja luotamme toisiimme sekä arvostamme erilaisuutta.

Työ on kaksivuorotyötä, myös satunnaisia yövuoroja on, jos omaat lääkeluvat. Tehtävän palkkaus on yksityisen sosiaalialan TES:n mukainen. Työ on tarvittaessa töihin kutsuttavaa keikkatyötä.

Työ edellyttää tartuntatautilain mukaista rokotesuojaa, tuberkuloosiselvitystä ja salmonellatodistusta sekä voimassa olevaa Suosikki/Terhikki-rekisteröintiä, ammattikorttia ja hygieniapassia.

Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti tehtävään valittavien ikääntyvien tai vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevien on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote.

Hae tehtävää rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta 6.9.2026 mennessä. Toimithan nopeasti, sillä täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löytyessä. Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa:
Yksikönjohtaja Sanna Hildén
puh. 040 657 8477 (arkisin klo 9–14)
sanna.hilden@onnikodit.fi


Koti täynnä ainutlaatuista elämäniloa.

Panostamme yksilöllisyyteen sekä laatuun ja palvelumme lähtökohtana ovat aina asukkaan omat ainutlaatuiset ominaisuudet, vahvuudet, mielenkiinnon kohteet sekä tuen tarpeet.

Onnikodit on osa Mehiläistä. Mehiläisen sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluiden ammattilaiset työskentelevät joka päivä tinkimättömästi yksityis-, yritys- ja hyvinvointialueasiakkaidemme hyväksi.

Tervetuloa mukaan vahvistamaan ammattilaistemme joukkoa!

title: SSA Team Helgenæs - Barselsvikariat (Genopslag)
description:
Er du Social- og sundhedsassistent med hjertet på rette sted og lyst til at arbejde i et team, hvor faglighed og fællesskab går hånd i hånd? Så er det måske dig, vi leder efter!

Vi søger lige nu en SSA til til barselsvikariet. Hos os får du mulighed for at arbejde i smukke omgivelser ved Nakskov Fjord, hvor naturen og nærværet skaber rammerne for en meningsfuld hverdag.

Om os og stillingen

Vi ligger tæt på motortrakfikvejen, mellem Maribo og Nakskov, så der er gode muligheder for at komme til arbejdspladsen.

Stillingen er et barselsvikariet i perioden 1/10-26 eller så hurtigt som muligt - 1/4-27, da vores faste SSA er gået på barsel.

Vi søger en kollega, der brænder for helhedspleje og ønsker at være en del af et engageret og tværfagligt fællesskab, hvor borgeren altid er i centrum.
Om Team Helgenæs – hvor faglighed og fællesskab mødes.

Team Helgenæs er et velfungerende og dedikeret team, der arbejder ud fra principperne i den nye Ældrelov med fokus på færre medarbejdere i borgerens hjem og helhedsorienteret pleje. Vi tror på, at kontinuitet og relationer skaber tryghed og kvalitet – både for borgeren og medarbejderen.

Vores tværfaglige samarbejde med sygeplejersker, terapeuter og øvrige faggrupper er en hjørnesten i vores arbejde, og vi afholder jævnligt borgerkonferencer og tværfaglige møder, hvor vi sammen finder de bedste løsninger med borgerens behov i centrum.

Vi har en sygeplejefaglig koordinator ansat, til at understøtte SSH og SSA, samt bidrage til den faglige udvikling i teamet.

Hos os bliver du en del af et team, hvor der er plads til faglig udvikling, sparring og humor i hverdagen. Vi vægter det gode samarbejde højt og tror på, at et stærkt fællesskab er nøglen til trivsel og kvalitet i opgaveløsningen.Som social- og sundhedsassistent bliver du en vigtig nøgleperson i plejen og udviklingen af borgernes hverdag.

Du får bl.a. ansvar for
  • At sikre tryghed, kvalitet og sammenhæng i plejen
  • At sparre fagligt med dine kollegaer og bidrage til fælles udvikling
  • At håndtere medicindosering og administration
  • Injektioner
  • Sårpleje og andre sygeplejeopgaver
  • At samarbejde tæt med pårørende, kollegaer og andre faggrupper

Vi leder efter dig, der
  • Er uddannet social- og sundhedsassistent
  • Brænder for ældreområdet og har en anerkendende tilgang til både borgere og kollegaer
  • Har lyst til at tage ansvar og tænke med i udviklingen af vores tilbud
  • Er nysgerrig, fagligt stærk og har et godt overblik – også når hverdagen er travl
Du må gerne være nyuddannet. Vi sørger for en god og grundig introduktion.

Vi tilbyder
  • Et stærkt fællesskab med dygtige kollegaer, der hjælper hinanden
  • Høj faglighed og mulighed for løbende kompetenceudvikling
  • En arbejdsplads med åbenhed, humor og plads til forskellighed
  • Indflydelse på din hverdag og udviklingen af teamet
  • En meningsfuld hverdag, hvor du kan se, at din indsats gør en forskel

Ansøgningsproces

Ansøgningsfristen er søndag den 6. september 2026.

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår

Løn efter gældende overenskomst og efter principperne om lokal løndannelse.

Social- og sundhedsassistent startløn ved 37t (trin 24+520 grundbeløb) kr 29.425,90/slutløn ved 37t (trin 24+10trin + 520 grundbeløb) kr. 34.716,65
Pension 14%. Fritvalg 1,29%

Tiltrædelse pr. 1. Oktober 2026, eller efter aftale.

Spørgsmål?

Hvis du har spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte Teamleder Britt Koch Bentzen på brikb@lolland.dk eller tlf.: +45 24 77 59 52.

Vi ser frem til at modtage din ansøgning!

I Lolland Kommune arbejder omkring 3.500 medarbejdere hver dag for at skabe værdi for borgerne og udvikle kommunen. Medarbejderne er nøglen til udviklingen og til en arbejdsplads præget af dialog, åbenhed og nytænkning. Derfor investerer vi målrettet i kompetencer, nye arbejdsformer og stærke karrieremuligheder.

Med en placering tæt på Tyskland, Sjælland og Fyn er Lolland samtidig et attraktivt sted at bo. Her får du gode forbindelser til resten af landet, aktive lokalsamfund, idylliske købstæder og storslået natur. Her er plads til både arbejde og fritid – og til en hverdag, der hænger sammen.

Læs mere om at arbejde og bo i Lolland Kommune på Lolland Kommune som arbejdsplads

title: IAM Architect - Saviynt
description:
IDMWORKS is an award-winning identity and access management (IAM) solutions firm that has been serving a wide range of sectors since its inception in 2004. As a firm that’s purely focused on IAM, IDMWORKS offers a comprehensive range of services designed to enable enterprises to effectively manage, secure and scale employee and customer access to systems, data, and software applications. This specialized service empowers organizations across key industries, including banking and finance, commercial and retail, healthcare, higher education, and government, to ensure secure and efficient access management.

IDMWORKS has been a pioneer in remote-work for more than 20 years with teams operating across the US, Canada and India. This approach has helped establish themselves as a leader in the field of IAM with their commitment to securing businesses and facilitating seamless interactions between companies, their customers, partners, and employees. This dedication has driven transformative growth in the organizations they serve.

Ready to become an integral member of a tight-knit team of IAM pros with a relentless commitment to delivering amazing customer experiences that create an environment where long-term business partnerships flourish? We anticipate what our customers need, chart a course for their success, and walk alongside them every step of the way.

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced IAM (Identity and Access Management) Architect - Saviynt to join our team. As an IAM Architect, you will play a crucial role in designing, implementing, and maintaining our organization's IAM solutions. Your primary responsibility will be to ensure the security and integrity of our digital assets by designing and implementing robust access control mechanisms and identity management frameworks.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement IAM solutions tailored to meet the specific needs and requirements of our organization.
  • Develop and maintain IAM policies, procedures, and standards to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including security, IT operations, and application development, to integrate IAM solutions into existing systems and workflows.
  • Conduct risk assessments and security audits to identify vulnerabilities and recommend remediation strategies.
  • Stay current with emerging technologies and trends in IAM and cybersecurity to continually enhance our organization's security posture.
  • Provide guidance and support to stakeholders on IAM-related matters, including access control, authentication, authorization, and identity governance.
  • Participate in the evaluation and selection of IAM tools and technologies, considering factors such as scalability, interoperability, and cost-effectiveness.
  • Lead IAM implementation projects from conception to completion, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with business objectives.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert on IAM-related topics, representing the organization in industry forums, conferences, and working groups.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • Proven experience (5+ years) designing and implementing IAM solutions in large, complex environments.
  • Experience within the past 5 years leading a Saviynt Implementation.
  • Strong understanding of IAM concepts, including identity lifecycle management, role-based access control, single sign-on, and multi-factor authentication.
  • Hands-on experience with IAM technologies such as Active Directory, LDAP, SAML, OAuth, and PKI.
  • Experience with IAM platforms and tools, such as Saviynt, Microsoft Identity Manager, Okta, Ping Identity, ForgeRock, or similar.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to assess complex security challenges and propose effective solutions.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, or CIAM preferred.
IDMWORKS is a forward-thinking company dedicated to providing top-tier identity and access management solutions. Their comprehensive offerings, coupled with their unmatched industry expertise and proven outcomes make them a valuable partner for enterprises needing to enhance their IAM program.

IDMWORKS provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, IDMWORKS will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at care@idmworks.com
