title: Verzorgende IG of Helpende Plus, Nachtdienst
description:
Veghel 16-28 uur €2.504 - €3.560 per maand Ouderenpsychiatrie Op locatie

Niet iedereen slaapt ’s nachts rustig door.

Sommige cliënten hebben een geruststellend woord nodig. Een helpende hand. Of iemand die even kijkt hoe het gaat.

Werk jij juist graag in de nacht? Bij Joseph Staete in Veghel ondersteun je samen met een ervaren nachtverpleegkundige ouderen met psychiatrische, somatische en cognitieve problematiek. Je werkt alleen nachtdiensten en staat er nooit alleen voor.

Dit maakt werken in de Nachtzorg bij GGZ Oost Brabant bijzonder

  • Je werkt uitsluitend in de nacht: geen wisselende dag-, avond- en nachtdiensten

  • Je werkt samen met een ervaren nachtverpleegkundige

  • Je combineert psychiatrie, somatiek en ouderenzorg

  • Je werkt in een warm en betrokken team

  • Je krijgt ruimte om echt aandacht te hebben voor bewoners

Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Direct een dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de € 2.735,- en € 3.560,- o.b.v. 36 uur (cao GGZ, FWG 35)

  • Tegemoetkoming in de reiskosten woon-werkverkeer.

  • ORT voor nacht- en weekenddiensten

  • Een volledige 13e maand (8,33% van je bruto jaarsalaris) en jaarlijks €1000 balansbudget om in te zetten voor opleiden, extra verlof of extra salaris.

  • Veel ruimte voor scholing en ontwikkeling

  • Een goede pensioenregeling via PFZW (Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn), FiscFree, TicketsforGood en meer! Lees hier meer over onze aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden

Nieuwsgierig wat we nog meer te bieden hebben? Kom dan bij ons op gesprek!

Dit is jouw werk

Tijdens de nacht zorgen jij en de nachtverpleegkundige samen voor rust, veiligheid en goede ondersteuning van onze cliënten.

Je bent niet eindverantwoordelijk voor de verpleegkundige zorg, maar hebt wel een belangrijke rol in het welzijn van bewoners. Je:

  • Ondersteunt cliënten bij nachtelijke zorgvragen

  • Helpt bij ADL-zorg waar nodig

  • Signaleert veranderingen in gedrag, stemming of gezondheid

  • Houdt toezicht op de afdelingen en appartementen

  • Ondersteunt de nachtverpleegkundige bij voorkomende werkzaamheden

  • Zorgt voor rust, veiligheid en structuur tijdens de nacht

Geen nacht is hetzelfde. Juist de combinatie van psychiatrie, somatiek en ouderenzorg maakt het werk afwisselend en inhoudelijk interessant.

“Je staat er nooit alleen voor. Ook 's nachts doen we het samen.”

Samen sterk, maak kennis met je werkplek en het team

Joseph Staete is een appartementencomplex in Veghel waar 54 ouderen wonen met complexe psychiatrische, somatische en cognitieve problematiek. Samen met ongeveer 50 collega’s bieden we zorg die aansluit bij wat iedere cliënt nodig heeft.

De sfeer? Warm, betrokken en collegiaal. We helpen elkaar wanneer dat nodig is en vinden samenwerken minstens zo belangrijk als goede zorg.

Op weg naar een mentaal sterke samenleving. Lees hier meer over de missie, visie en koers van GGZ Oost Brabant.

Praktisch & goed om te weten

  • Je werkt 16 tot maximaal 28 uur per week

  • Minder uren zijn bespreekbaar

  • Je werkt uitsluitend nachtdiensten van 22.45 tot 07.15 uur

  • Je werkt altijd samen. Er is altijd een verpleegkundige aanwezig in de nacht

  • Het team bestaat uit meerdere collega’s die samen de nachtdiensten verzorgen

Twijfel je of werken in de nacht bij je past? Kom gerust een keer kennismaken of meelopen bij Joseph Staete.

Dit breng je mee

Je hebt een zorgdiploma dat past bij deze functie, bijvoorbeeld:

  • Helpende Plus

  • Verzorgende IG

  • Maatschappelijke Zorg niveau 3, specifieke doelgroepen

  • of een vergelijkbare zorgopleiding

Daarnaast

  • Affiniteit met ouderen en psychiatrie

  • Blijf je rustig wanneer situaties onverwacht veranderen

  • Ben je oplettend en signaleer je bijzonderheden

  • Ben je vriendelijk, geduldig en benaderbaar

Heb je een andere zorgopleiding en twijfel je of die aansluit? Neem gerust contact met ons op. We kijken graag samen naar de mogelijkheden.

Klaar om kennis te maken?

Zolang de vacature online staat, kun je reageren. We gaan doorlopend in gesprek met geschikte kandidaten.

Wil je eerst meer weten? Neem voor meer informatie of een oriënterend gesprek contact met ons op.

Bianca Schouten Recruitment Adviseur b.schouten@ggzoostbrabant.nl 088-8461820 Stuur een Whatsapp bericht

Vragen over de functie? Sabine Cools Teamleider 06-10148179 Bel gerust als je meer wilt weten

GGZ Oost Brabant. Want het is zo gek nog niet om het samen te doen.

title: Kotisiivooja - Turku
description:
Hei sinä aktiivinen ja elämäniloinen työnhakija!

Oletko kiinnostunut tekemään merkityksellistä työtä ikäihmisten parissa? Liity iloiseen tiimiimme ja hae meille töihin.

Haemme nyt tiimiimme Kotisiivoojia palvelemaan asiakkaitamme Turun alueella. Tehtävänäsi on toimia ikäihmisen tai vammaisen siivoojana ja huolehtia kodinhoitajana hänen kotinsa siisteydestä luotettavasti ja vastuullisesti.

Kotisiivoojan työ sopii monenlaisissa elämäntilanteissa oleville, sillä voit itse vaikuttaa siihen, mitä työvuoroja otat vastaan. Voit olla eläkeläinen, opiskelija, alan ammattilainen tai jotain siltä väliltä. Saat meiltä kattavan perehdytyksen sekä koulutuksen tehtävään ja esihenkilösi on aina tavoitettavissa.

Työ on osa-aikaista ja asiakkailla käydään toistuvina aikoina arkipäivisin.

Tarjoamme:

  • Kiireettömän, vastuullisen ja merkityksellisen työn

  • Lämminhenkisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön

  • Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa työvuoroihin

  • Hyvän perehdytyksen

  • Kilpailukykyinen palkka 14 €/h.

Odotamme sinulta:

  • Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa

  • Hyviä sosiaalisia taitoja

  • Positiivista asennetta

  • Perushyvää fyysistä kuntoa

Eduksi katsomme siivousalan koulutuksen ja työkokemuksen.

Edellytämme lisäksi työnhakijalta pitkäaikaista sitoutumista tehtävään, sillä meillä käy asiakkaan luona aina sama työntekijä, jolloin myös itse työ on tuttua ja turvallista niin asiakkaalle kuin työntekijällekin. Samalla turvaamme palvelun laadun ja jatkuvuuden.

Tarkistamme valittujen rikosrekisteriotteet Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvontalain mukaisesti.

Palkkaus määräytyy tehtävän vaativuuden mukaan ja on 14 €/h, jonka lisäksi maksetaan yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan työehtosopimuksen mukaiset lisät. Olemme vastuullinen työnantaja ja meillä kaikki työntekijät ovat työsuhteessa. Kerrytät työssäsi normaalisti eläkettä ja olet luonnollisesti oikeutettu myös lomakorvauksiin.

Lisätietoa tehtävästä antaa maanantaisin ja torstaisin 9-14 välillä HR-koordinaattori Eetu Saapunki, 050 4784077 sekä sähköpostitse eetu@suomenseniorihoiva.fi.

Mikäli välität aidosti ikäihmisistä ja haluat liittyä iloiseen tiimiimme, hae rohkeasti paikkaa viimeistään 4.9.2026 mennessä urasivujemme kautta osoitteessa . Toimi nopeasti, sillä paikkoja täytetään jo hakuaikana.

Suomen Seniorihoiva Oy on täysin kotimainen hoiva-alan kasvuyritys, jonka tehtävänä on rikastaa senioreiden elämää. Yritys on perustettu vuonna 2013 ja se toimii kaikkialla Suomessa työllistäen noin 700 hoiva-alan ammattilaisia. Yritys tuottaa luotettavia ja korkealuokkaisia avustus-, seuranpito- ja hoivapalveluita 24 tuntia vuorokaudessa vuoden jokaisena päivänä. Yritys on merkittävä kotimainen sote-palveluiden tuottaja.

title: Sr. Data Engineer
description:
Job Description Summary

At The Coca ‑ Cola Company, we believe data is the foundation for creating personalized experiences and powering sustainable growth in today's digital-first world. As consumers engage with our brands in more connected ways than ever before, we are investing in advanced data and analytics platforms to unlock deeper insights, accelerate decision-making, and enable seamless innovation at scale.

In this role as a Sr. Data Engineer , you will play a critical part in shaping how data flows across our enterprise ecosystem. By leveraging your deep expertise in Spark, Scala development, and JVM-based engineering, you will design and implement integration frameworks that power both batch and streaming workloads on Microsoft Fabric and Synapse Analytics.

Core Responsibilities

  • Design and develop data integration pipelines and backend services for structured and unstructured data, using Apache Spark with Scala.
  • Build and optimize distributed computing applications that deliver scalable batch and streaming workloads within Microsoft Fabric environments.
  • Performance tuning, including partitioning strategies, memory configuration, query optimization, and workload balancing across large datasets.
  • Become the arena for technical innovation, performance analysis, and Vendor oversight.
  • Contribute to strong candidate selection criteria and collaborate with peer team to ensure a robust recruitment framework.
  • Assist in formulating localized talent acquisition strategies to attract and retain top-tier talent.
  • Partner with recruiters and hiring managers to ensure a positive candidate experience by providing timely feedback and updates.
  • Coordinate all recruitment activities within assigned regions to ensure projected T&L targets are met.
  • Encourage hard‑wired recruitment automation solutions to streamline the engagement process and provide timely talent acquisition insights.
  • Adhere to business implementation guidelines and contribute to technology development ecosystem.

Engineering Rigor

Champion the "You Build It, You Run It" philosophy. Apply strict functional programming and SOLID principles to write clean, modular, and testable Scala code.

Performance Optimization

Conduct deep Spark performance tuning - managing memory, query plans, partitioning strategies, and capacity optimization to deliver highly efficient batch and streaming workloads within Microsoft Fabric.

CI/CD & Automation

Architect and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Maven, and SBT to automate testing, deployment, and configuration of data artifacts.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Strong proficiency in Scala programming with demonstrated knowledge of functional programming concepts, concurrency models, and modular system design.
  • Spark Expertise ( 3 + years): Deep, hands‑on experience building, debugging and optimizing distributed computing applications using Apache Spark (Scala/Java preferred).
  • Experience designing data models (STAR, Vault, Tabular) for analytics.
  • Experience building REST based microservices on JVM.
  • Synapse/Fabric Experience (3+ years of combined experience); Designing and transforming large data using Azure Data Services (Synapse, ADF, Azure Functions, ARM Templates).
  • DevOps & CI/CD: Proven ability to build automated release cycles. Hands‑on expertise with Git, GitHub Actions, and build tools (Maven/SBT, UV are required ).
  • Demonstrated experience working with big data ecosystems such as Hadoop, Delta Lake, or similar technologies within cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
  • Delivery: Experience in Agile development (Scrum, lean techniques) and collaborating with global engineering teams.

Skills

Travel Required: 00% - 25%

Relocation Provided: No

We focus on four key behaviors - curious, empowered, inclusive and agile - and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. title: Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter) based in Ireland.

This is an opportunity to join an established digital product and contribute to a mobile experience used by a global community.
You’ll work on core product journeys including registration, discovery, profiles, messaging, engagement, and monetization.
The role combines hands-on Flutter development with a strong focus on analytics, performance, and measurable product outcomes.
You’ll help evolve a production mobile application across both iOS and Android while supporting multiple brands and configurations.
The environment is remote-first and internationally distributed, with experienced professionals collaborating across cultures and time zones.
You’ll work with modern Flutter architecture and tooling while contributing to a product where mobile quality and user engagement directly matter.
This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership, technical depth, and building scalable mobile experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and maintain core mobile product experiences across authentication and registration, search and discovery, profiles, photos, messaging, matching, and user engagement.
  • Analyze and improve key product funnels, including registration, upgrades, monetization, messaging engagement, and match or interest conversion.
  • Own and contribute to analytics for core mobile journeys, helping teams understand user behavior and identify opportunities for product improvement.
  • Monitor and improve platform-specific capabilities such as push notifications, deep links, and real-time features.
  • Analyze mobile advertising and in-app purchase revenue metrics and support initiatives designed to improve monetization performance.
  • Support compliance-related analytics and functionality, including consent management, age verification, and user verification.
  • Build and evolve production Flutter applications for both iOS and Android using maintainable, scalable architecture.
  • Contribute to multi-flavor and white-label application delivery, including brand-specific configurations, assets, store identifiers, and Firebase environments.
  • Develop automated tests across unit and widget levels and help maintain high standards of reliability and code quality.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, analytics, and other cross-functional stakeholders in a fully remote international environment.

    • Requirements

    • Strong professional experience with Flutter and Dart 3.x, including experience delivering and maintaining production applications for both iOS and Android.
    • Solid understanding of layered mobile architecture, including separation between UI, domain/use cases and repositories, and framework layers.
    • Hands-on experience with BLoC and Provider, as well as GetIt for dependency injection and GoRouter for navigation.
    • Experience working with Dio for networking and immutable data models using code generation tools such as built_value or similar technologies.
    • Experience building and shipping multi-flavor or white-label mobile applications, including per-brand configurations, assets, store IDs, and Firebase setups.
    • Practical experience writing automated tests, particularly unit and widget tests; familiarity with bloc_test or BDD-style testing is an advantage.
    • Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, performance, maintainability, and production development practices.
    • Analytical mindset with an interest in using product data and user behavior to improve mobile experiences and business outcomes.
    • Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a distributed team.
    • Fluent Russian and B2-level English communication skills.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote, full-time working opportunity.
      • Competitive compensation, with the initial salary level or range shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before employment begins.
      • 28 calendar days of vacation per year.

Why Vanguard?

Vanguard is a different kind of investment company. It was founded in the United States in 1975 on a simple but revolutionary idea: that an investment company should manage its funds solely in the interests of its clients.

This is a philosophy that has helped millions of people around the world to achieve their goals with low-cost, uncomplicated investments.

It's what we stand for: value to investors.

Inclusion Statement

Vanguard’s continued commitment to diversity and inclusion is firmly rooted in our culture. Every decision we make to best serve our clients, crew (internally employees are referred to as crew), and communities is guided by one simple statement: “Do the right thing.”

We believe that a critical aspect of doing the right thing requires building diverse, inclusive, and highly effective teams of individuals who are as unique as the clients they serve. We empower our crew to contribute their distinct strengths to achieving Vanguard’s core purpose through our values.

When all crew members feel valued and included, our ability to collaborate and innovate is amplified, and we are united in delivering on Vanguard's core purpose: to take a stand for all investors, to treat them fairly, and to give them the best chance for investment success.

How We Work

Vanguard has implemented a hybrid working model for the majority of our crew members, designed to capture the benefits of enhanced flexibility while enabling in-person learning, collaboration, and connection. We believe our mission-driven and highly collaborative culture is a critical enabler to support long-term client outcomes and enrich the employee experience.

description:

We are serial entrepreneurs, for example Paul Müller (founder Adjust, €1.2B exit) and Petter Made (founder SumUp, €8B) who are eager to support outlier personalities and serial entrepreneurs to build €1B+ companies.

Our offer:

  • A salary while you build your startup as you will directly be employed by us. Alternatively, you can opt for up to €500k in funding.
  • 1:1 sparring with unicorn founders on a weekly basis
  • Community: Access to the top 0.1% of founders, peers and investors
  • Team building: Hiring top notch talent supported through our network (over 50,000 professionals)
  • Distribution: Support in reaching product-market-fit and building up a sales force / marketing machine
  • Funding support for securing a multi-million euro funding round within 12 months (on average, EWOR Fellows raise > €2M after our Grand Pitch)

One of our fellows set a record for Europe’s largest pre-seed round by a first-time founder, securing a €12M pre-seed investment.

Tasks

  • You will own, build, and run your startup in fields such as Mobility
  • You will embark on an extensive personal development journey crafted by unicorn founders and follow a fully customised programme enhancing your goal, time, and energy management
  • You will receive support in hiring through our network to over 50,000 professionals and advice as well as best practices from serial entrepreneurs
  • You will receive intensive coaching to make your startup ready to raise millions in funding
  • You will iterate your product with us until having reached product-market-fit and receive support in building up a sales force or creating a marketing engine respectively

Requirements

  • You are based in Europe or the Americas or open to relocate
  • You are willing to take full responsibility for your own startup and scale it to €100M+ in revenues
  • You have excellent communication skills in the English language

Join us and build a €1B+ company with us!

title: Pricing Coordinator
description:
Help turn pricing strategy into accurate, controlled action. As Pricing Operations Coordinator, you’ll play a key role in ensuring approved pricing decisions are implemented efficiently, consistently and correctly across our systems. You’ll work closely with Pricing Strategy and Optimisation analysts and commercial stakeholders, helping protect data integrity while improving the way pricing activity is delivered.

Your mission

Your mission is to ensure approved pricing changes are executed accurately, on time and in line with agreed controls. You’ll own the implementation of pricing requests, enabling our analysts to focus on strategy while you help maintain strong and reliable data.

What you'll be doing

  • Execute approved pricing changes across relevant systems

  • Complete bulk uploads and other recurring pricing activities using standard procedures and approved templates

  • Validate pricing requests before execution, ensuring instructions are complete, accurate and compliant

  • Maintain a clear and auditable record of requests, approvals, execution and validation

  • Carry out post-implementation quality checks to confirm changes have been applied correctly

  • Monitor work queues and prioritise requests

  • Identify failed uploads, anomalies, SLA breaches and recurring issues through exception reporting

  • Support new pricing capabilities, system changes, automation and process improvements

  • Work with Pricing Strategy and Optimisation analysts to simplify, standardise, batch or automate recurring activities

Who we’re looking for

You’ll thrive in this role if you enjoy structured, detail-focused work, take pride in getting things right first time and are comfortable managing high-volume activity without compromising quality.

We’re looking for someone who brings:

  • Strong attention to detail and a clear commitment to accuracy, quality and data integrity

  • Confidence working with repetitive or high-volume tasks while maintaining consistent standards

  • Experience following structured processes, standard operating procedures, approval controls and service level expectations

  • Strong Excel skills, including working with structured data, templates and bulk-upload files

  • The ability to identify exceptions, investigate issues and escalate clearly without making unsupported assumptions

  • Good organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage deadlines and competing requests

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills

  • A proactive, collaborative approach and a continuous-improvement mindset

How you'll make an impact

  • Deliver pricing requests accurately and within agreed turnaround times

  • Maintain strong first-time-right performance and quality assurance standards

  • Keep work-in-progress and backlogs within agreed thresholds

  • Identify and resolve pricing exceptions quickly and effectively

  • Produce clear management information on throughput, accuracy, productivity and SLA performance

  • Improve operational controls, consistency and scalability

  • Help reduce manual effort by identifying opportunities for standardisation and automation

  • Build trusted working relationships across Pricing Strategy and Optimisation, Commercial, Technology and Data teams

About Awaze
Our mission is clear - to create amazing holidays with Europe’s widest choice of holiday homes.

With more than 110,000 properties across Europe, we are the largest managed vacation rentals business in the region. Our ambition is not only to be the biggest, but the best provider of holiday homes in Europe.

As travel continues to evolve, we are focused on what comes next. We will keep strengthening our relationships with guests and homeowners, continuously improving the way we work, and delivering strong performance. By making things simpler and smarter, we are building a business that is ready for what’s next - powered by proud, passionate and inclusive people.



Worth knowing

This is a full-time position (35 hours per week) offered on a 6-month fixed-term contract, with the possibility of an extension. This role is intended to be based in Lowestoft, however we are open to applications from candidates in Manchester.

What’s next?

If this sounds like the right next step for you, hit “Apply” and follow the instructions to submit your application. We tailor our recruitment process to each role to give both you and our hiring teams the best possible chance to assess whether this could be the start of a successful collaboration. You’ll hear from us shortly after we’ve reviewed your application.

We’re committed to running an inclusive and accessible recruitment process. All applicants will receive equal consideration for employment, and if you have any specific requirements or adjustments needed for the interview, just let us know when you accept your invitation - we’re happy to accommodate.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
About the Team

The engineering organization is a dynamic group of builders, problem-solvers, and infrastructure innovators dedicated to delivering scalable, secure, and AI-powered platforms that elevate how organizations work. We value resilient architecture, automation-first thinking, and a culture of continuous improvement. Every engineer here plays a key role in shaping the reliability, security, and operational excellence of our products.

What you get to do in this role:

  • Design, develop, and maintain infrastructure, including architecting and implementing robust infrastructure to support CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) products, ensuring dependability and scalability throughout the lifecycle.
  • Develop and test software applications, including writing, testing, and refining software in Python, adhering to company requirements and best practices for maintainable and efficient code.
  • Build, deploy, and manage applications using container technologies such as Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes, optimizing for automation and scalability.
  • Manage and evolve infrastructure across Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Azure, and AWS, utilizing native services for high availability, resilience, security, and multicloud interoperability.
  • Apply core concepts such as software development lifecycles, automation, and scalable architecture in every stage of product delivery.
  • Develop secure architecture, conduct code reviews for security vulnerabilities, and institute thorough software verification and testing procedures.
  • Oversee deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of the CPQ suite of microservices, including several AI-driven components, ensuring reliable operations across environments.
  • Collaborate with AI/ML teams to deploy and support intelligent microservices, gaining hands-on experience with data science implementations and real-world applications.
  • Perform routine and advanced tasks on PostgreSQL databases, such as designing schemas, optimizing queries, and ensuring data consistency and processing efficiency.
  • Provide expert application support for SaaS CPQ solutions by troubleshooting technical issues and ensuring smooth operation.
  • Contribute to the design and implementation of new products and features while also enhancing the existing product suite
  • Be a mentor for colleagues and help promote knowledge-sharing

To be successful in this role you have:

  • Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.
  • Experience in using AI Productivity tools such as Windsurf, Cursor, etc. Is a plus or nice to have.
  • Experience leveraging AI/ML in engineering and quality processes (e.g., automated testing, AI-driven insights, intelligent monitoring).
  • 5+years of experience in DevOps engineering, with a track record of delivering high-quality products.
  • Experience with GCP, Azure, or AWS and Hyperscalers.
  • Proficiency in Python.
  • Experience with software development lifecycle (SDLC) and automation — implementing automation, testing strategies, and CI/CD practices across delivery stages using GitHub for version control and GitHub Actions for automated build, test, and deployment workflows.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL database management.
  • Experience with AI/ML microservice integration.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with regulated markets on Azure is a plus.

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

title: SASA-IND-Supply Planner
description:
You will work in a small, 3-member micro-team with a Business Developer, who negotiates prices and take care of the overall commercial relation with the supplier, and a Production Engineer who takes care about production process and quality. As part of the annual action plan that your team will comprise, you will be responsible for improving the logistics process in order to ethically reduce logistics costs in the overall IKEA supply chain. You will also perform:

  • Secure operational capacities by ensuring high quality of capacity data from suppliers and by working continuously towards exceptions together with Need Planner and Supplier in a proactive manner.
  • Contribute to tactical capacity planning based on supplier performance on agreed capacity
  • Update and secure correct business set-up information in all relevant systems. Furthermore work with systems and reports, to proactively detect and act on possible deviations from goal.
  • Prepare suppliers for best replenishment and delivery solutions by continuously maintaining & developing supplier delivery performance and sender lead-times.
  • Contribute to identifying best logistical offer, furthermore implement, maintain and review by having customer and total cost in mind.
  • Actively contribute in the planning and execution of the best set-up for range changes at supplier, constraints periods and activities.
  • Continuously follow-up, analyse and take action to improve supplier delivery performance and ensure goods are shipped in time from suppliers.
  • Secure correct availability information from supplier to IKEA Retail in such quality that it can be for the benefit of customers.
  • Develop and maintain suppliers’ logistic competence towards becoming responsible on their own performance through: working closely with suppliers, running Supplier Development Projects and providing them relevant trainings & working methods.
  • For various reporting purposes secure a consistent foundation, gather, process and compile data linking to Logistics, Engineering and Supplier Development to enabling decision making, preparing/visualization the different source of data, showing the history, trends, benchmarking, connection between different data.
  • Working with multiple Business Teams, collecting, organizing, interpreting, and analyzing data related to purchasing activities. Contribute with experience and analytical expertise with the objective to extract meaningful and actionable insights from available data to support, fact-based decision-making.

We are looking for the people with knowledge of supplier capabilities, material, production flow, capacity planning. You have the ability to take the leadership to ensure supplier has goods ready in time and in full in order to fulfil customers’ need at lowest possible landed cost. You are able to translate the Category Plan into logistics solutions and always keep Total IKEA and Total Cost Development in mind.

To be successful in this role, below competences are important for you.

  • Degree with Supply Chain/Logistics certifications preferred
  • Relevant work experience of 8 to 12 years preferred
  • Exposure to multiple industry domains, including textiles, automotive, plastics, metals, and similar sectors, is preferred.
  • Knowledge of supply chain logistics including different restocking as well as a good understanding of capacity planning,
  • Good leadership skill to lead and develop suppliers in planning and logistic topics
  • Analytical skills and excellent knowledge and usage of needed tools/applications such as, Advanced Excel, Power BI etc.
  • Advanced knowledge of statistics, analysis methodologies, reporting and data visualization tools
  • Strong communication skills and team work
  • Ability to manage time well, to balance between the factory floor and office work.
  • Strong business sense and cost conscious

We welcome your application

Get ready to assemble something new! We look forward to receiving your application soon by 4-September-2026.

This position will be based in Bangalore, India. Traveling is a part of the assignment since our Supply Planners work closely with our suppliers. Please note that we will be interviewing continuously, which means that we may close the application process earlier than stated if we find the right candidate. So, don’t delay, please send us your application today.

This is a permanent position located in Bengaluru, India. If you have questions about the position, please write to Recruitment India.

The successful candidate will be required to complete a pre-employment screening as a condition of employment for this role.

We are an equal opportunity employer:
At IKEA, we value diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We are committed to providing coworkers with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. We encourage individualism and invite you to come join our team and be yourself with us! We are an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability status, or any other applicable characteristic protected by law. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need.

If you have a special need that requires accommodation in the recruitment process, just let us know.

title: Environmental and Social Consultant/Managing Consultant for Sustainable Finance
description:
Environmental and Social Consultant/Managing Consultant for Sustainable Finance

France Offices – Paris, Bordeaux, Aix-en-Provence, Lyon, (with flexible/remote working option)

We invite you to bring your consultancy and management skills into play as you contribute to innovative and high quality environmental, social and sustainability solutions across a range of international development projects in the infrastructure, energy and renewables sectors. To succeed in this role, you must have demonstrable experience in successfully supporting environmental and social input to complex international development projects, and to a have a good knowledge of international lender E&S standards, including the IFC Performance Standards, the Equator Principles and the OECD Common Approaches.

Specialist knowledge and expertise in expert disciplines - social topics and biodiversity in particular.

Inviting bright minds

Do you want to push the boundaries of your profession and develop your excellence in an open, collaborative and empowering culture? Are you a curious and open-minded person?

We work to create a sustainable future and our inspiring projects and innovative solutions aim to set the standard among our peers. You will join a global company that has been growing successfully since its founding in 1945. Together, we lead and leave a positive impact on societies, companies and people around the world.

If this sounds like you, or you’re curious to learn more, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our Global Impact Assessment and Biodiversity & Ecosystems Global Service Line and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

As our new Consultant or Managing Consultant, you will be part of our world-renown Sustainable Finance team, which sits within our Global Impact Assessment and Biodiversity & Ecosystems Service Line. Based in France, you would be working closely with around 100 dedicated practitioners across our global office network in Europe, Asia-Pacific and the Americas. Working for both borrowers/sponsors and lenders, the Sustainable Finance team’s core services are to support the bankability of multiple international development projects. We offer the opportunity to work on important and prestigious projects across a range of geographies and sectors.

Your key tasks and responsibilities will be:

  • Technical E&S input and delivery, including report writing and internal reviews, on a range of Independent Environmental & Social Consultant (IESC) projects for environmental and social due diligence (ESDD), impact assessment (ESIA) and strategic advisory support to clients.
  • Project managing small to large-scale IESC ESDD projects or ESIA projects.
  • Support/lead on world-wide site compliance audits and monitoring visits as part of IESC ESDD delivery.
  • Support/lead on proposal management and writing.
  • Support the implementation of the Sustainable Finance business development plan.

Your key deliverables within the first 12 months will be to:

  • Successfully support/lead a number of E&S due diligence assessments on behalf of lenders.
  • Successfully support/lead a number of E&S impact assessments on behalf of borrowers/sponsors to meeting international standards.
  • Support/lead development of a number of proposals.
  • Provide active support to the Business Development plan and the development of existing and new clients.

Your starting point for constant growth

From the moment you join Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you grow with the company. For this role, we believe your starting point is:

  • Strong project management skills including project financial management.
  • Technical expertise in environmental, social and/or biodiversity aspects of the international standards.
  • A Bachelor/Master degree in a relevant environmental, biodiversity and/or social discipline.
  • Good organisational and communication skills.
  • Good presentation and technical report writing skills in both French and English.
  • Ability to work independently, as necessary and collaboratively with a range of environmental, social and engineering technical specialists.
  • Practical experience of the implementation of international lender E&S standards, including the IFC Performance Standards, the Equator Principles and the OECD Common Approaches (between 2 – 15 years’ experience)
  • Experience in E&S consultancy
  • Must be fluent in English and French
  • Flexibility to undertake short duration international field visits is essential.
  • Driver’s licence is desirable.
  • Existing residency and eligibility to work in France (i.e., must have an existing work visa if not an EU citizen).

Personal qualities that will help you succeed in this role include:

  • Clear and confident communicator
  • Self-motivated and proactive
  • Team player and collaborative
  • Creative problem solver who is ‘solution focused'

Welcome to our Environment & Health division

Ramboll develops innovative, scientifically sound solutions that help increase liveability by reducing pollution and restoring natural environments. One of the world’s leading environmental and health consultancies, our bright minds are trusted by clients to manage their most challenging environmental, health and social issues.

Ramboll

You can find out more about Ramboll on our website:

Our 700 Impact Assessment specialists and our 100 Sustainable Finance specialists work in seamless global teams on projects around the world creating sustainable solutions for clients and society. The Impact Assessment and Biodiversity & Ecosystems Global Service Line is also presented on our website here: Impact assessment - Ramboll

What we can offer you

Ramboll offers the opportunity to be part of a dynamic global organisation and the long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company.

We also offer:

  • Flexible work environment
  • Training and career growth opportunities
  • ~35-37 days annual leave (25 CP + ~10-12 RTT), plus bank holidays
  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience
  • Matched pension contributions
  • Private medical cover and life assurance
  • Executive Status (“Cadre”)
  • Meal voucher (Up card)

Ready to join us?

Please submit a cover letter with your up-to-date CV in English. We invite diversity in all its forms and encourage applicants from all groups to apply.

We recognise that some candidates only apply when they tick every box. However, passion and potential often outweigh a perfect resume and Ramboll’s supportive learning culture can help you grow. So, if this role resonates with you but you don't meet all the requirements, we encourage you to apply. You might be the perfect fit for this opportunity or another within our team.

Deadline: 30.09.2025

Thank you for taking the time to apply! We look forward to receiving your application.

Work at the heart of sustainable change with Ramboll

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. As a foundation-owned people company, founded in Denmark, we believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. Our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act and being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. Ramboll employs more than 18,000 people globally across 35 countries. Ramboll experts deliver innovative solutions across Buildings, Transport, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, Management Consulting, and Architecture & Landscape.

Equality, Diversity, and Inclusion

Equality, diversity, and inclusion are at the heart of what we do. At Ramboll, we believe that diversity is a strength and that different experiences and perspectives are essential to creating truly sustainable societies. We are committed to providing an inclusive and supportive work environment where everyone is able to flourish and reach their potential. We also know how important it is to achieve the right balance of where, when, and how much you work. At Ramboll, we offer flexibility as part of our positive and inclusive approach to work. We invite applications from candidates of all backgrounds and characteristics. Please let us know if there are any changes we could make to the application process to make it more comfortable for you. You can contact us at job.advert.accessibility@ramboll.com with such requests.

title: Director, Drug Development Project Management & Pipeline Strategy
description:
Position Summary:

This role will partner closely with Quotient’s drug development project leaders and matrix teams to translate their scientific strategy into robust, integrated drug development project plans, and drive flawless execution of Quotient’s early drug pipeline. This role is accountable for planning, execution, and coordination across functional teams (e.g., drug discovery, translational medicine, biology, drug development strategy, and finance) as well as external CROs and collaborators. The successful candidate will coordinate and run drug development matrix project meetings, maintain governance-ready dashboards and decision logs, oversee budgets, contracts, and resource needs, and readiness for key drug development review milestones. By leveraging subject matter experts across key Research and Development functions to develop end-to-end drug development plans and execution strategies, this role will provide operational and planning leadership to drug development matrix teams, manage risks and interdependencies, consider regulatory and compliance requirements, and support reviews for Quotient’s Executive team and Board of Directors.

This role will also support the development of Quotient’s drug discovery pipeline strategy with scenario-based analyses based on landscape and competitive intelligence data. Given the close integration of Quotient’s proprietary genetics platform into the drug discovery process, this role will interface with research operations and strategy to build a seamless, end-to-end view of Quotient’s R&D pipeline.

This role will report to the Chief Development Officer (CDO). The role could be based at Quotient’s UK or US site.

Responsibilities:

  • With drug development matrix teams, support the translation of overarching drug development strategy and vision into integrated, detailed project plans (scope, milestones, critical paths, dependencies, risks) across functions.
  • Monitor progress versus plan; proactively identify issues and interdependencies, escalate to project leads as needed, and coordinate cross-functional mitigation plans
  • Schedule, structure, and run project team meetings (set agendas, pre-reads, minutes, action logs), track and drive closure of decisions and actions.
  • Build and maintain governance-ready views (dashboards, status summaries, decision logs) to enable Quotient’s Executive team and Board of Directors reviews
  • Support SMEs in operational execution with external partners (e.g., CROs), ensuring deliverables, timelines, and obligations are clearly understood and met.
  • Support functional heads in forecasting and tracking resource needs (FTE, external partners) across projects and the pipeline, flag constraints and propose options.
  • Coordinate budgets closely with the VP of Finance and track spend vs. plan and contracted scopes.
  • Establish and maintain a structured risk and issue management process (identification, impact assessment, mitigation/contingency, owners, timelines).
  • Support compliance with regulatory and quality expectations by organizing documentation and tracking contributions to regulatory submissions etc.
  • Maintain shared repositories (SharePoint, dashboards, trackers) for plans, data summaries, and decision histories to improve transparency and continuity.
  • Identify and implement continuous operational improvements to increase DD matrix team efficiency and focus on high-value scientific work.
  • Support the development of Quotient’s drug discovery pipeline strategy and, with members of Research Operations and Strategy, develop a holistic and end-to-end view of Quotient’s Research and Development pipeline.

Qualifications:

Essential

  • Bachelor’s degree in biological sciences or related discipline
  • Proven track record of applying project management methodologies in complex, matrixed environments; significant experience (typically 5–10 years) in drug development within pharmaceutical, or biotech industry settings
  • Knowledge and experience in drug discovery and an understanding of the principles of clinical development, drug discovery, regulatory strategy

title: Doktorand inom Oorganisk Materialkemi
description:
Vi har kraften från över 50 000 studenter och medarbetare. Studenter som ger framtidshopp. Medarbetare som varje dag bidrar till att Linköpings universitet tar sig an samtidens utmaningar. Vår värdegrund vilar på trovärdighet, tillit och trygghet. Genom att vara modiga, tänka fritt och göra nytt skapar vi tillsammans, med stora och små handlingar, en bättre framtid. Välkommen att söka jobb hos oss!

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Som doktorand inom oorganisk materialkemi ska du bedriva forskning inom tunnfilms deponering med CVD-tekniker, särskilt med en ytkemi som aktiveras med plasmaelektroner. Fokus kommer att vara deponering av metaller för elektriska kopplingar i halvledarchip.

Som doktorand ägnar du dig åt din forskarutbildning och forskningsprojekt där du ingår. I ditt arbete kan även ingå att undervisa eller att delta i andra institutionsuppdrag, upp till 20 procent av heltid.

Dina kvalifikationer

Du har avlagt examen på avancerad nivå inom kemi och materialvetenskap eller slutfört kurser om minst 240 högskolepoäng varav minst 60 högskolepoäng på avancerad nivå inom kemi och materialvetenskap eller på något annat sätt förvärvat i huvudsak motsvarande kunskaper.

Vi söker dig som är nyfiken på materialforskning i gränslandet mellan kemi och fysik och vill utveckla och förstå nya CVD-tekniker. Vi tror att du är en noggrann och analytisk person med stort eget driv att utforska okända kemiska processer på ytor och i plasmaurladdningar.

Du ska ha:

  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta i ett forskningslabb
  • Erfarenhet av CVD där ytkemin aktiveras av plasmaelektroner
  • Erfarenhet av in situ karakterisering av CVD-processer

Det är meriterande om du har:

  • Erfarenheter av att studera och verka i en internationell miljö
  • Tidigare vetenskapliga publikationer

Eftersom tjänsten innefattar både forskning och undervisning är förmåga att obehindrat kunna undervisa på svenska ett krav.

Avsiktsförklaring behöver inte bifogas.

Din arbetsplats

Kemiavdelningen bedriver forskning samt grundutbildning och forskarutbildning inom kemi. Av särskild vikt för denna tjänst är tunnfilmsdeponering, som är en internationellt ansedd del av forskningen vid Linköpings universitet. Kemiavdelningen, genom forskargruppen i oorganisk kemi bedriver forskning inom tunnfilmsdeponering med ALD och CVD på hög internationell nivå.

Läs mer om vår verksamhet här https://liu.se/forskning/pedersengruppen

Om anställningen

I samband med tillträde till anställningen kommer du att antas till forskarutbildningen. Läs mer om respektive fakultets forskarutbildning https://liu.se/forskning/forskarutbildning

Anställningen är tidsbegränsad till normalt fyra år heltid. Förlängning av anställning upp till fem år sker utifrån grad av undervisnings- och institutionsuppdrag. Vid särskilda skäl kan ytterligare förlängning ske. Du anställs till en början på ett år, och därefter förnyas anställningen med högst två år i taget, utifrån uppnådd studieplan.

Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Lön och förmåner

Doktorandlönen regleras utifrån en lokalt avtalad lönestege. Läs mer om förmåner för anställda https://liu.se/jobba-pa-liu/formaner.

Fackliga kontaktpersoner

Information om fackliga kontaktpersoner, se https://liu.se/jobba-pa-liu/hjalp-for-sokande.

Ansökan

Du söker denna anställning genom att klicka på knappen "Ansök" nedan. Din ansökan ska vara Linköpings universitet tillhanda senast den 11 september 2026. Ansökan som inkommer efter sista ansökningsdag beaktas inte.

Vi välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund, erfarenheter och perspektiv, det berikar och utvecklar vår verksamhet. För oss är det självklart att värna om allas lika värde, rättigheter och möjligheter. Läs om vårt arbete med https://liu.se/artikel/lika-villkor/.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Linköpings universitet har upphandlade avtal och undanber oss direktkontakt från bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av platsannonser.

title: Solution Specialist, Finance Systems
description:
Get to Know the Team

Grabber Technology Solutions (GTS) aims to be a technology leader that provides predictive and seamless experiences to all Grab employees (Grabbers). We are a diverse team of technology practitioners looking to outserve Grabbers with positive, personalised IT experiences, and we are looking for individuals with similar customer-centric and values to join our growing team.

Get to Know the Role

The Senior Solution Specialist will report directly to the Delivery Manager for Finance Systems. As a Solution Specialist, Finance Systems, you will work with GTS teams and Finance users to understand challenges, current processes and system requirements. You will translate these needs into future-state application requirements, process improvements and solution designs, working with other teams and external implementation partners where required.

You will focus on managing change requests and project implementations within the Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP environment, with an emphasis on Record-to-Report (R2R) processes. Experience in Order-to-Cash (O2C), Procure-to-Pay (P2P) and Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) will be an advantage.

The Critical Tasks You Will Perform

  • Lead Finance Systems change requests and project implementations from requirements gathering and solution design through testing, deployment and post-go-live stabilisation.
  • Collaborate with Finance partners to understand needs, document all-state processes, standardise requirements and perform fit-gap analysis.
  • Translate requirements into functional solution designs, configuration recommendations, process improvements and implementation plans.
  • Assess the impact, risks, dependencies and priorities of proposed changes across finance processes, data, integrations and related applications.
  • Coordinate System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect resolution, test-result validation and business approval.
  • Work with technical teams, Oracle Support, implementation partners and Finance partners to deliver integrations, data migrations, enhancements, releases and quarterly Oracle Fusion Cloud upgrades.
  • Evaluate new Oracle platform capabilities and conduct Proofs of Concept (POCs) to assess feasibility, value and agreement on Finance requirements.
  • Drive change adoption through process documentation, user guides, training materials, partner communication, knowledge transfer and continuous improvement of R2R processes.

What Essential Skills You Will Need

  • At least 3+ years of experience working with Oracle ERP Cloud applications, including knowledge of module interactions and integrations with third-party applications.
  • Experience managing at least two full lifecycle Oracle ERP Cloud projects, including delivery of R2R solutions.
  • Knowledge of Oracle Finance Cloud, General Ledger, Fixed Assets, Intercompany and Tax. We prefer a working knowledge of Receivables and Payables.
  • Experience with the change lifecycle, including configuration or development, SIT, UAT, release packaging, deployment and post-go-live support.
  • Experience preparing functional design documents, process documentation, user guides and training materials.
  • Analyse impacts and identify how a system change may affect related processes, data points, integrations and controls.
  • Partner management, with the ability to explain solution options and recommendations to business and technical audiences.

Good to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Oracle Procurement Cloud and Order Management Cloud.
  • Knowledge or experience with Oracle EPM and Master Data Management (MDM).
  • Experience with financial reporting tools such as Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI) and Business Intelligence (BI).
  • Experience with other Finance systems such as Concur or Kyriba.
  • Experience working in a global or international business environment.
  • Experience with Robotic Process Automation (RPA), Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and other automation solutions.

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Data Analyst
description:
At Bluesight, our mission is to create groundbreaking solutions that increase efficiency, safety and visibility for health systems, hospital pharmacy, and pharmaceutical manufacturers. We empower our customers to deliver the right medicine to the right patient at the right time, every time. We are a high growth healthcare information technology company with a start-up 'vibe' but over 3,000 customers using our proven solutions.

We’re looking for a Data Analyst to support the implementation of Bluesight SaaS products for our hospital customers. This person collects data, synthesizes and interprets results from a variety of disparate systems. The role will be responsible for finding and interpreting pertinent data points from both internal and external healthcare database source systems and developing analytical solutions using various business intelligence tools.

Typical work breakdown:

  • Validating and analyzing data in Excel: 60%
  • Customer-facing interactions: 30%
  • Writing or updating SQL, Python, and various other tasks: 10%

Candidates should be passionate about Excel, comfortable working directly with customers, and capable of leveraging SQL/Python/Ruby when needed to support file ingestion and automation.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Validate, reconcile, provide quality assurance, and analyze data input from disparate systems to ensure data integrity using Excel
  • Communicate data findings and serve as a point person for troubleshooting and resolving technical issues.
  • Partner with the implementation project lead and the customer to track progress, provide timely updates, and review data points with customers
  • Perform data extraction tasks using multiple databases through SQL
  • Develop solutions to support the SFTP automation of ongoing reporting needs
  • Acquire and retrieve data as necessary and assist in troubleshooting of data issues to ease end-user use of application
  • Other duties as assigned

Required Qualifications & Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree, or equivalent experience
  • 1+ years of experience in data analysis, experience in the healthcare industry a plus
  • Deep expertise and enthusiasm for Microsoft Excel and for using it to solve complex problems and trend data
  • Moderate experience with SQL for data extraction and transformation
  • Communicates promptly and effectively with both customers and internal teams, which includes both non-technical and technical audiences
  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills with high attention to detail
  • Proven ability to manage multiple projects, balance competing priorities, and meet goals and deadlines
  • Self-starter with a demonstrated history of success, multiple examples of taking initiative, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment
  • Strong interpersonal and customer service skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in teams and consistently meet or exceed customer expectations
  • Strong verbal and written communications skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working on an Operations team, especially in an implementation-focused role
  • Familiarity with installing or implementing SaaS products in a client environment
  • Knowledge of hospital EHR systems (e.g. Epic, Oracle (Cerner), MEDITECH, etc.)
  • Knowledge of hospital ADC systems (e.g. PyxisES, Omnicell, etc.)
  • Experience coding with Python or Ruby or other scripting language
  • Experience working with PHI, understanding of HIPAA
This position is open to applicants in the continental United States.
Why Bluesight?
Bluesight’s culture is built on innovation and teamwork. There’s room to grow and opportunities to take initiative. You will partner with sharp, motivated teammates looking to disrupt a massive industry—and have fun doing it. We truly believe that where you work and what you do matters. Join us as we revolutionize the hospital pharmacy landscape!
-Competitive salary
-Time off when you need it – unlimited vacation days!
-Generous insurance coverage
-401k program with a company match
-Fun, collaborative culture!
EOE AA M/F/VET/Disability
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment and will not be discriminated against on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, protected veteran status, disability, or any other basis protected by federal, state or local laws.

title: Förskollärare till Öjersjö Brunns förskola!
description:
Vi söker nu förskollärare till Öjersjö Brunns förskola. Hos oss kommer du att arbeta på en och samma avdelning som del i ett arbetslag.

I rollen som pedagog på våra förskolor arbetar du med att skapa trygga, roliga och lärorika pedagogiska miljöer där barn får möjlighet till inflytande och delaktighet. Du utgår från barnens erfarenheter, tankar och idéer och planerar undervisningen utifrån förskolans mål. Du tar vara på barnens kreativitet och arbetar som medforskande pedagog med det relationella lärandet som utgångspunkt.

Arbetet innebär att tillsammans med barnen utforska, undersöka och skapa lärande i vardagen. Du observerar, dokumenterar och reflekterar över undervisningen för att följa barnens lärande och utveckla utbildningen. Du samarbetar med kollegor och familjer och bidrar till en förskola där lärande, delaktighet och demokrati står i centrum.

Som förskollärare har du även ansvar för att planera, följa upp och utveckla undervisningen utifrån förskolans läroplansmål.

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad förskollärare med tidigare erfarenhet av arbete som förskollärare. För tjänsten är det meriterande om du har kunskap och erfarenhet av att arbeta med det systematiska kvalitetsarbetet som grund. Du behöver även ha god kunskap och erfarenhet av att arbeta med AKK (Alternativ och kompletterande kommunikation).

Utöver ovanstående vill vi att:

  • Du har ett tydligt fokus på uppdraget och en god förmåga att leda såväl barn som kollegor.
  • Du är nyfiken, engagerad och har en god samarbetsförmåga.
  • Du är flexibel med god kommunikationsförmåga och driver både förskolans och din egen utveckling framåt utifrån våra mål och riktlinjer.
  • Du har ett tydligt fokus på barns lärande och utgår från en tro på det kompetenta barnet när du planerar utbildningen.
  • Du är medveten om vikten av den pedagogiska dokumentationen och är väl förtrogen med de digitala verktygen.
  • Du ser det som en nödvändighet med reflektion i det pedagogiska ledarskapet.
  • Du är aktiv i att utveckla en stimulerande, lustfylld och kreativ lärmiljö och har metoder och strategier för att se och möta det enskilda barnets behov av utmaning.

Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

Bra att veta

Vid erbjuden anställning genomförs ID kontroll och ett godtagbart utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister ska uppvisas.

Din nya arbetsplats

Förskolorna i Öjersjö är belägna med skogen inpå knuten, vilket bjuder in till att lämna förskolan och upptäcka vår omgivning tillsammans med barnen. Vi prioriterar att dela upp barngruppen i mindre sammanhang under dagen; ute/inne, i aktiviteter och i olika rutinsituationer. Det är en stark vi-känsla och en stolthet på förskolorna där vi hjälps åt och använder våra kompetenser på bästa sätt. Här finns utrymme för dig som är nyfiken, kreativ och driftig att förverkliga dina pedagogiska idéer i verksamheten tillsammans med andra kollegor.

Hos oss i Partille kommun står alla människors lika värde i centrum. Med stort engagemang och korta beslutsvägar skapar vi tillsammans trygghet, kvalitet och utveckling för våra invånare.

Ring Partille kommuns växel, 031-792 10 00, och be att få prata med Rekryteringsenheten• Vi tar inte emot några personliga brev• Inför anställning behöver du kunna styrka din identitet och, vid behov, arbetstillstånd

title: Compliance Apprentice - 18 month contract
description:
Title:

Compliance Apprentice - 18 month contract

Company:

Everest Advisors (Uk), Ltd.

Job Category:

Compliance Oversight

Job Description:

About Everest

Everest is a global leader in risk management, with over 50 years of experience enabling businesses to thrive and economies to flourish. We underwrite risk, growth, and opportunity, and we are committed to disciplined capital allocation and long-term value creation for all stakeholders. Our team cares deeply about our impact on communities and the wider world.

We have an exciting opportunity for a Compliance & Risk Apprentice to join our Reinsurance division in London for an 18 month placement. You’ll play an important role in supporting our UK branch operations alongside our Compliance Officer. This is a great opportunity to learn compliance and risk fundamentals in a collaborative, global environment.

What is a Compliance & Risk Apprenticeship?

This 18-month program is your chance to begin or advance your career in financial services while earning a Level 3 Compliance & Risk qualification.

Compliance is all about helping businesses follow the rules - like keeping data safe and preventing financial crime. Risk management means spotting potential problems before they happen and making sure companies stay secure and trusted.

You’ll join a global reinsurance company in London, learning how the insurance/reinsurance market works and why compliance is so important. From supporting teams with regulations to helping protect against fraud, you’ll play a key role in keeping the business safe and fair.

Why is this exciting?

  • You’ll gain real-world experience in a professional office environment.

  • Learn from experts and build skills that are in high demand across the world of risk.

  • Enjoy a mix of work and study, with full support to complete your qualification.

  • Open the door to a long-term career in compliance, risk, or financial services.

If you’re curious, detail-oriented, and want a career that matters, this is the perfect starting point!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Providing advice, guidance and support for assigned business areas.

  • Supporting the business in the implementation of new regulation.

  • Supporting the Compliance Officer in the delivery of our Annual Compliance Plan.

  • Promoting a robust, transparent compliance and risk culture.

  • Assisting with the identification, assessment, advice, monitoring and reporting against the applicable regulatory codes, laws and regulations impacting on reinsurance compliance.

  • Assisting in compliance monitoring reviews and reports.

  • Assisting in the preparation of Compliance reporting to senior management including contribution to board and committee reports to ensure senior management and Board members are up to date and aware of key compliance issues and actions required.

  • Maintenance of the compliance registers.

  • Carry out testing and review of our key controls, in liaison with second and third line of defence teams, including risk management and internal audit.

What We’re Looking For:

  • Strong problem-solving and numeracy skills

  • You will have achieved (or be predicted) three A-levels or equivalent Level 3 qualifications (such as BTEC, T Level, or Advanced Apprenticeship)

  • You will have achieved (or be predicted) three A-levels or equivalent Level 3 qualifications (such as BTEC, T Level, or Advanced Apprenticeship)

  • Motivation to learn and develop in compliance and risk management.

  • Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills.

  • Good written and verbal communication skills.

  • No prior insurance experience required but preferred.

  • A proactive attitude and willingness to grow!

Why Join Us?

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Company Background

Coherent Solutions is a global digital product engineering company founded in 1995 and headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota. With a presence in nine countries and a team of more than 1,700 engineers, the company provides custom software development and engineering services across web and mobile applications, cloud, DevOps, and data. Coherent Solutions works with clients worldwide to build and scale digital products while fostering a culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous professional growth.

Project Description

We are looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our DevOps practice in a strategic role that is not initially tied to a specific client project. The engineer will support future client needs across cloud infrastructure, automation, CI/CD, containers, observability, and troubleshooting, working with different technology stacks and cloud platforms.

Technologies

  • AWS / Azure / GCP
  • IaC, Terraform
  • Jenkins / GitLab CI/CD / GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps / Bitbucket Pipelines / Bamboo
  • Docker
  • Kubernetes / Managed Container Platforms
  • Linux
  • Bash / Python / PowerShell
  • Prometheus / Grafana / Datadog / CloudWatch / Azure Monitor / Application Insights / ELK / Splunk / New Relic
  • GitHub Copilot / Claude Code / Cursor / ChatGPT

What You'll Do

  • Build, maintain, and improve cloud infrastructure using IaC;
  • Create and support CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure;
  • Deploy, operate, and troubleshoot containerized applications in Docker- and Kubernetes-based environments;
  • Work with development and QA teams to resolve build, deployment, configuration, and runtime issues;
  • Configure and maintain monitoring, logging, dashboards, and alerts;
  • Participate in incident investigations, root cause analysis, and reliability improvement initiatives;
  • Automate routine infrastructure and operational tasks using scripting;
  • Support cloud migration, infrastructure modernization, environment setup, and platform improvement initiatives;
  • Apply cloud and CI/CD security best practices, including IAM/RBAC, secrets management, and secure pipeline configuration;
  • Maintain technical documentation for infrastructure, deployment processes, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides;
  • Collaborate with distributed engineering teams and, when needed, communicate directly with client-side technical stakeholders;

Job Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, SRE, Platform Engineering, Build/Release Engineering, or a related role;
  • Strong hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP;
  • Experience with IaC, preferably Terraform;
  • Experience creating, maintaining, and improving CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Bitbucket Pipelines, Bamboo, or similar tools;
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and containerized applications;
  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes or managed container platforms;
  • Experience with Linux administration;
  • Scripting experience with at least one of the following: Bash, Python, or PowerShell;
  • Experience with monitoring and logging tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Application Insights, ELK, Splunk, New Relic, or similar tools;
  • Understanding of fundamental networking concepts, including DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, load balancing, routing, subnets, firewalls/security groups, and VPNs;
  • Understanding of cloud security fundamentals, including IAM/RBAC, secrets management, least-privilege access, and secure CI/CD practices;
  • Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, or similar tools;
  • Strong troubleshooting skills across infrastructure, cloud services, containers, CI/CD, and applications;
  • English proficiency at B2 level or higher;

Nice to have

  • Experience with more than one major cloud platform, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP;
  • Experience with Helm, Kustomize, Argo CD, Flux, or GitOps practices;
  • Experience with Ansible, Chef, Puppet, or SaltStack;
  • Experience with CloudFormation, AWS CDK, OpenTofu, Bicep, ARM templates, or Pulumi;
  • Experience operating Kubernetes clusters in production;
  • Experience with observability stacks, distributed tracing, OpenTelemetry, Loki, Alertmanager, or similar technologies;
  • Experience with DevSecOps tools such as Trivy, SonarQube, Veracode, Snyk, Checkov, tfsec, or CodeQL;
  • Experience working in regulated industries such as healthcare, life sciences, or finance, or with compliance frameworks and standards such as FedRAMP, ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, or GxP;
  • Experience with cloud migrations, infrastructure modernization, high availability, disaster recovery, or cost optimization;
  • Experience with Windows Server, IIS, Microsoft SQL Server, and Azure-centric environments;
  • Experience supporting data platform infrastructure such as Kafka, Spark, Airflow, Flink, Hadoop, NiFi, Redis, Elasticsearch, MongoDB, or similar technologies;
  • Cloud or Kubernetes certifications, such as AWS, Azure, GCP, CKA, CKAD, CKS, or Terraform Associate;

What Do We Offer

The global benefits package includes:

  • Technical and non-technical training for professional and personal growth;
  • Internal conferences and meetups to learn from industry experts;
  • Support and mentorship from an experienced employee to help you professional grow and development;
  • Health insurance;
  • Sports activities to promote a healthy lifestyle;
  • Flexible work options, including remote and hybrid opportunities;
  • Referral program for bringing in new talent;
  • Work anniversary program and additional vacation days.

title: Nätverkstekniker
description:
Nätverkstekniker till långsiktigt konsultuppdrag i Örebro

Vill du arbeta med komplexa och verksamhetskritiska nätverksmiljöer där tillgänglighet, säkerhet och stabilitet står i centrum? Nu söker vi två erfarna nätverkstekniker till ett långsiktigt konsultuppdrag hos vår kund i Örebro.

Om uppdraget

Som nätverkstekniker blir du en del av en kvalificerad IT-miljö med höga krav på driftsäkerhet och tillgänglighet. Du kommer att arbeta brett med drift, administration, konfigurering och felsökning av komplexa nätverkslösningar.

Rollen passar dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av enterprise-nätverk och trivs med att arbeta i tekniskt avancerade miljöer där nätverksinfrastrukturen är en central del av verksamheten.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

  • Arbeta med drift, administration och vidareutveckling av nätverksinfrastruktur.

  • Konfigurera och felsöka switching- och routinglösningar i komplexa enterprise-miljöer.

  • Arbeta med brandväggslösningar i miljöer med höga krav på tillgänglighet och säkerhet.

  • Hantera och felsöka virtualiserade nätverk och SDN-lösningar.

  • Arbeta med nätverksövervakning, analys och proaktiv felsökning.

  • Identifiera, analysera och åtgärda incidenter och störningar i komplexa nätverksmiljöer.

  • Bidra till att säkerställa en stabil, säker och tillgänglig nätverksmiljö.

  • Samarbeta med andra tekniska specialister och relevanta intressenter inom organisationen.

Vi söker dig som

För att vara aktuell för rollen ser vi att du har:

  • Minst 5 års erfarenhet av arbete med brandväggslösningar i organisationer med höga krav på tillgänglighet.

  • Minst 5 års erfarenhet av switching och routing i enterprise-miljöer.

  • Minst 3 års erfarenhet av virtualiserade nätverk och SDN-lösningar.

  • Minst 3 års erfarenhet av nätverksövervakning och relevanta övervakningsverktyg.

  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av felsökning i komplexa nätverksmiljöer med höga krav på tillgänglighet.

Du har en bred teknisk förståelse och är van att arbeta strukturerat med felsökning, incidenthantering och problemlösning. Du känner dig trygg i komplexa IT-miljöer och har förmågan att snabbt sätta dig in i tekniska utmaningar och hitta hållbara lösningar.

Meriterande

Det är meriterande om du har minst tre års erfarenhet av:

  • Drift, administration och konfigurering av Check Point-brandväggar.

  • Drift, administration och konfigurering av Citrix NetScaler/ADC.

  • Installation, konfigurering och användning av SolarWinds Orion för nätverksövervakning och analys.

Personliga egenskaper

För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är analytisk, lösningsorienterad och strukturerad. Du har ett stort tekniskt intresse och trivs med att arbeta i miljöer där kvalitet och tillgänglighet är avgörande.

Du är också kommunikativ och har lätt för att samarbeta med andra, samtidigt som du kan arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter.

Om konsultuppdraget

Uppdraget är ett konsultuppdrag på heltid med start enligt överenskommelse och löper till och med 30 september 2028.

Placering är Örebro och arbetet bedrivs på plats hos kund.

Tjänsten omfattas av säkerhetskrav och säkerhetsprövning kommer att genomföras innan uppdragets start. För uppdraget krävs också mycket goda kunskaper i svenska.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.
