title: Electrical Superintendent
description:
Our client is looking for a Lead Electrician who is accountable for running assigned electrical work in the field from mobilization through completion. This role creates value by delivering safe, code-compliant, high-quality work, keeping jobs moving on schedule, leading helpers and apprentices effectively, communicating job status clearly, and minimizing callbacks and rework.
The Lead Electrician is the field owner of execution on assigned jobs. That includes planning day-to-day work, identifying material and labor needs, checking quality before leaving the site, maintaining safety standards, and making sure the office and leadership team have the information needed to manage the business well.

Key Accountabilities and Responsibilities

Job execution and field leadership
• Lead assigned jobs in the field and take ownership for execution, workmanship, and day-to-day progress.
• Review the scope of work, assess actual field conditions, and adjust installation approach as needed while keeping leadership informed of meaningful changes.
• Complete work to code, company standards, and customer expectations.
• Maintain momentum on the job and make sound field decisions that keep work moving without sacrificing quality.
Schedule and production management
• Manage daily production against the expected timeline for the job.
• Coordinate labor, tools, and materials needed to complete work efficiently.
• Flag scope issues, labor shortages, material gaps, or site constraints early so schedule impacts can be addressed before they become failures.
• Balance speed with workmanship, recognizing that finishing fast only matters when the work is right.
Quality control and callback prevention
• Inspect completed work before leaving the site to verify quality, completeness, and code compliance.
• Check the work of helpers and apprentices and correct issues in real time.
• Confirm materials, devices, connections, tools, and cleanup are complete before job closeout or transition.
• Reduce avoidable rework, missed items, and callbacks by using disciplined self-checks and field oversight.
Safety and compliance
• Lead safe work practices on every assigned job.
• Ensure proper PPE, lockout/tagout, hazard awareness, barricades, and site-specific safety requirements are followed.
• Maintain a safe work area for crew members, customers, and other trades.
• Stop unsafe work and correct unsafe behavior immediately.
Reporting and communication
• Provide timely field updates to leadership on job progress, delays, material needs, schedule risks, and completion status.
• Submit or support accurate work orders, labor reporting, and job notes as required.
• Communicate clearly with the office and leadership so customer expectations, billing support, and scheduling decisions stay aligned with field reality.
• Escalate major issues early rather than letting the office or customer find out late.
Helper and apprentice development
• Direct the work of assigned helpers and apprentices in the field.
• Teach proper installation methods, safe work habits, and jobsite expectations.
• Hold assigned crew members accountable for attendance, work quality, pace, and conduct.
• Develop apprentices toward greater independence while protecting job quality and safety.

Qualifications

• Journeyman or Master Electrician capability preferred, with strong field leadership experience.
• Strong knowledge of commercial, industrial, and service electrical work.
• Able to read plans, assess field conditions, and identify material and labor needs.
• Able to lead helpers and apprentices while maintaining quality and safety.
• Strong judgment, accountability, and communication in fast-moving field conditions.
• Valid driver’s license and clean driving record preferred.

title: Medewerker Duurzaamheid (Junior)
description:
Duurzaamheid is al jarenlang een belangrijk thema binnen de Zandbergen Groep. Tegelijkertijd merken we dat klanten, leveranciers en wetgevers steeds meer vragen stellen over onderwerpen zoals CO₂-uitstoot, social compliance en regelgeving zoals EUDR, PPWR en CSRD.
Daarom zoeken wij een Medewerker Duurzaamheid (Junior) voor 24 uur per week. Iemand die energie krijgt van het verzamelen van informatie, het creëren van overzicht en het zorgen dat onze duurzaamheidsinformatie altijd actueel en goed onderbouwd is. Het is een praktische en coördinerende rol. Jij bent degene die de verschillende onderdelen samenbrengt, ontwikkelingen volgt en zorgt dat
collega's en klanten op jou kunnen rekenen als het gaat om duurzaamheidsvraagstukken.

Wat ga je doen?
✅Je coördineert en beantwoordt klantvragenlijsten over onderwerpen zoals duurzaamheid, CO₂-footprint en social compliance;
✅Je verzamelt, controleert en actualiseert relevante duurzaamheidsinformatie binnen de organisatie;
✅Je volgt ontwikkelingen rondom wet- en regelgeving, zoals EUDR, PPWR en CSRD, en vertaalt deze naar praktische acties;
✅Je schakelt met verschillende afdelingen om de juiste informatie op te halen en te borgen;
✅Je brengt in kaart welke data nodig is en vraagt deze op bij leveranciers en externe partijen;
✅Je signaleert welke documentatie, processen en beleidsstukken nodig zijn om aantoonbaar compliant te blijven;
✅Je ziet kansen voor verbetering en helpt processen rondom duurzaamheidsrapportages verder te professionaliseren.

Je werkt nauw samen met verschillende afdelingen binnen de organisatie en hebt daarnaast regelmatig contact met klanten en leveranciers.

Je bent nieuwsgierig, gestructureerd en vindt het leuk om informatie uit verschillende bronnen samen te brengen. Je houdt overzicht, neemt initiatief en krijgt energie van het uitzoeken van complexe vraagstukken.
💥Je hebt interesse in duurzaamheid, compliance en wet- en regelgeving;
💥Je beschikt over een afgeronde hbo-opleiding, bij voorkeur in een relevante richting;
💥Je hebt 1 of 2 jaar werkervaring in een vergelijkbare functie;
💥Je werkt nauwkeurig en weet informatie overzichtelijk vast te leggen;
💥Je bent communicatief sterk en schakelt gemakkelijk met collega's, leveranciers en klanten;
💥Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid en kunt zelfstandig werken;
💥Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed. Engels is een pré.

Wat bieden wij?
👉Salaris o.b.v. 40 uur tussen de €3.250,- en €3.750,- op basis van ervaring;
👉28 vakantiedagen (op basis van 40 uur);
👉Een goed pensioen waarbij wij 66% van de premie bijdragen;
👉Reiskostenvergoeding bij meer dan 10 km enkele reis;
👉Iedere maand een pakket met artikelen uit ons eigen assortiment;
👉Informele werksfeer met betrokken collega's;
👉Ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen je vakgebied;
👉Een zelfstandige functie met een duidelijk eigen aandachtsgebied.

De Zandbergen Groep
De Zandbergen Groep bestaat uit drie bedrijven. Zandbergen World’s Finest Meat is een toonaangevend familiebedrijf en levert een breed assortiment proteïnen, waaronder rundvlees, lamsvlees en gevogelte. The New Plant richt zich op de productie van plantaardige proteïnen en produceert voor Beyond Meat voor klanten in Europa, het Midden-Oosten en een deel van Afrika. Daarnaast worden hier de plantaardige McPlant burgers van McDonald’s geproduceerd. Frigomundo is het vrieshuis van de groep en beschikt over 30.000 palletplaatsen voor de opslag van producten van Zandbergen, The New Plant en externe klanten.

title: Testare av elektronik och hårdvara till tekniskt bolag
description:
Har du en bakgrund inom elektronik och tycker om att testa och hantera hårdvara? Nu söker vi både dig som är junior och dig med lite mer erfarenhet till ett testteam i Järfälla.

OM TJÄNSTEN

Friday söker för kunds räkning en testare inom elektronik och hårdvara till ett team i Järfälla som idag består av cirka 20 testare, både seniora och juniora.

Du kommer dagligen att arbeta med funktionstest av elektronik och hårdvara, i huvudsak egentillverkade produkter och testutrustningar. I arbetet ingår bland annat test av underenheter såsom kretskort och vågledare, leverans- och enhetstest på olika nivåer, mätningar av mikrovågsmoduler, starkströmsmätningar och arbete med kraftenheter.

För att trivas i rollen ser vi gärna att du tycker om att arbeta i team samtidigt som du självständigt kan söka information och driva ditt arbete framåt. Du delar gärna med dig av dina kunskaper och erfarenheter till andra. Som person är du envis, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad. Du har förmågan att tänka kreativt och tycker om att lösa tekniska problem.

VI SÖKER DIG SOM
  • Har gymnasieutbildning med inriktning mot elektronik samt viss akademisk utbildning och/eller erfarenhet av liknande arbetsuppgifter inom elektronikprovning eller motsvarande
  • Har ett gediget intresse för teknik
  • Har mycket goda kunskaper i både svenska och engelska, då båda språken förekommer i det dagliga arbetet

Meriterande färdigheter och erfarenheter:

  • Erfarenhet av att hantera multimeter och oscilloskop för manuella mätningar
  • Erfarenhet av test av prototyper och serieproducerade elektronikkonstruktioner med höga kvalitetskrav
  • Kunskap inom analog och digital teknik, mikrovågsteknik/RF och mätteknik
  • Erfarenhet av ritnings- och schemaläsning
OM KUNDFÖRETAGET

Kundföretaget är ett teknikbolag med verksamhet inom avancerad elektronik och tekniska lösningar. Här får du möjlighet att arbeta i en tekniskt utvecklande miljö tillsammans med både juniora och seniora kollegor. Som medarbetare får du ta ansvar, utveckla din kompetens och bidra med dina erfarenheter och idéer.

OM ANSTÄLLNINGEN

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag vilket innebär att du till en början kommer att vara anställd av Friday. Ambitionen från kundens och vår sida är att du efter konsultperioden blir direktanställd hos kunden.

ÖVRIG INFO
  • Omfattning: Heltid
  • Start: Flexibelt
  • Placering: Järfälla
  • Rekryteringsansvarig: Mattias Isik
  • Lön: Marknadsmässig

Ansök genom att klicka på länken nedan. Kom ihåg att vara snabb med din ansökan då vi gör löpande urval. Annonsen kan därför komma att stängas innan tjänsten är tillsatt om processen har gått vidare till urvals- och intervjufasen.

OM FRIDAY

Genom att vara en partner både till våra kandidater och kunder strävar vi efter att hitta den bästa matchningen. Det gör vi genom att lära känna våra kunder och kandidater på riktigt! Vi ser självklart till att kunskaps- och erfarenhetskrav matchar, men framför allt lägger vi vikt vid samsyn kring värderingar och företagskultur som båda parter värdesätter.

Vår passion är att hjälpa människor till rätt roll, arbetsplats och sammanhang inom IT och teknik. Därför grundade vi Friday med ambitionen att hjälpa dig till jobbet som ger dig fredagskänslan – varje dag!

Vi riktar oss främst till dig som är i början av din karriär eller studerar vid högskola/universitet inom IT och teknik.

Vår övertygelse är att människor uppnår sin fulla potential när man ser fram emot att gå till jobbet varje morgon. ”Friday – everyday”, hur låter det?

Sökord: testingenjör, testare, Stockholm, Järfälla, elektroteknik, elektronik, hårdvara, oscilloskop, RF, mätteknik.

title: Associate Expert Drug Supply
description:

Job Description Summary

Strokovni sodelavec za oskrbo zdravil (m/ž/d) / Associate Expert Drug Supply (m/f/d)


Job Description

#LI-Onsite

Strokovni sodelavec za oskrbo zdravil (m/ž/d) / Associate Expert Drug Supply (m/f/d)

Z veseljem napovedujemo ustanovitev novega obrata klinične proizvodnje v Sloveniji, namenjenega hitrejšemu odkrivanju inovativnih zdravil za bolnike po vsem svetu. Najsodobnejši objekt, ki se nahaja v Biocampusu v Mengšu, nudi izjemno priložnost za sodelovanje, inoviranje in vpliv.

V okviru klinične proizvodnje bioloških učinkovin iščemo sodelavca oziroma sodelavko za delo na področju inprocesne analitike proizvodnega procesa bioloških učinkovin.

Primarna odgovornost delovnega mesta je priprava, izvedba in dokumentiranje inprocesne analitike za podporo proizvodnji bioloških učinkovin. Vaše zadolžitve bodo vključujevale delo z različno analitsko opremo ter analitskimi metodami, uporabo aplikacije GLIMS, vodenje in pregled analitske dokumentacije, pregled rezultatov ter skrb za urejeno, skladno in učinkovito delovanje analitskega laboratorija.

Če vas veseli delo v analitskem laboratoriju, hkrati pa cenite dinamično okolje in neposredno povezavo s proizvodnjo, je ta pozicija odlična priložnost za vaš strokovni razvoj.

Postanite del zavzetega tima, ki soustvarja prihodnost medicine in prispeva k razvoju terapij za bolnike po vsem svetu. Veselimo se kandidatov, ki želijo s svojim znanjem in izkušnjami prispevati k uspešni vzpostavitvi in delovanju klinične proizvodnje v Sloveniji.

Vaše ključne odgovornosti:

  • priprava, izvedba in dokumentiranje inprocesne analitike proizvodnje bioloških učinkovin;

  • planiranje, izvajanje in dokumentiranje aktivnosti v skladu z zahtevami GxP;

  • izpolnjevanje in pregled GxP dokumentacije, vključno z dnevniki, obrazci, proizvodnimi poročili in izvornimi podatki;

  • priprava enostavnih postopkov, protokolov in poročil, kot so delovni postopki in poročila o trendih;

  • sodelovanje pri obravnavi odstopanj, reševanju težav ter izvajanju korektivnih in preventivnih ukrepov;

  • skrb za skladno, urejeno in varno delo v analitskem laboratoriju ter dosledno upoštevanje predpisov, internih postopkov in standardov kakovosti;

  • delovanje v skladu s standardi na področju kakovosti, etike, varnosti, zdravja, okolja in informacijske varnosti;

  • aktivno prispevanje k pozitivni delovni kulturi ter lastnemu strokovnemu in osebnemu razvoju.

Vaš doprinos k delovnemu mestu:

  • zaključena najmanj srednješolska izobrazba ustrezne smeri;

  • aktivno znanje slovenskega jezika in tehnično znanje angleškega jezika;

  • dobre organizacijske sposobnosti ter natančnost pri vodenju in upravljanju dokumentacije v skladu s pravili podjetja;

  • sposobnost doslednega upoštevanja navodil, postopkov in standardov dela;

  • osnovno oziroma ustrezno poznavanje računalniških orodij in programske opreme, relevantne za delo.

Zaželene izkušnje:

  • izkušnje na primerljivem delovnem mestu v proizvodnem ali analitskem okolju;

  • strokovno ali tehnično znanje s področja naravoslovnih ved;

  • poznavanje dobre proizvodne prakse (GMP) in izkušnje z delom v reguliranem okolju.

Z izbranim kandidatom bomo sklenili delovno razmerje za nedoločen čas s poskusno dobo šestih mesecev. Prijavo oddajte skupaj z življenjepisom v slovenskem in angleškem jeziku.

Koristi in nagrade

V Novartisu smo zavezani skupnemu preoblikovanju medicine – in nagrajevanju ljudi, ki jo uresničijo.

Pričakovana letna osnovna plača Razpon za delovno mesto: €20.300 do €37.700

Osnovna plača je določena glede na spolno nevtralne cilje, kot so relevantne veščine, kompetence in izkušnje v skladu s politiko plač Novartisa, ob vstopu v Novartis pa se redno pregleduje.

Poleg osnovne plače ste morda upravičeni do bonusa na podlagi uspešnosti, odvisno od določenih parametrov uspešnosti.

Nagrade, ki jih prinaša članstvo v naši ekipi, segajo daleč preko osnovne plače in spodbud. Ponujamo tudi različne konkurenčne ugodnosti v naravi, ki vam pomagajo uspevati osebno in poklicno, kot so zavarovalni načrti, pokojninski načrti, viri za dobro počutje in globalni programi priznanja. Poleg tega ponujamo prilagodljive in hibridne možnosti dela, kjer je mogoče, ter najmanj 14 tednov plačanega starševskega dopusta.

This state-of-the-art facility, located at Biocampus in Mengeš, offers an exceptional opportunity for collaboration, innovation, and impact.

Within clinical manufacturing of biological drug substances, we are looking for an associate to work in the field of in-process analytics supporting the biological drug substance clinical manufacturing process.

The primary responsibility of this role is the preparation, execution, and documentation of in-process analytics in support of biological drug substance production. The role includes the use of the GLIMS application, completion and review of analytical documentation, review of results, and ensuring an organized, compliant, and efficient analytical laboratory environment.

If you enjoy working in an analytical laboratory and value a dynamic environment with a direct connection to manufacturing, this position offers an excellent opportunity for your professional development.

Join a dedicated team that is helping reimagine medicine and contributing to the development of therapies for patients worldwide. We look forward to welcoming candidates who would like to contribute their knowledge and experience to the successful establishment and operation of clinical manufacturing in Slovenia.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Preparation, execution, and documentation of in-process analytics in support of biological drug substance production;

  • Planning, execution, and documentation of activities in accordance with GxP requirements;

  • Completion and review of GxP documentation, including logbooks, forms, production records, and raw data;

  • Preparation of simple procedures, protocols, and reports, such as working procedures and trending reports;

  • Participation in deviation handling, troubleshooting, and implementation of corrective and preventive actions;

  • Ensuring compliant, organized, and safe work in the analytical laboratory, with consistent adherence to regulations, internal procedures, and quality standards;

  • Working in accordance with standards related to quality, ethics, safety, health, environment, and information security;

  • Actively contributing to a positive work culture as well as to personal and professional development.

What you will bring to the role:

  • Completed at least secondary-level education in a relevant field;

  • Fluent knowledge of Slovenian and technical knowledge of English;

  • Good organizational skills and accuracy in maintaining and managing documentation in line with company requirements;

  • Ability to consistently follow instructions, procedures, and work standards;

  • Basic or appropriate knowledge of computer tools and software relevant to the role.

Desirable experience:

  • Experience in a comparable role within a manufacturing or analytical environment;

  • Professional or technical knowledge in the field of natural sciences;

  • Knowledge of Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) and experience working in a regulated environment.

The selected candidate will be offered long-term employment with a six-month probation period. Please submit your application together with a CV in Slovenian and English.

Benefits and Rewards

At Novartis, we are committed to reimagining medicine together—and rewarding the people who make it happen.

Base salary is determined using gender-neutral criteria such as relevant skills, competencies, and experience, in accordance with Novartis compensation policies, and is reviewed regularly after joining Novartis.

In addition to the base salary, you may be eligible for a performance-based bonus, depending on established performance criteria.

The rewards of being part of our team extend far beyond base pay and incentives. We also offer a variety of competitive benefits designed to support your personal and professional well-being, including insurance plans, retirement plans, wellness resources, and global recognition programs.

In addition, we offer flexible and hybrid working arrangements where possible, as well as a minimum of 14 weeks of paid parental leave.

title: Billing & Administration Coordinator
description:
MPLC is the legal way to show movies and TV in public or commercial spaces across the globe. For over 30 years, we’ve been the trusted partner to major Hollywood studios, independent producers, and the wider creative ecosystem, ensuring content creators are paid fairly and organisations respect copyright.

The Role in Two Bullet Points
  • You’ll own billing operations end-to-end — generating invoices, processing payments, reconciling discrepancies, and keeping accounts accurate across multiple business lines.
  • You’ll sit at the heart of Finance, Customer Service, and Administration — the go-to person who keeps renewals on track, inboxes under control, and data clean.

Responsibilities

This role requires a high volume of detail-oriented work — you’ll be handling bulk invoicing, inbox management, and data clean-up on a daily basis. You’ll need to be comfortable working across multiple systems (billing platforms, CRM, spreadsheets) and switching between tasks quickly. Some queries can be complex or time-sensitive, so resilience and good judgment are essential.

Requirements

Billing
  • Generate, review, and issue accurate customer invoices; process incoming payments and apply them to the correct accounts.
  • Reconcile billing discrepancies, manage credit notes, refunds, and adjustments, and resolve customer inquiries.
  • Review and mail out bulk invoices daily; manually amend and correct PDF invoices as needed for accurate delivery.
  • Ensure compliance with company billing policies and relevant financial regulations.
Account Renewals & Contract Review
  • Review accounts prior to renewal to confirm pricing, fee structure, and accuracy — including research for location increases or decreases.
  • Identify when proactive customer contact is required ahead of renewal and follow through accordingly.
  • Review contracts to confirm agreed terms are being adhered to.
Inbox & Lead Management
  • Manage all credit control inboxes, handling customer inquiries and account updates in a timely manner.
  • Progress new sales leads from initial request through to account creation and invoice issuance; follow up on unfinished account imports requiring customer contact.
  • Investigate lost contact records and carry out account clean-up across CRM and billing systems to ensure data accuracy.
Administration
  • ·Maintain accurate and well-organised records, files, and databases; support data entry and ensure information is up to date.
  • Handle all correspondence professionally and prepare documents, reports, and presentations as required.
  • Liaise with internal teams, customers, and vendors to resolve queries and provide general support to management.
You'll love this role if...
  • You have a keen eye for detail — numbers, dates, and discrepancies never slip past you.
  • You enjoy variety — juggling billing, customer communication, renewals, and admin without losing momentum.
  • You’re proactive and self-directed — you spot issues early and follow through without being prompted.

Benefits

  • £26,000 - £28,000
  • Hybrid or remote working
  • 25 days’ holiday + bank holidays
  • Life insurance
  • Private health insurance (including optical & dental)

We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.

Our Philosophy
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people.
Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.

Our Culture
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: Strategic Partner Management Associate
description:
About the Opportunity

At N26, we are on a mission to build the bank the world loves to use. Operating within our Banking Foundations Domain, the Strategic Partner Management team drives the core infrastructure, fintech capabilities, and third-party ecosystems that empower hundreds of thousands of European customers daily.

We are looking for an analytical, proactive, and execution-oriented Strategic Partner Management Associate to join our team.

This high-impact, hybrid position connects high-level strategy with day-to-day operational execution. In this role, you will act as a key liaison connecting external partners with internal stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Security. This role balances senior external partner management—including executive business reviews, vendor governance, and supplier selection—with hands-on operational execution.

In this role, you will:

Strategic Governance, Analytics & Executive Presence

  • Support Leadership on Executive Reviews (QBRs/HBRs): Prepare, facilitate, and follow up on high-stakes Quarterly and Half-Yearly Business Reviews with external strategic partners and internal domain leaders.
  • Advanced Analytics & Business Intelligence: Build, maintain, and present intuitive dashboards, performance metrics, and deep-dive analytical views to track vendor SLAs, quality metrics, and productivity trends to help leadership make informed decisions.
  • Cross-Functional Advisory: Partner with operations, product, tech and business teams to consult, specify, and deploy automated reporting and process solutions that scale with N26’s hyper-growth.

Financial Operations & Reconciliation

  • End-to-End Invoice Reconciliation: Design, implement, and run monthly processes to gather multi-source invoice inputs, perform accounting reconciliations, and validate complex partner billing against contracted rates.
  • Financial KPI Management & Dispute Resolution: Track invoice accuracy metrics, establish financial anomaly triggers, and support our finance and procurement teams manage and resolve complex billing disputes with external vendors.
  • Budget & Cost Optimization: Work alongside N26 Finance to operationalize vendor requests, track spend variance, and identify efficiency opportunities across domain partner contracts.

Lifecycle Management, Procurement & Compliance

  • MSA & Contract Execution: Support our procurement team in the execution and oversight of N26 Master Services Agreements (MSAs),ensuring ongoing compliance with Security, IT, Legal, Tax, Financial Invoicing, and Business Continuity Plans (BCP) standards.
  • Vendor Onboarding & Offboarding: Conduct rigorous procurement procedures, risk assessments, and technical readiness evaluations to seamlessly onboard and offboard external technology and service providers.
  • Access Rights & Operational Hygiene: Execute critical administrative tasks, including managing hardware/software licensing, access rights governance (adding/revoking), and routine partner-facing communication in strict accordance with N26 security protocols.
  • Audit Interface & Liaison: Act as the central interface for internal and external auditors, facilitating audit requirements and coordinating documentation, evidence collection, and remediations across external vendor stakeholders as well as internal Product and Tech teams.

What you need to be successful:

Background:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or related quantitative field.
  • 2–4+ years of hands-on experience in vendor management, strategic account management, BPO/ITO governance, or consulting/finance operations. Experience working for or with retail banks, neobanks and fintechs is a plus.
  • Foundational accounting knowledge with experience in multi-source invoice reconciliation, cost tracking, and financial dispute resolution.
  • Experience liaising with internal/external auditors or handling compliance, risk assessment, and/or regulatory reviews within tech or banking environments.
  • Proven track record of managing cross-functional projects, designing structured workflows, and delivering under tight timelines. Lean/Six Sigma experience or certification is a plus
  • Ability to manipulate complex dataset views, identify trends, and translate raw data into polished executive slides and actionable insights.

Skills:

  • Good interpersonal and communication skills - ability to work cross-functionally across multiple business units with autonomy.
  • Ability to distil informal customer and partner requirements into problem definitions, dealing with ambiguity and competing objectives.
  • Ability to triage operational issues with both business and technical stakeholders, establish root cause, and propose quality improvement mechanisms.
  • An autonomous attitude, and a ‘get things done’ approach.
  • Fluency in English.
  • International travel might be required (up to 20%).

Traits:

  • Actively help yourself (and others) be successful.
  • Continuously learn and challenge the status quo.
  • Think globally, act locally.
  • Strong bias for action.
  • Give and receive open, direct and timely feedback.

What’s in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
  • Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, discounts to fitness & wellness memberships, language apps and public transportation.
  • As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
  • Vacation days vary depending on your location of work. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
  • A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.
  • A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

Founded in 2013, N26 now has 7 million customers in 24 markets. We employ more than 1,500 employees across 3 office locations in Berlin, Vienna and Barcelona. Besides the main offices, N26 also has local offices in Paris, Madrid, Milan, and São Paolo.

Sounds good? Apply now for this position.

N26 is an equal opportunity employer and values diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status.

title: Senior Analyst - Cybersecurity
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Freshworks is looking for a Senior Analyst- Cybersecurity to join our GTM (Go-To-Market) Cybersecurity team. You'll sit at the intersection of Cybersecurity, customer trust, and go-to-market — acting as a subject matter expert who gives prospective and existing customers confidence and assurance in Freshworks' security posture.

Reporting to the Manager, Cybersecurity, you'll be a hands-on technical security advisor: fielding customer questions, responding to RFPs and security questionnaires, and partnering with Security Engineering and Product Engineering to translate technical security detail into clear, customer-ready answers. This is an execution-focused role within a growing team — you'll work inside the playbooks, templates, and systems the team builds, sharpening them through direct customer contact.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Be a trusted technical security advisor. Serve as a subject matter expert on cloud security, AWS architecture, and product security posture for prospective and existing customers.
  • Own the customer security dialogue. Respond to cybersecurity questionnaires, RFIs/RFPs, and other due diligence documents, and join customer calls jointly with Sales, Pre-Sales, Channel Sales, Customer Success, and Deals Desk teams.
  • Be the single point of contact for cloud security asks. Work closely with Security Engineering and Product Engineering as the primary liaison for cloud security and AWS architecture-related customer questions.
  • Create reusable security collateral. Partner with Security Engineering and Product Engineering to build customer-shareable technical security content based on recurring customer asks.
  • Review contracts with a security lens. Perform contract reviews (MSA, DPA, BAA, and related agreements) for cybersecurity obligations relevant to the role.
  • Coach and upskill the team. Support existing team members in strengthening their technical security knowledge.
  • Work across time zones. Align to different regions/shifts as needed, given the breadth of time zones Freshworks' customers span.
  • 4–7 years of experience in Cybersecurity, with depth in Application Security Architecture, Security Pre-Sales, or Solutioning.
  • Experience with cloud services/technology (AWS) as it relates to cybersecurity.
  • Good understanding of web frameworks and architecture.
  • Any experience in Pre-Sales or Solution Engineering within a SaaS setup is a plus.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills — able to communicate concisely and unambiguously with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfort working in a dynamic, fast-growing environment, with the discipline to respond to customers contextually and on time.
  • Self-sufficient and able to work with minimal direct supervision.
  • Flexibility to work different shifts/regions — this is a mandatory requirement of the role.

Technical Skills

  • Working knowledge of cloud security fundamentals on AWS (IAM, VPC, KMS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub).
  • Familiarity with web application security fundamentals: OWASP Top 10, secure SDLC basics, API security, and encryption standards (TLS, AES-256, key management).
  • General understanding of SaaS security models, multi-tenant architecture, and shared responsibility frameworks.
  • Exposure to security questionnaire and trust center platforms (e.g., Loopio, Responsive, SafeBase) and GRC tools (e.g., Drata, Vanta) is a plus.
  • Ability to read and interpret security documentation, SOC 2 audit reports, and architecture diagrams.
  • Good with automation — comfortable using scripting, workflow builders, or no-code/low-code tools to speed up repetitive tasks.
  • Working understanding of AI/GenAI concepts and how they intersect with data security and privacy, to speak confidently to customer questions in this area.

Certifications (Nice to have)

  • CompTIA Security+ or equivalent foundational certification
  • AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or AWS Solutions Architect – Associate
  • ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity (CC)
  • Certified Cloud Security Knowledge (CCSK)

Soft Skills

  • Clear communication: able to distill security topics for technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • Cross-functional collaboration: comfortable working with Security Engineering, Legal, Product, Sales, and Customer Success.
  • Customer empathy: understands that behind every questionnaire is a customer trying to make a trust decision.
  • Reliability under pressure: able to triage competing customer requests across time zones and deliver consistently.
  • Coachability and a growth mindset, with willingness to mentor others as experience grows.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Prior experience in Pre-Sales or Solution Engineering at a SaaS company.
  • Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, or HIPAA.
  • Exposure to trust center platforms (e.g., SafeBase) or security questionnaire tools (e.g., Loopio, Responsive).

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Enterprise customers don't just buy products — they buy trust. At Freshworks, the Cybersecurity GTM function is the front line of that trust, and this role puts you directly in front of the customers who depend on it. Every questionnaire you close, every call you join, and every piece of collateral you help build moves deals forward and strengthens the confidence customers place in Freshworks. If you want hands-on ownership of real customer security conversations at a fast-growing company, this is the role.

At Freshworks, we have fostered an environment that enables everyone to find their true potential, purpose, and passion, welcoming colleagues of all backgrounds, genders, sexual orientations, religions, and ethnicities. We are committed to providing equal opportunity and believe that diversity in the workplace creates a more vibrant, richer environment that boosts the goals of our employees, communities, and business. Fresh vision. Real impact. Come build it with us.

title: Apotekschef till Apotek Hjärtat Bergvik
description:

Din roll som apotekschef på Hjärtat

Som Apotekschef på Hjärtat ansvarar du för resultat-, drift-, personal- och farmaceutiska frågor på ditt apotek. Du leder ditt team mot att uppnå ditt apoteks ekonomiska mål. För att nå dit coachar och motiverar du personalen i deras dagliga arbete och utveckling. I rollen bidrar du med din farmaceutiska kompetens, engagemang och erfarenhet, till en bättre hälsa för våra kunder och till apotekets framgång.

På Hjärtat kan din karriär ta många spännande vägar. Möjligheterna är många! Läs mer om våra karriärvägar här.

På Bergvik söker vi nu en engagerad apotekschef till vårt apotek som ligger mitt i shoppingcentret. I närområdet finns även ett Hjärtat-apotek vid Maxi, vilket skapar fina möjligheter till samarbete och erfarenhetsutbyte. Vi har ett nära och hjärtligt samarbete mellan apoteken, och det finns alltid en kollega i närheten att bolla både stort och smått med.

Apoteket är rymligt och välplanerat, med en stor och inspirerande egenvårdsavdelning som passar shoppingkunden perfekt. I teamet finns idag fyra farmaceuter och tre apotekstekniker. Dessutom utgår två av våra regionala specialister härifrån – inom kvalitet och varuförsörjning – vilket ger dig ett extra stöd i både utvecklingsfrågor och den dagliga driften.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning där hel- eller deltid kan diskuteras.

Öppettider: vardagar 10–20, lördag och söndag 10–18

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad receptarie, apotekare eller utbildad apotekstekniker. Du är antingen i början av din karriär och vill utveckla dina ledaregenskaper eller så är du en erfaren ledare. Du känner igen dig i beskrivningen:

  • Som ledare är du drivkraftig med ett affärsmässigt tänkande
  • Du är effektiv, initiativrik, mål- och resultatorienterad och ser verksamheten utifrån ett helhetsperspektiv
  • Du har förmågan att motivera, stödja och utveckla andra

Nyfiken på mer? Lyssna på vårt podcastavsnitt om Apotek Hjärtat. Du hittar det här.

På Hjärtat strävar vi efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka. Vi välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund! Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen, skicka in din ansökan redan idag. Om roller kräver det så behöver du genomgå bakgrundskontroller innan anställning. All extern hjälp med rekrytering undanbedes.

Sista ansökningsdag: 2026-10-31

Kontaktperson: josefine.wase.carlbinder@apotekhjartat.se

title: Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter)

title: Software Engineer Singapore South East Asia
description:
Job Overview

You love building tools for fellow engineers. You consider it a craft.

You have strong software engineering fundamentals and have opinions on how to build robust, scalable, and secure software.

You’ve operated infrastructure at scale. You’ve seen it done right, and you’ve seen it gone wrong: Kubernetes, Kafka, Spark, microservices, and all the usual suspects.

Examples of What You’ll Do

  1. Development of our product, including the LLM-based reasoning engine, memory module, evaluation stack, simulation environment, and more.

  3. Help us iterate toward product-market fit in an early-stage, open-ended environment.
  4. Embody our end users (engineers with operational responsibilities), immersing yourself in their needs, pains, and aspirations.

How We Work

  • Less is more: Small teams delivering simple products are more impactful.
  • Culture is critical: We value excitement and chemistry. We only bring in the right people who align with our vision.
  • We’re in-person: We're early, so we must work closely.

The position will be based in Singapore. The ideal candidate will have a valid passport. Non-South African Citizens may apply.

Desired Experience & Qualifications

You love building with generative AI and have had some prior ML/AI experience. You have experience in Rust, C++, Go, Kotlin, or Scala. Our stack is Python, TypeScript, and Go right now, but some experience in high-performance languages is important.

Interested?

A Consultant will be in touch if you are shortlisted for the position. Please consider your application unsuccessful should you not have been contacted within 2 weeks. We will keep your CV on our database and contact you should you match the criteria of any other vacancies.

title: EHS Specialist
description:
Purpose of the Job

To support and implement the site's Environment, Health & Safety (EHS) Management System by ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements, company standards, and global EHS objectives. The role is responsible for identifying workplace hazards, driving corrective and preventive actions, conducting safety inspections and training programmes, monitoring contractor safety performance, promoting a strong safety culture, and ensuring a safe and healthy working environment for employees, contractors, and visitors.

Key Responsibilities

Safety Inspections, Audits & Compliance

  • Conduct regular safety inspections, audits, and surveys across plant areas to identify hazards and unsafe conditions.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable EHS regulations, company policies, and safety standards.
  • Perform workplace risk assessments and job hazard analyses for various departments and operations.

Incident Investigation & Corrective Actions

  • Investigate incidents, near misses, and unsafe occurrences; conduct root cause analysis.
  • Monitor and maintain the EHS Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) database, tracking implementation status and verifying effectiveness.
  • Recommend and monitor corrective and preventive actions to prevent recurrence.

EHS Training & Awareness

  • Conduct EHS induction training for employees, contractors, and visitors.
  • Deliver safety training programmes and awareness sessions on various EHS topics.
  • Promote employee engagement through safety campaigns and toolbox talks.

Safety Management & Permits

  • Support the development and implementation of EHS procedures, SOPs, and work instructions.
  • Review and issue work permits for high-risk activities, verifying compliance with safety controls.
  • Monitor fire protection systems and support emergency preparedness planning and drills.

Contractor & Performance Management

  • Maintain records of contractor EHS evaluations and monitor compliance with site safety requirements.
  • Track site EHS performance against KPIs and prepare reports and dashboards for management review.
  • Experience Required: 4-5 Years in Pharma or Chemical API
  • Qualification: B.Tech- Chemical / Diploma-Chemical or MSc-Chemistry

Make Your Mark with TAPI

Your journey with TAPI is more than a job—it’s an opportunity to make a lasting impact on global health. If you’re ready to lead, innovate, and inspire, we’re excited to welcome you to our team. Together, let’s shape the future of pharmaceuticals. Apply on top of this page and our talent acquisition team will be in touch soon!

Our Commitment

At TAPI, we believe great talent comes from many backgrounds and experiences. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and supportive workplace where everyone can belong, contribute, and grow. We encourage applications from all individuals who share our curiosity, ambition, and values.

title: Woonbegeleider Amstelveen Zonnehuis Juliana
description:
Woonbegeleider Amstelveen Zonnehuis Juliana
28 uur per week

Kun je in de zorg werken zonder zorgdiploma? Jazeker, bij Zonnehuisgroep Amstelland! Een zorgdiploma is voor deze functie niet nodig. Wij vinden jouw motivatie, betrokkenheid en enthousiasme minstens zo belangrijk. Als woonbegeleider ondersteun je ouderen bij zorg- en welzijnstaken, maaltijden en huishoudelijke werkzaamheden. Dankzij jouw aandacht en hulp voelen bewoners zich veilig, gezien én echt thuis. Wil jij werk doen dat er iedere dag toe doet? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog via de sollicitatiebutton van deze vacature woonbegeleider Amstelveen Zonnehuis Juliana.

Wat ga je doen?
Als woonbegeleider Amstelveen Zonnehuis Juliana zorg je samen met je collega's voor een warme, veilige en huiselijke woonomgeving. Je geeft bewoners de persoonlijke aandacht die zij verdienen en sluit zoveel mogelijk aan bij hun wensen en behoeften. Je werkzaamheden zijn verdeeld over drie aandachtsgebieden:

Zorg
Je ondersteunt bewoners bij de algemene dagelijkse levensverrichtingen (ADL), zodat zij zich prettig en comfortabel voelen. Denk hierbij aan het ondersteunen bij:

  • Wassen, douchen, tandenpoetsen en haren kammen;

  • Aan- en uitkleden;

  • Begeleiden bij het toiletbezoek en de persoonlijke hygiëne.

Welzijn
Je draagt bij aan een fijne dag voor bewoners door bijvoorbeeld:

  • Samen een wandeling te maken;

  • De krant (voor) te lezen of een spelletje te spelen;

  • Tijd te nemen voor een gezellig gesprek.

Voeding en huiskamerondersteuning

  • Je ondersteunt bewoners tijdens de maaltijden en zorgt voor een prettig en ontspannen eetmoment;

  • Je zorgt voor een frisse en opgeruimde leefomgeving door te helpen met dagelijkse schoonmaakwerkzaamheden.

Het ondersteunen bij ADL vormt een belangrijk onderdeel van deze functie.

Beschikbaarheid
Je bent beschikbaar van maandag t/m zondag, dus ook in de weekenden en op feestdagen.

Diensten (7 uur)

  • Ochtend: 7.30 - 15.00 uur;

  • Avond: 13.30 - 21.00 uur;

Wij bieden

  • Een bruto uurloon tussen € 15,90 en € 19,58 (FWG 20, CAO VVT), afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring;

  • Een contract dat past bij jouw wensen: oproep of vast;

  • 8% vakantiegeld en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering (13e maand);

  • Onregelmatigheidstoeslag wanneer van toepassing;

  • Klik hier voor alle secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Persoonlijke ontwikkeling
Bij Zonnehuisgroep Amstelland investeren we niet alleen in onze bewoners, maar ook in jou. Daarom krijg je volop mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen via onze Zonnehuisgroep Academie, trainingen, workshops, cursussen en e-learnings. Als woonbegeleider Amstelveen Zonnehuis Juliana volg je daarnaast een korte verplichte basiscursus met de thema's:

  • ADL-ondersteuning en basiszorg;

  • Communicatie en omgangsvormen;

  • Huishouding, maaltijden en voeding;

  • Activiteiten, welbevinden en omgaan met dementie.

Waar ga je werken?
Als woonbegeleider werk je op Zonnehuis Juliana in Amstelveen. Dit zonnehuis maakt deel uit van het complex Zonnehuis Amstelveen. Er zijn vier afdelingen met elk twee huiskamers en een groot balkon. De bewoners hebben allen een vorm van dementie. Door de lange gangen en de opzet van de afdeling hebben de bewoners veel leefruimte. In de eigen slaap-/zitkamer kan een bewoner zich even terugtrekken. Elke afdeling heeft een eigen team met helpenden, verzorgenden IG, verpleegkundigen, voedingsassistenten, woononderbegeleiders en vrijwilligers. De medewerkers vormen een zeer hecht team en doen vaak en graag een stapje extra voor de bewoners.

Wie ben jij?
Een zorgdiploma heb je niet nodig. Affiniteit met de ouderenzorg wel. Je bent er voor bewoners, juist ook tijdens de persoonlijke verzorging. Met jouw professionele en respectvolle houding zorg je ervoor dat zij zich tijdens deze zorgmomenten veilig, vertrouwd en op hun gemak voelen. Daarnaast:

  • Ben je gemotiveerd en werk je graag met ouderen;

  • Werk je prettig samen én kun je zelfstandig aan de slag;

  • Zie je werk liggen, neem je initiatief en verantwoordelijkheid;

  • Ben je communicatief vaardig en help je bewoners met een glimlach;

  • Heb je oog voor hygiëne;

  • Vind je het geen probleem om af en toe in een andere dienst bij te springen.

Interesse?
Wil jij het verschil maken voor ouderen én werken in een warm en betrokken team? Solliciteer dan vandaag nog via de solliciteerbutton van deze vacature woonbegeleider Amstelveen Zonnehuis Juliana. Heb je eerst nog vragen? Bel of app gerust met onze recruiters Rianne (06-15638462) of Peter (06-30515201). Zij vertellen je graag meer over deze functie.

Bij Zonnehuisgroep Amstelland vragen wij standaard referenties op. Ook is een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) onderdeel van de sollicitatieprocedure.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Retail Assistant - Murray Bridge
description:
Want to kick-start your career? Join our outstanding retail team as a Store Assistant at ALDI! No retail know-how needed. We're looking for people with a positive attitude, a strong work ethic, and a willingness to learn!

Our stores are open every day, including weekends and holidays – there's never a dull moment with plenty of variety. We do supermarkets a bit differently, you’ll get to experience all areas of the store rather than just be in one area, giving you lots of variety.

Store Assistants are the backbone of our retail stores and keep our stores running by:

  • Being a customer service superstar and serving customers at the registers with a smile.
  • Keeping shelves stocked with products so that our customers can find all their favourites.
  • Being an expert in stock handling by making sure our products are in date and listed at the right price.
  • Creating eye-catching displays of our ALDI special buys.
  • Keeping the store tidy, organised and looking great.
  • Enjoy a fantastic hourly rate of $31.27 + shift allowances.
  • Full weekend availability will be advantageous.
  • Join a top-notch retail team – we're an "Employer of Choice" seven times over.
  • Be part of a company with purpose - we’re committed to sustainability for our planet, positively impacting our communities, supporting our farmers and suppliers and giving our customers a richer life for less.
  • Average of 20 hours per week.
  • Our team aren’t casuals - benefit from permanent part-time perks, including paid leave, parental leave and sick leave.
  • Start your retail career with us with extensive training and career opportunities with over 80% of our store management roles filled internally.
  • Work in a friendly and supportive environment with small teams.
  • Boost your well-being with the MyALDI Wellbeing program with discounted access to Fitness Passport and health insurance.
  • Support during life’s most important moments including paid parental leave, superannuation on parental leave, up to 5 days paid compassionate leave, natural disaster leave, emergency services leave etc.
  • Need support? Our confidential Employee Assistance Program is available to you and your family, free of charge.

With the opportunity to make a real difference to real people, ALDI is a place you’ll feel proud to work.

title: Fullstack Developer (Europe)
description:
Company Overview

Holafly is a high-growth scale-up revolutionising how businesses and travellers connect to the internet abroad. Since 2018, we’ve empowered travellers in over 200 destinations worldwide with secure and reliable eSIM solutions. With a team of 500+ professionals across multiple countries, we are scaling globally to support travellers with seamless, unlimited data connectivity.

We’re not just connecting people—we’re enabling freedom and peace of mind, ensuring our users stay connected from the second they land, wherever their journey takes them.

The Role

As a Fullstack engineer, you will bridge the gap between high-performance UI and the future of connectivity by building AI-integrated web experiences. Your mission is to ensure our global platform remains resilient, scalable, and intuitive, directly impacting how millions of users access the internet.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architect scalable UIs using React and TypeScript, ensuring every component meets our high standards for performance and accessibility.

  • Backend Support & Integration: Develop and maintain efficient Node.js RESTful APIs to support frontend requirements and business logic.

  • API Standards: Experience working with OpenAPI (Swagger) for documenting and defining robust API contracts.

  • Drive technical excellence by implementing Test-Driven Development (TDD) and comprehensive testing suites to maintain a robust codebase.

  • Collaborate on AI-driven features, integrating intelligent workflows into the frontend to enhance the customer journey.

  • Maintain design consistency by leveraging Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui to build beautiful, functional interfaces.

  • Optimize full-stack efficiency by collaborating on Node.js services and RESTful API integrations.

  • Lead by example in code quality, conducting peer reviews that foster a culture of clean, maintainable code.

Qualifications

  • Strong expertise in React and TypeScript, with a deep understanding of modern state management.

  • Node.js Proficiency: Solid experience building and consuming RESTful APIs using Node.js (Express, NestJS, or similar).

  • Proven commitment to Quality through TDD and experience with Testing Library/Jest.

  • Proficiency in Tailwind CSS and component libraries like shadcn/ui for rapid, high-quality development.

  • Familiarity with AI integration, understanding how to connect frontend layers with LLMs or AI services.

  • Testing Standards: We value consistent quality; we use twd-js as our core frontend testing tool to automate development chores and maintain a high-quality codebase. Familiarity with it (or a similar testing mindset) is a plus.

Nice to Have

  • DevOps Basics: Experience with Docker and containerized environments to ensure local-to-production consistency.

  • Cloud & CI/CD: Knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure and hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines.

title: Forskningsassistent i Statsvetenskap
description:
Vi har kraften från över 50 000 studenter och medarbetare. Studenter som ger framtidshopp. Medarbetare som varje dag bidrar till att Linköpings universitet tar sig an samtidens utmaningar. Vår värdegrund vilar på trovärdighet, tillit och trygghet. Genom att vara modiga, tänka fritt och göra nytt skapar vi tillsammans, med stora och små handlingar, en bättre framtid. Välkommen att söka jobb hos oss!

Om jobbet

Arbetsuppgifterna för denna anställning innebär att tillsammans med forskare kartlägga, analysera och presentera hur kommuner och andra offentliga organisationer arbetar med och vill utveckla användningen av ai i sina verksamheter. Forskningsassistenterna kommer att vara verksam inom forskningsmiljön RIDE som är ett samarbete mellan avdelningarna för Statsvetenskap samt Informationssystem och digitalisering vid IEI, LiU. Arbetsuppgifterna består av att samla in material från kommuner genom dokumentstudier och intervjuer enskilt och grupp, att analysera och på olika sätt presentera detta material. Därtill kan det bli aktuellt att genomföra presentationer och att även bidra till vissa utbildningsuppdrag.

Om dig

Vi söker dig som har en mastersexamen i Statsvetenskap eller motsvarande.

Då en viktig del av arbetsuppgifterna handlar om att möta andra personer fäster vi stor vikt vid erfarenheter av och god förmåga att hantera sådana situationer. Bifoga därför gärna namn på personer som kan intyga detta från tidigare uppdrag, exempelvis från praktikplatser, sommarjobb eller liknande. För anställningen krävs att du har körkort. Goda språkkunskaper på både svenska och engelska är ett krav för anställningen.

Din arbetsplats

Läs mer om vår verksamhet här https://liu.se/organisation/liu/iei/statsv

Om anställningen

Tidsbegränsad anställning på deltid. Tillträde och omfattning enligt överenskommelse.

Lön och förmåner

Linköpings universitet tillämpar individuell och differentierad lönesättning och sker i enlighet med gällande kollektivavtal (RALS/RALS-T) samt universitetets riktlinjer för lönebildning.

Läs mer om förmåner för anställda https://liu.se/jobba-pa-liu/formaner.

Fackliga kontaktpersoner

Information om fackliga kontaktpersoner, se https://liu.se/jobba-pa-liu/hjalp-for-sokande.

Ansökan

Välkommen att skicka in din ansökan med CV och ansökningsbrev senast den 20 september 2026. Du söker denna anställning genom att klicka på knappen "Ansök" här nedan. Ansökan som inkommer efter sista ansökningsdag kommer inte att beaktas.

Vi välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrund, erfarenheter och perspektiv, det berikar och utvecklar vår verksamhet. För oss är det självklart att värna om allas lika värde, rättigheter och möjligheter. Läs om vårt arbete med https://liu.se/artikel/lika-villkor/.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Linköpings universitet har upphandlade avtal och undanber oss direktkontakt från bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av platsannonser.

title: Platform Engineer (564)
description:
Platform Engineer

About the opportunity Drive broad organizational impact by building internal platform capabilities, optimizing infrastructure, and empowering product engineering teams to scale seamlessly.

About our client Our client is a global full-service credit rating agency, providing credit ratings, investor research, and market data across US and European markets with a focus on trust and transparency.

What you'll do

title: Vil du være med til at skabe magi i hverdagen i børnehøjde?
description:
Er du pædagogen med et smittende engagement, et anerkendende menneskesyn og lysten til at gøre en mærkbar forskel? Børnehuset Rørskov søger en aktiv og nærværende kollega, der vil være med til at inspirere og forme rammerne for vores fantastiske børnehavebørn og udvikle dig sammen med os.
Uanset om du er erfaren eller sprudlende nyuddannet, hører vi utroligt gerne fra dig!

Hvem er vi?
Børnehuset Rørskov er et mindre og hyggeligt børnehus beliggende i Store Rørbæk tæt på Frederikssund. Vi har plads til ca. 55 børn (ca. 18 vuggestuebørn og 36 børnehavebørn).
Vi bor med udsigt til marker og er en integreret del af et stærkt og velfungerende lokalsamfund, og vi pakker gerne ladcyklerne eller tager rejsekortet for at tage på eventyr i nærområdet. Hos os hjælper vi hinanden på tværs af hele huset, og vi arbejder for et godt arbejdsmiljø med arbejdsglæde.

Vores pædagogiske fundament
I Rørskov brænder vi for den faglige kvalitet og den dybe relation til det enkelte barn.
  • Husets børnesyn: Tager udgangspunkt i at barnet at kompetent og er ressourcestærkt.
  • Tryg base og børnespor: Vi skaber tryghed ved at gribe børnenes egne interesser, spor og nysgerrighed.
  • ICDP som kompas: Personalegruppen er i gang med ICDP-uddannelsen, som danner fundamentet for vores pædagogiske greb og børnesyn.
  • Nærmeste udviklingszone (NUZO): Vi guider og støtter børnene i hverdagens sociale fællesskaber. Vi arbejder ofte i mindre grupper, så der er tid og ro til at styrke det enkelte barns trivsel og udvikling.
  • Tæt forældresamarbejde: Vi tror på, at åbenhed og dialog er vejen frem, når vi i fællesskab skal skabe tillid og udvikling omkring barnet og vægter dette højt.

Vi tilbyder dig
  • Højt til loftet og pædagogisk frihed: En alsidig personalegruppe, der inviterer til nytænkning og giver dig frihed til at igangsætte kreative aktiviteter ud fra børnekulturen.
  • Faglig udvikling: Gode muligheder for efteruddannelse, løbende sparring og tæt vidensdeling i et stærkt, professionelt team.
  • Medindflydelse: En nøglerolle i den fortsatte udvikling i praksis og af den styrkede pædagogiske læreplan.
  • En hjertevarm arbejdsplads: Engagerede kollegaer, der prioriterer det gode arbejdsmiljø og fælles arbejdsglæde.

Dine primære opgaver
  • Planlægge og gennemføre pædagogiske aktiviteter, der pirrer børnenes nysgerrighed gennem leg og læring.
  • Skabe en tryg, struktureret og indholdsrig hverdag i tæt samarbejde med dine kollegaer og forældre.
  • Guide, støtte og igangsætte pædagogiske forløb i mindre børnegrupper.
  • Bidrage aktivt til teammøder, institutionens udvikling og det gode psykiske arbejdsmiljø.

Vores ønsker til dig
  • Du er uddannet pædagog (nyuddannede er meget velkomne!).
  • Du er nærværende, autentisk og besidder en personlig robusthed i en varieret hverdag.
  • Du har kendskab til den styrkede pædagogiske læreplan og kan omsætte den til praksis.
  • Du evner at inkludere alle børn i fællesskabet med blik for det enkelte barns ressourcer og kompetencer.
  • Du arbejder selvstændigt og struktureret, og du møder både børn, forældre og kollegaer med en åben, anerkendende og positiv tilgang.

Det praktiske
  • Tiltrædelse: Gerne hurtigst eller 10. oktober 2026
  • Ansættelsessamtaler: Vi afholder samtaler løbende, så send din ansøgning med det samme.
  • Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår: Sker efter gældende overenskomst og principperne i Ny Løn.
  • Ansøgningsfrist: 16. september kl. 12.00.

Vil du lege med
Har du spørgsmål, eller har du lyst til at høre mere om den ledige stilling? Så tøv ikke med at ringe til os!
Kontakt dagtilbudsleder Mette Gjerlev Hollund på telefon 23 11 95 35.
Vi glæder os utroligt meget til at høre fra dig og byde dig velkommen i Rørskov!

title: Werkstudent - Customer Contact
description:
Ben jij op zoek naar een interessante bijbaan naast je studie, waarin je jezelf verder kan ontwikkelen in professioneel klantcontact? Klinkt dit als iets voor jou? Dan komen we graag met je in contact!

Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt. Daarom zoeken wij mensen die niet terugdeinzen voor verandering, die van aanpakken weten, die de ambitie hebben om resultaten neer te zetten en die daarom het beste uit zichzelf en hun team weten te halen. Slimmer samen, noemen wij dat.

Wat ga je doen?

Bij het Personal Solutions salesteam van Zwitserleven werk je samen met ervaren professionals die weten hoe je resultaten boekt. Je maakt vanaf dag één onderdeel uit van een gedreven team waar prestatie en plezier hand in hand gaan. Work hard, play hard is hier geen slogan, maar de dagelijkse realiteit.

Je leert van de besten, bouwt waardevolle salesvaardigheden op en krijgt verantwoordelijkheid in een omgeving met een open, energieke sfeer. Successen vieren we samen, net als teamuitjes en borrels.

Je staat klanten vriendelijk en professioneel te woord en zorgt voor juiste, volledige en duidelijke antwoorden. Met jouw communicatieve skills en groeiende kennis werk je actief aan een hoge klanttevredenheid. Geen vraag laat je onbeantwoord: je denkt mee, zoekt het uit en zorgt dat de klant met vertrouwen verder kan.

Wat dit werk extra leuk maakt?

  • Je ontwikkelt sterke gespreks- en schrijfvaardigheden

  • Je bouwt inhoudelijke kennis op in de financiële dienstverlening

  • Je werkt in een team waarin kwaliteit, zorgvuldigheid en klantgerichtheid centraal staan

#LI-DNI

Wat vragen we van jou?

  • Beschikbaarheid van 16-24 uur per week.

  • Basiskennis of ervaring van klantcontact, bijvoorbeeld in een callcenter, klantenservice, horeca of retail (servicegericht).

  • Inzicht in hoe je klanten professioneel en servicegericht helpt.

  • Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk, om informatie duidelijk en foutloos over te brengen.

  • Bereidheid om financiële kennis te leren.

  • On the job leren we je de kennis van pensioenen, verzekeringen en wet- en regelgeving.

  • We investeren graag in training en begeleiding zodat je de benodigde productkennis en vaardigheden ontwikkelt.


Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt pakweg 900 collega's die allemaal vinden dat ze bij een bijzonder bedrijf werken. Je krijgt de mogelijkheid om een belangrijke bijdrage te leveren aan het maatschappelijk relevante thema van pensioenen. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je pensioen goed geregeld is, zodat je zorgeloos kan genieten van je oude dag.


Jij krijgt de kans om echt het verschil te maken als het gaat om duurzaamheid, omdat we in onze bedrijfsvoering en onze beleggingen al jaren de toon aangeven. Uiteraard krijg je een (flexibele) werkplek op een van onze kantoren die behoren tot de beste 7% van de wereld, echt waar.


In ruil voor jouw inzet, talent en vaardigheden krijg je naast je salaris een vakantietoeslag en een dertiende maand, 27 vakantiedagen (bij een contract van 36 uur) en een OV-kaart of reiskostenvergoeding (indien van toepassing) voor de dagen dat je naar kantoor komt. En, niet onbelangrijk vinden wij, je krijgt elk jaar een goed opleidingsbudget, zodat je jezelf kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Zo krijg je de kans om door te groeien, binnen ons bedrijf of daarbuiten.

title: VECĀKAIS RISINĀJUMU UN INTEGRĀCIJU INŽENIERIS/-E ( JAVA)
description:
• Izstrādāsi un uzturēsi visaptverošu risinājumu arhitektūras un tehniskā dizaina dokumentāciju, kā arī veidosi stabilus integrāciju un servera puses risinājumus uzņēmuma lietojumprogrammām un pakalpojumiem

  • Uzņemsies tehnisko atbildību par integrācijas platformām, mikropakalpojumiem un servera puses lietojumprogrammām, nodrošinot vienotu arhitektūru, stabilu sistēmu darbību un atbilstību tehniskajiem standartiem

  • Sniegsi padziļinātu tehnisko atbalstu produkcijas vidēm, tostarp veiksi problēmu pamatcēloņu analīzi, risināsi incidentus, novērsīsi defektus un nodrošināsi trešā līmeņa (L3) tehnisko atbalstu

  • Veicināsi nepārtrauktu attīstību, izvērtējot un ieviešot mūsdienīgas izstrādes pieejas, integrācijas risinājumus, izstrādes rīkus un jaunākās tehnoloģijas, kā arī iesaistoties stratēģisku tehnoloģiju lēmumu pieņemšanā

  • Bakalaura vai maģistra grādu IT vai citā saistītā tehniskā jomā

  • Vismaz 7 gadu profesionālo pieredzi programmatūras izstrādē ar Java, tostarp darbā ar Spring Boot, Spring Integration, Apache Camel, ziņojumapmaiņas platformām (JMS) un datubāzu projektēšanu

  • Padziļinātas zināšanas uzņēmuma līmeņa integrāciju arhitektūrā, tīmekļa pakalpojumu tehnoloģijās (REST/SOAP), mikropakalpojumos, API risinājumos un uz notikumiem balstītas arhitektūras principos

  • Labas zināšanas par programmatūras izstrādes principiem un labo praksi, tostarp risinājumu projektēšanu, koda kvalitātes nodrošināšanu, automatizētu testēšanu, koda pārskatīšanu, CI/CD procesiem un drošu programmatūras izstrādi

Uzņēmumā Cembra mēs aktīvi izmantojam mākslīgo intelektu, lai uzlabotu darba procesus, sadarbību un inovācijas. Mēs sagaidām, ka mūsu darbinieki būs atvērti mākslīgā intelekta rīku izmantošanai, lai ikdienas darbā paaugstinātu efektivitāti un darba kvalitāti.

title: Studentermedhjælper til reception og salg af hudplejeprodukter - N'AGE Hørsholm
description:
Til vores nye flotte klinik i centrum af Hørsholm søger vi en studentermedhjælper, som er et naturtalent indenfor kundeservice og salg af hudplejeprodukter.

Som studentermedhjælp i receptionen spiller du en vigtig rolle i at sikre, at vores kunder får den bedst mulige oplevelse hos N’AGE. Du får du et afvekslende job med faglige udfordringer, der spænder vidt, lige fra femstjernet service til de kunder, der kommer i klinikken, håndtering af bookinger og skriftlig besvarelse af kundehenvendelser, til løbende oprydning og renholdning af klinikken og andre praktiske opgaver.

Du bliver en del af et stærkt lille team af kosmetiske sygeplejersker med en ekstremt høj faglighed indenfor deres felt, men du skal samtidig trives med et selvstændigt ansvar, og have gåpåmod til at lære en masse på kort tid. Du vil blive uddannet og løbende vurderet indenfor både kundeservice og salg af hudplejeprodukter.

Timetallet er 6-10 timer om ugen og i perioder er der mulighed for flere timer. Vagter ligger typisk fra eftermiddag til tidlig aften i hverdagene og engang i mellem om lørdagen. Fleksibilitet indenfor disse rammer er et stort plus. De primære opgaver er:

  • Tage imod kunder, servere kaffe og sikre, at de føler sig yderst velkomne
  • Sikre optimering af behandlernes bookingkalender, booke tider for kunder og besvare telefon og mails
  • Rådgivning i og salg af premium hudplejeprodukter
  • Sikre at klinikken hele tiden fremstår pæn, ryddelig og indbydende
  • Fylde varer på produktdisplays og lager
  • Lettere rengøring og vask
  • Andet forefaldende arbejde
  • Du er i gang med din videregående uddannelse indenfor en studieretning, hvor du har fleksibilitet ift. arbejdstider og kan arbejde ca. 12-15 timer om ugen - gerne mere i ferieperioder
  • Du er serviceminded og din positive væremåde spreder godt humør blandt både kunder og kolleger
  • Du går op i god hudpleje og har virkelig lyst til at rådgive og sælge hudplejeprodukter – dokumenteret salgserfaring er et plus
  • Du fører opgaverne ordentligt til dørs og sikrer, at der er styr på alle ender
  • Du er initiativrig i forhold til egen læring og søger sparring på det, du ikke ved
  • Du er mødestabil og er fleksibel ift. at tage en ekstra vagt indimellem, når der er behov
  • Du har gode formuleringsevner i både skrift og tale, og god IT-forståelse

Er dette den helt rigtige rolle for dig, og kan du se dig selv i N'AGEs stærke værdier, så vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig. Send os venligst dit CV på dansk og nogle supplerende ord om, hvorfor dette studiejob er det helt rigtige for dig. Vi vurderer ansøgninger og afholder samtaler løbende og lukker stillingsopslaget, når vi har fundet vores nye kollega.

title: Materials Handler
description:
Moog is a performance culture that empowers people to achieve great things. Our people enjoy solving interesting technical challenges in a culture where everyone trusts each other to do the right thing. For you, working with us can mean deeper job satisfaction, better rewards, and a great quality of life inside and outside of work.

Job Title:

Materials Handler

Reporting To:

Supply Chain Manager

Work Schedule:

Onsite – Halifax, NS

We are looking for a Material Handler to join our team!

Why Moog Focal?

Our Moog culture is unlike any other!
Every day, millions of people rely on our products for critical power, communication, and control systems. Whether it’s on land, sea, in the air, or underwater, our industry‑leading technologies enable the reliable operation of robots, sensors, and machinery in harsh environments around the world.

At Moog Focal, we are technical leaders in global markets, defining and delivering proven engineering solutions for challenging marine, defense, and industrial applications. We specialize in rugged electro‑optical slip rings, fluid swivels, high‑power electrical swivels, advanced fiber‑optic multiplexers, and subsea control systems. Our pursuit of excellence is driven by our commitment to customers.

We value the skill and dedication of our employees above all else. For people looking for inspiring, meaningful work in a warm, respectful, family‑like environment, Moog Focal will feel like home.

Our Team

We are a team of experienced supply chain experts who take responsibility for doing our part towards delivering quality products and services on time. We put forth our absolute best effort on a daily basis.

We know that we must be exceptional at our jobs in order to provide the service the company needs. We understand the need for continuous improvement in all our activities and we continually look for ways to improve our process.

We treat everyone with respect. We don’t take ourselves too seriously. We want people to be passionate about their work and we believe that we are more productive when we’re at ease and enjoying ourselves.

If you are looking to apply your current experience and to add to your skills through on-the-job training and through mentorship and coaching this is your opportunity. We provide opportunities to build expertise in specialized and critical technical areas. At Focal you are part of a team.

In This Role, You Will:

  • Deliver raw materials, components, and packaging supplies to production lines in accordance with production schedules.
  • Manage and replenish materials using Kanban signals/cards to support just-in-time (JIT) production.
  • Monitor Kanban levels and trigger replenishment to avoid stockouts or overstock situations.
  • Monitor inventory levels and coordinate with Planning and Purchasing to address shortages, overstock, or obsolete items.
  • Ensure proper material handling to prevent damage, contamination, or loss
  • Remove finished goods, scrap, and empty containers from production areas.
  • Operate material handling equipment such as forklifts, pallet jacks, or tuggers (as required).
  • Receive incoming shipments and verify quantities and condition against purchase orders and packing slips.
  • Inspect materials for damage or discrepancies and report issues as needed.
  • Accurately enter receipts into ERP/WMS systems.
  • Label, store, and organize materials in designated locations.
  • Conduct regular audits to ensure Kanban accuracy and compliance with inventory rules.
  • Maintain Visual Management standards for Kanban racks and storage areas.
  • Support cycle counts and physical inventories to maintain inventory accuracy.

Who You Are:

  • A hands-on team player who enjoys being on the floor, supporting production, and keeping materials moving efficiently.
  • A strong communicator and collaborator who works closely with production, planning, and purchasing teams to solve problems and keep operations on track.
  • Detail-oriented and accurate, with a strong focus on inventory integrity and doing things right the first time.
  • Organized and proactive, able to stay on top of multiple priorities in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.
  • A strong communicator and collaborator who works closely with production, planning, and purchasing teams to solve problems and keep operations on track.
  • Comfortable with systems and processes, including ERP/WMS tools and structured inventory or Kanban methods.
  • Committed to safety and quality, following proper material handling procedures to prevent damage or risk.
  • Adaptable and dependable, able to work independently while contributing to overall team success
  • Customer‑focused, building trust through responsiveness and follow‑through
  • Committed to safety and consistent with warehouse best practices.

What You Bring:

  • Experience working in a manufacturing, warehouse, or production environment
  • Familiarity with inventory systems, scanners, or ERP/WMS tools
  • Demonstrated problem-solving ability, particularly in addressing inventory discrepancies or material shortages
  • Ability to operate, or willingness to learn, forklifts and other material handling equipment. Forklift certification is considered an asset.
  • Experience with receiving, inventory control, or cycle counting is considered an asset.
  • Exposure to Kanban or just-in-time (JIT) inventory systems is preferred.
  • Ability to lift up to 50 lbs (22 kg) regularly and perform physical tasks such as standing, walking, bending, and reaching.
  • Comfortable working in a manufacturing environment (noise, temperature variation, etc.) (required).

Want to learn more about Moog Focal? Visit

Focus on You

It is our core belief that if we take care of our employees, they will take care of our customers, partners, shareholders, and communities where we live and work. We embody our Values and live them everyday!

Here are just a few benefits of working with us!

  • Your Personal Life is important to us
    • Flexible working hours
    • Paid Vacation, personal days and other additional company paid days off
  • Your health and wellbeing matter!
    • Competitive Total Pay compensation package, including matching Retirement Savings program and access to complimentary financial advice, Company Profit sharing plan
    • Comprehensive health, dental and vision coverages available on first day of hire, including sickness/disability coverages
    • Family and Employee assistance program
    • Flexible Spending Accounts: HSA & PWA (Healthcare Spending and Personal Wellness accounts)
  • Your Career Development and Progression matters! Grow your career with us!
    • We invest in flex assignments, on the job development, self-directed online courses, mentorship along with other Moog development programs
    • Company Educational Financial and Professional Development support
    • Employee Service Anniversary Recognition program
    • Employee Referral program

We embody a performance culture that empowers and inspires individuals to achieve remarkable things. We make diversity, equity, and inclusion a priority. Our goal is to create a culture where we value, respect, and provide fair treatment and equal opportunities for all employees. Moog aspires to be a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company where employees are empowered to bring their whole, authentic selves to work every day. By recognizing and celebrating our differences, we cultivate an environment that’s the right fit for every person inside of it.

Please Note: Moog Focal follows Controlled Good Regulations. Candidates must be able to apply for registration which entails being willing to provide consent to a Controlled Goods security assessment either at time of hire or at another time while employed with Moog Focal and be either a Canadian citizen or a permanent resident in Canada.

title: Associate, Strategy & BizOps - Mobility
description:
