title: Leg psykolog, Akut- och Bedömnings-mottagning i Umeå
description:
Region Västerbotten arbetar för att god hälsa och hållbar utveckling ska stärka varandra. Vi tar ansvar för en jämlik välfärd och för att forskning och innovation ger resultat.

Psykiatriska kliniken vid Norrlands universitetssjukhus i Umeå är Norrlands största psykiatriska klinik med drygt 400 medarbetare. Vi har tre allmänpsykiatriska vårdavdelningar, rättspsykiatrisk verksamhet, ett flertal specialiserade öppenvårdsmottagningar och behandlingsenheter. Psykiatriska kliniken har flyttat till ett nybyggt hus där vårdmiljön präglas av tanken om miljöns betydelse för främjande av hälsa. Vård- och arbetsmiljö stöttas av modern teknik och forskning.

Psykiatriska kliniken arbetar för en jämlik vård och behandling som grundas på forskning och klinisk erfarenhet.

Vi söker leg psykolog till Psykiatriska akut- och bedömningsmottagningen

Psykiatriska akut- och bedömningsmottagningen riktar sig en bred psykiatrisk patientgrupp. Mottagningens uppdrag innefattar psykiatrisk akutsjukvård, diagnostik och behandling. Ett centralt uppdrag är psykiatriska bedömningar av patienter som remitterats från annan vårdgivare/ aktör. I det ingår i vissa fall att hänvisa patienter till rätt vårdnivå inom regionen. Vi erbjuder vård i form av bland annat läkemedel, utredning, kurativa insatser samt psykologisk behandling. Akut- och bedömningsmottagningen har multiprofessionella team där skötare, sjuksköterskor, kuratorer, psykologer och läkare ingår.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Som psykolog hos oss bidrar du med kunskap och engagemang som får människor att känna sig trygga.

Som psykolog på psykiatrisk akut- och bedömningsmottagning kommer din huvudsakliga arbetsuppgift vara allmänpsykiatriska basbedömningar med nya patienter till vuxenpsykiatrin. Bedömningarna görs på ett strukturerat sätt med fokus på initial diagnostik och bedömning av vårdnivå. Arbete med neuropsykiatriska utredningar förekommer också, även dessa görs i enlighet med klinikens rutiner. I arbetet har du gott stöd av det professionella teamet på mottagningen.

KVALIFIKATIONER
Leg. psykolog med erfarenhet av arbete inom psykiatrisk vård eller annan likvärdig verksamhet. Även erfarenhet av strukturerad diagnostik/utredning är meriterande.

Vi söker dig som tycker om att ta egna initiativ, arbetar strukturerat och vill engagera dig i utvecklings- och förändringsarbeten.

Arbetet förutsätter att du är trygg i din roll som psykolog, att du kan arbeta självständigt och har en god kommunikativ förmåga, både i relation till kollegor såväl som patienter.

Stor vikt fästs vid personlig lämplighet

Anställningsform: Tidsbegränsad anställning.
Varaktighet: 6 månader eller längre, tillträde: 2026-10-26  Eller enligt överenskommelse, upphör: 2027-04-30  .
Arbetstid: Dagtid.

Läs mer om våra förmåner för dig som jobbar med oss på webbsidan

https://www.regionvasterbotten.se/nar-du-jobbar-hos-oss/formaner

Vi strävar efter en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka och välkomnar därför sökande med olika bakgrund.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har vi tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanbeder oss därför bestämt kontakt med mediesäljare, rekryteringssajter och liknande.

Om du har skyddad identitet och vill ansöka så kontaktar du rekryterande chef och skickar sedan in dina ansökningshandlingar via post.

Inför anställning kommer vi att be om ett utdrag ur misstanke- och belastningsregistret.

title: Systemtekniker Lagring och Backup
description:
Senior Systemtekniker – Lagring & Backup

Vill du arbeta med verksamhetskritisk IT-infrastruktur där hög tillgänglighet, säkerhet och stabil drift står i fokus? Vi söker nu en senior systemtekniker inom lagring och backup till ett långsiktigt konsultuppdrag i Örebro.

Om rollen

Som systemtekniker kommer du att arbeta med drift, förvaltning och vidareutveckling av infrastruktur för lagring och backup i en komplex enterprisemiljö. Du blir en viktig del av ett tekniskt team där robusthet, kontinuitet och säkerhet är centrala delar av arbetet.

Rollen passar dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av lagrings- och backupmiljöer och som trivs med att felsöka komplexa tekniska problem, automatisera arbetsprocesser och säkerställa en stabil och tillgänglig IT-infrastruktur.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

  • Ansvara för drift och förvaltning av lagrings- och backupinfrastruktur.

  • Arbeta med NetApp ONTAP och SnapCenter.

  • Genomföra felsökning, analys och problemlösning i komplexa enterprisemiljöer.

  • Säkerställa hög tillgänglighet och kontinuitet i verksamhetskritiska miljöer.

  • Arbeta med VMware vSphere, inklusive konfiguration av datastores och diskar.

  • Utveckla och underhålla script och automatiseringar för effektivare drift och administration.

  • Arbeta med nätverksrelaterade frågeställningar kopplade till lagring och backup.

  • Bidra till vidareutveckling och förbättring av befintliga tekniska lösningar.

  • Dokumentera tekniska lösningar, förändringar och driftrelaterade aktiviteter.

Vi söker dig som

Vi söker dig som har flera års erfarenhet av arbete med lagring och backup i större eller verksamhetskritiska IT-miljöer.

För att vara framgångsrik i rollen ser vi att du har:

  • Minst 5 års erfarenhet av backup och lagring i miljöer med höga krav på tillgänglighet.

  • Minst 4 års praktisk erfarenhet av NetApp ONTAP och SnapCenter.

  • Erfarenhet av felsökning och problemlösning i komplexa enterprisemiljöer.

  • Erfarenhet av scripting och automation.

  • Grundläggande kunskaper inom nätverkskommunikation.

  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av VMware vSphere, inklusive datastores och diskkonfiguration.

  • God förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i både tal och skrift.

Meriterande

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

  • Rubrik RSC/RSC-P

  • NetApp SnapVault

  • NetApp StorageGRID

  • Commvault Backup & Recovery

  • S3-lagring på NetApp

Personliga egenskaper

Som person är du strukturerad, analytisk och lösningsorienterad. Du är trygg i komplexa tekniska miljöer och har ett metodiskt arbetssätt vid felsökning och problemlösning.

Du tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter, samarbetar väl med andra och har förmågan att kommunicera tekniska frågeställningar på ett tydligt och professionellt sätt.

Om konsultuppdraget

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag på heltid med placering i Örebro. Uppdraget löper från avtalets tecknande till 31 oktober 2028.

Du får möjlighet att arbeta i en verksamhetskritisk IT-miljö med avancerad infrastruktur och höga krav på tillgänglighet och säkerhet.

Då uppdraget är säkerhetsklassat kommer säkerhetsprövning att genomföras innan uppdragets start.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Urval och intervjuer kan ske löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Are you ready to discover the role of a Business Analyst in Netcompany?

Joining as a Business Analyst, you will be part of our EUSS Service within the Directorate-General for Health and Food Safety (DG SANTE). You will be responsible for bridging the gap between the business needs and the Eudamed IT solution.
The European database on medical devices is an online platform that provides a living picture of the lifecycle of medical devices that are made available in the European Union (EU). It will integrate different electronic systems to collate and process information about medical devices and related companies (e.g. manufacturers). In doing so, EUDAMED aims to enhance overall transparency, through better access to information for the public and healthcare professionals, and coordination between the different Member States in the EU.

As a Business Analyst you will:

  • Analyse business processes, identify process issues, delays, bottlenecks and propose process improvements and automation opportunities
  • Construct workflow charts and diagrams, study process and system capabilities, write specifications
  • Gather requirements, define scope, use cases, business rules and the business domain while clarifying terminology
  • Conduct impact analysis of a requirement or change request
  • Write and Maintain documentation regarding processes and analysis of the system
  • Liaise between various departments and groups
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders and communicate effectively
  • Collaborate with and drive cross-functional teams and Information Technology (IT) teams

What would make you a fit for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in appropriate field (business analysis, operational research, mathematical modelling, statistics, data analytics or related fields), or 2 years hands-on experience in similar role
  • Detail oriented, analytical, and inquisitive; great analytical, critical thinking and problem-solving abilities
  • Experience with data analysis and modelling
  • BPMN knowledge
  • Excellent MS Office skills (Excel, Visio, PowerPoint)
  • Ability to effectively communicate and influence key stakeholders to support proposed strategies, process improvements and operational decisions
  • Familiarity with brainstorming and collaborative methods and tools
  • Basic experience with/knowledge of machine learning, artificial intelligence
  • Experience in change management
  • Certifications like Business Analyst, Agilist, Scrum, Lean/Sig Sigma, aCAP, or other relevant

Being a part of the Netcompany team, you will be provided with:

If you are looking forward to be part of a diverse environment, and have the opportunity to work alongside well-experienced professionals, on challenging, large-scale projects that directly impact millions of citizens around the globe, then this is the place to be!

By joining Netcompany in Athens, you will be part of a vivid team of 2,300+ tech professionals. When at the office, you'll have the flexibility to work from our three modern, sustainable, and state-of-the-art offices.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter) based in Austria.

This is an opportunity to join an established digital product and contribute to a mobile experience used by a global community.
You’ll work on core product journeys including registration, discovery, profiles, messaging, engagement, and monetization.
The role combines hands-on Flutter development with a strong focus on analytics, performance, and measurable product outcomes.
You’ll help evolve a production mobile application across both iOS and Android while supporting multiple brands and configurations.
The environment is remote-first and internationally distributed, with experienced professionals collaborating across cultures and time zones.
You’ll work with modern Flutter architecture and tooling while contributing to a product where mobile quality and user engagement directly matter.
This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership, technical depth, and building scalable mobile experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and maintain core mobile product experiences across authentication and registration, search and discovery, profiles, photos, messaging, matching, and user engagement.
  • Analyze and improve key product funnels, including registration, upgrades, monetization, messaging engagement, and match or interest conversion.
  • Own and contribute to analytics for core mobile journeys, helping teams understand user behavior and identify opportunities for product improvement.
  • Monitor and improve platform-specific capabilities such as push notifications, deep links, and real-time features.
  • Analyze mobile advertising and in-app purchase revenue metrics and support initiatives designed to improve monetization performance.
  • Support compliance-related analytics and functionality, including consent management, age verification, and user verification.
  • Build and evolve production Flutter applications for both iOS and Android using maintainable, scalable architecture.
  • Contribute to multi-flavor and white-label application delivery, including brand-specific configurations, assets, store identifiers, and Firebase environments.
  • Develop automated tests across unit and widget levels and help maintain high standards of reliability and code quality.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, analytics, and other cross-functional stakeholders in a fully remote international environment.

    • Requirements

    • Strong professional experience with Flutter and Dart 3.x, including experience delivering and maintaining production applications for both iOS and Android.
    • Solid understanding of layered mobile architecture, including separation between UI, domain/use cases and repositories, and framework layers.
    • Hands-on experience with BLoC and Provider, as well as GetIt for dependency injection and GoRouter for navigation.
    • Experience working with Dio for networking and immutable data models using code generation tools such as built_value or similar technologies.
    • Experience building and shipping multi-flavor or white-label mobile applications, including per-brand configurations, assets, store IDs, and Firebase setups.
    • Practical experience writing automated tests, particularly unit and widget tests; familiarity with bloc_test or BDD-style testing is an advantage.
    • Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, performance, maintainability, and production development practices.
    • Analytical mindset with an interest in using product data and user behavior to improve mobile experiences and business outcomes.
    • Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a distributed team.
    • Fluent Russian and B2-level English communication skills.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote, full-time working opportunity.
      • Competitive compensation, with the initial salary level or range shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before employment begins.
      • 28 calendar days of vacation per year.
      • 7 wellness days annually for personal needs, recovery, or household matters without requiring sick leave.

title: Mobile Product Manager / Product Owner
description:
About Us

Flying Bisons is a leading Strategic Design & Digital Consulting company based in Warsaw, with projects across Europe and the Middle East. Our mission is to help our clients Unleash Digital Potential™.

We work at scales where real impact happens: enterprise platforms, government services, and corporate ecosystems used by millions of people. Our projects include national workforce platforms (Qiwa, Ajeer), education ecosystems (Madares), major banks (Bank Pekao, Alinma), global telecoms (Ooredoo, Salam), and international brands (KFC, Hebe, NaTemat, Enel-Med).

Our uniqueness comes from going beyond design craft. As we wrote in our manifestos - Strategic Design - Manifest and Strategic Design - The Future of Design - design craft is only 10% of success. The other 90% - the Invisible 90% - is about navigating politics, aligning stakeholders, and protecting fragile visions until they reach reality.

That’s why we’re building the discipline of Strategic Design - and we want you to be part of it.

About the Project and Scope of Collaboration

You will be involved in building and launching a new mobile application for a client operating in the food industry. The role combines mobile product management, business understanding, coordination, and close cooperation with the client and the team building the application.

During the first approximately 12 months, you will cooperate with Flying Bisons while gradually building deep knowledge of the client's business, industry, customers, processes, and product. You will work closely with key stakeholders, including direct cooperation with the business owner, and become the person connecting the business context with day-to-day product decisions.

The long-term plan is for you to transition directly to the client's organization after the initial collaboration period and continue owning and developing the mobile product from within the business.

This is a strong fit for someone who combines hands-on mobile product experience, analytical thinking, strong stakeholder management, and the ability to quickly understand a new business domain.

Scope of Services

  • Taking an active product role in building and launching a mobile application.

  • Building a deep understanding of the client's business, industry, users, and operational context.

  • Translating business and user needs into clear product requirements, priorities, and decisions.

  • Cooperating closely with UX/UI designers, mobile developers, analytics, and other specialists involved in the product.

  • Coordinating product topics between the client and the delivery team.

  • Working directly with key stakeholders and the business owner.

  • Defining and prioritizing features, user journeys, requirements, and acceptance criteria.

  • Using product data, business insights, and user feedback to support product decisions.

  • Identifying dependencies, risks, and open questions that may affect product development.

  • Supporting the product launch and its further development based on real user and business needs.

  • Gradually taking increasing ownership of the mobile product and its business context.

  • Preparing for long-term ownership and development of the application within the client's organization.

What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who has:

  • At least 3 years of experience as a Product Manager, Product Owner, or in a comparable digital product role.

  • Proven experience in managing and developing mobile applications. This is a must-have for this role.

  • Experience working on a mobile product through at least several stages of its lifecycle, ideally including development, launch, and further growth.

  • A strong understanding of mobile user journeys, usability, engagement, retention, conversion, and product analytics.

  • Experience working closely with UX/UI designers and mobile development teams.

  • Experience in food, foodtech, HoReCa, retail, delivery, or a closely related consumer-facing industry.

  • Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data and business context when making product decisions.

  • The ability to understand business needs and translate them into concrete product actions.

  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Confidence in working directly with senior business stakeholders or business owners.

  • The ability to quickly understand a new business domain and build strong domain knowledge.

  • Independence, ownership, strong self-organization, and a proactive approach.

  • Very good Polish and good English.

  • Availability for regular onsite cooperation in Warsaw.

  • Openness to transitioning to a long-term role directly within the client's organization after approximately 12 months.

Nice to Have

  • Experience developing consumer-facing mobile products with frequent user interaction.

  • Experience taking a mobile application from development through launch and subsequent growth.

  • Experience with mobile product analytics, funnels, retention, engagement, or experimentation.

  • Experience working in an agency, consultancy, software house, or embedded product team.

  • Experience working in a founder-led or family-owned organization.

What We Offer as Part of the Collaboration

  • Approximately 12 months of B2B cooperation with Flying Bisons while building and launching a mobile product for our client.

  • A clear long-term perspective, with the planned transition to the client's organization after the initial collaboration period.

  • The opportunity to participate in building a new mobile application and then continue developing it over the longer term.

  • The opportunity to become deeply involved in the business and gradually take ownership of a key digital product.

  • Direct cooperation with decision-makers on the client side.

  • Close cooperation with experienced specialists from product, design, technology, research, and analytics.

  • A role with real influence on both the initial development and long-term direction of the product.

  • Hybrid cooperation in Warsaw, with approximately 3 days onsite and 2 days remote per week.

  • A project where ownership, analytical thinking, strong communication, and business understanding are genuinely important.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Analytical Wizards is part of the Definitive Healthcare family. We balance innovation with an open, friendly culture and the backing of a long-established parent company, known for its ethical reputation. We guide customers from what’s now to what’s next by unlocking the value of their data and applications to solve their challenges, achieving outcomes that benefit both business and society. Our people are our biggest asset, they drive our innovation advantage and we strive to offer a flexible and collaborative workplace where they can thrive. We offer industry-leading benefits packages to promote a creative and inclusive culture. If driving real change gives you a sense of pride and you are passionate about powering social good, we’d love to hear from you.

Role Overview
We are looking for a skilled Data Scientist with strong expertise in Business Intelligence and data analytics to design, develop, and optimize scalable reporting solutions using Power BI and cloud data platforms.

Core Responsibilities
• End-to-end development: Handling end-to-end design and deployment of advanced Power BI solutions, including data ingestion, storage and presentation layers.
• Advanced Data Modeling: Designing robust semantic models using star and snowflake schemas to ensure optimized relationships and aggregations.
• Complex DAX Development: Writing and optimizing complex Data Analysis Expression (DAX) for measures, calculated columns, and intricate KPIs to handle large datasets.
• ETL & Data Transformation: Developing sophisticated data transformation logic, for instance using Power Query (M language), and building reusables dataflows and pipelines.
• Governance and Security: Implement Row-Level Security and enforce data governance, documentation and quality standards.
• Performance Tuning: Troubleshooting and optimizing existing reports and SQL queries to ensure high performance and usability at scale.

Required Skills

  • Expert Power BI - Proficiency with the entire stack.
  • Power BI Desktop, Service, Gateway and Power BI Report Building. Experience with Power Automate Tableau desktop, cloud, server, data connectivity and prep layers.
  • Advanced SQL: Expert-level skills in writing, optimizing and troubleshooting complex SQL queries (CTEs, analytical functions, stored procedures)
  • Cloud Data Platforms: Hands-on experience with cloud environments like Snowflake and AWS (S3, AWS Sage maker, Athena)
  • Scripting: Proficiency in Python for advanced data processing, automation and custom visuals.
  • Performance Tuning: Experience with tuning tools such as DAX Studio or Tabular Editor is preferred

title: Programmacontroller | Ministerie EZK
description:

  • Afgeronde WO-opleiding.

Contact

title: IT Auditor
description:
At Broadridge, we've built a culture where the highest goal is to empower others to accomplish more. If you’re passionate about developing your career, while helping others along the way, come join the Broadridge team.

As a Manager, IT Auditor in the IT Audit team within the Corporate Audit Group, you will play an integral part in supporting the assessment of the integrity, confidentiality and availability of Broadridge’s technology infrastructure. The IT Audit team is responsible for conducting comprehensive internal audits of our IT systems, applications and processes, identifying risks, and recommending improvements to enhance our operational efficiency and compliance with regulatory requirements. This role demands the candidate possess strong analytical skills, ability to communicate IT risks in business terms, a general understanding of the financial industry and technical proficiency in at least one of the areas of focus below:

• IT Infrastructure Engineering: Distributed Systems, Mainframe, Midrange, Database, Network, Cloud: Configuration Management, Infrastructure Resiliency, Data Encryption

• IT Operations: Performance and Capacity Monitoring, Patch Management, EOL Management, Event Logging, Incident Management, Privileged Access Management, Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery

• Change Management, Problem and Incident Management, IT Asset Management and CMBD, Third Party Management

• IT Governance: KPI Monitoring, Process Innovation, Executive Reporting and Escalation

• IT Support Services: Workstations, Email and Messaging Platforms, Collaboration Tools and Mobile Technologies

• Data Center Engineering: Environmental and Physical Security Controls

• Information Security: Governance, Endpoint Protection, Security Monitoring, Identity and Access Management, Vulnerability Management

• Software Development Life Cycle, DevOps

Responsibilities:

· Audit Lead:

o Lead IT audits in all stages of the audit process, including planning, fieldwork testing, and reporting in collaboration with fellow associates.

· Evaluate Technology Controls:

o Evaluate technology infrastructure, application controls, and associated processes for multiple platforms and technologies deployed at Broadridge.

o Identify control deficiencies, document findings in workpapers, and propose remediation recommendations in collaboration with fellow associates.

· Corporate Audit Activities:

o Support various Corporate Audit activities, including audit issue monitoring and tracking, and contributing to the annual IT risk assessments.

· Professional Skepticism:

o Demonstrate professional skepticism and present audit results to stakeholders in an objective and unbiased manner.

· Relationship Building:

o Develop valuable and trusting relationships with internal business partners by executing efficient audit work and offering suggestions to enhance risk management based on an enterprise-wide view of technology risk management.

Qualifications:

· Experience:

o 5 – 8 years of experience in one of the following areas: systems and network operations and/or administration, internal audit, technology risk management, information security, or IT program management.

· Education:

o BS/BA degree in computer science or information systems from an accredited university or equivalent experience.

· Skills:

o Ability to execute in a fast-paced, high-demand environment while balancing multiple priorities.

o Ability to work effectively in a team environment and across all organizational levels, where flexibility, collaboration, and adaptability are important.

o Strong verbal, written, and social communication skills.

o Good analytical skills with high attention to detail and accuracy and proven problem-solving skills.

o Knowledge and understanding of audit methodologies and tools that support audit processes.

· Certifications:

o Possesses or is in the process of obtaining certification in one or more of the following designations: CISSP, CISA, or CIA.

We are dedicated to fostering a collaborative, engaging, and inclusive environment and are committed to providing a workplace that empowers associates to be authentic and bring their best to work. title: Senior Systems Analyst
description:
Job Description:

The Role

Equity Trading Technology is looking for a Senior Systems Analyst to join our common trading platform which is used across multiple asset classes within Fidelity’s Asset Management business unit.

As a member of our team, you will analyze both current and new business and technical processes, identify system interfaces and dependencies.

Your role will involve translating business functions into clear technical specifications. You will collaborate closely with various teams across business and technology teams. Your insights will help assess systems, identify dependencies, and sequence work effectively. Our product area serves a critical business function, giving you the chance to truly make a difference.

The Expertise and Skills You Bring

  • Third level degree or equivalent and over four years of professional experience
  • General understanding or interest in financial industry, including equity and credit markets
  • Experience capable of assessing the magnitude and impact of work at a granular level, down to individual user stories.
  • Experience with relational databases (e.g., Oracle)
  • Expertise in defining test cases with appropriate detail, ensuring acceptance criteria align with real business value—essentially, ensuring we test the right elements.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the technical acumen to drive outcomes and influence stakeholders effectively.

The Team

In our Equity Technology organization, we are committed to empowering our investment professionals with the very best tools and technologies to deliver world class investment performance to our customers. Our technology experts work across a broad array of investment processes supporting many different types of securities and investment objectives. Through outstanding business and technology partnership, we can offer great solutions to help our customers meet their financial objectives.

Are you ready to make a meaningful impact? Join a dynamic, collaborative team dedicated to enhancing our Trading capabilities within Asset Management.

In our common Trading product area, we empower our Investment Professionals with cutting-edge technology.

As a Senior Systems Analyst, you will analyze both current and new business and technical processes, identify system interfaces and dependencies, and document process and system flows. Your role will involve reverse-engineering existing applications to informing the development of new ones, translating business functions into clear technical specifications. With Asset Management fully transitioned to the cloud, this is an ideal environment to advance your career in a fast-paced and high-visibility space. Our product area serves a prominent user base, giving you the chance to truly make a difference.

You will collaborate closely with various teams within the domain and across business and technology teams. Your insights will help assess systems, identify dependencies, and sequence work effectively. A deep understanding of existing applications and business processes will be essential as we evolve our platform with the latest technological advancements.

This is an opportunity for you to share your technical expertise and strengthen our engineering community. We seek someone passionate about delivering high-quality software products that impress our users, utilizing Agile development practices.

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Finance or a related field.

Skills

  • 4+ years of experience in business-critical applications, with a strong advantage for those knowledgeable in Asset Management/ investment professional business-facing tools.
  • Solid understanding of financial industry, including equity and credit markets
  • Analytical mindset capable of assessing the magnitude and impact of work at a granular level, down to individual user stories.
  • Proficient in navigating modern technologies, including service-based application tiers, SQL, and API design and validation.
  • Experience with both relational databases (e.g., Oracle).
  • Moderate to advanced expertise in analyzing end-to-end processes, utilizing tools and techniques for data presentation and analysis, including REST API technologies.
  • Data-driven approach to decision-making, with the ability to measure, collect, and leverage data effectively while balancing intuition.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the technical acumen to drive outcomes and influence stakeholders effectively.
  • Expertise in defining test cases with appropriate detail, ensuring acceptance criteria align with real business value—essentially, ensuring we test the right elements.
  • Passion for guiding best practices and providing mentorship to fellow Systems Analysts as our team expands.
  • Knowledge of cloud computing platforms, particularly AWS, including familiarity with cloud migration strategies and tools.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity with flexibility and adaptability.

title: Bedemand søges hos Houkjær Begravelse til Sakskøbing og opland
description:
Hvis du forstår dig på mennesker og vil være en del af et dedikeret team – skal du søge dette job.

Om jobbet:

I bedemandsarbejdet ser vi relationen til de pårørende som altafgørende. Vi strækker os langt for de mennesker, der står i en svær situation, og som har brug for, at du kan få øje på deres behov. Vi har lige nu et ledigt job med udgangspunkt i vores afdeling i Sakskøbing med tilhørende filialer: Nr. Alslev, Nykøbing Falster, Maribo, Nakskov og Vordingborg. Vi kan tilbyde en hverdag med en høj grad af selvstændighed og frihed til at planlægge dagens opgaver, sammen med de øvrige i teamet. Jobbet er på gennemsnitligt 37 timer, og du indgår i vagtrul med både aften- og weekendvagter.

Du vil få en grundig introduktion til virksomheden samt jobbet, som bl.a. består af:

  • Samtale med pårørende

  • Lægge afdøde i kiste og klæde dem på

  • Administrative og praktiske opgaver i forbindelse med højtidelighederne, herunder rustvognskørsel

  • Et konstruktivt samarbejde med de mange samarbejdspartnere om det gode forløb

Om dig:

Vi ønsker en kompetent og yderst serviceminded kollega. Du er ansvarsbevidst, sætter en ære i at udføre dit job professionelt og respektfuldt – også selvom du har travlt. Du spiller ind med et godt kollegaskab i teamet. Du er en god bilist med egen bil, har flair for IT, og har en god fysik. Helst har du erfaring som bedemand.

Om os:

Vi er en begravelsesforretning med afdelinger i store dele af landet, i alt 150 ansatte. Vi er ISO 9001-certificeret og har eget akademi, som tilbyder alle ansatte kontinuerlig efteruddannelse.

Tiltrædelses hurtigst muligt.

title: Digital Project Manager
description:
Digital Project Manager
Dublin, hybrid

DEPT® is a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, our 4,000+ specialists deliver growth invention services across Brand & Media, Experience, Commerce, CRM, and Technology & Data. We’re 50|50 tech and marketing, partner-led, and first to move. Clients include Google, Lufthansa, Meta, eBay, and OpenAI. We have been certified B Corp and Climate Neutral since 2021.

JOB PURPOSE

This role is within Experience & Engineering in Ireland. We combine our skills in developing future-ready technical solutions with our expertise in creating beautiful designs to deliver exceptional and engaging digital experiences that build lasting relationships with our clients.

As Project Manager you will drive several web design and build projects from initial concept to delivery. You will manage the full project life-cycle, from requirements capture, through solution design, build, test and deployment. You will also manage project risks, issues and dependencies, to deliver projects on time, on budget and to high quality.

You will work with a range of clients on several different projects and must be adept at managing and building client relationships and reporting on the status of projects. You will be the key contact for clients, advising them on cost, available resources, problems and solutions.

Liaising and updating stakeholders on the status of projects, you will track the project deliverables and match those with agreed deadlines. You will continuously assess working methods and processes and make recommendations for improvement. Oversee projects’ financial budget, notifying stakeholders of key cost implications, changes to budget, spending and cost changes.

YOU:

  • Have a strong background in digital project management working on projects from initial briefing to delivery
  • Experienced in Agile project delivery
  • Have agency experience with a passion for IT, e-commerce and digital projects
  • Have previous experience with project managing the development of web and mobile sites
  • Adept at building effective client relationships and working with several stakeholders to deliver targets
  • Strong communication with excellent presentation, report writing and data analysis capabilities;
  • Can work under pressure, change direction when required and work on a range of client projects at the same time.

WE OFFER:

  • A flexible, hybrid working policy.
  • 26 days holiday (inclusive of 5 compulsory days) plus bank holidays.
  • Cycle to Work Scheme.
  • Pension scheme.
  • EAP and Wellbeing Scheme.
  • The offices are stocked with refreshments available throughout the day.
  • Social and cultural events, plenty of opportunities to connect with colleagues through organised activities and celebrations.
  • Inspirational Talks, bringing the outside in with regular guest speakers and events.
  • Learning and Development, supporting your growth with continuous opportunities to learn and advance.

  • The opportunity for possibility. We want to enable you to do what you do best and help you develop your skills further with training, development and certifications.

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

We are drawn to people who stay curious, move with intent, and never stop inventing. Our culture runs on three values: better together, relentlessly curious, and get sh*t done. It is how we work, how we grow, and how we make things that matter.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

At DEPT®, we take pride in creating an inclusive workplace where everyone has an equal opportunity to thrive. We actively seek to recruit, develop, nurture, and retain talented individuals from diverse backgrounds, with varying skills and perspectives.

Not sure you meet all qualifications? Apply, and let us decide! Research shows that women and members of underrepresented groups tend not to apply for jobs when they think they may not meet every requirement, when in fact they do. We believe in giving everyone a fair chance to shine.

We also encourage you to reach out to us and discuss any reasonable adjustments we can make to support you throughout the recruitment process and your time with us.

Want to know more about our dedication to diversity, equity, and inclusion? Check out our efforts here.

title: Network & Customer Scientist

Network and Customer Scientist

title: Integration Consultant
description:
The Opportunity

Cint seeks an Integration Consultant for our Demand Integrations Team, reporting directly into our regional lead. This is a junior role, supporting the individual regional teams and their customers while having the responsibility for a small, individual portfolio of customers.

The Demand Integrations team's mission is to deliver deep technical expertise and custom software engineering solutions to develop automated workflows for partners via API integrations.

As Integration Consultant in the Demand Integrations team, you will support a set of existing customers and the onboarding of new customers. Cint’s goal is to ensure a quick and successful onboarding within a month. You will also be responsible to monitor the health of integrations for various customers and flag any concerning statistics.

Important metrics for every Integration Consultant are the health of the customer’s integration, the growth of the customer and the speed to launch for every new customer.

The Integration Consultants works closely with Customer Success Team and the Account Management. On the technical side, we provide feedback to our internal tech and product teams about customer feedback and their needs.

Candidates with a can-do attitude and a proactive, hands-on approach, who like to problem solve, embrace and thrive with change and who work well in a team environment will thrive in this team.

Enthusiastic team players will quickly be able to make their mark in our fast-paced and stimulating environment where creativity, personal growth and initiative are encouraged and supported.

This position is focused on our customers in the APAC region and therefore requires the candidate to support and be flexible with these time zones.

Remote working is fully supported as the team is operating globally with various locations (and remotely).

The Team

The Demand Integrations team is part of the overall Customer Experience Org. We work closely with all departments, acting as facilitators between our internal sales and customer success teams and the external customers and their tech teams.

We also close the loop between our internal tech and product teams with customer feedback and feature requests to ensure customer voices are heard.

The Demand Integrations team supports customers globally. Team members are located in various US and European cities as well as in India. Our team supports three main areas: Cint’s Marketplaces, Measurement and Data solutions, and Optimization & Health.

What You Will Do

  • Help build and manage relationships with customers in our allocated portfolio to drive the health and growth of your customer’s integrations

  • Gain an understanding of your customer’s internal structures, key stakeholders and their business and needs

  • Provide technical guidance to customers during all phases of their integration life cycle

  • Collaborate with the other account team members to update them on progress, plan and implement measures to grow your customers

  • Analyse your customers’ integration performance on a regular basis to proactively recommend improvements internally and to your customers

  • Investigate and resolve customer issues in a timely and professional fashion

  • Develop a full understanding the industries in which Cint and your customers operate

  • Ability to understand different and unique customer business models and how an integration with Cint will benefit them

  • Practice superior time management self-discipline to work independently from home

What We Are Looking For

  • Technical experience relating to APIs, API implementation, platform-to-platform integrations

  • Ability to focus on large amounts of data daily

  • Proven stakeholder management experience, with the ability to build and maintain strong relationships with technical and non-technical stakeholders across different teams and levels
  • Strong experience managing stakeholder expectations, handling competing priorities, communicating progress and risks, and driving issues through to resolution

  • Ability to quickly learn and implement new technologies and APIs by following technical documentation.

  • Enjoys solving problems and prefers analytical methods

  • Strong communicator and flexible team player

  • Ability to convey complicated ideas to non-technical stakeholders

  • Tech-savvy, with proficiency in using MS-Office products - key features expertise:

    • Excel V-lookups, Pivot tables with filtering/formulas/etc, de-duplications checks

  • Extremely thorough and detail-oriented in both communication and analysis

  • Curiosity and drive to learn new technologies and systems

  • Must be able to work in an evolving, fast-paced environment and demonstrate the ability to effectively manage multiple tasks simultaneously

  • Confident in speaking and writing in English

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Bachelor’s degree. (Business administration, information technology, Market Research, computer science, information technology, engineering or related discipline preferred)

  • Familiarity with internet protocols and API frameworks, as well as at least one programming language

  • Experience with SQL, Postman, Power BI, JIRA, or Salesforce is a plus

  • Experience with Grafana and/or similar systems

  • Experience with AI

  • Awareness of modern software development methodologies, with emphasis on application architecture and API infrastructure

  • Additional Language skills beyond English

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen; every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.

More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. (www.cint.com)

Additionally, in a world of AI, we want our candidates to understand our approach to the use of AI during the interview and hiring process, so we'd appreciate you reading our AI usage guide.

title: IT Infrastructure Consultant I
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The Infrastructure Consultant I supports asset lifecycle activities, including procurement, inventory tracking, deployment, maintenance, refresh, and disposal of hardware assets. The role assists in monitoring asset compliance, maintaining accurate asset records, generating asset-related metrics and reports, and supporting integration with asset management and IT service management systems. Additionally, the Consultant I prioritizes and responds to inquiries from service desk teams, technical specialists, and business stakeholders, maintains asset governance documentation, coordinates hardware inventory audits, implements asset management process improvements, and supports communication, training, and awareness initiatives related to hardware asset management practices.

Job Responsibilities

  • Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of IT assets, including procurement, deployment, transfer, refresh, return, and disposal.
  • Maintain accurate asset inventory records and ensure data integrity in IT Asset Management (ITAM) tools and CMDB.
  • Monitor stock levels, weekly Physical stock verification and perform reconciliations activity with IT Asset Tools.
  • Coordinate technology refresh programs and track asset replacement activities.
  • Manage IT asset disposal and scrap processes, ensuring compliance with company policies and audit requirements.
  • Prepare and analyze inventory, refresh, compliance, and utilization reports.

Eligibility Criteria

  • 4–6 years of experience in IT Asset Management, Inventory Management, IT Operations, or a related discipline.
  • Experience managing end-user computing assets such as laptops, desktops, monitors, and peripherals.
  • Understanding of IT asset lifecycle management and inventory control processes.
  • Experience supporting audits, asset reconciliation, and compliance activities.

Preferred Skills

  • Hands-on experience with ITAM tools such as ServiceNow.
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, Lookup functions, and reporting.
  • Knowledge of CMDB, ITIL framework, and IT Service Management processes.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Experience working in a large enterprise or multi-location environment.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high levels of accuracy and compliance.

Primary Skills

Incident Management, Information Technology (IT) Infrastructure, Infrastructure Monitoring, IT Infrastructure Support, Problem Resolution

Shift Time

General Shift (India)

Recruiter Info

Dipti Murudkar

dsudh@allstate.com

About Allstate

Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.

title: Working Student / IDP: Software Development (m/f/d)
description:
Shape the future of real-world LiDAR applications at a leading high-tech company in Munich.

At Blickfeld, we develop our own innovative LiDAR technology based on a frictionless MEMS mirror. Our sensors create 3D data of the environment in high resolution. These 3D point clouds contain detailed information about the exact size, position and speed of objects which allows us to analyze the shape and movement of people, vehicles and other objects. Blickfeld LiDAR sensors excel in a wide variety of applications, e.g. security, volume measurement and traffic management, and smart cities.

As part of our innovative software team, you will contribute to the integration of our LiDAR sensors into modern security environments. After an onboarding phase, you will work on interoperability testing, system integrations, and the development of device software components with a high degree of autonomy.

Tasks

System Integration: You test the interoperability of our LiDAR devices with various Video Management Systems (VMS) and Video Surveillance (CCTV) platforms to ensure seamless integration into existing security environments.

Testing Environment Maintenance: You maintain and extend the testing environment used for validating device integrations, including installation and configuration of VMS platforms, and troubleshooting of the test infrastructure.

Software Development: You contribute to the development and maintenance of our device integration stack by implementing, integrating, and debugging software components running on the device.

Validation & Documentation: You document integration results, compliance findings, and system behavior to support interoperability improvements and product development.

Requirements

Education: You are currently studying for a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Communications Engineering, or a comparable technical field.

Programming Skills: You have solid experience with Python and TypeScript. You are familiar with object-oriented design principles and comfortable working in complex development environments.

Automated Testing: You have experience with testing frameworks such as PyTest and understand modern testing practices. You are capable of manually counting points within the 3D point cloud space.

Technical Stack (Plus): Experience with one or more of the following technologies is a plus: GitLab, Docker, CI/CD tools, CMake, Asyncio, Protobuf, gRPC, RTSP, gStreamer, open6d, SOAP, Web Services, ONVIF.

Mindset: You enjoy solving technical problems and contributing to the development of reliable and robust software solutions.

Communication & Languages: You have fluent English skills and are comfortable collaborating in an international team.

Benefits

Purpose & Technology: You work on cutting-edge LiDAR technology that enables safer, smarter, and more efficient environments—from critical infrastructure to smart cities—while contributing directly to real-world impact.

Ownership & Growth: You operate in a dynamic high-tech environment with flat hierarchies, where individual initiative is valued, responsibilities are clear, and your ideas can quickly make a difference.

Agile Ways of Working: You operate in an agile setup with monthly sprints and releases, allowing you to regularly implement new ideas and see tangible results.

Work Model: We value face-to-face interaction within the team, so you will mainly work on-site at the office. In some cases, and by arrangement, you can occasionally work from home.

Team & Culture: You become part of a passionate, technology-driven team where like-minded people inspire each other and share a strong enthusiasm for innovation.

Team Spirit: We value a positive working environment and promote team spirit through regular team events and joint activities.

Health & Fitness: You receive a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership, giving you access to a wide range of sports and fitness activities such as yoga, swimming, climbing, and team sports across Munich.

Excellent coffee: For the perfect start to the day and in between, we have extremely good coffee to support and invigorate you.

We, Ivan Smolin (Hiring Manager) und Yves Gendronneau (HR) are looking forward to your application, including your CV, certificates and a motivation letter.

title: Senior Applied Value Engineer - UKI Energy, Oil & Gas
description:
Celonis is the global leader in Process Intelligence and the pioneer of Process Mining technology. As one of the world’s fastest-growing enterprise SaaS companies, we are changemakers pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. We invest heavily in advanced AI capabilities—specifically our Process Intelligence Graph—to turn data insights into immediate business action. We believe there is a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by placing intelligence at the core of every business process. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team:

As an Senior Applied Value Engineer you push the envelope in solving mission-critical problems for our customers. You will work with our most strategic customers, understand their strategy and key challenges, and build Celonis solutions using cutting-edge AI technologies from market leaders such as Microsoft and OpenAI. With Celonis’ market-leading Process Intelligence (PI) Platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ businesses and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to executives, and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization to increase Celonis' footprint at those customers..

Role Description

  • As a Senior Applied Value Engineer you are pushing the envelope in solving business-critical problems for our customers. You will be working with our most strategic customers, understanding their objectives and key challenges, and building Celonis solutions using the world’s leading Process Intelligence (PI) platform in combination with the largest AI and ML technology partners, such as Microsoft, OpenAI and Databricks. With Celonis’ Process Intelligence (PI) platform we feed operational context to AI so it understands our customers’ business and enables them to industrialize AI unlocking real ROI on AI deployments and at scale. There is no AI without PI. You will prototype these solutions, demonstrate their value to Executives and ensure successful implementation, adoption and value realization in order to increase the footprint of Celonis at those customers.

Key Responsibilities:

  • AI Discovery & Solutioning: Understand customers AI strategy and business critical challenges. As Celonis product & domain expert, find the best problem-solution fit and translate customer requirements into innovative solutions that move the needle
  • Hackathons & Prototyping: Think out of the box, have a „can-do“ attitude and don’t shy away from complex problems. Leverage cutting edge AI technologies to rapidly build creative prototypes in customer hackathons solving business critical problems
  • Agentic Process Transformation: Support our customers in achieving real ROI out of AI deployments at scale enabling a fundamental shift in business operations from traditional, rule-based automation to the use of autonomous AI agents empowered by our Celonis Process Intelligence Platform
  • Proof projects: End-to-end execution of business-critical Proof-of-Value projects, incl. architecture and deliver secure, scalable LLM/agent systems with RAG, tools, and guardrails; integrating with enterprise data, identity, and compliance frameworks.
  • Ensure Successful Project Outcome: Senior Applied Value Engineer stay involved with projects until agreed value & adoption thresholds are reached
  • Specialize in Domains or Industries: To scale knowledge across the organization Senior Applied Value Engineer specialize in domains (e.g. supply chain) and industries

Requirements:

  • 6+ years of experience leading technical pre-sales, including defining AI roadmaps, building compelling ROI/TCO business cases and prototyping of machine learning and generative AI solutions.
  • Understanding of generative AI techniques like RAG, few shot learning, prompt engineering, multi-agent orchestration, multimodal understanding, or fine-tuning that are used to build high-impact use cases like intelligent chatbots and automated text processors.
  • Understanding of business processes across sectors (such as Supply Chain or Finance) with the ability to translate high-level business needs into specific AI use cases.
  • Good knowledge of Python and common ML libraries (such as LangChain, pandas, pydantic, sklearn, PyTorch) as well as data engineering tools and technologies.
  • Strong presentation skills to both internal and external stakeholders (including executives), whether whiteboarding sessions or formal readouts and demos.
  • Bachelor’s Degree required, Masters Degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or related fields, or equivalent work experience preferred.

Nice to have (big plus):

  • Hands-on experience building agentic systems using LLM orchestration, RAG, function calling, and prompt engineering, while ensuring safety through rigorous evaluations and guardrails.
  • Working knowledge of tools in the LLM ecosystem such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, or other OSS packages.
  • Experience in deploying and monitoring models at scale across major cloud platforms (AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, GCP Vertex)

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis makes processes work — for people, companies, and the planet. Powered by process mining and AI, the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform integrates process data and business context to create a living digital twin of business operations. We enable thousands of companies worldwide to understand how their business actually runs and, together with their partners, build intelligent solutions that transform and continuously improve the way they operate — unlocking billions in value. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.

Job Category: Communications

Employee Type: Regular

The Opportunity:
As a CACI Public Affairs and Media Engagement Specialist, you will support the U.S. Central Command Public Affairs Directorate (CCPA) which serves as the principal advisor to the Commander on all internal and external communication strategies in support of the command's theater objectives. CCPA supports the command's obligation to keep the American people and regional audiences informed about USCENTCOM operations that lead to defeating our adversaries, improving regional stability and promoting and protecting U.S. interest in the USCENTCOM area of responsibility (AOR).

Responsibilities:
As a Public Affairs and Media Engagement Specialist, you will be responsible for researching, writing, and coordinating responses to queries from national and international media; and when directed and under U.S. Government supervision, answer media queries on a non-attributable basis. Media Operations Officers will be expected to support emergent 24/7 shift surge requirements, when necessary, in case of crisis or other unforeseen events, or as directed by the Director, CCPA to provide media monitoring and real-time feedback on news and press coverage on key USCENTCOM issues, providing the ability to alert CCPA leadership of breaking coverage and to correct inaccurate reporting. Other duties will include:
• Conduct research as required to write public affairs guidance (PAG), response to query (RTQ), and talking points (TPs) on key issues.
• Plan and conduct daily conference calls with community PAOs, including both higher PA headquarters and USCENTCOM component PA offices.
• Provide media training expertise to key senior USCENTCOM leaders or designated spokespersons.
• Develop and provide preparatory books for key senior USCENTCOM leaders in advance of media engagements.
• Develop and provide a timely rollup summary product to CCPA leadership and other USCENTCOM leaders at the end of a media engagement or coverage of a high-profile issue.
• Assist in the preparation of senior CCPA personnel in executing weekly public affairs briefings with the Pentagon Press Corps, including the development of timely talking points, taking notes on the briefings, researching queries in real-time as required, etc.

Qualifications:

Required:
• Current Top Secret Security Clearance.
• Proficiency with the AP Stylebook.
• 5-7 years of experience in developing public affairs plans and media campaigns.
• Bachelor's degree.
• Current U.S. passport.
• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications.
• Ability to exercise sound judgment in a dynamic and highly political environment is required.
• Must exhibit excellent organizational, time management, writing, editorial, and presentation skills.
• Fluency in written and spoken English.
Desired:
• Defense Information School (DINFOS) Qualification Certification.
• Experience in U.S. military public affairs
• Experience in a country or area in the USCENTCOM Area of Responsibility - Middle East or Central Asia.
• Joint professional military education (JPME).

title: Senior CSAT Analyst
description:
Etraveli Group is a leading global flight technology provider, specializing in flight sales and offering flight content delivery and fintech products. We are here to solve complexity, by connecting millions of flights and travelers across the globe, from search and selection to trip and beyond.

We partner with major global platforms such as , Google Flights, Skyscanner, and Kayak, providing seamless flight booking and related services. Our B2B portfolio includes Precision, our specialist in travel fintech; Tripstack, our B2B Flights as a Service Provider and world leader in virtual interlining, serving as the gateway to Etraveli Group’s flight content and fulfillment services; Wenrix, the AI Infrastructure for profitable growth in air; and , Sweden’s leading flight comparison site. We also operate our own online travel agency brands including Gotogate, Mytrip, and Flightnetwork.

Every day we strive to make the world smaller for our customers and bigger for our people. Our diverse team of more than 3200 passionate professionals is what makes us the industry’s tech wonder and the best in the world at what we do.

Major offices in Sweden (HQ), Greece, India, Canada, Israel, Poland, UK, and Uruguay.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior CSAT Analyst that will be responsible for measuring, monitoring, and interpreting customer satisfaction across Etraveli Group. Beyond core analytical delivery, the role serves as a technical reference point for the CSAT Analytics team and as a senior voice in stakeholder engagement — proactively championing the use of CSAT data in business decision-making in CS, Product, UX, and E-Commerce. The Senior CSAT Analyst drives the translation of customer feedback into actionable insight at a strategic level, and operates as a key liaison between the CSAT Analytics team and senior stakeholders across the organization.

The position reports to the Associate Director.

CSAT Survey Design and Administration

  • Design, build, and maintain CSAT surveys across post-interaction touchpoints (phone, email, chat, self-service) using Qualtrics or equivalent survey platforms.

  • Manage survey distribution logic, sampling rules, and response collection to ensure representative and reliable data.

  • Administer survey tooling, including user access management, configuration, and troubleshooting of technical issues.

Data Analysis & Insights Generation

  • Lead complex, multi-variable analysis to uncover drivers of satisfaction and dissatisfaction across segments, markets, and interaction types

  • Define and own the analytical approach for ad hoc deep-dives and strategic insight requests

  • Translate findings into strategic recommendations, connecting CSAT insight to business outcomes

Continuous Reporting and Dashboards

  • Drive the CSAT reporting framework, ensuring reports are fit for purpose at all levels of the organization

  • Present findings independently to senior management and cross-functional leadership, with a narrative that connects data to decisions

  • Proactively identify and escalate emerging trends before they become issues

Stakeholder collaboration

  • Act as the primary CSAT Analytics contact for senior stakeholders across CS, Product, UX, and E-Commerce

  • Proactively shape the insight agenda — identifying where CSAT data can inform decisions before stakeholders ask

  • Champion data-driven decision-making by advocating for CSAT as a core input in strategic and operational discussions

Team development and Knowledge Sharing

  • Mentor analyst(s) within the CSAT Analytics team, providing guidance on analytical methods, output quality, and stakeholder communication

  • Review and quality-assure analytical work produced by the team

Data Quality and Process Improvement

  • Own methodology and standards for survey design and CSAT measurement across the team

  • Drive continuous improvement in analytical workflows and data quality practices

Requirements

  • 3–6 years as analyst/researcher, with a track record of independently leading analytical projects end-to-end

  • Proven record of data analysis skills: experience of gathering, organizing and analyzing

  • Proven ability to present to and influence senior stakeholders

  • Excel/Google Sheets proficiency

  • SQL proficiency

  • Dashboard/viz tool familiarity (Tableau, Looker, Power BI etc.)

  • Proficiency in text analytics, and experience in advanced segmentation or statistical analysis

  • Fluent English

  • High attention to detail

  • Able to work independently under deadline pressure

  • Strong communication and storytelling skills

  • Proactive and improvement-oriented

Benefits

An opportunity to be a part of a global rapidly growing organization where we value the opinions of each member of the team. You will interact with the management on a regular basis and help them make data driven business decisions. With us you can enjoy:

  • Hybrid working environment - having the opportunity to work both remotely and at the office enabling you flexibility! Additionally you'll have two weeks per year that you can choose to work from a remote location. #LI-Hybrid.

  • Health Benefits - Through partners we offer a private health insurance plan. We also offer the possibility to use 2 extra medical leave days in case of need.

  • Monthly ticket restaurant card - to spend in one of the thousands affiliated restaurants, cafes, stores or supermarkets across Greece.

  • Office in the City – We sit on bright, large floors (over 4000㎡!) in central Athens. Just a short walk from the Megaro Mousikis Metro station.

  • We have a relaxed & fun work environment where you can enjoy free breakfast, coffee/tea, play ping pong or video games.

  • We also like to schedule company/department/team activities and events outside the office space!

Diversity disclaimer

At Etraveli Group we value diversity; we pride ourselves on being a company represented by people of all different backgrounds. During hiring, we are committed to ensure equality and promote diversity in the workplace at every selection stage. As such, we provide the same opportunities for all candidates regardless of race, religion or belief, gender, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other characteristic protected under any anti-discrimination law or regulation.

title: Customs & Compliance Specialist
description:
THE ROLE:

  • Ensure full compliance with HMRC, Irish Revenue, Windsor Agreement, EU Customs and other applicable trade and regulatory requirements.
  • Oversee and monitor all import and export customs activities, ensuring accurate declarations, documentation, tariff classifications, customs valuations, origin determinations and duty calculations.
  • Maintain and continuously improve the Internal Control and Customs Compliance Management System (CCMS), ensuring all identified risks are properly mitigated, and all relevant controls are implemented, monitored and effectively maintained.
  • Maintain AEO accreditation and all relevant customs authorisations, ensuring adherence to the requirements of HMRC and other regulatory authorities
  • Lead internal customs and compliance audits, support HQ audit requirements and act as the primary contact for external audits and inspections conducted by HMRC, Irish Revenue, the Federal Office of Economics and Export Control, Chambers of Commerce and other regulatory bodies
  • Work closely with Finance, local operational stakeholders and Central Customs to resolve any relevant Customs compliance and any relevant issues (import duties, VAT,Customs Broker documentation) as a priority, ensuring timely escalation, accurate reporting and compliance at all times
  • Provide customs-related reporting, compliance metrics and performance indicators to Group Customs and senior management as required.
  • Drive continuous improvement, process documentation and standardisation, automation initiatives and compliance awareness across the business to strengthen governance and operational efficiency
  • Lead or support customs, trade compliance and broader regulatory projects, while providing expert guidance and ad-hoc support to the business as required

RESPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES INCLUDE

Customs Management:

  • Oversee accurate and timely import/export customs declarations for the UK and Ireland, ensuring correct classification, valuation, origin, duty and VAT treatment.
  • Ensure customs clearance documentation is complete, accurate, retained correctly and available for audit purposes.
  • Manage relationships with customs brokers, shipping agents, logistics providers, HMRC, Revenue Commissioners and other relevant authorities.
  • Monitor changes in customs legislation and ensure business processes are updated accordingly.
  • Act as Customs Coordinator to reperesent local entity to communicate with HMRC and with Central function, and connect with any relevant projects
  • Maintain and optimise customs authorisations and simplifications, including AEO, customs warehousing and postponed VAT accounting.
  • Work with Finance and operational teams to ensure accurate customs reporting, duty payments, VAT treatment and HMRC MSS reconciliation.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce customs costs, improve efficiency and support automation of customs processes, including but limited to Free Trade Agreements analysis, implementation of Special Programs or systems impelementations.
  • Act as local key user for future Customs system implementation.

Regulatory & Operational Compliance:

  • Develop, implement and maintain customs, trade and wider regulatory compliance policies, procedures and control documentation.
  • Ensure adherence to Group Customs, HQ Compliance, statutory requirements and relevant corporate standards.
  • Lead and support internal and external audits, providing required documentation, evidence and corrective action plans.
  • Ensure legal and regulatory requirements are met to obtain and maintain relevant customs authorisations, certifications and accreditations.
  • Identify, investigate and resolve compliance issues, discrepancies, audit findings and control deficiencies.

Risk Management & Governance:

  • Conduct monthly customs transactional data and risk assessments across customs, trade, product compliance and wider regulatory activity.
  • Manage and monitor the Internal Control and Customs Compliance Management System, ensuring identified controls are maintained, reviewed and evidenced.
  • Maintain effective controls, SOPs, fallback processes and governance frameworks to reduce operational and compliance risk.
  • Perform periodic checks and reviews of declarations, classifications, valuations, origin determinations and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure corrective actions are implemented where compliance gaps or control weaknesses are identified.
  • Report compliance risks, audit outcomes, control effectiveness and performance indicators to senior leadership and Group Customs.
  • Promote a culture of compliance, risk awareness and continuous improvement across the business.

Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Partner with Supply Chain, Finance, Procurement, Commercial, Operations and Accounts Payable to embed compliance into daily processes.
  • Act as the key contact for customs and compliance queries, providing practical guidance to internal stakeholders.
  • Work closely with Group Customs, Export Control, regional compliance teams and external advisors to ensure alignment with corporate and regulatory requirements.
  • Train and update teams on customs, trade and compliance requirements in a clear and practical way.
  • Build strong relationships with external service providers, authorities, auditors and professional advisors to support compliant and efficient operations.Conduct workstation assessments and arrange appropriate equipment where required.
  • Manage properly Customs Broker relation, define standard procedures and service metrics
  • Ensure compliance with health & safety policies and maintain relevant records.
  • Proven experience in customs operations and trade compliance, ideally in a distribution or automotive/tyre‑related sector.
  • Strong understanding of UK and EU customs regulations, Incoterms, duty reliefs, and cross‑border processes.
  • Experience working with any Customs System (e.g. SAP GTS)
  • High attention to detail with the ability to balance operational urgency and regulatory accuracy.
  • Strong communication skills and confidence to work with senior stakeholders.

This is a hybrid full-time role with 3 days in the office, based in our head office at Botanica Ditton Park (Datchet) and will report into Business Governance & Support Services Manager Loredana Bugan.

If you wish to apply, please send your CV and a cover letter via Continental Internal Jobs Portal.

The closing date for this vacancy is 7th August 2026.
