title: Planvoorbereider Nieuwbouw
description:
Een goed plan zie je straks terug op de bouw. Omdat alles klopt: technisch, organisatorisch en in de samenwerking. En precies daar ligt jouw kracht. Als planvoorbereider nieuwbouw zorg jij dat een ontwikkelconcept verandert in een maakbaar en haalbaar bouwplan. Je overziet het geheel en zorgt dat alles staat vóór de uitvoering begint. Je signaleert risico’s op tijd en maakt keuzes die het verschil maken op de bouwplaats. Je werkt aan woningbouwontwikkelingen in de regio. Projecten waar je al vroeg aan tafel zit en waar jouw invloed zichtbaar is in het eindresultaat.

Welkom bij Van Wijnen Dordrecht!

Bij Van Wijnen Dordrecht ben je onderdeel van een grote familie met 32 vestigingen door heel Nederland. Hier combineer je de kracht van een landelijke organisatie met het warme contact van een lokaal team. Als planvoorbereider nieuwbouw bouw jij bij Van Wijnen elke dag aan iets dat ertoe doet. Samen maken we Nederland een stukje mooier, stap voor stap, steen voor steen. Dát bouwen wij.

Vestiging Dordrecht wordt jouw thuisbasis, uiteraard samen met de bouwlocaties van jouw eigen projecten. Het unieke aan vestiging Dordrecht is dat hier onze Van Wijnen wortels liggen. In 1907 werd in Dordrecht het bedrijf opgericht en daarmee zijn we al meer dan 100 jaar actief in de regio. Niet alleen onze projecten bevinden zich in de buurt, maar ook onze collega’s komen uit Dordrecht en omstreken. Daardoor heerst er op onze vestiging een echt Dordtse ‘poten-in-de-klei’ cultuur. Een no-nonsense mentaliteit met korte lijnen en het gevoel alsof we nog steeds een familiebedrijf zijn. Naast onze nieuwbouw projecten zoals de Willemstoren, Erasmusveld of een mooi transformatieproject zoals Glashaven werken wij ook aan bijzondere renovatieprojecten zoals het WTC Rotterdam en zorglocaties zoals het Smeetsland project.

Dit bouw jij

  • Strakke regie in de planfase: Jij pakt vanaf het begin de leiding. Je verwerkt de feedback van de klant direct in het ontwerp en zorgt dat het plan inhoudelijk en procesmatig volledig klopt voordat het project naar buiten gaat.

  • Vertaling van klantwensen: Je vertaalt de wensen van de klant naar een concreet, gedetailleerd en uitvoerbaar bouwplan. Hierbij stuur je strak op maakbaarheid, haalbaarheid en kosten, waarbij je precies overziet hoe alle onderdelen samenkomen en wat dit betekent voor de uitvoering.

  • Proactief risico- en kansenmanagement: Je ziet risico’s voordat anderen ze zien en zorgt dat ze geen probleem worden op de bouw. Tegelijkertijd signaleer en identificeer je slimme kansen om het project nog beter, efficiënter of slimmer in te richten. Daarin ben je een stevige en waardevolle sparringpartner voor de projectleiding, de klant en externe partijen.

  • Borging van kwaliteit en afstemming: Tijdens de verdere uitwerking bewaak je de kwaliteit op detailniveau. Je zorgt dat tekeningen en specificaties naadloos op elkaar aansluiten en behoudt de regie in de afstemming met adviseurs zoals architecten, constructeurs en installateurs.

  • Toetsing en regelgeving: Je toetst de plannen continu aan de geldende wet- en regelgeving, waardoor het vergunningstraject en de voorbereiding vlekkeloos en zonder onnodige vertraging verlopen.

Aan het eind van de dag weet je: dit is werk dat telt.

Wat jij zoekt in een baan

  • Werken bij een vooruitstrevend en duurzaam bouw- en vastgoedbedrijf waar collega’s met trots elke dag het verschil maken;

  • Uiteraard kan je bij ons rekenen op een marktconform salaris, aangevuld met vakantiegeld en een gratificatieregeling;

  • Een goede werk-privébalans vinden we belangrijk, daarom kan je bij ons deels thuiswerken en zelf je werktijden indelen;

  • 30 verlofdagen plus een individueel budget van 13 extra dagen (op basis van 40 uur) – want bij hard werken hoort ook zéker tijd voor ontspanning;

  • Een smartphone naar keuze en laptop van Van Wijnen;

  • Duurzaam rijden in een elektrische leaseauto met laadpas of een mobiliteitsbudget;

  • Ontwikkelen en groeien? Dat kan bij ons zeker! Via het Van Wijnen College krijg jij alle ruimte om jouw talenten te laten bloeien;

  • En natuurlijk een werkgever die jouw gezondheid en vitaliteit serieus neemt, met een mooie bijdrage aan je aanvullende zorgverzekering.

Hier herken jij jezelf in

  • Bouwkundig fundament: Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding Bouwkunde én relevante ervaring als planvoorbereider of senior werkvoorbereider in de woningbouw.

  • Natuurlijke organisator: Je overziet moeiteloos het grote geheel, zonder de cruciale details in de uitwerking uit het oog te verliezen.

  • Analytisch en overtuigend: Je onderbouwt technische keuzes haarscherp en durft daadkrachtig richting te geven in het voorbereidingsproces.

  • Proactieve risico- en kansenzoeker: Je denkt meerdere stappen vooruit; je tackelt knelpunten vóór ze op de bouw belanden en grijpt slimme kansen om de kwaliteit te verhogen.

  • Verbindende regisseur: Je schakelt en onderhandelt moeiteloos op elk niveau — van architect en constructeur tot de klant en projectleiding.

  • Eigenaarschap en lef: Je pakt de regie, neemt graag verantwoordelijkheid voor het eindresultaat en staat stevig in je schoenen.

Toe aan een baan waarin jij écht het verschil maakt? Kom bouwen aan een duurzame toekomst met collega’s die barsten van de energie. Enthousiast? Reageer dan snel via de button hieronder. Wie weet bouwen we binnenkort samen aan iets moois!

title: Strategisk/taktisk inköpare av konsulter
description:
Vi söker en Strategisk/taktisk inköpare av konsulter till en myndighet inom elkraft.

Detta är ett konsultuppdrag. Stationeringsort är Stockholm.

Tjänsten är på heltid.

Uppdraget innebär ett nära samarbete med kunden vilket ställer stora krav på flexibilitet och samarbetsförmåga.

Uppdraget

Som strategisk/taktisk inköpare arbetar du med att stödja verksamheten i behovet av konsulttjänster, främst genom avrop från ramavtal inom projektering, teknik och IT samt genom upphandlingar av konsulttjänster och andra kategorier. Du ansvarar för hela inköpsprocessen från framtagning av förfrågningsunderlag till avtal och utvärdering samt arbetar med kontraktsförvaltning, uppföljning och utveckling av inköpsprocesserna.

Arbetsuppgifter

Utforma uppdragsbeskrivningar och krav för resurs- och uppdragskonsulter tillsammans med beställare samt sammanställa och granska anbudsformulär och skicka avropsförfrågningar till ramavtalsleverantörer via e-Avrop

Hantera frågor från leverantörer och verksamheten under anbudstiden, sammanställa utvärderingsunderlag, stödja beställare i utvärderingen, ta fram beslutsunderlag för tilldelning samt tilldela och upprätta avtal och inköpsorder

Driva och genomföra upphandlingar enligt LUF:s olika förfaranden samt upphandla ramavtal och kontrakt främst inom kategorin konsulter med ABK09 som grund

Förvalta och följa upp avropsavtal och leverantörer, inklusive förlängningar, budgetutökningar, indexregleringar, fakturahantering, arkivering samt uppföljning av inköpsordrar

Ha kontakt med säkerhetsenheten kring säkerhetsklassning, avtal och status i processen samt med ramavtalsleverantörer i avtalsfrågor och stödja verksamheten i övriga inköpsfrågor

Arbeta proaktivt för att minska ledtider och effektivisera avropsprocessen samt bidra med kompetens för att kontinuerligt förbättra arbetssätt, rutiner, mallar och processer inom inköpsnära frågor

Arbeta med masterdata för konsulter samt viss rapportering och statusuppdatering och använda digitala system för avrop och upphandling, bland annat ServiceNow (SVEA) och e-Avrop

Krav (OBS, obligatoriska)

Du ska ha minst en av följande eftergymnasiala utbildningar: högskole/universitetsexamen inom ekonomi, teknik, juridik eller beteendevetenskap, alternativt KY-/YH-examen inom inköp.

Du ska ha arbetat med inköp/upphandling/avrop i minst 8 år.

Du ska ha minst 5 års erfarenhet av att genomföra avrop/upphandling i enlighet med LOU eller LUF.

Du ska ha minst 5 års arbetslivserfarenhet inom IT-, bygg-, energi-, eller elkraftsbranschen.

Du ska ha minst 5 års erfarenhet av strategiskt inköpsarbete.

Du ska ha genomfört minst 2 ramavtalsupphandlingar med avtalsgrund ABK09.

Du ska ha minst 2 års erfarenhet av att avropa/upphandla konsulter utifrån ett inköpsperspektiv som huvudsaklig arbetsuppgift vilket bedöms vara minst 50% av en fulltidstjänst. Arbetet ska ha genomsyrat hela processen från framtagning av avrops- eller upphandlingsunderlag till kontraktering.

Flytande svenska i tal och skrift.

Meriterande

Du bör ha minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet av att avropa/upphandla tekniska /projekterings-/IT-konsulter, inom de senaste 5 åren.

Du bör ha minst 3 års arbetslivserfarenhet av att avropa/upphandla projekteringar/markåtkomst/tillstånd/team inom de senaste 5 åren.

Du bör ha lett och genomfört minst 3 upphandlingar enligt förhandlat förfarande.

Du bör ha arbetat minst 3 år med strategiskt utvecklingsarbete inom inköp med goda resultat.

Övriga krav

Säkerhetsprövning: Säkerhetsprövning och registerkontroll krävs.

Om oss

Centios övergripande mål är att vara ett konsultbolag som erbjuder smarta och hållbara lösningar som utvecklar samhället på ett positivt sätt.

Våra medarbetare erbjuds villkor som är anpassade för individen. Det innebär att arbetstider, arbetsomfattning, arbetsplats och kompetensutveckling så långt som möjligt anpassas utifrån medarbetarens behov.

Bland våra medarbetare hittar du engagerad personer som brinner för samhällsutveckling. Vi jobbar i små grupper där du kan bidra med dina erfarenheter samtidigt som du får ta del av andras kunskap och erfarenhet.

För oss är det viktigt med välmående och att hitta en sund balans mellan arbete och fritid. Därför har vi en nollvision mot stress och sätter trivsel och hälsa främst.

Läs gärna mer om oss på centio.se.

Vänligen skicka ditt CV på svenska.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

title: Tehniskais spēļu mākslinieks(-ce) /Technical Game Artist
description:
Mēs meklējam talantīgu un proaktīvu Tehnisko spēļu mākslinieku, kurš pievienosies mūsu komandai. Šajā lomā Tu būsi svarīgs savienojums starp mākslas, dizaina un izstrādes komandām, nodrošinot gan radošus, gan tehniski kvalitatīvus rezultātus.

  • Nodrošināt tehnisko atbalstu dizaina komandai, palīdzot risināt tehniski sarežģītus uzdevumus un darbā ar programmatūru un rīkiem, tostarp strādājot ar spēles kodu/Blueprints;
  • Nodrošināt praktisku atbalstu māksliniekiem un inženieriem aktīvu veiktspējas un validācijas jautājumos, kā arī palīdzēt risināt spēles problēmas un kļūdas;

  • Veidot spēles aktīvus un vidi pēc pieprasījuma (spēt palīdzēt Game Artist kolēģiem viņu uzdevumos noslodzes gadījumos);
  • Zināšanas rakstzīmju animācijā (spēja rediģēt un attīrīt animācijas);
  • Izstrādāt un uzturēt tehnisko dokumentāciju komandas vajadzībām;
  • Sekot līdzi aktuālajām un nākotnes tendencēm grafikas programmatūrā un aparatūrā;
  • Sadarboties ar iekšējām komandām, lai radītu idejas uzlabojumiem un priekšlikumiem;
  • Sadarboties ar izstrādātājiem, dizaina komandu un iesaistītajām pusēm;
  • Uzturēt projektus un darba failus, kā arī skaidri komunicēt izpildes termiņus;
  • Piedalīties dizaina pārskatēs, komandas sanāksmēs un ideju ģenerēšanas sesijās.

We are looking for a talented and proactive Technical Game Artist to join our team. In this role, you will act as a key link between art, design, and development teams, ensuring both creative and technically high-quality results.

  • Provide technical support to the design team, assisting with complex technical tasks and working with software and tools, including game code/Blueprints;
  • Provide hands-on support to artists and engineers in asset performance and validation, and help resolve in-game issues and bugs;
  • Develop and implement automation processes within the art department;
  • Create game assets and environments on request, supporting Game Artists during peak workload periods;
  • Apply character animation knowledge, including editing and cleaning animations;
  • Develop and maintain technical documentation for team use;
  • Stay up to date with current and emerging trends in graphics software and hardware;
  • Work with internal teams to generate ideas for improvements and proposals;
  • Collaborate with developers, the design team, and stakeholders;
  • Maintain project files and ensure clear communication of delivery timelines;
  • Participate in design reviews, team meetings, and brainstorming sessions.

Prasības:

  • Vidējā speciālā vai augstākā izglītība;
  • Angļu valoda vismaz B2 līmenī (mutiski un rakstiski) darba pienākumu veikšanai - darbam ar uzņēmuma iekšējām sistēmām un ikdienas saziņai ar citiem starptautiskajiem departamentiem;
  • Vismaz 3 gadu pieredze spēļu izstrādē;
  • Zināšanas C++, Python vai MAXScript;
  • Pieredze ar versiju kontroles sistēmām (Git, Perforce);
  • Pieredze ar 3D rīkiem (3ds Max, Maya, Blender u.c.);
  • Labas Unreal Engine zināšanas (Niagara – priekšrocība);
  • Pieredze ar daļiņu sistēmām;
  • Pamatzināšanas Adobe rīkos (Photoshop, Substance);
  • Labas komunikācijas, analītiskās un problēmu risināšanas prasmes;
  • Spēja strādāt ar vairākiem uzdevumiem, ievērot termiņus un veidot dokumentāciju;
  • Spēja strādāt patstāvīgi un komandā;
  • Spēja skaidri komunicēt idejas starp komandām.

Būs priekšrocība:

  • Izglītība dizainā, multimedijos vai līdzīgā jomā;
  • Pieredze ar citiem spēļu dzinējiem;
  • Zināšanas ZBrush vai līdzīgos rīkos;
  • Pieredze ar renderēšanas rīkiem (piem., Corona);
  • Spēcīgas skriptēšanas prasmes (C++, Python, MAXScript);
  • Izpratne par WebGL;
  • Pieredze ar AI rīkiem vai LLM;
  • Pieredze iGaming nozarē.

title: Sterilization Associate Process Engineer
description:
We are the people who give possibilities purpose

BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities.





Job Description

About the Role

Join BD and play a key role in supporting our Ethylene Oxide (ETO) sterilization operations. As an Associate Process Engineer, you will help ensure safe, efficient, and compliant sterilization processes while driving quality, operational excellence, and continuous improvement. This role offers the opportunity to work across Production, Quality, Maintenance, Supply Chain, and EHS teams to support critical manufacturing operations that impact healthcare worldwide.

What You'll Do

  • Support daily EtO sterilization operations to ensure safety, quality, and production objectives are met.

  • Monitor sterilization process parameters and review cycle records for compliance with approved specifications.

  • Troubleshoot process and equipment issues and support investigations related to deviations, non-conformances, and customer complaints.

  • Execute validation and qualification activities, including IQ/OQ/PQ, requalification, and new product sterilization projects.

  • Analyze process data to identify opportunities for optimization, improved chamber utilization, and cost reduction.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure smooth and efficient sterilization operations.

  • Support preventive maintenance programs, equipment upgrades, and reliability improvement initiatives.

  • Prepare and maintain technical documentation, validation reports, CAPAs, change controls, and operating procedures.

  • Ensure compliance with ISO 11135, ISO 13485, GMP, FDA, and company quality system requirements.

  • Participate in audits, risk assessments, HAZOP reviews, and continuous improvement projects.

  • Monitor key operational metrics and drive improvements in process performance and product release efficiency.

  • Promote a strong safety culture by adhering to all environmental, health, and safety requirements related to EtO operations.

Job Requirements

  • Diploma in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Fresh graduates are welcome to apply. Relevant internship or industrial experience in manufacturing environments will be an advantage.

  • Knowledge of sterilization processes, validation activities, or process engineering is preferred.

  • Familiarity with GMP, FDA regulations, ISO 13485, ISO 11135, or other regulated industry standards is advantageous.

  • Problem solving ability to interpret process data and identify improvement opportunities

  • Good communication and interpersonal skills

  • Commitment to workplace safety, quality, and operational excellence.

  • Singaporean (s) and Singapore (s) only.

What's In It for You

  • Competitive full‑time compensation package and benefits

  • Paid company holidays (public holidays, rest days, etc.)

  • Opportunities for career development and growth

  • Convenient company transportation provided

Why Join Us?

To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive.

We believe that when people connect in person, we learn faster, collaborate more deeply, and build a stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face-to-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success.

To learn more about BD visit .

title: Senior Database Engineer
description:
Senior Database Reliability Engineers (DBRE) keep database systems that support all user-facing services and many other Grab production systems running smoothly 24/7/365. DBREs are a blend of database engineering and software developers. They apply sound engineering principles, operational discipline, and mature software development and automation (with Agentive AI capabilities). They specialize in databases, such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Vector databases. In that capacity, DBREs are peers to SREs and bring database expertise to the SRE and Infrastructure teams and our engineering teams.

The Day-to-Day Activities

  • You will implement best practices across supported datastores ( MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Vector database's).
  • Improve the end-to-end platformization of the database lifecycle to support feature-ready agentic workflows.
  • Transform database platform self-service capabilities into reusable APIs for cross-platform integration.
  • Enhance database reliability and performance across Grab while partnering with application teams to ship solutions.
  • Improve database observability through metric tracking, anomaly detection, and preventive automated actions.
  • Collaborate across platform and application engineering teams to safely deploy production changes and reduce database-related incidents.
  • Provide database expertise to engineering teams through schema migration reviews, query optimization, and performance tuning solutions.
  • Automate database infrastructure and empower engineering teams by delivering self-service tools.
  • Improve database client library, connection pooling, stability, scalability, capacity planning, and performance tuning for Grab's infrastructure.
  • Develop database infrastructure that can scale to support hundreds of thousands of concurrent users.
  • Build the best High Availability (HA) and Business Continuity / Disaster Recovery (BC/DR) solutions.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation to support database production issues across services.

The Must-Haves

  • At least 6 years of experience running MySQL/PostgreSQL databases in large Environments
  • Knowledge in infrastructure automation (Python Programming)
  • Awareness of cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP)
  • Experience with SQL
  • Experience with Linux
  • Experience with stable and secure systems management practices.
  • Knowledge of data modelling and data structure design skills.
  • Experience with AI and Agenting AI capabilities to enhance the automation and platform features.

Life at Grab

We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:

  • We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance.
  • With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.
  • Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave, and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave
  • We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.
  • Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours

What We Stand For At Grab

We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that provides equal opportunity for Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. We consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, race, religion, age, gender, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

title: Fraud Investigator - Accidental Damage (12 Month FTC)
description:
At 1st Central, everything starts with our people.

As one of the UK’s leading motor and home insurers, we use smart technology, data and great service to make insurance fast, fair and simple for over 1.4 million customers. We’re proud to create an environment where people feel supported, trusted and able to grow - whether that’s developing new skills, taking on fresh challenges or making a real impact every day. If you’re looking for a role where you can make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.

Are you a detail-oriented investigator with a talent for uncovering the truth? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment? If so, we have the perfect opportunity for you!

We’re on the hunt for a talented Fraud Investigator – Accidental Damage to join our Counter Fraud Services team in Salford Quays, Manchester on a 12-month fixed term contract.

Working as part of a growing and vibrant team, you’ll be responsible for protecting the business and customers from the impact of fraud. You’ll be investigating a caseload of suspected fraudulent accidental damage claims by conducting telephone interviews with our customers to gather crucial information. Collaborating with internal colleagues, stakeholders and third-party suppliers to evaluate and investigate evidence, enabling you to make an informed decision on each claim.

Core skills we’re looking for:

  • ​Investigative: You’ll be proficient in gathering and analysing evidence, interviewing customers and conducting thorough investigations.
  • Analytical: You’ll have an ability to analyse data to detect patterns and anomalies that may indicate fraud.
  • Problem-solving: You’ll think creatively and strategically to resolve complex claim cases.
  • Negotiation: In some cases, fraud investigators may need to negotiate with suspects or other parties to obtain information or resolve issues.

Working flexibly, you'll spend the first 3 months in the office full-time for training and support, then hybrid begins with 4 days at home and 1 day in the office. But if you prefer to be in the office more, that's good with us too.

What’s Involved:

  • You’ll manage a portfolio of suspected opportunistic and organised accidental damage fraud claims.
  • You’ll conduct telephone interviews with customers.
  • You’ll engage with external suppliers such as accident investigators, motor engineers, and key specialists.
  • You’ll conduct open source and desktop investigations using databases like CUE and HPI.
  • You’ll assess evidence such as police reports and engineering findings.
  • You’ll support telephony targets while providing professional customer service.
  • You’ll process payments on claims files within limits.
  • You’ll ensure accurate reserves on claim files.
  • You’ll meet fraud KPIs and targets.
  • You’ll ensure compliance with financial crime procedures.
  • You’ll comply with the requirements, and act in accordance with, the Group Code of Conduct and Fitness and Propriety policies at all times
  • You’ll ensure compliance with Company Policies, Values and guidelines and other relevant standards/ regulations at all times.

Experience & Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of basic motor insurance fraud.
  • Proven track record of managing caseloads with adherence to SLAs.
  • Good knowledge of FCA Consumer Duty principles.
  • Basic understanding of indemnity and ability to identify straightforward policy-related issues.
  • Familiarity with fraud indicators.
  • Ability to deploy and interpret ClearSpeed results.

Skills

  • Strong communication skills (verbal and written).
  • Good time management and organisation.
  • Solid problem-solving skills.
  • Computer literacy (Word, Excel).
  • Proactive approach to learning.

Behaviours

  • Self-motivated and eager to learn.
  • Embraces feedback.
  • Demonstrates a positive attitude.

Ready to join us?

We’re looking for talented people who want to make a real impact for our customers, colleagues and business. Apply today and discover where a career at 1st Central could take you.

title: Data engineer (f/m/d)
description:
Created in 2016, Free2move simplifies mobility-related uses by offering a wide range of services to satisfy everyone's 🚘 travel needs.

With Free2move, you can rent a city car for shopping or for your stay in Italy or book a car park during your weekend in Paris... all in one click, on our web/mobile platform! 📲

Born from the merger of the Stellantis Group 🚗 and the start-up TravelCar, Free2move, thanks to its agility and its spirit of conquest has managed to establish itself in just few years as a reference player to revolutionize the mobility of all travellers.

Having become the #1 reflex for more than 6 million users, Free2move operates in more than 170 countries across different continents 🌎 and is available in 30 languages and 26 currencies. 5000 partners trust us and several hundred thousand vehicles are available!

If you want to join a team of +650 experts and bold international projects, then you're in the right place! 🎯

You will evolve in an ultra-dynamic, innovative, agile, internationally-focused structure and integrate our talented teams, full of ideas and motivation and with multidisciplinary skills, at the crossroads of the digital eco-system and the fast-changing automotive sector.

At Free2Move, data science and analytics are at the very core of our products and decision-making. Our analytics team tackles a wide range of impactful topics—from influencing key business decisions and optimizing operations, to putting the algorithms that govern critical aspects of our products into production.

You will be joining our dedicated Pricing Analytics team, which takes charge of all topics related to pricing.

We deeply understand pricing dynamics and use this expertise to build and improve Machine Learning algorithms that define our pricing in real-time.

Your Next Missions As a Data Engineer in our team, you will own the full lifecycle of data products and act as a technical leader.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Collaborating closely with Data Scientists to bring state-of-the-art, real-time pricing algorithms to production for millions of users.

  • Taking full ownership of the data pipelines within the Pricing Analytics scope.

  • Architecting and building the right systems to solve highly complex or vaguely defined problems.

  • Engaging with cross-functional stakeholders to lead the design, development, optimization, and productionization of ML and ML-based solutions.

  • Managing the infrastructure on which our Pricing algorithm runs and taking responsibility for the performance of the pricing ML system.

  • Leading cross-team efforts to leverage and scale our ML infrastructure for model development, training, and deployment needs.

  • Writing well-crafted, well-tested, readable, and maintainable production-quality code.

Who You Are & What You Bring We believe in team success over individual achievement and foster a highly collaborative environment. To thrive in this role, you bring:

  • Education: A degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related quantitative field.

  • Coding Expertise: Expert-level proficiency in SQL and Python, with a strong track record of writing clean, modular, optimized code for complex data transformations. (Note: Previous experience as a Data Scientist is a strong plus!)

  • Data Modeling: Significant hands-on experience modeling enterprise Data Warehouses using dbt (including Kimball methodology, dimensional modeling, star schemas, data testing, and data lineage).

  • Cloud & Big Data: Strong experience with the Databricks ecosystem (Delta Lake, PySpark, Unity Catalog, SQL Endpoints, Serverless compute) and AWS cloud infrastructure (S3, IAM, KMS, DataSync).

  • Orchestration & DevOps: Solid experience writing and orchestrating complex production DAGs using Apache Airflow (or MWAA), managing deployments with Docker/Kubernetes, and working with CI/CD pipelines (Git, GitHub Actions, Terraform).

  • Data Visualization: Hands-on experience building, optimizing, and maintaining enterprise dashboards using Tableau, PowerBI, or Databricks SQL Dashboards.

  • Modern Workflows: A habit of actively leveraging AI tools (like Claude and Databricks AI features) to accelerate pipeline creation, automate dbt documentation, and write smart PR review guardrails.

  • Compliance & Security: A solid understanding of GDPR requirements, including how to enforce PII masking, access control policies, data retention, and auditing via Unity Catalog.

  • Mindset & Communication: An analytical mindset capable of translating complex business requirements into scalable, bulletproof data marts and KPI metrics. You prefer simple, efficient, well-tested code over fragile architectures. You can also communicate complex technical concepts clearly to business stakeholders and domain teams (Pricing, Customer, Advanced Analytics).

  • Languages: Fluency in English (written and oral) is required to work effectively in our international context.


What we offer 🎁


Working at Free2move means becoming part of a tribe in which the culture of performance rhymes with a good atmosphere. It is also:

  • A start-up spirit supported by a large Group

  • The opportunity to revolutionize the uses of mobility with us!

  • A neat integration to start well

  • Lots of possibilities for development

  • Collaboration with multidisciplinary and international teams

  • International projects to perfect your background!

  • An access to our E-Learning platform 📚 : for the development of languages and other skills...This list is not exhaustive...

Permanent contract

Location : France, Spain or Italy

Package :

  • Annual gross salary package depending of your experience: +/- 50/60K€

title: Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter) based in Romania.

This is an opportunity to join an established digital product and contribute to a mobile experience used by a global community.
You’ll work on core product journeys including registration, discovery, profiles, messaging, engagement, and monetization.
The role combines hands-on Flutter development with a strong focus on analytics, performance, and measurable product outcomes.
You’ll help evolve a production mobile application across both iOS and Android while supporting multiple brands and configurations.
The environment is remote-first and internationally distributed, with experienced professionals collaborating across cultures and time zones.
You’ll work with modern Flutter architecture and tooling while contributing to a product where mobile quality and user engagement directly matter.
This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership, technical depth, and building scalable mobile experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and maintain core mobile product experiences across authentication and registration, search and discovery, profiles, photos, messaging, matching, and user engagement.
  • Analyze and improve key product funnels, including registration, upgrades, monetization, messaging engagement, and match or interest conversion.
  • Own and contribute to analytics for core mobile journeys, helping teams understand user behavior and identify opportunities for product improvement.
  • Monitor and improve platform-specific capabilities such as push notifications, deep links, and real-time features.
  • Analyze mobile advertising and in-app purchase revenue metrics and support initiatives designed to improve monetization performance.
  • Support compliance-related analytics and functionality, including consent management, age verification, and user verification.
  • Build and evolve production Flutter applications for both iOS and Android using maintainable, scalable architecture.
  • Contribute to multi-flavor and white-label application delivery, including brand-specific configurations, assets, store identifiers, and Firebase environments.
  • Develop automated tests across unit and widget levels and help maintain high standards of reliability and code quality.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, analytics, and other cross-functional stakeholders in a fully remote international environment.

    • Requirements

    • Strong professional experience with Flutter and Dart 3.x, including experience delivering and maintaining production applications for both iOS and Android.
    • Solid understanding of layered mobile architecture, including separation between UI, domain/use cases and repositories, and framework layers.
    • Hands-on experience with BLoC and Provider, as well as GetIt for dependency injection and GoRouter for navigation.
    • Experience working with Dio for networking and immutable data models using code generation tools such as built_value or similar technologies.
    • Experience building and shipping multi-flavor or white-label mobile applications, including per-brand configurations, assets, store IDs, and Firebase setups.
    • Practical experience writing automated tests, particularly unit and widget tests; familiarity with bloc_test or BDD-style testing is an advantage.
    • Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, performance, maintainability, and production development practices.
    • Analytical mindset with an interest in using product data and user behavior to improve mobile experiences and business outcomes.
    • Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a distributed team.
    • Fluent Russian and B2-level English communication skills.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote, full-time working opportunity.
      • Competitive compensation, with the initial salary level or range shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before employment begins.
      • 28 calendar days of vacation per year.
      • 7 wellness days annually for personal needs, recovery, or household matters without requiring sick leave.
      • Employee referral bonuses of up to $5,000 for successful recommendations.
      • 50% reimbursement for professional training, international conferences, and industry events.
      • Corporate discounts for English language lessons.
      • Health support of up to $1,000 gross per year per employee where corporate medical insurance is unavailable, which can be used toward private health insurance or eligible medical expenses for employees and close relatives.

title: System Verification Engineer Specialist
description:
About Justera Group
Justera Group AB is a leading Swedish IT consulting firm with great experience specializing in building high-performing technology teams and delivering end-to-end IT solutions. Led by dynamic female executives, Justera Group focuses on helping businesses harness the power of digital technologies to continuously evolve in today’s rapidly changing economy. The company has deep expertise in IT consultancy, software development, and recruitment services, providing clients with purpose-driven, well-trained consultants who consistently deliver efficient and effective results. Justera Group manages the entire talent lifecycle, from hiring to ongoing management, ensuring the right fit for each project on time and within budget. With their strong commitment to quality, collaboration, and client success, Justera Group is a trusted partner for technology innovation across Sweden.

About the Role:
We are looking for an experienced System Verification Engineer to join a General Services organization within the automotive industry. The team is driving the transformation toward connected services and new business models, developing solutions that improve customer productivity, efficiency, and profitability.

As an End-to-End System Verification Engineer, you will be responsible for verifying services across the complete customer journey—from onboard functionality in the vehicle to offboard systems, customer portals, mobile applications, and supporting service infrastructure.

You will work in a cross-functional and collaborative environment where understanding customer needs and ensuring a high-quality user experience are key. Your verification results and technical insights will play an important role in determining whether the services meet customer expectations.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Perform end-to-end system verification of connected services across rigs and vehicles.

  • Verify complete service flows covering:

    • Offboard customer portals and systems

    • Onboard applications and vehicle functionality

    • Mobile applications used by truck drivers

  • Develop and maintain test methods, test cases, and verification strategies.

  • Develop and use simulations for system-level verification.

  • Perform software download (SWDL), integration, and configuration activities.

  • Execute system-level verification on rigs, both with and without simulations.

  • Perform verification activities directly on vehicles.

  • Analyze test results, logs, and system behavior to identify and isolate issues.

  • Conduct root cause analysis of quality issues and collaborate with relevant teams to drive resolution.

  • Work closely with development, integration, service, and other engineering functions.

  • Contribute to continuous improvements of verification methods, tools, and processes.

  • Ensure that delivered services meet functional, technical, and customer expectations.

Requirements:

  • Experience in system verification of distributed embedded systems.

  • Experience within automotive services, telematics, infotainment/entertainment, or related connected-vehicle domains.

  • Strong experience with manual end-to-end verification across:

    • Mobile applications

    • Offboard systems

    • Onboard vehicle functionality

  • Hands-on experience with verification on test rigs and vehicles.

  • Experience working with rigs using simulations and/or simulated environments.

  • Knowledge of test frameworks and verification toolchains.

  • Experience with Vector CAN tools or similar automotive communication and diagnostic tools.

  • Good working knowledge of Linux and Android.

  • Experience with system simulations.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to perform log analysis and root cause analysis of system and quality issues.

  • Strong system-level thinking and a quality-focused mindset.

  • Good understanding of integration and interfaces within distributed systems.

What We Offer:

  • A dynamic and innovative workplace driving advancements in cutting-edge robotic technologies

  • The opportunity to collaborate with talented cross-functional teams on meaningful and impactful projects

  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package

  • A supportive culture that fosters continuous learning, growth, and professional development

  • Flexible hybrid working model for an optimal work-life balance

  • 25 days of annual leave to recharge and relax

  • An annual wellness allowance of 3,500 SEK to support your health and wellbeing

title: 9 årig tjej söker personlig assistent
description:
Alma Assistans är det engagerade företaget som i samarbete med kunden skapar den personliga assistansen. Vi jobbar nära kunden och vet att goda relationer är nyckeln till en väl fungerande assistans. Vi är verksamma i hela Sverige med huvudkontor i Uppsala och lokala kontor i Gävle, Stockholm, Göteborg, Helsingborg, Jönköping och Växjö.

Vi söker nu timvikarier vid behov till en 9  årig tjej. 

Vi vill att du är noggrann, pålitlig och har hjärtat på rätta stället. Det är en merit om man har erfarenhet som personlig assistent eller inom vårdyrket men det är inte ett krav. Vi ser gärna någon med erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn. Det viktiga är att du passar tillsammans med kund och kan hantera de arbetsuppgifter som ska utföras. Stor vikt läggs på personlig lämplighet.
Vi ser gärna kvinnliga assistenter  
Du som söker ska ha dessa egenskaper:

* Är en lugn och trygg person med ett eget driv. 
* Ser och kan ta ansvar för vad som behöver göras.
* Har en stor förmåga att sätta dig in i någon annans situation och perspektiv.
* Viktigt att du har erfarenhet av att arbeta med barn
* Du bör vara erfaren och vara snabblärd

Arbetspass är främst förlagda 07:00-16:00 eller 14:45 - 21:00. Passen är förlagda Jämna veckor enbart.
Vi söker timvikarier. 

Flickan är multihandikappad, hon kan inte röra på sig själv alls. Hon kan inte sitta, stå eller hålla upp sitt huvud själv. Hon är även blind. Hon behöver hjälp med allt. Som assistent måste man alltid tänka att det är du som är hennes händer, fötter och hennes ögon. Flickan får sin näring och mediciner via sond. Hon har även epilepsi.

Urval och rekrytering kommer att ske fortlöpande under annons tiden. Tveka därför inte utan skicka in din ansökan med CV och personligt brev där du kortfattat beskriver dig själv som person, tidigare erfarenheter och varför du söker just det här arbetet.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Teknikintresserad problemlösare med känsla för struktur?
description:
Jobbeskrivning

Kan du göra komplex teknik begriplig?

Du behöver inte vara teknikinformatör idag. Men du kan bli en hos oss.

Är du duktig på att förstå teknik och förklara den för andra?

Vi söker dig som gillar att skapa struktur, förvandla komplex information till tydliga instruktioner och göra teknik enklare att förstå och använda.

Du kanske arbetar som ingenjör, tekniker, kvalitetsingenjör, utbildare, projektledare eller specialist inom ett tekniskt område. Kanske är det redan du som får uppgiften att dokumentera arbetssätt, beskriva processer eller hjälpa andra att förstå hur produkter och system fungerar.

Oavsett väg in i yrket tror vi att rätt person har en stark teknisk förståelse, ett intresse för kommunikation och en förmåga att göra komplicerade saker begripliga.

Som teknikinformatör hjälper du våra kunder att skapa och förbättra teknisk information för produkter, system och verksamheter. Du arbetar nära ingenjörer, utvecklare, specialister och användare för att samla in kunskap och omvandla den till användarvänlig dokumentation.

Du kan bland annat komma att arbeta med:

  • Teknisk dokumentation och manualer
  • Arbetsinstruktioner och processbeskrivningar
  • Servicedokumentation och underhållsinstruktioner
  • Krav- och systemdokumentation
  • Digitala informationslösningar
  • Strukturering och kvalitetssäkring av information

Våra kunder finns inom industri, försvar, telecom, energi och andra teknikintensiva verksamheter.

Baskunskaper

Baskunskaper
  • God teknisk förståelse och intresse för hur produkter, system och processer fungerar.
  • God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
  • Eftergymnasial utbildning eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet inom teknik, IT, naturvetenskap, språk eller annat relevant område.
  • Förmåga att strukturera och förmedla information på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt.

Personliga färdigheter, egenskaper, erfarenhet

Vem är du?

Vi tror att du känner igen dig i flera av följande punkter:

  • Du har ett genuint teknikintresse och tycker om att förstå hur produkter, system och processer fungerar.
  • Du är nyfiken och trivs med att lära dig nya saker.
  • Du har lätt för att skapa struktur och ordning i komplex information.
  • Du kommunicerar tydligt i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska.
  • Du tycker om att samarbeta med andra och bygga relationer.
  • Du har en eftergymnasial utbildning eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet inom teknik, IT, naturvetenskap, språk eller annat område som vi bedömer som relevant.
Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:
  • Teknisk dokumentation eller användardokumentation
  • Utbildning, instruktioner eller kunskapsöverföring
  • Process- eller kvalitetsarbete
  • Kravhantering eller systemdokumentation
  • XML, DITA eller CMS-system
  • S1000D eller Simplified Technical English (STE)
  • Erfarenhet från försvars-, industri-, energi- eller tillverkningssektorn

Vi välkomnar sökande med olika bakgrunder. Du kan exempelvis ha erfarenhet från teknik, produktion, underhåll, kvalitet, systemutveckling, utbildning eller dokumentation.

Vi värdesätter nyfikenhet, drivkraft och förmågan att lära minst lika högt som tidigare erfarenhet av teknikinformation.

Vi erbjuder

Sedan 1989 har Sigma hjälpt några av Sveriges mest teknikintensiva företag att göra komplex information begriplig, användbar och tillgänglig. Genom åren har vi byggt upp en unik kompetens inom teknisk information, informationsutveckling och användarcentrerad dokumentation.

Vi nöjer oss inte med att följa utvecklingen inom branschen, vi är med och driver den. Vi samarbetar med utbildningsaktörer, utvecklar metoder och arbetssätt för modern informationsutveckling samt bidrar till hur yrket teknikinformatör utvecklas för framtidens behov.

Det innebär att du som börjar hos oss inte bara får ett nytt jobb. Du får möjlighet att utvecklas tillsammans med några av Sveriges mest erfarna specialister inom teknisk information.

Hos oss får du:

  • Intern utbildning som ger dig en stark grund inom teknikinformation och informationsutveckling.
  • Stöttning från erfarna kollegor, mentorer och specialister.
  • Tillgång till metoder och arbetssätt som utvecklats under flera decennier.
  • Möjlighet att arbeta med ledande företag inom industri, försvar, energi och teknik.
  • En arbetsgivare som aktivt investerar i kompetensutveckling och kunskapsdelning.
  • En kultur där nyfikenhet, lärande och samarbete är en naturlig del av vardagen.

Vi tror inte att du måste ha arbetat som teknikinformatör tidigare för att lyckas hos oss. Det viktigaste är att du har teknisk förståelse, förmåga att strukturera information och viljan att lära dig ett yrke som blir allt viktigare i takt med att produkter, system och processer blir mer komplexa.

Vi letar inte efter en specifik titel i ditt CV. Vi letar efter människor som är nyfikna, teknikintresserade och har potential att bli riktigt skickliga teknikinformatörer.

title: Erfaren tandsköterska sökes till praktik på Gärdet
description:
Information om arbetsplatsen

Vi söker en tandsköterska som vill bli en del av vårt härliga team på en modern och fullt utrustad

tandläkarpraktik i Stockholm. Vår ambition är att erbjuda högkvalitativ tandvård, att bemöta våra

patienter på ett personligt och professionellt sätt och att skapa trygghet och långvariga patientrelationer.

Mottagningen är ljus och fin och ligger på Gärdet i Stockholm, med närhet till tunnelbana. Här arbetar tre tandläkare, tre tandsköterskor och två tandhygienister. Vi har en familjär stämning hos oss och alltid nära till skratt, för oss är det viktigt att vara professionella och samtidigt ha roligt på jobbet.

Arbetsuppgifter

Tjänsten hos oss innebär omväxlande uppgifter som exempelvis assistans, profylax och steril. Du

kommer också att arbeta administrativt i reception med patientkontakter, kallelser och tidboksplanering.

Vi erbjuder en strukturerad introduktion där hela teamet hjälper dig att successivt komma in i de olika arbetsmomenten.

Du kommer att arbeta delegerat och i ett högt tempo.

Kvalifikationer

Du är utbildad tandsköterska med erfarenhet av kliniskt arbete. Du har ett intresse för delegerat patientarbete och vill fortsätta utvecklas inom yrket. Erfarenhet av kirurgi är meriterande. Vi värdesätter personlig lämplighet högt och söker dig som bidrar till en positiv arbetsmiljö och ett gott patientbemötande.

Personliga egenskaper

Vi söker dig som är omtänksam och engagerad och som alltid sätter patienternas bästa i fokus.

Du har god klinisk förståelse, god samarbetsförmåga och trivs med varierande arbetsuppgifter.

Du har förmågan att överblicka, planera och prioritera.

Övrig information

Anställningsform: Tillsvidare med provanställning

Arbetstid per vecka: 40 timmar

Tillträdesdatum: Enligt överenskommelse

Vi kommer att genomföra intervjuer löpande vilket gör att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdagen.

Om Praktikertjänst

Praktikertjänst startade för över 65 år sedan och är en av Sveriges största vårdgivare. Vi har 750 mottagningar, från Vittangi i norr till Ystad i söder, som drivs av praktiker som tillsammans äger hela Praktikertjänst. Vi är övertygade om att det skapar engagemang, delaktighet, fokus på kvalitet, kontinuitet samt kompetensutveckling - och är en viktig anledning till att vi varje år hamnar i topp vad gäller både nöjda patienter och medarbetare. Hos oss får du en trygg anställning med fina förmåner och goda möjligheter till både personlig och professionell utveckling. Vi vet att våra medarbetares välbefinnande är grunden till nöjda patienter och i det långa loppet, ett mer välmående samhälle.

title: Member of Technical Staff
description:
We’re in an unbelievably exciting area of tech and are fundamentally reshaping the data storage industry. Here, you lead with innovative thinking, grow along with us, and join the smartest team in the industry.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

Join the Pipeline Engineering team at Everpure™ as a Software Engineer to build, own, and operationally scale the microservices and Temporal workflows driving continuous integration for FlashArray, FlashBlade, and Hyperscale. In this developer-first role based in Bangalore, you will design durable production services and agentic AI tools that directly reduce time-to-signal, optimize compute utilization, and absorb operational toil across our global engineering workforce.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Architect Deterministic CI Workflows: Design and deploy production microservices and durable Temporal workflows that make pipeline execution resilient, resumable, and fully debuggable for enterprise storage platforms.

  • Optimize Compute & Testbed Utilization: Extend in-house scheduling logic and placement algorithms across bare-metal hardware and VM fleets to minimize queue times and maximize infrastructure efficiency.

  • Build Operational AI Agents: Engineer RAG pipelines and agentic workflows over failure logs, vector stores, and test metadata to automate root-cause analysis, flake classification, and developer triage.

  • Drive Platform Observability & Ownership: Establish key platform metrics—including time-to-signal and pass/flake rates—while operating your services end-to-end to ensure long-term stability and eliminate recurring failure modes.

  • Collaborate Across Product Teams: Partner with platform and product engineering groups to deliver developer experience improvements, self-service tools, and streamlined integration paths.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Backend & Systems Engineering: Strong expertise in typed systems languages (such as Go or Rust) for backend platform services, paired with Python proficiency for automation and AI logic integration.

  • Distributed Systems & Operational Fundamentals: Practical mastery of microservice architecture (concurrency, retries, idempotency) along with solid Linux/Unix debugging skills across network, storage, and application layers.

  • AI & Retrieval Integration: Practical knowledge of building agentic workflows, prompt design, and integrating LLM APIs with vector databases and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems.

  • Infrastructure & Containerization: Hands-on skill in containerizing microservices and managing workloads with Kubernetes, alongside data querying proficiency (SQL or analytics engines) to prove operational impact.

Workplace Location: We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure’s policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US:

  • Innovation: We celebrate those who think critically, like a challenge, and aspire to be trailblazers.
  • Growth: We give you the space and support to grow along with us and to contribute to something meaningful. We have been named Fortune's Best Workplaces in Technology™, Fortune's Best Workplaces in the Bay Area™, and certified as a Great Place to Work®!
  • Team: We build each other up and set aside ego for the greater good.

And because we understand the value of bringing your full and best self to work, we offer a variety of perks to manage a healthy balance, including flexible time off, wellness resources, and company-sponsored team events. Check out for more information.

OUR COMMITMENT TO A STRONG AND INCLUSIVE TEAM:

We’re forging a future where everyone finds their rightful place and where every voice matters. Where uniqueness isn’t just accepted but embraced. That’s why we are committed to fostering the growth and development of every person, cultivating a sense of community through our Employee Resource Groups and advocating for inclusive leadership.

Join us and bring your best.

Bring your bold.

Pure and simple.

title: Brand Narrative and Asset Strategist
description:
Founded in 2004, NetBrain is the leader in no-code network automation. Its ground-breaking Next-Gen platform provides IT operations teams with the ability to scale their hybrid multi-cloud connected networks by automating the processes associated with Diagnostic Troubleshooting, Outage Prevention and Protected Change Management. Today, over 2,500 of the world’s largest enterprises and managed services providers leverage NetBrain’s platform.

What We Need

We are seeking a Brand Narrative & Asset Strategist to build and run NetBrain's brand storytelling across two connected motions: campaign-integrated asset development and an always-on brand program. This role is accountable for both producing the work and setting the narrative strategy behind it — deciding the angle, format mix, and editorial approach for the always-on program, and shaping how campaign briefs translate into a coherent asset plan, rather than executing a fully scoped plan handed down from someone else.

This is a hands-on role. You will personally write, produce, and ship content across formats — blog posts, whitepapers, case studies, ebooks, webinars, email nurture, video, and social — and bring in the agency of record or freelance support for work beyond what one person can carry on deadline. This is a hybrid role based our of our Burlington, MA headquarters.

What You'll Do

Campaign-Integrated Asset Development

  • Take campaign objectives and thought starters from the Director, Integrated Campaigns and shape them into a complete asset plan and narrative approach across the buyer journey — identifying gaps, not just filling in what's already specified.
  • Translate complex technical and product concepts into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and business buyer personas.
  • Build production plans covering every asset, owner, milestone, and dependency, sequenced against campaign launch timing.
  • Write, produce, and deliver assets against campaign briefs across formats — blog posts, whitepapers, case studies, ebooks, webinars, video scripts, email nurture, and social — matched to audience, funnel stage, and approved messaging.
  • Collaborate with the Director, Integrated Campaigns to align content with campaign strategy across the full funnel (TOFU/MOFU/BOFU).
  • Track and report campaign asset performance against defined metrics, including engagement, conversion, and pipeline influence — not just traffic or reach — with recommendations that inform the next campaign build.

Always-On Brand Program

  • Develop and maintain NetBrain's always-on narrative strategy and editorial calendar — audience, themes, channels, formats, and cadence — aligned to campaign priorities, product launches, and pipeline goals, looking at least four to six weeks ahead.
  • Personally produce and ship the majority of always-on material, bringing in freelance or agency support for format types or volume beyond individual capacity.
  • Track awareness and engagement metrics and use them to adjust the always-on strategy on an ongoing basis.
  • Support SEO strategy for owned content, including keyword research, on-page optimization, and organic traffic growth.
  • Contribute to thought leadership efforts, including executive ghostwriting, bylines, and speaking or webinar content.
  • Lead a quarterly review of the always-on strategy for the VP, Integrated Marketing, with recommendations for the following quarter.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Reporting

  • Partner with the Director, Integrated Campaigns to align asset production with campaign timing and objectives.
  • Partner with Solutions Marketing to build messaging-aligned content that supports positioning and competitive differentiation, confirming alignment before any asset — campaign or always-on — goes into production.
  • Brief, edit, and quality-control work from the agency of record or freelance contributors on assets this role delegates for capacity reasons, ensuring it meets the narrative and quality bar this role has set.
  • Maintain and evolve brand voice and editorial standards across all written content produced for this role's two lanes.
  • Provide regular performance and strategy reporting to the VP, Integrated Marketing across both motions, using engagement, conversion, and pipeline data to refine strategy on an ongoing basis.

What You Bring

  • 6+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience spanning brand storytelling, content strategy, campaign execution, or integrated marketing.
  • Demonstrated ability to both produce polished, on-brand assets across formats (written, video, social) and originate a longer-term brand or editorial strategy, not just execute one already defined.
  • Strong project management skills, able to run multiple concurrent production timelines against hard campaign deadlines.
  • Excellent writing and editing skills, with experience adapting tone and format across audiences and channels.
  • Analytical mindset, comfortable defining KPIs and using performance data to guide format, channel, and cadence decisions.
  • Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals and content performance tools (e.g., Google Analytics, HubSpot).
  • Experience briefing or directing freelance or agency partners on discrete pieces of work.
  • Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or equivalent.
  • Ability to move fluidly between hands-on production and independent strategic planning without losing quality on either.
  • Experience marketing enterprise technology or network operations solutions is preferred.
  • Familiarity with account-based marketing (ABM) content strategies preferred
  • Experience supporting a product launch or category-narrative effort is nice-to-have
  • Manual Dexterity: Repetitive motion of wrists, hands and fingers for using a computer.
  • Stationary Tasks: Sitting for extended periods, remaining in a stationary position.

What We Offer

Our comprehensive compensation package is vital in how we recognize our people for the impact they make on us reaching our goals as a company.

For this role, the estimated base is $125,000 - $150,000 + Bonus. The actual salary may vary based on a range of factors, including market and individual qualifications objectively assessed during the interview process.

The range listed above is a guideline and may be modified. People Experience offers a comprehensive benefits package in addition to cash compensation that includes but is not limited to 401k and medical/dental coverage. Speak with your Recruiter for more details on our Total Rewards philosophy.

title: Lead / Principal Consultant - Data and AI
description:
Celonis is the global leader in Process Intelligence and the pioneer of Process Mining technology. As one of the world’s fastest-growing enterprise SaaS companies, we are changemakers pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. We invest heavily in advanced AI capabilities—specifically our Process Intelligence Graph—to turn data insights into immediate business action. We believe there is a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by placing intelligence at the core of every business process. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.

The Team

Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Lead / Principal Consultant - Data and AI, who we refer to internally as Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects, pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.

The Role

As a Lead / Principal Consultant - Data and AI (referred to internally as a Lead / Principal Deployment Engineer) you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.

This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer. You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact.

The Work You’ll Do

Initiate and Connect

  • Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases
  • Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria
  • Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required

Build & Value

  • Direct AI deployment agents (Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements
  • Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights
  • Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer
  • Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot
  • Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies
  • Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact
  • Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance

Rollout, Adoption, and Handover

  • Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption
  • Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations
  • Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value
  • Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff

Domain & Industry Depth

  • Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals
  • Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage
  • Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

What Makes This Role Different in the AI Era

  • You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually
  • You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly
  • You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers
  • You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer
  • You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable

The Qualifications You Need

  • Experience: 7+ years minimum in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators.
  • Platform skills: Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. Proficiency in PQL, SQL, and Python.
  • AI fluency: Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.
  • Business and process domain expertise : Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus.
  • Consulting skills: Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences.
  • Analytical mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with a value-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact.
  • Learning agility: Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field.
  • Languages: Fluency in English and German required.
  • Travel: Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases.

What Celonis can offer you:

  • Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
  • Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time "Celonaut" is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
  • Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
  • Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
  • Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
  • Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated "Wellness Weeks" that prioritize work/life balance.
  • Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
  • Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
  • Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

About Us:

Celonis makes processes work — for people, companies, and the planet. Powered by process mining and AI, the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform integrates process data and business context to create a living digital twin of business operations. We enable thousands of companies worldwide to understand how their business actually runs and, together with their partners, build intelligent solutions that transform and continuously improve the way they operate — unlocking billions in value. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.


Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.

Celonis Inclusion Statement:

At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.

Your Privacy:

Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices

By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
