title: Säljledare / Ställföreträdande butikschef - Göteborg Sisjön (NYÖ)
description:
Är du ett serviceproffs som vill vara med och bidra till fantastiska kundupplevelser? Är du dessutom en mästare på att inspirera och utveckla människor? I #teamlidl hjälper vi varandra att lyckas. Och vi växer tillsammans. Nu söker vi fyra engagerade säljledare/ställföreträdande butikschefer till vårt nya team i vår kommande butik Sisjön!

Som säljledare/ställföreträdande butikschef på Lidl är du butikschefens högra hand och har en given plats i butiksledningen. Du motiverar och inspirerar butiksteamet till att uppnå sin fulla potential varje dag och säkerställer att uppgifter utförs effektivt, korrekt och i tid. Du deltar självklart i det dagliga butiksarbetet och arbetar tillsammans med teamet för att ge våra kunder den bästa butiksupplevelsen.

Rollen innefattar uppgifter som:

• Säkerställa och leverera utmärkt kundservice i butiken

• Stötta butikschefen i det dagliga arbetet i butiken och se till att ni når resultat genom att leda, motivera och utveckla butikspersonalen samt delta i det dagliga arbetet på ett föredömligt sätt

• Säkerställa att butiken lever upp till våra grundpelare inom kundvänlighet, varutillgänglighet, färskhet, renlighet och lönsamhet

• Arbeta målinriktat med butikens nyckeltal

• Samordna och organisera introduktion och vidareutbildning av alla butiksmedarbetare

• Du har även totalansvaret för butiksdriften när butikschefen inte är på plats

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av att leda och utveckla team i en snabbrörlig och resultatorienterad miljö. Du har god problemlösningsförmåga och är duktig på att planera och delegera arbetsuppgifter. Du drivs av ditt starka kundfokus och prioriterar alltid kundupplevelsen. Att överträffa satta mål och maximera produktiviteten i ditt arbete ihop med teamet ser du som en självklarhet. Utöver det är du en god kommunikatör och kan genom feedback utveckla teamet och butiken.

Vi ser även att du:

• Har en avslutad gymnasieutbildning eller motsvarande, gärna med inriktning mot handel.

• Behärskar svenska flytande i både tal och skrift.

Vi ser det som meriterande om du har tidigare erfarenhet av att arbeta som ställföreträdande butikschef, butikschef eller som avdelningsansvarig inom dagligvaruhandeln eller annan serviceorienterad bransch.

Du får arbeta i en miljö som karaktäriseras av våra värdeord: prestation, respekt, tillit, jordnära attityd och gemenskap. Eftersom vi växer, kan du växa. Snabbt. Inom din roll, eller mot en annan. På samma plats, eller någon annanstans. Inom butik, lager, kontor. Lokalt, nationellt eller globalt. Vi stöttar dig på din resa mot mer ansvar och nya utmaningar. Du blir en del av ett stort team där alla kavlar upp ärmarna och hjälps åt. Du får allt från friskvårdsbidrag, föräldrapenningtillägg och medarbetarrabatt i våra butiker till kostnadsfri rådgivning av psykolog, jurist och ekonom samt mängder av erbjudanden via vår förmånsportal. Självklart omfattas du också av kollektivavtal och tjänstepension.

Vill du vara med på vår resa?

Rekryteringen sker med löpande urval, varför vi gärna ser att du skickar din ansökan snarast. Vår rekryteringsprocess består av tester, telefonintervju, personlig intervju och digital referenstagning. Hör av dig till oss om du har ett särskilt behov av anpassning när det kommer till urvalstesterna. Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med inledande provanställning. Då butiken är öppen alla veckans dagar kommer arbetet att ske enligt schema där tidiga morgonpass, dagspass, kvällspass och helgpass ingår.

Har du frågor om tjänsten eller ansökningsprocessen, vänligen kontakta rekryteringsteamet på mail: jobb@lidl.se.

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!

Om Lidl

På Lidl händer det grejer precis hela tiden. Mellan doften av krispiga croissanter och ljudet av veckans kampanj som rullar ut i hyllorna finns en energi som smittar av sig. Vårt hemliga recept? Team Lidl – alla vi som hjälps åt för att allt ska klaffa. Hela vägen från lagergolven till butikshyllorna och kontoren. För oss är det lika självklart att vi levererar högsta kvalitet till branschens bästa pris som att ge dig ett tryggt jobb med schyssta förmåner och utrymme att utvecklas. Att vi är certifierade Top Employer och Karriärföretag är kvittot på att vi menar allvar. Ett jobb som lönar sig helt enkelt.

title: Salarisadministrateur
description:
Ben jij een ervaren salarisadministrateur die energie krijgt van complexe cao’s, nauwkeurige verwerking én het verbeteren van bestaande werkwijzen? Dan zoeken we jou voor ons team in Heerenveen.

Arriva is een organisatie met veel verschillende bedrijfsonderdelen, locaties en arbeidsvoorwaarden. Dat maakt salarisadministratie bij ons uitdagend en afwisselend. Je krijgt niet alleen te maken met verwerking, maar ook met kennisborging, uniformering en het verder professionaliseren van onze manier van werken.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Salarisadministrateur zorg je samen met collega’s voor een correcte, tijdige en betrouwbare salarisadministratie. Tegelijkertijd help je mee om kennis beter vast te leggen, processen te verbeteren en verschillen in werkwijzen zichtbaar te maken.

  • Je verwerkt en controleert salarisadministratieve mutaties binnen een complexe cao-omgeving.

  • Je draagt bij aan een correcte en tijdige salarisverwerking voor medewerkers binnen Arriva.

  • Je haalt impliciete kennis bij collega’s op en helpt deze expliciet, overdraagbaar en toekomstbestendig te maken.

  • Je signaleert verschillen in werkwijzen en denkt mee over meer uniforme en efficiënte processen.

  • Je kijkt met frisse ogen naar bestaande processen en durft verbeteringen bespreekbaar te maken.

  • Je werkt nauw samen met HR Services, de Specialist HR & Payroll Processen en Arbeidsvoorwaarden.

  • Je brengt vanuit salariskennis input in bij procesverbeteringen en systeeminrichting.

  • Je bent bereid om waar nodig naar andere locaties, zoals Breda, te reizen om goed samen te werken met collega’s.

Wie zoeken wij?

We zoeken geen junior die het vak nog volledig moet leren, maar een salarisprofessional die al stevig genoeg staat om zelfstandig te werken, vragen te stellen en mee te bouwen aan vernieuwing. Je vindt het leuk om complexiteit te doorgronden en je hebt oog voor kwaliteit, structuur en samenwerking.

Verder:

  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur aangevuld met relevante salarisadministratieve opleidingen.

  • Ruime ervaring binnen salarisadministratie, bij voorkeur in een grotere organisatie met meerdere cao’s.

  • Kennis van loonheffingen, sociale zekerheid, pensioenen en relevante wet- en regelgeving.

  • Ervaring met AFAS/AFAS Profit is een pré.

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig, gestructureerd en hebt een sterk verantwoordelijkheidsgevoel.

  • Je bent kritisch op bestaande werkwijzen en durft op een constructieve manier te zeggen wat beter kan.

  • Je staat stevig in je schoenen en vindt het leuk om bij te dragen aan vernieuwing en kennisborging.

  • Je bent bereid om periodiek naar collega’s op andere locaties te reizen.

Dit bieden wij jou

De functie is ingeschaald in schaal 9 met een bruto minimum van € 4.379,- en een bruto maximum van € 6.236 per maand.

Verder ontvang je:

  • 30 vakantiedagen op basis van 40 uur

  • Een Persoonlijk Keuze Budget met onder andere 13e maand en 8% vakantiegeld.

  • Een Persoonlijk Ontwikkelbudget en toegang tot de Arriva Academy.

  • Reiskostenvergoeding en gratis reizen met Arriva via de glimble-app.

  • Hybride werken en een thuiswerkplekbudget van €900,-.

  • Een rol waarin je zichtbaar bijdraagt aan professionalisering van de salarisadministratie binnen Arriva.

Solliciteer snel!

Leuk dat je het team komt versterken! Solliciteer snel via de sollicitatieknop. Heb je eerst nog vragen over de (sollicitatie)procedure? Neem dan contact op met Ricardo Abbas, Corporate Recruiter, via ricardo.abbas@arriva.nl. Voor inhoudelijke vragen neem je contact op met Tony Gijswijt, Teammanager HR Services en Payroll via tony.gijswijt@arriva.nl. Een (digitaal) assessment is onderdeel van de procedure.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter) based in Germany.

This is an opportunity to join an established digital product and contribute to a mobile experience used by a global community.
You’ll work on core product journeys including registration, discovery, profiles, messaging, engagement, and monetization.
The role combines hands-on Flutter development with a strong focus on analytics, performance, and measurable product outcomes.
You’ll help evolve a production mobile application across both iOS and Android while supporting multiple brands and configurations.
The environment is remote-first and internationally distributed, with experienced professionals collaborating across cultures and time zones.
You’ll work with modern Flutter architecture and tooling while contributing to a product where mobile quality and user engagement directly matter.
This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership, technical depth, and building scalable mobile experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and maintain core mobile product experiences across authentication and registration, search and discovery, profiles, photos, messaging, matching, and user engagement.
  • Analyze and improve key product funnels, including registration, upgrades, monetization, messaging engagement, and match or interest conversion.
  • Own and contribute to analytics for core mobile journeys, helping teams understand user behavior and identify opportunities for product improvement.
  • Monitor and improve platform-specific capabilities such as push notifications, deep links, and real-time features.
  • Analyze mobile advertising and in-app purchase revenue metrics and support initiatives designed to improve monetization performance.
  • Support compliance-related analytics and functionality, including consent management, age verification, and user verification.
  • Build and evolve production Flutter applications for both iOS and Android using maintainable, scalable architecture.
  • Contribute to multi-flavor and white-label application delivery, including brand-specific configurations, assets, store identifiers, and Firebase environments.
  • Develop automated tests across unit and widget levels and help maintain high standards of reliability and code quality.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, analytics, and other cross-functional stakeholders in a fully remote international environment.

    • Requirements

    • Strong professional experience with Flutter and Dart 3.x, including experience delivering and maintaining production applications for both iOS and Android.
    • Solid understanding of layered mobile architecture, including separation between UI, domain/use cases and repositories, and framework layers.
    • Hands-on experience with BLoC and Provider, as well as GetIt for dependency injection and GoRouter for navigation.
    • Experience working with Dio for networking and immutable data models using code generation tools such as built_value or similar technologies.
    • Experience building and shipping multi-flavor or white-label mobile applications, including per-brand configurations, assets, store IDs, and Firebase setups.
    • Practical experience writing automated tests, particularly unit and widget tests; familiarity with bloc_test or BDD-style testing is an advantage.
    • Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, performance, maintainability, and production development practices.
    • Analytical mindset with an interest in using product data and user behavior to improve mobile experiences and business outcomes.
    • Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a distributed team.
    • Fluent Russian and B2-level English communication skills.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote, full-time working opportunity.
      • Competitive compensation, with the initial salary level or range shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before employment begins.
      • 28 calendar days of vacation per year.
      • 7 wellness days annually for personal needs, recovery, or household matters without requiring sick leave.
      • Employee referral bonuses of up to $5,000 for successful recommendations.
      • 50% reimbursement for professional training, international conferences, and industry events.
      • Corporate discounts for English language lessons.
      • Health support of up to $1,000 gross per year per employee where corporate medical insurance is unavailable, which can be used toward private health insurance or eligible medical expenses for employees and close relatives.
      • Workplace support, including equipment and coworking resources; employees working outside company-supported locations can receive up to $1,000 gross every three years toward home-office or coworking expenses.
      • Internal gamified recognition program where colleagues can award bonuses redeemable for merchandise, team-building activities, massage certificates, and other rewards.
      • International, remote-first working environment with opportunities to collaborate with professionals across different countries and cultures.

title: Consultant – Wind & Solar Advisory
description:
World leader in Renewables

Ramboll is a world leader in Offshore and Onshore wind & Solar with a unique value proposition. We employ around 900 experts in Wind&Solar as part of our 18,000 employees. With our international, multidisciplinary and wind energy specific competencies, we are a true full-range service provider for Offshore and Onshore energy as well as Solar projects in all project phases. Ramboll supports clients globally to identify, evaluate and quantify both risks and opportunities, allowing them to make well educated, strategic decisions based on practical project development, financing and execution experience, combined with robust engineering know-how and we are one of only very few consultancies in the world that provide advisory and engineering services at different stages of a project.

Within Ramboll, over 900 highly qualified experts are working on onshore and offshore wind as well as solar projects globally, operating primarily from our 12 key offices across the Nordics, Germany, UK, Poland, Spain, Netherlands, APAC and the US.

Your new role

As our new Consultant, you will be part of our global Wind & Solar Advisory team, supporting clients across onshore wind, offshore wind and solar projects. You will contribute to advisory assignments that combine technical, commercial and strategic perspectives, helping clients make informed decisions across different project phases. You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams across areas such as electrical design, structural design, civil engineering, grid connection, project economics, permitting, procurement and construction interfaces.

Your key responsibilities

As part of a multidisciplinary project team, you will support advisory assignments of varied complexity and scale across onshore wind, offshore wind and solar projects. Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Support project managers and senior consultants in planning and coordinating work packages, interfaces and deliverables, ensuring alignment with project specifications, regulatory requirements, industry standards and client expectations.
  • Prepare clear reports, technical notes, analyses and presentations, including feasibility assessments, risk reviews, technical due diligence findings, performance evaluations and recommendations for client decision-making.
  • Review and assess project information across cross-technical areas such as electrical design, structural design, civil works, grid connection, project layout, CAPEX/OPEX assumptions, project schedules, procurement strategies and construction interfaces.
  • Support tender and procurement processes by contributing to technical requirements, reviewing bidder documentation, supporting technical evaluations and helping identify key risks, gaps and opportunities.
  • Coordinate inputs from Ramboll specialists and external stakeholders, helping integrate technical, commercial and financial perspectives into coherent client deliverables.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Wind & Solar Advisory tools, templates, technical requirements and knowledge-sharing initiatives across international projects.

Your new team

You will be part of our global Wind & Solar Advisory team working on offshore and onshore wind farm developments as well as solar projects worldwide. You will join an established and vibrant team of highly talented and engaged colleagues located across different geographies, providing consulting services to our clients along the whole value chain of wind projects renewable energy projects. You will collaborate with local and international colleagues and play a critical role in defining and delivering projects, developing innovative solutions, and shaping and enhancing our service delivery.

About you

From the moment you start at Ramboll, we will support your personal and professional development so that you can continue to grow with the company. Whilst we look forward to supporting your continued learning and development, for this role we have identified some qualifications, skills, and capabilities that will set you up for success.

Required qualifications, skills and experience

  • Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Engineering in relevant field (electrical, mechanical, renewable energy etc.), or related field
  • Minimum of 2 years of relevant professional experience in renewable energy, infrastructure, engineering consultancy, project development, technical advisory, project execution, transaction advisory or project finance.
  • Experience preparing client-facing reports, technical notes, presentations, tender documentation or financial/commercial analyses.
  • Interest in onshore wind, offshore wind and solar projects, with an ability to understand cross-technical and commercial topics such as design interfaces, project economics, risks, procurement and delivery models.
  • Strong writing and communication skills in Polish and English.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders in multidisciplinary and international teams.

Additional experience that would be an advantage

  • Experience in one or more areas relevant to renewable energy projects, such as electrical design, structural design, civil engineering, grid connection, energy yield, technical due diligence, permitting, procurement, O&M, CAPEX/OPEX modelling or financial modelling.

What we can offer you

An outstanding opportunity to join our Energy Division and work with 2,000 experts in 15 countries, covering the full spectrum of renewable energy technologies and all parts of the value chain. In this role, you will gain exposure to international onshore wind, offshore wind and solar projects, work at the interface of technical, commercial and strategic advisory, and contribute to projects that support the energy transition.

  • Competitive base salary, working with the hybrid model and benefits package (Private medical care, life insurance, holiday allowance, Christmas bonus)
  • Ongoing investment in your development
  • Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles
  • The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company
  • Flexible work environment

Work at the heart of sustainable change

Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. So, that’s where we start – and how we work. At Ramboll, our core strength is our people, and our history is rooted in a clear vision of how a responsible company should act. Being open and curious is a cornerstone of our culture. We embrace an inclusive mindset that looks for fresh, diverse, and innovative perspectives. We respect, embrace, and invite diversity in all forms to actively cultivate an environment where everyone can flourish and realize their full potential.

The position is also open to candidates registered in the lists of protected categories pursuant to art. 1 - L68/99

title: Supervisor Retail | KPN Store Doetinchem

title: Sr. Forward Deployed Engineer - Deployment Services
description:
We are seeking a Forward Deployed Engineer to join our Deployment Services team within Customer Success. This role focuses on application-layer platform work: Python automation, database operations, API integration, data migration tooling, and backend service configuration for customer environments.

This engineer will work alongside Senior Solutions Engineers to deliver platform services to defense, aerospace, and commercial customers. Where the Solutions Engineer leads agent/module integration and Dgraph operations, this role owns the data and API layer: writing migration scripts, managing database operations, configuring backend services, building automation tooling, and integrating platform APIs. Our customers operate in regulated, security-sensitive environments across AWS, Azure, GovCloud, on-premises Kubernetes, and air-gapped networks.

The ideal candidate is a strong Python developer with database and API experience, comfortable working directly with customers, and capable of building reliable automation tooling under time pressure.

Core Responsibilities

  • Write and maintain data migration scripts for customer identity transitions (Zitadel to Keycloak), multi-tenancy data migrations, and schema changes

  • Manage database operations across customer environments, including PostgreSQL administration, Dgraph query optimization, schema migrations, data integrity verification, and performance tuning

  • Configure and validate backend platform services per customer requirements: Identity Service, Keycloak, AI Chat, and service integrations

  • Build and maintain Python automation tooling for repeatable deployment and configuration tasks

  • Integrate platform APIs for customer-specific workflows, including authentication flows, data exchange endpoints, and service configuration

  • Configure identity provider integrations per customer requirements (Keycloak, SAML, OIDC, SSO with PingFederate, Okta, Azure AD)

  • Troubleshoot application-layer issues in customer environments, including service configuration, database performance, API connectivity, and authentication failures

  • Support agent and module deployment alongside the Solutions Engineer, including configuration validation, backend connectivity, and module integration testing

  • Coordinate with customer engineering teams on service configuration requirements, data migration schedules, and validation

  • Maintain migration runbooks, service configuration documentation, and customer environment notes based on field experience

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in software engineering, platform engineering, or a technical customer-facing delivery role

  • Strong Python development skills, including production scripts, automation tools, and data processing pipelines

  • Hands-on experience with relational databases in production (PostgreSQL preferred), including queries, schema migrations, performance tuning, and backup/restore

  • Working knowledge of REST APIs, including building integrations, debugging connectivity, and reading API documentation

  • Experience with Kubernetes at an operational level (deploying and troubleshooting workloads, reading logs, understanding pod lifecycle)

  • Familiarity with identity and authentication systems (OAuth, OIDC, SAML, LDAP) at a configuration level

  • Experience working directly with external customers in a technical capacity

  • Strong troubleshooting skills, able to trace issues across application logs, database queries, and service configurations

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills for customer-facing interactions

  • U.S. Citizen

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with graph databases (Dgraph, Neo4j, or similar), including queries, schema design, and performance optimization

  • Experience with Keycloak or other open-source identity providers (administration, realm configuration, user federation)

  • Experience with AWS services (S3, IAM, KMS, RDS) or equivalent Azure experience

  • Familiarity with Helm charts and Kubernetes application deployment

  • Experience writing data migration tooling for production systems with rollback capabilities

  • Experience with TypeScript/Node.js in addition to Python

  • Familiarity with compliance or security frameworks such as FedRAMP, NIST, CMMC, or similar

  • Experience supporting defense, aerospace, or government customers

  • Experience with monitoring and observability tools (CloudWatch, Grafana, Prometheus)

  • Industry certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect Associate, CompTIA (Security+), or similar

  • Active security clearance (Secret or Top Secret)

Why This Role?

The engineers who do this job well become some of the most technically well-rounded people in the industry. You'll see how large, complex organizations actually work -- not just the happy path. You'll build things that get used immediately. And because you're reporting into Istari's Customer Success org (not a sales or account team), your career trajectory stays technical. You'll also have the Istari team behind you: regular syncs, access to internal engineering resources, and a clear path to influence the product you're deploying.

About Istari Digital

Istari is a digital engineering software company building open, scalable infrastructure for engineering data. Our platform lets customers simply and securely integrate engineering models across disciplines, organizations, and security levels -- whether they're designing prototypes, performing virtual testing, or training AI and autonomy for complex systems.

Focus is rewarded. Finish is remembered.

Facts are friendly. Even when they are not fun.

Fellowship is fundamental. Make others successful.

title: Junior Business Analyst
description:
Health Systems Junior Business Analyst

The Health Systems Junior Business Analyst supports the analysis, testing, and implementation of technology solutions within the Health Systems environment. The role works closely with Senior Business Analysts and the Health Systems Team Lead to translate business requirements into functional specifications, execute testing, document processes, and support business and operational initiatives.

This role is designed to develop strong business analysis capability within the healthcare technology environment while providing support across strategic projects, business-as-usual (BAU) enhancements, and production support activities.

At Kaelo, our mission is to provide quality and affordable healthcare that significantly improves the lives of all South Africans. The Health Systems team plays a critical role in enabling this mission by delivering technology solutions that improve operational efficiency and member experience.

JOB DESCRIPTION

The Health Systems Junior Business Analyst will be responsible for:

Business Analysis & Documentation

  • Gather and document business requirements under the guidance of Business Analysts and Team Lead.
  • Assist in preparing Functional Requirement Specifications (FRS), Business Requirement Specifications (BRS), user stories, and process documentation.
  • Document business processes, workflows, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
  • Support process mapping and business rule documentation.

Testing & Quality Assurance

  • Design and execute test cases based on business requirements.
  • Perform system, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing.
  • Log, track, and retest defects until resolution.
  • Validate implemented solutions against agreed business requirements.

Project & BAU Support

  • Support the delivery of strategic projects and BAU system enhancements.
  • Assist with production support investigations and issue analysis.
  • Monitor and follow up on assigned tasks and project deliverables.
  • Participate in release validation and post-implementation testing.

Data Analysis & Continuous Improvement

  • Analyse operational data to identify trends, exceptions, and potential system improvements.
  • Assist with SQL queries and data validation activities.
  • Support automation and process improvement initiatives.
  • Assist in preparing reports and dashboards where required.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Liaise with business users, technology teams, and external partners during analysis and testing activities.
  • Participate in workshops, requirement gathering sessions, and daily project meetings.
  • Communicate progress, risks, and testing outcomes clearly and professionally.

PERSON DETAILS: WORK EXPERIENCE

REQUIRED – Essential Experience

  • 1–3 years' experience in Business Analysis, Systems Analysis, or a healthcare technology environment.
  • Exposure to the Medical Aid or Medical Insurance industry.
  • Experience documenting business and functional requirements.
  • Experience performing system testing and defect validation.
  • Experience working with business users and technology teams.

Advantageous

  • Experience working with the MIP Medical Aid/Medical Insurance Administration System (CRM and Administration modules).
  • Exposure to healthcare claims, membership, provider, or wellness administration systems.
  • Exposure to Agile or Waterfall project delivery methodologies.

EDUCATION: QUALIFICATIONS: ACCREDITATIONS WITH PROFESSIONAL BODY

REQUIRED

  • Business Analysis certification (IIBA, FTI, or equivalent).

Preferred

  • Exposure to Agile or Scrum methodologies.
  • SQL or database-related training.

Technical Skills

Essential

  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Requirements gathering and documentation.
  • Test case design and execution.
  • Process documentation and business process mapping.

Advantageous

  • JIRA or similar work management tools.

COMPETENCIES & ATTRIBUTES

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • High attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Good planning and organisational skills.
  • Ability to learn quickly in a dynamic environment.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong stakeholder engagement and teamwork.
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines.
  • Self-motivated with a willingness to learn and grow.

Adaptable and proactive approach to continuous improvement

title: Loss Adjustor
description:
Loss Adjuster – Salary £34,000 - £45,000

Available Locations: Glasgow, and Leeds

Are you someone who thrives on delivering exceptional customer service while balancing cost effectiveness? Do you love coordinating several stakeholders and communicating effectively to ensure proactive management of claims? Due to continued growth, we’re looking for Desk based Loss Adjuster to join our specialist team. This is more than just a desk-based role — it’s a chance to make a real difference to people’s lives when they need it most.

About the Role

As a Desk based Loss Adjuster, you’ll be at the heart of our response to building-related damage caused by escape of water, fire, flood, or Impact etc acting as claim owner for customers and suppliers. You’ll manage household claims up to £50,000, taking full ownership from instruction through to settlement. This is a role that requires both technical acumen and empathy — balancing cost-effective solutions with exceptional customer care.

You’ll be part of a close-knit team, working virtually but collaboratively, supported by field-based colleagues (acting as your eyes on site) and a trusted supplier network. Your ability to interpret scope of works, building pathology, and coordinate multiple stakeholders will be key to delivering timely, high-quality outcomes.

Why This Role Matters

This isn’t just about processing claims — it’s about rebuilding homes and restoring peace of mind. Your technical knowledge and decision-making will directly influence the speed, quality, and cost of reinstatement. Managing claims of this scale comes with significant responsibility, and your expertise will ensure we deliver fair, accurate, and customer-focused solutions every time.

What We’re Looking For

  • Exceptional empathy and communication skills; including delivering difficult news with sensitivity and maintaining strong customer relationships

  • In depth expertise in the Residential (Home) property insurance sector, ideally in a loss adjusting, contractor management or technical claims role managing Flood, Escape of water (EOW) and fire damage alongside health and safety and industry specific regulations.

  • Strong understanding of building pathology and reinstatement techniques including Knowledge of building standards, materials, and mitigation practices inc. BDMA qualification (desirable but not essential)

  • Ability to interpret and where appropriate challenge scopes and of schedule works using photos, video, and remote tools

  • Ability to project manage claims ensuring a proactive approach to file management (including confident stakeholder management of customers, contractors, DR&R, and other suppliers

What You’ll Bring

  • A passion for helping people and solving problems

  • A proactive, solution-focused mindset

  • The confidence to make decisions and stand by them

  • A collaborative approach and willingness to share knowledge within a team

  • A desire to grow your technical expertise and contribute to a high-performing team

What you’ll get for this role:

Our purpose - with you today, for a better tomorrow – is a promise we make to our colleagues too. And one of the ways we live up to that promise is by investing in you. We have so much to offer when it comes to being an Aviva colleague.

  • Starting salary £34,000 - £45,000 (dependent on skills, experience, and location)

  • Bonus opportunity - 8% of annual salary Actual amount depends on your performance and Aviva’s.

  • Generous pension scheme - Aviva will contribute up to 14%, depending on what you put in.

  • 29 days holidays plus bank holidays, and you can choose to buy or sell up to 5 days

  • Make your money go further - Up to 40% discount on Aviva products, and other retailer discounts

  • Up to £1,200 of free Aviva shares per year through our Matching Share Plan and share in the success of Aviva with our Save As You Earn scheme

  • Brilliantly supportive policies including parental and carer’s leave

  • Flexible benefits to suit you, including sustainability options such as cycle to work

  • Make a difference, be part of our Aviva Communities and use your 3 paid volunteering days to help others

  • We take your wellbeing seriously with lots of support and tools

Take a look to learn more. Put a salary into this calculator to see what your total Aviva Reward could be.

Aviva is for everyone:

We’re inclusive and welcome everyone – we want applications from all backgrounds and experiences. Excited but not sure you tick every box? Even if you don’t, we would still encourage you to apply. We also consider all forms of flexible working, including part time and job shares.

We flex locations, hours and working patterns to suit our customers, business, and you. There is a requirement for you to spend at least 50% of your time in our offices every week - combining the benefits of flexibility, with time together with colleagues.

To find out more about working at Aviva take a look here

We interview every disabled applicant who meets the minimum criteria for the job. Once you’ve applied, please send us an email stating that you have a disclosed disability, and we’ll interview you.

We’d love it if you could submit your application online. If you require an alternative method of applying, please send an email zsombor.szekeres@aviva.com

title: Video Editor
description:
Working at Omnisend is... kind of boring. Not the soul-crushing kind, more like smart people doing great work without chaos or drama.
That’s because we focus on what matters. No pointless meetings, micromanagement, or unnecessary bureaucracy getting in the way. And when we're not sure what the next move should be, we test it — we're data-driven, and insights beat gut feelings every time.
Same goes for how we treat each other. Feedback here is honest, because people actually listen, and there's no room for egos or hand-holding. Everyone's an experienced professional who moves fast and adapts easily.
All of this matters, because Omnisend is customer-funded and customer-driven, so our work stays rooted in solving real problems for ecommerce brands. Results > promises.
And when the work's done, we know how to enjoy it — the grown-up kind. Workations, team gatherings, the occasional party. Nothing forced, no awkward icebreakers. We genuinely like being around each other.

We are looking for a Video Editor to help grow Omnisend’s YouTube channel and produce high-quality video content for various teams across the company. You’ll be part of the Communications & Creative team, supporting all video-related initiatives and contributing to the overall success of our video content.

This role is hands-on and creative, focused on editing engaging, educational, and brand-aligned videos that captivate and inform our audience.

What You'll Do

  • Edit raw footage into polished, engaging final videos.

  • Collaborate with internal teams, including Content, Design, Product, and Marketing, to develop video topics that support Omnisend’s brand goals.

  • Contribute creative ideas and suggest ways to improve video storytelling and performance.

  • Stay up to date with YouTube trends, algorithm changes, and Video industry best practices.

  • Organize video assets and manage project timelines efficiently.

We expect that you’ll bring:

  • Mid-to-senior-level experience in video editing.

  • Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro and familiarity with After Effects.

  • The ability to make basic motion graphics adjustments independently.

  • A strong creative eye for storytelling, pacing, and video structure, supported by concrete examples from your work or examples.

  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to consistently meet deadlines.

  • A collaborative and flexible approach, with openness to feedback and different ways of working.

  • Confidence in sharing your ideas and contributing to creative discussions.

  • Nice to have: experience with colour grading and audio editing.

What we offer in return:

  • Gross salary starting point from 2500 EUR/month based on experience.
  • Quarterly salary reviews.
  • An unlimited learning budget for self-improvement complying with the best interest of Omnisend.
  • Working methods and best practices inspired by the best tech companies in Silicon Valley.
  • Over 80% senior colleagues in Product - and over half company-wide - to accelerate your growth.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work possibilities.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Unlimited access to psychotherapy.
  • Workstation budget.
  • Personalized work anniversary gifts (house cleaning, spa treatments, international flights etc.)
  • Annual company trip abroad, company gatherings twice a year, team-led teambuildings.
  • Additional days off for KASP and Rifleman’s Union members.
  • Inclusive family-related time-off policy.
Omnisend is an email and SMS marketing platform built for ecommerce brands. With one-click integration to major ecommerce platforms, intuitive automation, and powerful email templates, we make sophisticated marketing effortless — no learning curve required.
Award-winning 24/7/365 customer support? Check. A platform trusted by growing brands and seasoned pros alike? Absolutely. The idea that “great marketing needs to be expensive”? Our 150,000+ customers prove that wrong every day.

title: Refugee Health Coordinator, Limited Term -  2025837
description:
Are you a person of compassion? An advocate for justice? Someone who stands up for the rights of the vulnerable and speaks out for the marginalized, the exploited and the forgotten? Do you believe in our calling as Christians to welcome the least of these and love our neighbor?

If you answered ‘yes’, to any of the above, World Relief, and millions of people around the world need you.

At this pivotal moment in time, we are rapidly expanding and growing our team to meet the increasing needs of our world. We are looking for people who want to use their gifts and talents to make a real and tangible difference in our world and the lives of the suffering.
If you’re looking for a purpose-driven career in which you can grow your talents, while also standing up for the rights of the vulnerable, we want you to join us today.
ORGANIZATION SUMMARY
World Relief is a global Christian humanitarian organization whose mission is to boldly engage the world’s greatest crises in partnership with the church. The organization was founded in the aftermath of World War II to respond to the urgent humanitarian needs of war-torn Europe. Since then, for 80 years, across 100 countries, World Relief has partnered with local churches and communities to build a world where families thrive and communities flourish.

Today, organizational programming focuses on humanitarian and disaster response, community strengthening and resilience, and refugee & immigrant services and advocacy.

POSITION SUMMARY:
This position will be responsible for assisting refugees and immigrants to obtain their Initial Health Screening, establish a primary care provider, and help with follow up care. They will provide health education and orientation to the U.S. healthcare system through orientations with all newly arrived refugees and additional workshops. This position will work closely with the transportation volunteers and case managers to provide ongoing health coordination for clients with intensive medical needs, as well as provide other refugee case management support as needed.
This is a limited-term position funded through a grant agreement until 6/30/2027 and contingent upon funding extension.
Hybrid: 4 days in office, 1 day WFH/Week

ROLE & RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Schedule health screening appointments for refugee clients within 30-90 days of arrival
  • Assist with transportation planning and provision, and connecting clients to public transportation
  • Ensure that follow-up immunizations are scheduled, and that barriers to care are addressed with the client
  • Ensure good communication with the health screening clinic and attend bi-monthly meetings to discuss collaboration and client coordination
  • Coordinate with health screening clinic to obtain referrals for follow-up appointments
  • Provide orientation of the U.S. health care system to new arrivals, including proper filling and following of prescription instructions, medical insurance, when to use primary care vs the emergency room
  • Provide referrals to community resources and other service providers, including assisting clients without health insurance in accessing free or low-cost healthcare when possible.
  • Coordinate with medical providers to equip clients to follow plan of care as directed
  • Assist clients in identifying a local primary care provider if necessary
  • Ensure clients have access to a local pharmacy and assist with initial filling of prescriptions
  • Promote the health of immigrants through coordination of health workshops and collaboration with local healthcare providers.

title: Global Operations Intern
description:
Who we are:

Geotab ® is a global leader in IoT and connected transportation and certified “Great Place to Work™.” We are a company of diverse and talented individuals who work together to help businesses grow and succeed, and increase the safety and sustainability of our communities.
Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Geotab’s open platform and Geotab Marketplace ®, offering hundreds of third-party solution options, allows both small and large businesses to automate operations by integrating vehicle data with their other data assets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.
Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Geotabbers accept that challenge and are willing to take on new tasks and activities - ones that may not always be described in the initial job description. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. To see what it’s like to be a Geotabber, check out our blog and follow us @InsideGeotab on Instagram.

Who you are:

We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Global Operations Intern (Product Ops Focus) who will play a hands-on part in maintaining data accuracy across our Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems, smoothing out product labeling workflows, coordinating international test device deployments and providing general operational project support to our internal teams and external partners. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What you'll do:

As a Global Operations Intern (Product Ops Focus) your key area of responsibility will be maintaining ERP data and SKU accuracy, assisting with product labeling and workflow resolution, coordinating import and customs logistics, and supporting new product testing setups and partner engagement. You will need to work closely with internal teams, external regional partners, freight forwarders, customs brokers, and project leads. To be successful in this role you will be an enthusiastic, resourceful, and proactive self-starter with excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. In addition, the successful candidate will have strong problem-solving skills, an operational mindset, familiarity with ERP systems and Excel/Google Sheets, and an excellent understanding of AI in day-to-day operational practice.

How you'll make an impact:

  • Audit and maintain SKU catalog accuracy across core ERP platforms; identify, troubleshoot, and re-catalog missing or dropped SKUs to ensure unbroken order fulfillment and reporting.

  • Assist with product labeling governance by implementing and documenting standard operating procedures (SOPs) based on established solutions.

  • Perform routine system health checks to ensure operational data consistency across warehousing and dispatch systems.

  • Assist in securing local regulatory permits and clearance documentation required for importing hardware, with a specific focus on specialized test devices entering Singapore and other APAC regions.

  • Monitor shipment trajectories and ensure seamless hand-offs between freight forwarders, customs brokers, and internal teams.

  • Coordinate logistics and hardware provisioning for new product evaluations and trial runs.

  • Serve as a central communications point for external partners and internal team members participating in product test phases.

  • Track test unit distribution, log partner feedback, and aggregate status reports for project leads.

  • Gap analysis completed across 100% of active SEA partners within first 6 weeks.

  • Partner account register maintained and updated monthly.

  • Identified SKU gaps remediated within agreed timeframe.

  • SKU enablement requests actioned within 1 business day.

  • Shipping concession status confirmed for all eligible partners within first 8 weeks.

  • Action registers maintained and up to date across all assigned SEA projects.

  • Deliverable tracking & follow ups completed proactively - with status reported to Senior PM.

  • Alpha/beta testing support - 100% of units tracked with log maintained throughout the program.

  • Manage label rework initiative with no outstanding requests.

  • Shipping cost recovery cases logged and followed up within agreed timeframe.

What you'll bring to this role:

  • Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s degree/Diploma in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Analytics, Engineering, Operations Management, or a related field.

  • Excellent understanding of AI in day to day operational practice, Familiarity with ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite, SAP, or similar), Excel/Google Sheets (vlookups, pivot tables), and data management principles.

  • Strong attention to detail with an ability to trace missing system data and follow through on resolution workflows.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication in English to effectively coordinate with regional partners and cross-functional teams.

  • Resourceful and proactive in navigating customs requirements, permit applications, and device distribution logistics.

If you got this far, we hope you're feeling excited about this role! Even if you don't feel you meet every single requirement, we still encourage you to apply.
Please note: Geotab does not accept agency resumes and is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Please do not forward resumes to Geotab employees.

Why job seekers choose Geotab:

Flex working arrangements
Home office reimbursement program
Baby bonus & parental leave top up program
Online learning and networking opportunities
Electric vehicle purchase incentive program
Competitive medical and dental benefits
Retirement savings program

*The above are offered to full-time permanent employees only

How we work:

At Geotab, we have adopted a flexible hybrid working model in that we have systems, functions, programs and policies in place to support both in-person and virtual work. However, you are welcomed and encouraged to come into our beautiful, safe, clean offices as often as you like. When working from home, you are required to have a reliable internet connection with at least 50mb DL/10mb UL. Virtual work is supported with cloud-based applications, collaboration tools and asynchronous working. The health and safety of employees are a top priority. We encourage work-life balance and keep the Geotab culture going strong with online social events, chat rooms and gatherings. Join us and help reshape the future of technology!
We believe that ensuring diversity is fundamental to our future growth and progress and is an integral part of our business. We believe that success happens where new ideas can flourish – in an environment that is rich in diversity and a place where people from various backgrounds can work together. Geotab encourages applications from all qualified individuals. We are committed to accommodating people with disabilities during the recruitment and assessment processes and when people are hired. We will ensure the accessibility needs of employees with disabilities are taken into account as part of performance management, career development, training and redeployment processes. If you require accommodation at any stage of the application process or want more information about our diversity and inclusion as well as accommodation policies and practices, please contact us at careers@geotab.com. By submitting a job application to Geotab Inc. or its affiliates and subsidiaries (collectively, “Geotab”), you acknowledge Geotab’s collection, use and disclosure of your personal data in accordance with our Privacy Policy. Click here to read our Privacy Notice.

title: In-Person Program Associate
description:
About Indigo

Indigo Research is dedicated to transforming the education landscape by pairing high school students with research mentors to complete and publish research projects. Whether in-person or online, we aim to deliver transformative educational experiences and cultivate the next generation of scholars. The In-Person Programs Associate will be a key member of the Operations Team who supports the successful planning, delivery, and continuous improvement of Indigo Research's in-person programs.

Role Overview

The In-Person Program Associate works closely with the In-Person Program Lead to support the planning and implementation of in-person student programs. The role is designed to strengthen Indigo Research's operational capacity as the in-person program portfolio expands.

The Associate will take ownership of defined administrative and operational work streams throughout the full program cycle, including program logistics, student interviews and records, vendor coordination, program readiness, and post-program operational close-out. They will also support the Program Lead in developing and implementing systems, processes, and documentation that allow programs to be delivered consistently and at greater scale.

The Associate must be highly organized, proactive, and comfortable working across different stakeholders and in ambiguous, fast-paced environments. They must also be available and eligible to travel internationally and be physically present during the in-person portion of programs, particularly during June–August and December. Indigo is currently pursuing an ambitious expansion with multiple cohorts across 3 continents, and the Associate will be a critical component for success.

Key Responsibilities

Program Logistics & Coordination

  • Support the In-Person Program Lead in planning and executing program logistics throughout the program lifecycle.

  • Research accommodation options based on established program requirements, budget, location, and student needs; conduct outreach, coordinate required paperwork and escalate key commercial decisions to the Program Lead.

  • Research, plan, and coordinate student excursions, campus visits, museum visits, and other experiential activities in line with program expectations and approved budgets.

  • Maintain accurate records of vendor contacts, pricing, services, and program-specific notes to build institutional knowledge across locations.

  • Identify logistical risks or gaps early and flag them to the Program Lead with relevant information and potential solutions.

Student Admissions & Operations

  • Conduct student interviews for applicants across each admissions cycle and maintain accurate interview records.

  • Ensure the operations dashboard is kept current with the latest student information, application status, interview outcomes, and payment statuses.

  • Track outstanding student forms, documentation, and other pre-program requirements and proactively follow up as needed.

Program On-Ground Delivery

  • Support the Program Lead in ensuring that programs are appropriately prepared for launch and that outstanding requirements are clearly identified.

  • Travel to program sites and provide on-ground operational support throughout the in-person portion of assigned programs.

  • Coordinate day-to-day logistics on site and liaise with vendors, mentors, residential staff, and other stakeholders to support smooth program delivery.

  • Address on-ground student/parent concerns and escalate to the Program Lead based on severity.

  • Monitor the student experience on site and proactively identify routine operational issues.

  • Maintain a professional, welcoming, and safe environment for students while adhering to Indigo Research and Crimson Education policies and procedures.

Post-Program Operations

  • Own the operational close-out of assigned programs, including outstanding vendor follow-ups, documentation, invoices, and other administrative requirements.

  • Report incidents, operational issues, lessons learned and relevant follow-up actions to the Program Lead.

Qualifications & Skills

Qualifications

  • 1-2 years of working experience in education, program operations, youth development, project management, or a related field.

  • Experience working on in-person programs, events, student experiences, or other multi-stakeholder projects.

  • Experience working with operational dashboards, project management tools, or data trackers.

  • Experience coordinating vendors, logistics, travel, events, or customer-facing programs is preferred.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Suite.

  • Knowledge of college admissions and international education systems is preferred.

  • Knowledge of research and publication processes is preferred.

Skills

  • Outcome-oriented: Highly organized, effective at time management, result-oriented, and able to take ownership of responsibilities with a positive attitude and can-do mindset.

  • Problem solving & resilience: Comfortable with multitasking, remains positive in times of uncertainty, recognizes when to ask for support, and initiates solutions.

  • Attention to detail: Able to manage multiple moving parts, maintain accurate records, and identify gaps or inconsistencies before they become problems.

  • Communication & interpersonal skills: Communicates clearly and professionally with students, parents, vendors, mentors, and internal stakeholders.

  • Customer service attitude: Demonstrates patience and empathy, and shows genuine care for student experience.

  • Adaptability & travel readiness: Comfortable working on site, managing changing circumstances, and traveling internationally during program periods.

What Success Looks Like

Program administrative delivery

  • Contracts and logistics secured at least 90 days ahead of program launch

  • Proactive issue identification and reporting

Student admissions & onboarding

  • Reduce average application to onboarding cycle time to 14 calendar days

  • Complete student interviews within 7 calendar days of application

Operational capacity & scalability

  • Build replicable systems and processes

  • Reduce operational workload and manual intervention

  • Scale vendor relationships

Program delivery

  • Smooth and consistent program execution

  • Effective on-ground support

title: [C3F] Data Platform Engineer
description:
Project – the aim you’ll have

Our customer provides innovative solutions and insights that enable our clients to manage risk and hire the best talent. Their advanced global technology platform supports fully scalable, configurable screening programs that meet the unique needs of over 33,000 clients worldwide. Headquartered in Atlanta, GA, they have an internationally distributed workforce spanning 19 countries with about 5,500 employees. Our partner perform over 93 million screens annually in over 200 countries and territories.

Position – how you’ll contribute

  • Build and operate change-data-capture pipelines from PostgreSQL into Azure, using Kafka Connect and Debezium as the core of the platform
  • Configure, deploy and scale connectors end to end - connector setup, task management, offsets, schema history, and snapshot strategy
  • Run these pipelines as stateful workloads on Kubernetes (AKS), covering configuration, secrets, networking and resource tuning
  • Monitor and troubleshoot the platform in production: connector failures, task rebalances, restarts, throughput and backpressure, message-size limits, retries and recovery
  • Automate the platform in Python - configuration-driven onboarding of new data sources, pipeline orchestration, monitoring and alerting, recovery workflows, and automated testing
  • Integrate CDC streams with the wider Azure data stack: Event Hubs, ADLS, Azure PostgreSQL, ADF and Databricks
  • Manage platform infrastructure as code, so environments are reproducible and changes are reviewable
  • Apply data protection requirements to sensitive data flowing through the pipelines - masking, hashing, access control and retention

Expectations – the experience you need

  • Solid commercial experience as a data or platform engineer, with hands-on work on streaming or CDC pipelines rather than batch reporting alone
  • Practical Kafka knowledge - topics, partitions, offsets, consumer groups and delivery semantics - including at least one Kafka Connect deployment you ran yourself
  • Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills, with working knowledge of WAL, logical replication, replication slots and replication lag
  • Working understanding of CDC concepts: initial snapshots, inserts, updates and deletes, event ordering, at-least-once delivery, and schema evolution
  • Confident Python for automation and tooling - orchestration, monitoring, recovery scripts, and automated tests
  • Hands-on experience with Azure data services, for example Event Hubs, ADLS or Azure PostgreSQL
  • Comfortable working with Kubernetes as a user: deploying workloads, handling configuration and secrets, reading logs, debugging failing pods
  • Ability to debug a running pipeline from metrics and logs - telling throughput problems from backpressure, retries or a genuine connector failure

Additional skills – the edge you have

  • Production experience with Debezium specifically - snapshot strategies on large tables, schema history recovery, offset loss, and bringing connectors back after failure
  • Experience operating stateful workloads on AKS: StatefulSets, stable worker identity, and resource tuning under load
  • Infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD for data platform components (Terraform, Bicep or similar)
  • Hands-on work with Databricks and ADF at production scale
  • Experience implementing data protection controls for sensitive data - masking, hashing, access control and retention policies

Our offer – professional development, personal growth

  • Flexible employment and remote work
  • International projects with leading global clients
  • International business trips
  • Non-corporate atmosphere
  • Language classes
  • Internal & external training
  • Private healthcare and insurance
  • Multisport card
  • Well-being initiatives

  • Past ISEF winners and judges who coach students to compete for state, national, and international science fair awards

  • Capstone project mentors who help students design and scale leadership initiatives with real-world impact, measurable outcomes, and credible external validation


We’re backed by leading VC firms, including Tiger Global, Heal Partners, IceHouse Ventures, and Movac, and recently closed a USD $40M Series D funding round at a USD $640M valuation. We now operate across 21 markets worldwide, including the US, Canada, UK, Singapore, Japan, Hong Kong, Australia, and New Zealand.

About Crimson Capstone

Our revamped Capstone Program gives students the opportunity to transform their interests into purposeful, high-impact projects across six pathways:

  • Education & Programs

  • Software & Technology

  • Engineering & Innovation

  • Policy & Social Impact

  • Arts & Media

  • Ventures & Business

Each pathway is structured around three progressive outcome levels, designed to reflect a student’s journey from exploration and foundational execution to increasingly sophisticated, independent, and impact-driven work. As students advance, they are challenged to deepen their expertise, take greater ownership of their projects, and demonstrate tangible outcomes within their chosen field.

The Role

As a Capstone Mentor, you’ll guide students through their personalized project journey, helping them transform their ideas into meaningful, well-executed initiatives. You’ll support students in developing their vision, building and executing strategic plans, and progressing toward their pathway- and tier-specific outcomes.

Through regular mentoring sessions, document reviews, progress checkpoints, and coordination of expert consultations, you’ll provide the structure and guidance students need to stay on track. Your role is to help students take increasing ownership of their projects while ensuring they deliver work that demonstrates substantive growth, leadership, and meaningful impact - both within the project itself and as part of their broader college application journey.

What are the main responsibilities for this role?

  • Mentor students through regular sessions, structured checkpoints, and ongoing project guidance.

  • Guide project development from initial proposal through execution, milestone completion, and final submission.

  • Track student progress against pathway- and tier-specific outcomes, providing timely feedback and support to keep projects on track.

  • Coordinate expert consultations and external resources, helping students access the expertise, networks, and opportunities needed to strengthen their projects.

  • Support students in developing meaningful, impact-driven projects that demonstrate ownership, leadership, and real-world outcomes.

  • Collaborate with Strategists and Admin teams to ensure a coordinated and seamless student experience.

Who You Are?

  • Strong academic or professional background in a field relevant to one or more of our six Capstone pathways.

  • Top 30 U.S. university or Oxbridge degree strongly preferred, though exceptional candidates with strong industry experience will also be considered.

  • For candidates in Australia, New Zealand, or Latin America, a U.S. educational background is not required. We particularly value strong industry experience, project management skills, and a track record of delivering projects.

  • Resourceful and well-connected, with the ability to identify opportunities, leverage networks, and help students access relevant people, tools, and resources.

  • Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to guide students from idea development through execution.

  • A genuine passion for mentorship, leadership development, and helping students create meaningful, high-impact work.

  • Available for a minimum 5 hours per week

Why work for Crimson?

  • Work in a collaborative, fast-paced environment

  • Make a real impact on students’ futures

  • Enjoy global reach with the flexibility of remote work

  • Use cutting-edge technology to empower learning

If you're passionate about growing in a fast-paced, collaborative environment and want to work with cutting-edge technology, then we'd love to hear from you!

title: Supporttekniker för direkt uppstart!
description:
Är du tekniskt intresserad, van vid att arbeta med datorer och trivs med att kombinera teknik med kundkontakt? Nu söker vi en supporttekniker till ett spännande projekt hos vår kund i Grums med start omgående och som pågår till mitten av december. Du blir en del av ett team som arbetar med ett större projekt med fokus på datamigrering och teknisk support. Här söker vi framför allt dig som är nyfiken på teknik, arbetar noggrant och snabbt kan sätta dig in i nya system och arbetssätt.

Information om tjänsten

Professionals Nord söker för vår kunds räkning en supporttekniker. Uppdraget är en del av vår personaluthyrning där du kommer vara anställd av Professionals Nord och arbeta som konsult hos vår kund. Uppdraget startar så snart som möjligt och pågår till mitten av december.

Den här rekryteringsprocessen hanteras av Professionals Nord och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor kring tjänsten går till jesper.wingqvist@pn.se (mailto:jesper.wingqvist@pn.se).

Du erbjuds

  • Ett spännande projekt där du får arbeta praktiskt med IT och datamigrering
  • Möjlighet att få värdefull erfarenhet inom IT och teknisk support
  • Att bli en del av ett team där ni arbetar tillsammans och stöttar varandra genom projektet

Arbetsuppgifter

Som supporttekniker blir du en del av ett befintligt team som arbetar med ett större projekt där en mjukvarulösning ska flyttas till en molnbaserad miljö. Ditt huvudsakliga fokus kommer vara datamigrering och att säkerställa att information flyttas över på ett korrekt och strukturerat sätt.

Arbetet är inte tekniskt avancerat, men kräver att du är bekväm med datorer, har ett tekniskt intresse och tycker om att sätta dig in i nya system. Du arbetar på plats i Grums tillsammans med dina kollegor och kommer även ha kontakt med kunder i samband med projektet.

Dina arbetsuppgifter innefattar bland annat:

  • Datamigrering och hantering av information mellan olika system
  • Arbete i olika datorbaserade system och program
  • Enklare teknisk support och felsökning
  • Kontakt och dialog med kunder i samband med migreringen
  • Säkerställa att arbetet genomförs noggrant och enligt givna processer

Vi söker dig som:

Har ett tekniskt intresse och känner dig bekväm med att arbeta med datorer och olika system. Du behöver inte ha lång erfarenhet inom IT eller datamigrering – det viktigaste är att du har en god datorvana, är nyfiken på teknik och har lätt för att lära dig nya system och arbetssätt. Har du tidigare erfarenhet av IT, teknisk support, datamigrering eller liknande arbete ser vi det som meriterande.

Vi tror att dina personliga egenskaper är avgörande för hur väl du kommer trivas i rollen. Du är noggrann och strukturerad, vilket är viktigt eftersom du kommer arbeta med hantering och migrering av data. Eftersom rollen även innebär kundkontakt ser vi att du är kommunikativ, serviceinriktad och känner dig bekväm i dialog med andra. Du tycker om att samarbeta, bidrar till teamet och har ett lösningsorienterat förhållningssätt när du stöter på nya utmaningar.

START: Omgående

OMFATTNING: Heltid, till mitten av december

STAD: Grums

URVAL: Sker löpande

KONTAKT: Jesper Wingqvist

title: Software Engineer – Autonomous & Electric Mobility
description:
Have you recently graduated with a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a similar field, or do you have up to 3 years of experience as a Software Engineer? Are you interested in software development, autonomous technology and solving complex technical challenges? Our client is now looking for a Software Engineer to join their Control Tower team in Gothenburg.

Working as a Software Engineer at our client

Our client is a technology company working with digital, electric and autonomous solutions for the future of road freight. You will be joining the Control Tower team, which is responsible for the system used by operators to monitor and assist autonomous vehicles remotely.

As a Software Engineer, you will work closely with the Team Lead and Product Manager, as well as with other teams across the organization. The team works end-to-end, which means that you will be involved in several parts of the development process and have the opportunity to take ownership of what you build. Your work will include software development, testing, system design and data streaming, with a strong focus on safety and reliability.

You will be part of a collaborative team where people are happy to help each other, share knowledge and solve problems together. The company also has a strong social culture, with different activities, happenings and employee-led clubs throughout the year.

The position is hybrid and based in Gothenburg.

Being a consultant at Nexer Tech Talent

Nexer Tech Talent specializes in giving tech talents the opportunity to build their careers at leading technology companies. For this role, you will be employed by Nexer Tech Talent and work as a consultant at our client in Gothenburg.

You will be part of the team from day one and work with real products and technical challenges alongside experienced colleagues. You will also have a consultant manager at Nexer Tech Talent who will support you throughout the assignment.

The intention is that, after the agreed consulting period, you will be offered direct employment with our client, provided that the collaboration works well for both parties.

Desired qualifications:

  • Newly graduated or up to 3 years of professional experience as a Software Engineer

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a similar field

  • Good foundation in software design, version control, automated software testing, data structures and algorithms

  • Experience working with Linux-based operating systems

  • Understanding of network protocols such as IPv4, IPv6, UDP, TCP, TLS and HTTP

  • Fluent in English, spoken and written

We are looking for someone who is curious, driven and enjoys working with others. You take responsibility for your work and like getting involved in different parts of a solution. Since the team works end-to-end, it is important that you enjoy working broadly and contributing where needed. For a newly graduated candidate, personality and drive are particularly important. You take initiative, want to develop and are comfortable becoming an active part of the team from the start.

It is a plus if you have experience with:

  • Rust and/or Golang

  • Cloud infrastructure, such as Google Cloud Platform or another cloud provider

  • gRPC or similar RPC frameworks

  • Safety-critical and/or real-time systems

Application

Does this sound like you? We are constantly screening resumes, and applications are considered on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. Selection and interviews are held continuously.

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Tech Recruiter Jennie Kähäri, jennie.kahari@nexergroup.com

We are looking forward to hearing from you!

About Nexer Tech Talent

Nexer Tech Talent is part of the Nexer Group – a tech company with deep roots in Swedish entrepreneurship and innovation. Together, we are over 2500 employees in 16 countries who, for more than 35 years, have helped our clients stay ahead strategically, technologically, and communicatively. The AM acts as the member’s central point of contact and “quarterback,” coordinating cross-functional Premier teams (Sales, GPO/Supply Chain, Technology, Advisory, Customer Success, AI/Analytics, and others) to deliver an integrated, high-value experience.
