title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
Company Background

Coherent Solutions is a global digital product engineering company founded in 1995 and headquartered in Minneapolis, Minnesota. With a presence in nine countries and a team of more than 1,700 engineers, the company provides custom software development and engineering services across web and mobile applications, cloud, DevOps, and data. Coherent Solutions works with clients worldwide to build and scale digital products while fostering a culture of collaboration, transparency, and continuous professional growth.

Project Description

The engineer will join the QA Automation practice and contribute to future client projects across different technology stacks. Assignments may include web and/or API test automation, manual testing, CI/CD, and collaboration with Agile teams and distributed stakeholders.

Technologies

  • Java / JavaScript / TypeScript / Python / C#
  • Selenium WebDriver / Selenide / Playwright / Cypress / WebdriverIO
  • Postman / Swagger / OpenAPI / REST Assured / Unirest / HTTP client libraries
  • SQL
  • Git
  • Jenkins / GitLab CI/CD / GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps / CircleCI / TeamCity
  • TestRail / Zephyr / Xray / QMetry / Qase
  • Allure / ReportPortal

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated tests for web, API, backend, integration, and/or mobile applications;
  • Analyze requirements, acceptance criteria, and technical documentation to define appropriate test scenarios and coverage;
  • Create and maintain test cases, checklists, test plans, regression suites, and other test documentation;
  • Perform manual functional, regression, smoke, exploratory, and integration testing;
  • Develop automated UI and API tests using project-specific automation frameworks;
  • Support and improve existing test automation frameworks;
  • Analyze automated test results, investigate failures, and stabilize flaky tests;
  • Report defects with clear reproduction steps and verify fixes;
  • Prepare and maintain test data for manual and automated testing;
  • Run automated tests locally and in CI/CD pipelines;
  • Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, BAs, POs, DevOps engineers, and client stakeholders;
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, including planning, refinement, demos, retrospectives, and daily meetings;
  • Suggest improvements to QA processes, automation coverage, and test reliability;
  • Adapt to new tools, frameworks, and project-specific technologies as required;

Job Requirements

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in QA automation;
  • Practical automation experience with at least one mainstream programming language: Java / JavaScript / TypeScript / Python / C#;
  • Experience creating and maintaining automated tests for web UI using Selenium WebDriver / Selenide / Playwright / Cypress / WebdriverIO or similar tools;
  • Experience with REST API testing using Postman / Swagger / OpenAPI / REST Assured / Unirest / HTTP client libraries or similar;
  • Basic SQL skills for test data preparation and data validation;
  • Experience with Git and running and analyzing automated tests in CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins / GitLab CI/CD / GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps / CircleCI / TeamCity or similar;
  • Experience with Jira, at least one test management tool such as TestRail / Zephyr / Xray / QMetry / Qase, and test reporting tools such as Allure or ReportPortal;
  • Experience using AI-assisted development or testing tools;
  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, SDLC, STLC, OOP principles, and test automation design patterns;
  • Experience with manual testing and the ability to focus on manual testing based on project needs;
  • Experience analyzing requirements and test results, creating and maintaining test documentation, including test cases, checklists, and regression plans;
  • Experience writing clear defect reports, verifying fixes, and providing clear status updates;
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum/Kanban teams, communicating clearly with distributed teams, and participating in client or team meetings when needed;
  • English level: B1+ or higher;

Nice To Have

  • Experience with more than one programming language for automation;
  • Experience building automation frameworks from scratch;
  • Experience with Docker or containerized test execution;
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure / AWS / GCP;
  • Experience with mobile testing or mobile automation using Appium / XCUITest / Espresso / BrowserStack;
  • Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter / k6 / Locust;
  • Experience with BDD tools such as Cucumber / Gherkin;
  • Experience with microservices testing;
  • Experience with data or ETL testing;
  • Experience in regulated domains such as healthcare, finance, insurance, or life sciences;

What Do We Offer

The global benefits package includes:

  • Technical and non-technical training for professional and personal growth;
  • Internal conferences and meetups to learn from industry experts;
  • Support and mentorship from an experienced employee to help you professional grow and development;
  • Health insurance;
  • Sports activities to promote a healthy lifestyle;
  • Flexible work options, including remote and hybrid opportunities;
  • Referral program for bringing in new talent;
  • Work anniversary program and additional vacation days.

Quotient is seeking a Senior Engineer in our Data Infrastructure team to design and evolve our cloud, data and AI infrastructure underpinning our genomics-first drug discovery platform.

Working within the Data Infrastructure team, you will lead complex initiatives spanning AWS platform engineering, scientific data systems and AI/ML workloads. You will collaborate closely with cloud engineers, data engineers, bioinformaticians, AI scientists, computational biologists, and experimental scientists to turn evolving scientific needs into secure, reliable and scalable engineering solutions.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with substantial technical autonomy. You will make cross-system architecture and operational trade-offs, establish reusable engineering patterns, and mentor our Cloud Engineers and Data Engineers through design reviews, delivery and troubleshooting. The role does not require formal line management, but it does require clear technical leadership and accountability for platform outcomes.

This hybrid role is based at the Chesterford Research Campus, near Cambridge, and reports to the Head of Data Infrastructure. The successful candidate will normally work from the campus at least three days per week, participate in operational support and incident escalation, and must have permission to work in the UK.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the architecture and evolution of our AWS-based infrastructure across cloud services, scientific data platforms and AI/ML workloads, balancing delivery speed, reliability, security and cost.
  • Design and implement reusable infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD and environment-management patterns that make production systems easier to build, test, deploy and operate.
  • Own cross-cutting engineering decisions for observability, identity and access management, networking, resilience, capacity, data movement and lifecycle management.
  • Partner with Cloud Engineers and Data Engineers to deliver integrated solutions, providing practical mentoring through technical design, code review, incident response and operational improvement.
  • Work with AI scientists, computational biologists and scientific teams to translate model development, training, evaluation, inference and data requirements into secure, reproducible platform capabilities.
  • Diagnose and resolve complex failures spanning infrastructure, data pipelines, applications and AI workloads; lead incident reviews and ensure corrective actions improve the wider system.
  • Establish and reinforce engineering standards for testing, documentation, release management, operational readiness, security and cost visibility across the Data Infrastructure team.
  • Evaluate new technologies and shape the infrastructure roadmap with the Head of Data Infrastructure, making pragmatic build-versus-buy and sequencing decisions for an early-stage biotech.

Qualifications:

Essential

  • Substantial experience designing, building and operating production cloud or data infrastructure, typically gained through seven or more years of relevant work or equivalent demonstrated capability.
  • Advanced hands-on experience with AWS and ownership of multiple interdependent production systems, including the ability to troubleshoot failures across service boundaries.
  • Strong experience with infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD, containerised workloads, cloud networking, identity and access management, and production observability.
  • Strong software engineering skills in Python and Linux, including automated testing, version control, code review and maintainable automation or platform tooling.
  • Experience supporting data-intensive life-science systems or workflows, with enough domain understanding to reason about large scientific datasets, reproducibility, provenance and scientific user needs.
  • Experience enabling AI/ML workloads in cloud environments, such as data preparation, model training, evaluation, inference, orchestration or production deployment.
  • A track record of leading complex technical initiatives under ambiguity, making explicit trade-offs and remaining accountable for reliable operational outcomes.
  • Demonstrated ability to mentor engineers and communicate architecture, risk and delivery choices clearly to both technical and scientific stakeholders.

Desirable Experience

  • Genomics, digital pathology, structural biology or other high-volume scientific data modalities and formats.
  • AWS CDK, Batch, ECS, EKS, S3, RDS or Postgres, Athena, SageMaker, Bedrock, or equivalent services.
  • Scientific workflow and data orchestration frameworks such as Nextflow, Dagster, Airflow or similar.
  • Platform security, privacy or governance controls for sensitive biomedical or clinical data.
  • Identity platforms and federation technologies such as Entra ID, SSO or role-based access patterns.
  • Working in an early-stage biotech, research-intensive startup or another fast-changing environment with a small engineering team.

Values and Behaviors:

  • Encourage respectful disagreement and cultivate open-minded, ego-free interactions to continuously push each other towards excellence
  • Seek out diverse perspectives; practice active listening and genuine curiosity to ensure all contributions are valued, regardless of source
  • Recognize the impact of your behavior, language and attitudes, and strive for balanced, meaningful exchanges that enhance mutual growth and understanding in all interactions
  • Use a company-first mindset to guide decision-making; prioritize team over individual success
  • Take calculated risks and challenge convention in the quest for exceptional outcomes

About Quotient:

Quotient Therapeutics is a privately-held, early stage company developing breakthrough medicines informed by natural somatic genetic diversity present in patients. Through our work in somatic genomics, we are forging a new status quo for biopharma research and development across a broad pipeline of internal and partnered programs.

The company was founded by Flagship Pioneering, an innovative enterprise that conceives, creates, resources, and grows first-in-category life sciences companies. Flagship Pioneering has created over 100 groundbreaking companies over the past twenty years, all of which are pioneering novel and proprietary biological, industrial, and engineering approaches to solve major needs in human health and sustainability. These companies include Moderna (MRNA), Generate Biomedicines, Sana Biotechnology (SANA), Tessera Therapeutics, Evelo Biosciences (EVLO), Indigo Agriculture, Seres Therapeutics (MCRB), and Syros Pharmaceuticals (SYRS).

Quotient Therapeutics and Flagship Pioneering are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.

Quotient Therapeutics (“Quotient”) and Flagship Pioneering (“FSP”) do not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Quotient, FSP or their employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Flagship Pioneering’s internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of FSP, and FSP will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.

Your application data is processed through Greenhouse, our applicant tracking system, and may also be reviewed using AI-assisted screening tools. We do not sell your personal information. title: Varierad tjänst på behandlingshem – vi söker rätt person
description:
Vill du vara med och göra verklig skillnad i människors liv på riktigt?

Hos oss på Wäxthuset söker vi inte bara en ny medarbetare, utan rätt person som vill bli en del av vårt lilla, familjära team.

Vi är ett behandlingshem där gemenskap, ansvar och engagemang står i centrum. Här arbetar vi nära varandra och våra patienter, med målet att hjälpa människor tillbaka till livet.

Om tjänsten

Tjänsten är en allroundroll där du blir en viktig del av den dagliga verksamheten. Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat att innefatta:

Arbete i kök två dagar i veckan

Jourpass en vardagskväll i veckan

Patientnära arbete

Praktiska sysslor såsom körningar och arbete på gården

Köket är husets hjärta och här lagar du inte bara mat, utan arbetar tillsammans med våra patienter och skapar struktur, gemenskap och delaktighet.

Att arbeta jour hos oss innebär att du kan möta människor i svåra livssituationer, skapa trygghet och upprätthålla struktur även under utmanande stunder.

Tjänsten är flexibel men vi tänker 80% vardagar/vardagskvällar. Utifrån att tjänsten är varierande krävs att du kan prioritera och planera dina arbetsuppgifter. Kökstjänsten delas med en annan person, och du behöver kunna planera driften av köket tillsammans med denna kollega.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som:

Är engagerad, driven och ansvarstagande

Trivs med att arbeta i team men också är trygg i att arbeta självständigt

Har ett genuint intresse för människor och vill bidra till förändring

Är flexibel och inte rädd för att ta dig an varierande arbetsuppgifter

Du delar vår värdegrund som vilar på 12-stegsprogrammet och ser människors potential till förändring. För att passa i rollen behöver du vara en person som lever som du lär. Du är trygg i dig själv, har förmåga att sätta gränser och är samtidigt skicklig på att bygga relationer med patienten i fokus.

Krav

2 års eftergymnasial utbildning med inriktning på socialt arbete

5 år fri från belastningsregister

B körkort för manuella bilar

Vid eget beroende minst 2 års drogfrihet och pågående tillfrisknande i 12 stegsprogrammet

Meriterande

Arbete i kök

Erfarenhet och av stressreducerande metoder som yoga, meditation och andningstekniker

Vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du:

Arbeta i ett litet, nära och familjärt team

En meningsfull arbetsvardag där du gör skillnad

En varierad roll med stort ansvar och möjlighet att påverka

En arbetsplats med tydlig struktur och rutiner

En närvarande chef och hög kompetens i teamet

Känner du att detta är mer än ett jobb och att det är ett sammanhang du vill vara en del av?

Då vill vi gärna höra från dig.

Tillträde enligt överenskommelse.

Skicka din ansökan med CV och personligt brev till paula.junhov@waxthuset.se Rekryteringsprocessen sker löpande, så vänta inte med att söka!



Vid frågor vänligen kontakta föreståndare

Paula Junhov Rindberg

paula.junhov@waxthuset.se

title: Det perfekta extrajobbet - Noggranna ålderskontrollanter sökes
description:
Det perfekta extrajobbet!

För mer information, besök gärna vår hemsida www.betterbusiness.se/for-shoppers/

Nu söker vi dig som är intresserad av att utföra provköp som mystery shopper i form av ålderskontroller, dvs. kontroller för att säkerställa att alkohol inte säljs till minderåriga. (Alkohollagen Kap 5 § 5). Enligt krav från vår uppdragsgivare behöver du vara 20 år fyllda då du kommer att genomföra provköp på alkoholhaltiga varor.

Som mystery shopper agerar man på uppdrag av aktuell butik/butikskedja. Jobbet innebär att agera och uppträda som en vanlig kund utefter angivet scenario samt kontrollera butikens servicenivå, och i vissa fall kontrollera efterlevnad gällande ålderskontroll vid inköp av varor med åldersgräns. Detta uppdrag handlar om just säkerställande av ålderkontroll genom provköp, för att vara provköpare i det åldersspann där ålderskontroll krävs behöver du alltid vara 20 år fyllda och/eller i närliggande högre ålder som är åldersrepresentativ för det lagliga inköpet av alkoholhaltig vara.

Passar du inte in i just denna profil går det ändå bra att registrera sig hos oss för andra uppdrag. Vi erbjuder uppdrag i butik, restaurang, webb och telefon som anonym kund/gäst.


Som mystery shopper är du noggrann, bra på att observera och ta till dig instruktioner, samt behärskar det svenska språket i tal och skrift. Uppdragens omfattning och arbetstid varierar från 30 minuter till cirka tre timmar att utföra. Som shopper väljer du själv hur många uppdrag du vill utföra.

Att vara mystery shopper är inget heltidsarbete utan ett perfekt extrajobb som går utmärkt att kombinera med annat arbete eller studier. Du får betalt per utfört uppdrag. Vi på Better Business hjälper företag att förbättra sin kvalitet och sin service genom att erbjuda dem verktyg för att utvärdera sitt kundbemötande. Ett av våra viktigaste verktyg är anonyma kundbesök i olika serviceinrättningar, så kallat mystery shopping. Better Business Sweden är specialister på mystery shopping och våra shoppers är tillsammans med våra kunder företagets viktigaste personer.


Körkort är meriterande.

Registrera dig som mystery shopper på vår hemsida www.beonline1.com, där du fyller i ditt CV och relevanta uppgifter. Vi tar inte emot ansökningar via mail men du får gärna höra av dig vid fler frågor.


Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Senior Service Delivery Manager
description:
As a Senior Service Delivery Manager, you will be responsible for leading strategic client relationships and ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality services across a portfolio of accounts. Acting as a trusted advisor to customers, you will work closely with senior stakeholders, the wider Service Delivery team, Technical Consultants, and business leadership to drive service excellence, customer satisfaction, operational effectiveness, and business growth.

You will play a key role in governance, financial oversight, risk management, service improvement, and the identification of opportunities to expand and strengthen customer partnerships.

Roles & Responsibilities

  • Strategic Client Management: Develop and maintain strong relationships with key customer stakeholders, acting as the primary escalation and governance point of contact.
  • Service Reporting & Governance: Own the production and presentation of customer-facing and internal service reports, providing insights, recommendations, and performance trends.
  • Executive Service Reviews: Lead regular service and governance reviews with customers, ensuring service performance aligns with contractual obligations and business objectives.
  • Customer Success & Escalation Management: Proactively manage escalations, service issues, risks, and customer requirements, ensuring timely resolution and stakeholder communication.
  • Financial Management: Oversee invoicing, account profitability, and commercial performance across assigned accounts.
  • Forecasting & Commercial Oversight: Lead monthly forecasting activities for revenue and project costs, identifying risks, opportunities, and corrective actions to achieve financial targets.
  • Compliance & Best Practice: Ensure adherence to ISO20000 standards, ITIL best practices, and organisational governance requirements.
  • Continual Service Improvement: Drive service improvement initiatives, leveraging customer feedback, performance metrics, and industry best practices to enhance service delivery.
  • Risk & Business Continuity Management: Identify, assess, and mitigate operational and business risks while ensuring robust business continuity plans are maintained.
  • Customer Satisfaction: Take ownership of customer satisfaction metrics, developing and implementing action plans to drive continuous improvement.
  • Business Development & Growth: Identify and cultivate opportunities for additional services, projects, and strategic engagements within existing customer accounts.
  • Leadership & Mentoring: Provide guidance and mentorship to Service Delivery Managers and wider team members, promoting best practice and professional development.

Qualifications, Essential Skills & Experience

  • Experience: 10+ years of experience in Service Delivery Management, with a proven track record of managing complex customer environments and strategic accounts.
  • Language: Fluent English, both written and spoken.
  • Stakeholder Management: Ability to engage and influence senior business and technical stakeholders both internally and externally.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal, written, presentation, and negotiation skills.
  • Customer Relationship Management: Strong background in customer engagement, service governance, and executive stakeholder management.
  • Analytical Skills: Highly developed analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a data-driven approach to decision making.
  • Revenue Growth: Demonstrated success in identifying, developing, and securing revenue-generating opportunities within existing accounts.
  • Financial Acumen: Strong experience managing account financials, including forecasting, budgeting, invoicing, and profitability management.
  • Process & Governance: Proven ability to operate effectively within a process-driven, service-oriented environment.
  • Leadership: Experience leading cross-functional teams and mentoring colleagues to deliver exceptional customer outcomes.
  • Initiative: Self-motivated and capable of independently driving priorities, managing competing demands, and escalating appropriately.
  • Teamwork: Collaborative team player with a strong customer-centric mindset.
  • ITIL Expertise: ITIL v4 Certified with strong practical experience across Service Design, Service Transition, Service Operations, and Continual Service Improvement.

At Version 1, we believe in providing our employees with a comprehensive benefits package that prioritises their wellbeing, professional growth, and financial stability.

  • Salary Range: €70,000 - €85,000
  • Share in our success with our Quarterly Performance-Related Profit Share Scheme, where employees collectively benefit from a share of our company's profits
  • Strong Career Progression & mentorship coaching through our Strength in Balance & Leadership schemes with a dedicated quarterly Pathways Career Development programme
  • Flexible/remote working, Version 1 is tremendously understanding of life events and people’s individual circumstances and offer flexibility to help achieve a healthy work life balance
  • Financial Wellbeing initiatives including; Version 1 Pension with a 5% employee-matched contribution, Private Healthcare Cover, Life Assurance, Financial advice and an Employee Discount scheme
  • Employee Wellbeing schemes including Gym Discounts, Bike to Work, Fitness classes, Mindfulness Workshops, Employee Assistance Programme and much more.
  • 24 days holiday allowance plus Public Holidays, enhanced maternity/paternity leave, marriage/civil partnership leave and special leave policies
  • Educational assistance, incentivised certifications, and accreditations, including AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, and Red Hat
  • Reward schemes including Version 1’s Annual Excellence Awards & quarterly Star Awards.
  • Environment, Social and Community First initiatives allow you to get involved in local fundraising and development opportunities as part of fostering our diversity, inclusion and belonging schemes.
  • And many more exciting benefits… drop us a note to find out more.

Version 1 is an equal opportunities employer

We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive and respectful workplace where everyone feels valued and able to thrive. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, identities and lived experiences, and we value the different perspectives people bring including those shaped by disability and neurodiversity.

We want every candidate to have a positive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need reasonable adjustments at any stage of the process, please contact your recruiter at ekta.bahl@version1.com. We will consider all requests carefully, respectfully and confidentially.

title: Machine Technician - Pune
description:
Job Description:

The main purpose of this role is to run the machines /Process by operating respective equipment’s. Learns the process conditions through Standard Operating Process/Standard Running Conditions and deliver the standard Output as expected. This role works closely with Area associates to deliver the area performance by contributing in respective of their work to ensure the Safety/Quality/Efficiencies/Wastages are delivered as per plan.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain/Follow safety standards in the area.

  • Maintain /Follow Quality and Food safety standards in the area.

  • Raising and closing the Safety /Food Safety near misses in the area.

  • Follow /Maintains the Personal hygiene and GMP guidelines as applicable.

  • Ensure the equipment and subsystems runs efficiently as per SOC. Executes Shutdown, Startup procedures. Ensure routine operations are adhered which may include task such as clearing jams, cleaning Equipment’s, and disposing of defective product or raw materials.

  • Operational level troubleshooting of the equipment’s and escalate the issues beyond area of expertise.

  • Ensure proper area documentation as per standards.

  • Awareness of the Line wastages and work towards elimination of these wastages. Contributes to continuous improvement of the line by implementing Kaizen /OPLs and contributes in Problem solving small group activities.

Behavioural

  • Follow the Associate Concept

  • Behave and act in accordance with the Five Principles

Output

  • Run machines to SOC. Be familiar with all SOCs.

  • Rectify and/or escalate issues, which prevent achievement of SOCs and/or Schedule. Log all such occurrences accurately and fully.

  • Ensure changeovers are completed within specified time to the right standard in accordance with Operating Procedures where these are available.

  • Ensure CP0 module level data is captured an escalation are timely shared with key stakeholders .

Costs

  • Operate work station to minimise product and packaging wastage.

  • Know the target standards for the machine which he/she is operating.

  • Fix or immediately escalates issues or faults that are causing excess waste. Record all incidences in Logbooks or on systems provided.

Quality

  • Ensure all activities that demonstrate due diligence are carried out

  • Carry out all the area cleaning by using the House keeping teams

  • Under go basic Food Safety training

  • Monitor & maintain Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Process Prerequisite Programmes (OPRPs & PRP’s)

  • Monitor the Critical Control Points (CCP’s) as per define frequency

  • Maintain accuracy of operational records

Safety

  • Ensure behavior at work complies with Mars Safety Policy.

  • Ensure validation in SSWs are completed within time period.

  • Escalate safety issues appropriately .

  • Perform all the activities in the area as per Mars Global Safety standard eg –Lock out Tag Out (LOTO), working at height etc.

  • Carry out the Safety interlock inspections in areas as per the schedule and immediate escalation in case of any failure.

  • Support Area Associate in carrying out regular toolbox talks with the contractors on the safe practices.

Hygiene

  • Maintain personal hygiene and Uniform standards at all times.

  • Maintain Work area hygiene standards.

  • Complete hygiene tasks as directed and record completion as applicable .

General

  • Communicate effectively issues and exceptions for their specific workstation to other shifts, technicians, in logbooks as well as verbally.

  • Seek Support from LM’s for their own development and skills acquisition.

  • Work flexibly with the other associates in their work group. Every day find ways to improve ways of working and their work area and equipment.

  • Monitor their own performance in all the groups above to form a basis for discussion at their next appraisal.

Educational & Professional Qualification

  • ITI (2 years technical course after 10th Standard) with good communication skills in Marathi/Hindi/English.

Knowledge/Experience

  • Minimum 3 years working experience, FMCG sector experience preferred.

title: Opticien
description:
Hoi, wij zijn Ace & Tate – en ja, we maken brillen. Maar belangrijker nog, we zorgen ervoor dat werken hier de moeite waard is.

We zoeken een Opticien in Amsterdam Beethovenstraat, 32-40 uur. Onze winkel opent in november en je kunt er vanaf dag één bij zijn.

Wat onze Opticiens doen en vereisten

  • Voer hoogwaardige oogtesten uit met ondersteuning van geavanceerde apparatuur en jouw kennis van binoculaire refractie.
  • Zorg voor de perfecte bril door te zorgen voor een optimale pasvorm, comfort en helder zicht.
  • Een expert binnen optiek door het team te trainen en te ondersteunen met vakinhoudelijke kennis.
  • Loop voorop in optiek door technische vaardigheden te combineren met eersteklas service voor scherp en comfortabel zicht.
  • Klanten adviseren over glazen met speciale aandacht voor upgrades zodat zij precies de juiste keuze maken.
  • Werkervaring in de optiek is vereist, een diploma is een pluspunt.
  • Vloeiend Nederlands (basis Engels is een plus) is essentieel voor effectieve klantcommunicatie en samenwerking binnen het team.

Wat we bieden

  • €2.917 – 5.000 per maand op fulltime basis, inclusief 8% vakantiegeld. Plus een maandelijkse bonus tot 16% wanneer de store targets worden behaald.
    Het salaris binnen deze range is afhankelijk van ervaring.
  • Geen zorgen over je studieschuld: zit je nog vast aan een terugbetaling bij je huidige werkgever? Wij nemen die gewoon voor onze rekening.
  • Vrije tijd die telt 25 vakantiedagen per jaar (fulltime), met de mogelijkheid om op te lopen tot 30 dagen op basis van dienstjaren.
  • Reizen zonder zorgen met reiskostenvergoeding bij een afstand van meer dan 10 km van de werkplek.
  • We geven om jou via samenwerking met ClassPass, de optie om een online consult in te plannen met een psycholoog via OpenUp en gezonde snacks.
  • Zie er stijlvol uit tot twee gratis brillen per jaar, plus korting voor vrienden en familie.
  • Benefits at Work toegang tot dit platform voor kortingen op producten en diensten.
  • Tijd om terug te geven met 1 betaalde vrijwilligersdag per jaar voor medewerkers die 32+ uur per week werken.
  • Een cultuur om van te houden met regelmatig en memorabele teamevenementen.
  • Tijd om te groeien toegang tot ons online leerplatform.
  • Voor nu én later deelname aan ons pensioenplan.

title: Account Expert (US)
description:
Working at Omnisend is... kind of boring. Not the soul-crushing kind of boring — more like the “no drama, no chaos, just smart people doing great work” kind. The kind that lets you focus on what matters, without pointless meetings, micromanagement, or bureaucracy. We’re data-driven. We test, we iterate, we improve. Gut feelings don’t drive decisions — insights do. We trust each other. We’re transparent, give real feedback, and actually listen. No egos, no hand-holding — just a team of experienced professionals moving fast, adapting easily, and delivering impact. Omnisend is customer-funded and customer-driven. Our work is rooted in solving real problems that help ecommerce brands grow. No empty promises — we bring in results. And yes, we have fun. But the grown-up kind — workations, team gatherings, the occasional party. No forced fun, no awkward icebreakers. Just genuine moments with a team that actually enjoys working together.
About the role:
The Account Expert role at Omnisend is a crucial part of our customer and partner success. We highly believe in the importance of customer-centricity and are looking for individuals with a great positive attitude and ability to work well with merchants and partners alike. This position is perfect for client-oriented and goal-driven individuals who are passionate about ecommerce and marketing, have a problem-solving mindset and strong technical and interpersonal skills. This role requires the ability to work across organizational stakeholders and a research-based mindset.

What you’ll do @Omnisend:

  • Be passionate about customer success and establish themselves as a trusted advisor for Omnisend’s top tier customers.
  • Proactively develop strategies with our merchants to help increase revenue through digital marketing strategies for their managed accounts.
  • Onboard new clients, so they are set up for success. This may include assistance with migrating contacts, guiding them through a warmup process and helping them set up their first campaigns and automations across channels.
  • Be proactive with strategic advice and guidance on a weekly, bi-monthly or monthly cadence and respond to client questions in a timely manner.
  • Provide best practices to ensure clients are achieving their business goals.
  • Regularly review customer dashboards, address any open issues and ensure consistent messaging and appropriate escalation.
  • Keep merchants up to date on product releases and new features.
  • Contribute feedback to Product/Engineering on platform improvements to enhance customer engagement.
  • Conduct QBRs, establish quarterly goals for customers and help achieve them.
  • Document troubleshooting and problem resolution steps.

We expect that you’ll bring:

  • 1-2 years of customer success-related experience.
  • An understanding of what the main digital marketing metrics are and what is driving their trends (opens, clicks, conversions).
  • A proven track record of creative problem-solving for customers.
  • Fluency in English language.
  • Experience and comfort discussing business and sales topics with clients during renewal or cancellation conversations.
  • Excellent communication skills via chat, phone, video conference, email and comfortable to use Wechat as communication tool.
  • Strong time management skills and clear sense of ownership and independent working ability.
  • An understanding of (either some or all): Slack, Zoom, Intercom, Mixpanel, Hubspot, G-Suite, and Omnisend or other e-commerce and marketing platforms.
  • Experience in e-commerce, SaaS, project management -or- marketing, and advising customers on marketing strategy is a plus!

What we offer in return:

  • Gross salary starting from 6000 USD/month based on experience + commission depending on individual results.
  • An unlimited learning budget for self-improvement complying with the best interest of Omnisend.
  • Working methods and best practices inspired by the best tech companies in Silicon Valley.
  • Senior colleagues that enable us to have a high-performing, productive environment where your growth will accelerate.
  • Private health insurance.
  • Remote work possibilities.
  • Unlimited access to psychotherapy.
  • A workstation budget.
  • Personalized work anniversary gifts (house cleaning, spas, international flights & more that you choose depending on the year).
  • Attractive workations and team-led team-building events.
Omnisend is an email and SMS marketing platform built for ecommerce brands. With one-click integration to major ecommerce platforms, intuitive automation, and powerful email templates, we make sophisticated marketing effortless — no learning curve required.
Award-winning 24/7/365 customer support? Check. A platform trusted by growing brands and seasoned pros alike? Absolutely. The idea that “great marketing needs to be expensive”? Our 150,000+ customers prove that wrong every day.

title: Servicetekniker Trädgårdsmaskiner
description:
Gillar du att skruva, felsöka och få maskiner att fungera igen? Då kan det här vara jobbet för dig!

Vi söker en engagerad och pålitlig servicetekniker till vår verkstad. Hos oss arbetar du med service, felsökning och reparation av allt från gräsklippare till motorsågar och trimmers från kända märken som t.ex. Husqvarna, Stihl & Stiga.

Om tjänsten

Som servicetekniker hos oss får du en varierad arbetsdag där du bland annat arbetar med:

  • Service, felsökning och reparation av trädgårdsmaskiner
  • Underhåll och diagnostik
  • Arbete med diagnosverktyg
  • Kundkontakt, bland annat vid utlämning av maskiner
  • Att hålla ordning och bidra till att verkstaden fungerar smidigt och effektivt
  • Enklare administrativa uppgifter och arbete i digitala system


Vem är du?

Vi tror att du är en person som gillar att lösa problem och få saker gjorda. Du är självgående, tar egna initiativ och trivs med ett praktiskt arbete där dagarna kan se olika ut.

Vi ser gärna att du är:

  • Noggrann och lösningsorienterad
  • Tekniskt intresserad och praktiskt lagd
  • Självgående och ansvarstagande
  • Positiv och serviceinriktad
  • Stresstålig och bekväm med perioder av högt tempo
  • Bekväm med datorer och digitala verktyg
  • Erfaren av verkstadsarbete – eller har ett stort intresse och vilja att lära dig


Det viktigaste för oss är inte att du kan allt från början, utan att du har rätt inställning, är nyfiken och vill utvecklas.

Hos oss blir du en viktig del av ett litet team där alla hjälps åt. Som mindre företag kan vi erbjuda en personlig och familjär arbetsmiljö, varierande arbetsuppgifter och möjlighet att påverka din egen roll.

Du kommer att växla mellan kundkontakt och praktiskt arbete i verkstaden. Ena stunden felsöker du en åkgräsklippare, nästa löser du ett problem med en motorsåg – och resultatet av ditt arbete märks direkt.

Vi erbjuder schyssta villkor, gemenskap och möjlighet att utvecklas tillsammans med verksamheten.

För rätt person ser vi gärna en fast anställning med 6 månaders provanställning.

Om vi inte hittar rätt matchning direkt kan vi börja med en timanställning. Finns engagemanget och viljan där, finns goda möjligheter att det utvecklas till en heltidstjänst.

Krav:

Gymnasieutbildning

Talar flytande svenska

Engelska i tal och skrift är meriterande

Erfarenhet inom kundservice är meriterande

Behärskar data/butiks system då mycket arbete sker vid datorer.

Vill du bli en av oss?

Skicka ditt CV och personliga brev till info@berno.nu

Vi gör löpande urval och tjänsterna kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, så skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Vi ser fram emot att höra ifrån dig!

title: B2B-mötesbokare till soliga Málaga i September
description:
B2B-mötesbokare till soliga Málaga – arbeta med svenska företagsprojekt med start i September.

Är du redo att utveckla dina kommunikationsförmågor och arbeta med professionella B2B-projekt under solen i Málaga?

Vi söker svenska mötesbokare som vill bli en del av vårt växande team i Spanien. Du arbetar med svenska företagsprojekt och hjälper våra samarbetspartners att skapa nya affärsmöjligheter genom kvalitativa möten med rätt beslutsfattare.

Du blir en del av ett mindre och engagerat team där kvalitet, struktur och goda resultat står i fokus. Vi arbetar uteslutande med B2B – inga privatkunder.

Vad gör en B2B-mötesbokare?

Som B2B-mötesbokare kontaktar du svenska företag och bokar möten åt våra samarbetspartners. Du skapar professionella dialoger, identifierar företagens behov och säkerställer att rätt beslutsfattare får möjlighet att träffa en specialist eller rådgivare.

Du får en gedigen introduktion till varje projekt och arbetar med etablerade företag inom flera spännande branscher – bland annat inom HR, lön, HR-administration, IT-lösningar, betalningslösningar och lagerstyrningssystem.

Den perfekta kandidaten

Vi söker dig som är social, nyfiken och tycker om att skapa nya relationer. Du kommunicerar professionellt på svenska och trivs med att prata med företagskunder.

Erfarenhet av mötesbokning, försäljning eller kundkontakt är meriterande, men inget krav. Det viktigaste är din inställning, din vilja att utvecklas och din förmåga att skapa förtroende i samtal med svenska företag.

Du blir en del av ett team där kvalitet, struktur, samarbete och personlig utveckling är centralt.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

  • Kontakta svenska företag och boka möten för professionella rådgivare och konsulter
  • Skapa dialog med beslutsfattare och identifiera relevanta affärsbehov
  • Arbeta med flera B2B-projekt inom exempelvis HR, IT, fintech, försäkring, pension och affärssystem
  • Säkerställa hög kvalitet i kunddialoger och mötesbokningar
  • Bidra till teamets gemensamma mål och resultat
  • Utveckla dina kunskaper inom kommunikation, försäljning och affärsförståelse

Dina kvalifikationer

  • Flytande svenska i tal och skrift
  • God kommunikativ förmåga och lätt för att skapa relationer
  • Intresse för B2B-kommunikation och professionell kundkontakt
  • Positiv inställning och vilja att lära dig nya färdigheter
  • Förmåga att arbeta strukturerat och målinriktat
  • Erfarenhet inom mötesbokning, försäljning eller kundservice är meriterande men inget krav

Lön och förmåner

  • Fast lön med attraktiv bonusmodell
  • Fast anställning på kontoret i Málaga
  • Grundlig introduktion och utbildning inom alla projekt
  • Möjlighet att arbeta med flera olika branscher och målgrupper
  • Ett starkt svenskt team med god sammanhållning
  • Löpande utvecklingsmöjligheter inom försäljning och rådgivning
  • En arbetsmiljö där kvalitet prioriteras framför kvantitet

Vad får du ut av att arbeta hos oss?

  • Praktisk erfarenhet av professionell B2B-kommunikation
  • Möjlighet att utveckla dina färdigheter inom försäljning, rådgivning och affärsutveckling
  • Inblick i spännande branscher som HR, IT, fintech och företagslösningar
  • Möjlighet att arbeta i internationell miljö med svenska företag
  • Ett liv och en karriär i soliga Málaga
  • Goda utvecklingsmöjligheter för dig som är ambitiös och vill växa
  • Ett engagerat team med fokus på samarbete, utveckling och resultat

Är du redo för nästa steg i din karriär och vill kombinera professionell utveckling med livet i Spanien? Då ser vi fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Monteur WTB / Procesoperator
description:
In deze functie als Monteur WTB/Procesoperator vervul je twee rollen; tijdens de productieperiode (bietencampagne) van september t/m januari werk je als Procesoperator. Wanneer we geen productie draaien (intercampagne) werk je als Monteur Werktuigbouwkunde.

Tijdens de bietencampagne en diksapraffinage ben je werkzaam in 5-ploegendienst en zorg je ervoor dat de productie op de suikersectie goed verloopt. In deze periode ben je +/- 80% op de controlekamer te vinden en +/- 20% in de fabriek. Je lost mechanische storingen op en samen met jouw collega’s zorg je ervoor dat de fabriek zonder problemen draait. Tijdens de campagne werk je in een sociaal en hulpvaardig team dat bestaat uit ongeveer 20 collega’s. Het team bestaat uit procesoperators, storingsmonteurs en fabricage medewerkers.

Als Procesoperator regel en bedien je de processen binnen jouw expertise en draag je zorg voor het optimaliseren van procesonderdelen. Het gaat hierbij om de juiste afstemming tussen product, proces en installaties. Verder denk je mee in het verbeteren van preventief onderhoud en los je eerstelijns storingen op.

Tijdens de intercampagne ben je werkzaam in dagdienst als Monteur WTB en pleeg je onderhoud aan de stilstaande machines- en installaties. Je houdt je bezig met de werktuigbouwkundige onderdelen van de suikersectie. Denk hierbij aan pompen, leidingwerk en hydrauliek. Gedurende de intercampagne werk je veel samen met onderhoudsmonteurs en storingsmonteurs aan het verbeteren van het productieproces. Iedereen werkt hard, maar we vinden ook humor en plezier in het werk enorm belangrijk.

  • Een afgeronde Mbo 4 opleiding, in de richting werktuigbouwkunde. Ook wanneer je de opleiding AOT/MAROF, Procestechniek of een vergelijkbare opleiding hebt afgerond nodigen we je uit te reageren;
  • Minimaal enkele jaren ervaring in een soortgelijke functie, bij voorkeur in de procesindustrie. Ook stage-ervaring is hierbij waardevol!
  • Je werkt graag samen met collega’s maar kunt ook zelfstandig complexere werkzaamheden uitvoeren;
  • Daarnaast ben je gedreven, ga je proactief te werk en ben je in staat in verschillende functiedisciplines mee te denken;
  • Je bent ambitieus en bereid jezelf verder te ontwikkelen door het volgen van een opleiding of aanvullende cursussen.

Op basis van een 40-urige werkweek en afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring bieden we het volgende:

  • €3.600 tot €4.200 bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring
  • 30% ploegentoeslag tijdens de campagne- en diksapraffinage over 40 uur. Jij werkt 33,6 uur tijdens de campagne maar wordt betaald voor 40. Buiten de campagne werk je in dagdienst
  • 25 vakantiedagen en +/- 10 ADV-dagen
  • Eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%
  • Pensioenregeling met slechts 3% eigen bijdrage en 25% inleg door Cosun.

en nog veel meer conform onze CAO.

title: Product Delivery Manager
description:
Do you want to shape the future with us?

Role Overview

The Product Delivery Manager supports Product Management and R&D in turning product strategy into coordinated, measurable execution and will be part of the Product Management & Innovation Team reporting to the Chief Product Officer.

Working closely with Product Managers, R&D, and the CPO, the role ensures that priorities are translated into clear plans, dependencies are actively managed, and agreed outcomes are delivered. The Product Delivery Manager enables these teams to operate effectively by creating transparency, maintaining momentum, and removing operational friction.

The role combines elements of product operations, program management, release management, and commercial product administration. It is particularly suited to someone who is highly structured, collaborative, and comfortable coordinating work across multiple functions.

Key Responsibilities

OKRs and Team Execution

  • Drive quarterly OKR planning, check-ins, progress tracking, and retrospectives.

  • Ensure OKRs are measurable, outcome-oriented, and aligned with company priorities.

  • Escalate risks, blockers, resource conflicts, and unclear ownership.

Prioritization and Delivery

  • Translate priorities into clear plans, actions, owners, dependencies, and deadlines.

  • Facilitate prioritization, roadmap, capacity, and delivery reviews.

  • Maintain a consolidated view of priorities, progress, risks, and cross-team initiatives.

Requirements and Releases

  • Support Product Managers with requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

  • Coordinate release plans, readiness reviews, documentation, and commercial readiness.

  • Align Product, R&D, Sales, Support, Operations, and other stakeholders.

Licensing and Pricing

  • Maintain licensing, packaging, subscriptions, entitlements, and upgrade information.

  • Coordinate licensing changes and pricing-guide updates across relevant teams and systems.

  • Support updates to CRM, CPQ, ERP, and pricing tools.

Product Operations

  • Coordinate product and release documentation.

  • Establish an effective meeting and planning cadence for Product and R&D.

  • Improve transparency, accountability, tools, templates, and working practices while reducing unnecessary administration.

Experience and Qualifications

Required

  • One to three years of experience in product operations, project coordination, program management, product management, business operations, or technology delivery.

  • Strong practical knowledge of Scrum, OKRs, and agile product-development principles.

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage several parallel initiatives, dependencies, and stakeholders.

  • Clear written and verbal communication in English; Swedish is an advantage.

  • Ability to prepare structured decision material, plans, meeting documentation, and status reporting.

  • Confidence in following up on commitments, identifying blockers, and escalating risks constructively.

  • Strong proficiency with collaboration, documentation, spreadsheet, presentation, and planning tools.

Preferred

  • Experience as a Scrum Master, Product Owner, or in a similar agile delivery role.

  • Experience working with R&D or engineering teams.

  • Familiarity with product roadmaps, backlogs, release planning, requirements, and user stories.

  • Familiarity with commercial product processes, including pricing, licensing, product launches, and lifecycle management.

Personal Characteristics

The successful candidate is:

  • Structured and dependable.

  • Proactive rather than reactive.

  • Comfortable creating clarity in ambiguous situations.

  • Persistent in following up without becoming bureaucratic.

  • Collaborative and able to influence without formal authority.

  • Curious about customers, products, technology, and commercial models.

  • Capable of challenging unclear requirements or unrealistic commitments constructively.

  • Focused on outcomes rather than task completion alone.

  • Comfortable working across organizational boundaries.

  • Eager to learn and grow toward a broader product-operations, program-management, or product-management role.

Role Summary

The Junior Product Delivery Manager is the operational connective tissue between Product Management, R&D, Innovation, and the wider organization.

The role ensures that product teams have clear objectives, transparent priorities, coordinated plans, complete commercial and operational readiness, and disciplined follow-through. By reducing operational friction and improving execution, the role enables Product Managers and engineers to focus more effectively on solving meaningful customer problems and delivering valuable products.

WELCOME TO APPLY

The position is permanent, full-time employment located in our headquarters in Solna. We value work-life balance; therefore, you can combine remote work and work from the office.



ABOUT NET INSIGHT

Net Insight (Nasdaq: NETI B) provides the highest performing, most open video transport and media cloud technology for content providers as the industry standard for flexibility and service across live contribution, distribution and remote production media workflows.

For over 25 years, the world’s leading content owners, broadcasters, production companies, service providers and enterprises have trusted Net Insight’s Emmy® Award winning Nimbra technology to guarantee media delivery. Today, Net Insight partners with hundreds of customers in over 70 countries to ensure media flows across managed and unmanaged IP networks, and the cloud – from anywhere, to everywhere. It enables customers to get the best from any mix of virtualized, cloud and IP technology and is the only platform to support all the major industry standards, protocols and clouds.

Welcome to Net Insight, where innovation, collaboration, and trust are the cornerstones of our success. As one team, we are committed to delivering value to our customers, contributing to the growth and success of our company. Together we create a dynamic and positive workplace where everyone is valued, engaged and empowered to make an impact

title: Senior Engineer, Digital Design
description:
Renesas has a growing presence in India with HC approaching 1000+ and significant presence with active government and university collaboration as well as OSAT footprint (JV with CG India). With the growing importance of India as a market (Growing semiconductor market and government goals / mandates of localization needs) and talent hub, our division’s (India for India) mission is to grow India market. We aspire to create products (SoCs, Software, Power and Analog chips etc) which serve needs for local market. Renesas is a leading electronics supplier globally, and this is a unique opportunity to directly influence the future products which will be offered to our customers in a new, fast growing and large Indian market with specific needs and applications.

We are seeking a highly motivated and innovative Staff/Sr Staff/Principal IC Design Engineer (RTL Design) with strong experience in SoC development flows. In this role, you will play a pivotal part in the design and development of advanced integrated circuits that power Renesas MCU products. You will lead complex RTL design efforts, own key IP/subsystem deliverables, mentor junior engineers, and help evolve design methodologies and best practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead RTL design and development of complex IPs and subsystems within MCU SoCs, ensuring compliance with performance, power, and area (PPA) targets
  • Drive micro-architecture definition and high-level digital design for assigned blocks
  • Support SoC integration, delivering high-quality subsystem views and documentation to Back-end and Design Verification teams
  • Own design quality checks, including lint, CDC, and RDC, and actively support functional verification of assigned blocks
  • Collaborate closely with system architects, verification engineers, physical design teams, and software teams to define specifications and ensure seamless end-to-end integration
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, raising overall team capability and design quality
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of RTL design methodologies, coding guidelines, and design processes
  • Bachelor’s degree in Electronics & Communication Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or related technical field
  • Minimum of 8 years of hands-on experience in digital IC/ASIC design, with a strong track record of delivering high-quality silicon
  • Strong expertise in RTL design using Verilog/VHDL
  • Solid understanding of digital design principles, timing analysis, clocking, resets, and verification methodologies
  • Experience using industry-standard EDA tools for synthesis, simulation, and static timing analysis
  • Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to own blocks end-to-end

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience owning complex IPs or subsystem designs in large SoCs
  • Strong background in micro-architecture design and high-level digital design
  • Hands-on experience with RTL quality tools such as Spyglass (Lint, CDC, RDC)
  • Experience with low-power design techniques and methodologies
  • Familiarity with SoC-level design and integration
  • Understanding of synthesis flows and timing constraints
  • Scripting experience in Shell, Perl, Python or use of AI for design is a strong plus.

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

title: Shipping specialist
description:
Littelfuse (NASDAQ: LFUS) is a diversified industrial technology manufacturing company shaping solutions for the safe and efficient transfer of electrical energy. Headquartered in Chicago, Illinois, USA, we serve customers across industrial, transportation, and electronics markets worldwide. With approximately 16,000 employees we design and manufacture innovative technologies that support electrification, energy efficiency, and advanced automation. Our global reach is matched by a culture that empowers innovation and long-term growth. Guided by our principles We Care, We Succeed With Our Customers, and We Own the Outcome, we work collaboratively, think boldly, and deliver solutions that move industries forward.

About the Job

1、Handling the shipping includes identifying the shipping method and providing the correct packing documents as well as arranging the shipment
Import shipment:

  • Confirm the shipping method (by truck/air/sea/express) and booking with the FWD create the AWB for the express shipment.

  • Check the freight cost and confirm with FWD

Export shipment:

  • Calculate the volume and book the space with FWD (at least 3 days before for HK and NL shipment, and 7 days before for US shipment).

  • Booking the truck before export shipment 1 day

  • Do keying data on system (Work with other dept. as IT, production line, QC to solve arisen issue: error picking list; error system...)

  • Make the warehouse release form

  • Make the pre-alert shipping documents sent to Distribution team

  • Sample shipment: about 5-7 shipments/week according to CS instruction

2、Handling the issues along with the shipment, such as:

  • Delay shipment, shortage the space in peak season

  • Provide tracking number of orders as CS or other dept's requires

  • Handle cases of lost or damaged goods during import and export.

3、Provide the export data for the customs: Classification by type of customs declaration (B13, E62, G23…), invoice, packing list, GW, Volume

4、Make the payment and reports (Team Guru, TRAM report, Logistics fee report)

5、Control the shipping cost and make sure the reasonable cost

6、Accomplish the other tasks assigned by Manager

About You

  • Education: University degree is preferred

  • Degree of Logistics/ Supply chain management major is preferred

  • Working in FDI, EPE company is advantage

  • Work Experience:

  • ~3 years or above of experience in a similar position

  • Familiar with support working in Shipping & Logistics

  • Use computers and MS software well.

  • Know & use MRP/ERP system

  • Able to use English in work; spoken & reading, writing email for communication with Global logistic team, FWD

  • Have business sense, able to negotiation

  • Able to manage several workers who support shipping

At Littelfuse, we support employee growth and development. Guided by our culture principles, our teams work together to deliver value for customers and make a positive impact in the communities where we operate. We are an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workplace where everyone has the opportunity to grow and contribute. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, performance-based incentives, flexible work arrangements, and development opportunities.

title: Data & Analytics PM
description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Team context

User Operations sits within Fever's broader User Support organization. User Operations is the strategic/enablement layer behind the operating User support structure, organized around three areas: AI integration, Systems, and Data.

Within Data, we focus on continuous improvement. We don't just maintain information that's useful and relevant to stakeholders inside and outside the department, we translate that data into concrete initiatives that let us keep questioning and improving how we work.

The role

We're looking for a Project Manager with a strong analytics backbone. This isn't a "build the dashboard and move on", we need someone who can go from constructing the data (dashboards, reporting, automations) to understanding what it actually means for the business, so they can help management make consistently data-driven decisions.

Projects will range from a variety of stakeholders, such as, providing user support with operating actionable metrics, giving partners visibility into how their events are performing or helping on app developments that directly shape the user experience.

What we're looking for

Analytics (70% weight)

  • 2-4 years of experience in data/analytics (analyst, data PM, BI, ops analytics). A relevant Master's or further training in the field is a plus.
  • Comfortable building and maintaining dashboards in tools like Metabase, Looker, or similar.
  • Scripting/automation experience.

Project management & structure (30% weight)

  • Demonstrated ability to run a project end-to-end.
  • Organized, structured, and comfortable prioritizing your own workload.
  • You default to improving things, not just maintaining them. When you spot something inefficient, you fix it or raise it, you don't leave it for later.
  • Comfortable communicating with both technical (central Data team) and non-technical (support ops) stakeholders.
  • Not required today, but a plus: some early signs of enjoying explaining things to others or helping people grow. This role is expected to evolve into managing a team member over time, no prior people-management experience needed.

Languages & location

  • Full professional fluency in both English and Spanish, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Based in Madrid or willing to relocate to Madrid

Why you'd love it: Benefits & Perks

  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance
  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Work in a location in the heart of Madrid
  • Home-office friendly
  • Health insurance
  • Gympass membership
  • English Lessons
  • Other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee and the possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow.
  • Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth

title: Vehicle Technician Apprentice
description:
Drive Your Career Forward: The Holdcroft Academy Apprenticeship

Are you ready to turn your passion for cars into a high-powered career?

The Holdcroft Academy is looking for its next generation of talent.

Whether you are a school leaver or a career changer looking for a fresh start, we want to hear from you.

This is the perfect opportunity for someone who loves getting under a bonnet, figuring out

how things work, and has a genuine passion for vehicles.

We don't just offer a job; we offer a 30-month journey to becoming a fully qualified Level 3

technician through our ''Growing Our Own" philosophy.

Why Choose the Holdcroft Academy?

● Open to Everyone: Age is just a number. Whether you are 16 or 46, if you have the

drive to learn, you belong here.

● Earn While You Learn: Receive a competitive wage from day one, which can grow

as you progress.

● No College Commute: All training is delivered on-site at our dealerships. You won't

have to travel to an external college or worry about traditional term times.

● Expert Support System: You’ll have a dedicated coach for one-to-one support, plus

a ''Buddy'' (usually a Master or Senior Technician) on-site to mentor you daily.

● The ''Holdcroft Way'': You will learn our unique way of working from day one, setting

you up for long-term success in our business.

What You’ll Be Learning

Your apprenticeship follows a comprehensive 30-module plan. Highlights include:

● Advanced Diagnostics: Learning to identify faults in complex engine systems and

electronic control units (ECU).

● Mastering Mechanics: Hands-on experience with braking systems, manual and

automatic gearboxes, and suspension.

● Future-Proof Skills: Training in High Voltage Awareness, Air Conditioning (F-gas),

and Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS).

Important Dates & Recruitment

We use a modern recruitment process designed to let your skills shine:

● End of June: Application closing date.

● Early July: Central Assessment Day. Instead of a scary interview, you'll participate

in group tasks to show off your teamwork and communication skills.

● Mid-September: The official start date for our new intake.

Requirements

● Qualifications: GCSE English and Maths at Grade 4/C or above are essential.

● Key Skills: We look for candidates who are logical, organised, and have great

attention to detail.

● Driving: Ideally, you’ll have a full driving license, but don’t worry if you aren't there

yet! If you’re under 17 or haven’t started yet, we just look for a real desire to get

behind the wheel as soon as you’re able.

A Future Without Limits

After completing your Level 3 qualification, your journey at Holdcroft is just beginning. You

could progress into roles such as:

● Master Technician

● Service Manager

Ready to Join the Team?

Click Apply Now. Or apply through the Holdcroft careers website or the government

Apprenticeship portal.

A Note for Parents & Guardians

We understand that transitioning from school to the workplace is a big step.

Apprentice Technician The Holdcroft Academy is designed to make this transition safe and successful:

● Dedicated Safeguarding: The safety and well-being of our apprentices is our top

priority. All apprentices have access to a dedicated coach and a mentor who is

trained to provide a supportive and safe learning environment.

● Structured Mentorship: Your child will be paired with a ''Buddy'' (typically a Master

Technician) who provides daily guidance and ensures they are working safely and

correctly.

● Professional Qualification: This Level 3 program is equivalent to A-Levels and

provides a nationally recognised qualification through the IMI or equivalent.

● On-Site Security: By delivering all training within our own dealerships, we maintain a

consistent, professional environment without the need for external travel to colleges.

● A Guaranteed Future: We invest heavily in our ''Grow Our Own'' talent strategy,

which is why we guarantee a permanent job to every apprentice who completes the

program.

title: Research Associate CEA
description:
Research Associate (Strategic Recruiting) – Centre for Expert Acquisition (CEA)

Location: Gurugram (Delhi NCR) – In-office
Shift: US Hours (approx. 6:00 PM – 2:30 AM IST)

Overview

Guidepoint is launching a centralized Centre for Expert Acquisition (CEA) team to build and scale expert coverage across priority sectors, particularly within Private Markets.

This team will operate differently from traditional recruiting. Instead of reacting to individual client requests, the CEA team builds proactive, programmatic pipelines — mapping markets, identifying priority companies and personas, and continuously recruiting high-value experts aligned to Guidepoint’s long-term strategy.

This is a high-execution, outbound role with significant time spent on phone-based outreach and engagement with senior industry professionals.

The role is fully in-office during US hours and is part of a new, high-visibility team being built from the ground up.

What You’ll Do

As a Research Associate (Strategic Recruiting), you will play a key role in expanding Guidepoint’s expert network in targeted industries and functions.

  • Identify and recruit senior industry professionals (executives, operators, customers, investors, subject matter experts) aligned to priority sectors
  • Execute high-volume outbound outreach daily via phone, LinkedIn, and email
  • Engage and communicate with senior professionals, clearly articulating Guidepoint’s value proposition
  • Screen and qualify experts for relevance, depth of experience, and suitability
  • Build and maintain accurate profiles in Guidepoint’s CRM systems
  • Work closely with internal stakeholders to understand sector priorities and coverage gaps
  • Meet and exceed weekly and monthly recruiting KPIs in a performance-driven environment
  • Continuously refine outreach strategies based on response rates and conversion trends
  • Support onboarding and early activation of newly recruited experts

What You Have

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher with strong academic performance
  • 0–2 years of experience in recruitment, B2B sales, inside sales, business development, lead generation, or similar roles
  • Comfort with cold calling and outbound outreach as a core daily activity
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Willingness and ability to work a fixed US-hours night shift from office (mandatory)
  • Results-oriented mindset with a track record of meeting or exceeding targets
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Intellectual curiosity and willingness to learn about new industries
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating closely within a team

Who Thrives in This Role

  • Individuals who enjoy fast-paced, target-driven environments
  • People comfortable speaking with senior professionals daily
  • Self-starters who take ownership and operate with high accountability
  • Candidates motivated by performance, growth, and building something from scratch

What Makes This Role Unique

  • Direct exposure to senior executives, investors, and industry leaders globally
  • Opportunity to help build a new, centralized recruiting engine from the ground up
  • High visibility within Guidepoint’s global research and operations leadership
  • Clear, KPI-driven performance structure with measurable impact
  • Strong career progression into recruiting, strategic sourcing, and research roles

What We Offer

  • Competitive base compensation with performance-linked incentives
  • Comprehensive medical coverage
  • Structured training and onboarding
  • Collaborative, high-energy team environment
  • Fast-paced, merit-driven growth opportunities

About Guidepoint

Guidepoint powers end-to-end research workflows for the world’s best research teams.

Backed by a global network of more than 2 million experts and over 1,600 employees, Guidepoint delivers real-time access to expertise, primary research, and actionable knowledge that help organizations make informed decisions. Through consultations, surveys, events, proprietary content, and AI-enabled tools, we support every stage of the decision-making process—from developing hypotheses and gathering insights to validating assumptions and building conviction for critical decisions.

At Guidepoint, our success relies on the diversity of our employees, experts, and clients, which enables us to foster meaningful connections and a broad range of perspectives. We are committed to creating an inclusive and welcoming environment where individuals of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences can contribute and succeed.

title: Senior Labour Relations Specialist, Employee Relations and Transitions - EMEA
description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

As a critical extension of our clients’ HR teams, we navigate and advise on the intricate paths of global employment with unmatched speed, expertise, and precision. The vision of the Lifecycle team at Remote is not just about maintaining the gold standard in HR practices; it’s about elevating it, integrating cutting-edge technology solutions, and enriching customer experiences in over 80+ countries. On this team, your work directly influences our ability to sustain and extend our compliance coverage, continuously enhance our customer journeys, and significantly increase our operational capacity. You’re not just part of a team; you’re at the forefront of shaping the future of work, ensuring every interaction is fast, intuitive, and profoundly impactful. Dive into a role where your passion for innovation, commitment to excellence, and drive to make a global difference aligns with our mission to empower organizations worldwide to employ anyone, anywhere — compliantly.

The Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations & Transitions manages employee exits for Remote's external employees with a focus on legal compliance and providing delightful customer service. Additionally, the specialist provides first-level Employee Relations support, guiding clients through workplace concerns and coordinating appropriate resources when needed.

As part of a larger employee Lifecycle team, the Specialist is also expected to contribute to process improvements and initiatives in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.

Key Responsibilities

Offboarding

  • Möjlighet att arbeta med moderna och hållbara energilösningar

  • Korta beslutsvägar och möjlighet att påverka verksamheten

title: Rehabilitation Consultant (Psychologist, Rehabilitation Counsellor)
description:
Experts in workplace health, injury management and safety, Acumen Health (part of the APM Group) delivers the highest standard in services across personal injury and occupational health. The team at Acumen Health focus on recovery and function to get clients back to work and back to life whatever their age, stage or situation. Our personal injury division provides services through federal and state-based Workers Compensations, Occupational Rehabilitation and Injury Management.

  • Apply your clinical reasoning skills to support people who have sustained a physical and/or psychological injury at work
  • Taking a more holistic care approach, you will work within a multidisciplinary team to support the journey from rehab to healing
  • Perform a variety of assessments including Vocational Assessments, Transferrable Skills Assessment, Job preparation services, Worksite Assessments and initial needs assessments
  • Collaborate with a variety of stakeholders, including injured employees and employers, medical specialists and other allied health professionals
  • Develop, implement and monitor rehabilitation plans through case management

Our client base is diverse. You will be exposed to transport, agriculture, government, construction, hospitality, retail, manufacturing and professional services industries as well as Department of Veterans Affairs.

Enjoy meaningful and purposeful work as you support your client return to the same job or to find a new employment opportunity.

Joining the APM group, you have the opportunity to grow your career in Human Services across multiple global brands and geographies. A diverse team of almost 16,000 people across 11 countries with a shared purpose – to enable better lives for our employees and the communities we work in. Additionally Acumen Health is the exclusive provider of Occupational Rehabilitation services to the ADF.

Our work enables the people we serve to realise their ambitions and aspirations through sustainable employment, independence, better health and wellbeing and increased social participation. As a valued APM employee you will have access to a comprehensive to make your experience working for APM the best it can be.

You can expect a great work-life balance, extensive learning opportunities, networking programs and employee benefits. Enjoy all the perks of a global conglomerate including access to a Fitness Passport, plus discounts at hundreds of retail outlets and reduced health insurance.

But most of all you can expect to make a lasting impact on the lives of others, who rely on our services.

What’s in it for you:

We’ll work with you to TAILOR a career pathway that meets your career goals. We have a variety of working options to fit your needs and will match you to what works best for you.

Joining a high-quality service provider, you will be SUPPORTED and MENTORED through direct interaction and an extensive onboarding process (incl. ongoing shadowing) to build your technical knowledge and expertise and enable your success.

Enjoy a combination of working from home and office. Manage your own calendar to suit your work life balance.

What will make you successful:

  • Current unrestricted (or eligibility for) registration or membership with the relevant industry body (AHPRA or ASORC)
  • Tertiary qualifications in Rehabilitation Counselling or Psychology (Fully registered or Provisional Psychologists with external supervision)
  • Strong clinical reasoning
  • Ability to engage across multidisciplinary teams to support the achievement of a common goal
  • Passion to help people rehabilitate
  • Occupational Rehabilitation experience will be desirable

Ready to join?

Click APPLY now and complete your application through our online recruitment platform.

For a confidential chat please contact Amanda Whinney on 0458 379 067 or connect at:

We're committed to Equality, Diversity and Inclusivity. We welcome all people to join our team, including Veterans, people from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities, living with disability, all gender identities, LGBTQIA+, people of any socioeconomic status, of any age, race, national origin or ethnicity. We believe each person’s uniqueness makes us even better at the work we do.
