title: Sjuksköterska till avdelning G9, Gällivare Sjukhus
description:
Avdelning G9 är en medicin/rehab avdelning innehållande medicin/rehab/stroke/PAVA. Avdelningen har i dagsläget 16 vårdplatser med två team.

Vi söker

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad sjuksköterska med god förmåga att uttrycka dig på svenska i tal och skrift. Erfarenhet av arbete på vårdavdelning är meriterande. Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper och söker dig som arbetar självständigt, har ett strukturerat arbetssätt och god kommunikativ förmåga. Du har lätt för att samarbeta, tar ansvar för ditt arbete och har en helhetssyn som bidrar till att skapa trygg och kvalitativ vård för patienterna.

Det här får du arbeta med

Som sjuksköterska på avdelning G9 arbetar du i ett tvärprofessionellt team tillsammans med läkare, undersköterskor, fysioterapeuter och arbetsterapeuter, där patienten alltid står i centrum. Du har en arbetsledande roll gentemot undersköterskor och samverkar nära övriga yrkesgrupper för att säkerställa en god och säker vård. I rollen ansvarar du för omvårdnaden av cirka åtta patienter och arbetsuppgifterna omfattar bland annat läkemedelshantering, dokumentation, patient- och anhörigkontakter samt deltagande i läkarronder. Arbetet är varierande och erbjuder en bred klinisk erfarenhet där ingen dag är den andra lik.

Det här erbjuder vi dig

  • Dubblerad ersättning för arbete under obekväm arbetstid. En satsning Region Norrbotten gör för medarbetare i dygnet runt verksamhet, något som gör oss unika bland regioner i Sverige
  • Interna utbildningar
  • Utvecklings- och karriärmöjligheter där du får vara med och skapa framtidens hälsa och vård
  • Kliniskt basår för dig som ny sjuksköterska för att arbetet ska bli stimulerande, utvecklande och tryggt, läs mer här https://www.norrbotten.se/sv/jobba-hos-oss/anstallningsvillkor-och-utveckling/
  • Hälsofrämjande arbetsplatser med tillgång till friskvårdsaktiviteter och friskvårdsbidrag
  • Länk till våra förmåner: https://www.norrbotten.se/sv/jobba-hos-oss/anstallningsvillkor-och-utveckling/

Information om tjänsten

Vi erbjuder dig en tillsvidareanställning på heltid, arbetstiden är förlagd till dag/kväll och helg. Urval och intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Region Norrbotten tillämpar individuell lönesättning enligt kollektivavtal.

Vi verkar för att ha medarbetare med kunskaper inom Sveriges nationella minoritetsspråk och sätter därför värde på dina kunskaper i samiska, meänkieli, finska, romani chib och jiddisch. Vi arbetar aktivt för en jämn könsfördelning och ser mångfald som en styrka. Vi välkomnar medarbetare med olika bakgrund och arbetar för att vår arbetsplats ska vara tillgänglig för alla.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Senior Staff Engineer, Digital Design (Power & Analog ICs)
description:
We are seeking a Senior Staff Digital Design Engineer to architect and implement the digital content within power, analog, and mixed-signal IC products. This is a senior individual-contributor role requiring ownership from requirements and microarchitecture through RTL, synthesis, timing closure, DFT support, and silicon bring-up.

The successful candidate will design control, sequencing, protection, diagnostics, trimming, communication, test, and safety-related logic that works closely with analog circuitry. The emphasis is not on large processor SoCs. It is on high-quality digital design embedded inside power and analog ICs.

You will be expected to resolve ambiguous requirements, make sound area-power-performance trade-offs, develop reusable design practices, mentor engineers, and collaborate across analog design, verification, physical design, test, applications, and product teams.

Responsibilities :

Digital Architecture & RTL Design

  • Translate product and circuit requirements into robust digital microarchitecture and detailed block specifications.

  • Design optimized RTL for control, sequencing, protection, diagnostics, trimming, communication, test, and low-power functions within power and analog ICs.

  • Own block-level integration and contribute to chip-level digital architecture, interfaces, clocking, reset, power-state, and register-map decisions.

  • Make and document trade-offs across functionality, area, power, testability, timing, reuse, and implementation risk.

Implementation, Timing & DFT

  • Develop synthesizable Verilog/SystemVerilog RTL, synthesis scripts, timing constraints, and implementation collateral.

  • Own or guide synthesis, lint, CDC/RDC, low-power checks, static timing analysis, and handoff to physical design.

  • Support DFT architecture and implementation, including scan insertion, ATPG enablement, test modes, and production-test requirements.

  • Work with place-and-route teams on timing closure, congestion, power, and post-layout issues.

Verification & Silicon Support

  • Collaborate with verification engineers on verification planning, assertions, coverage, debug, and specification closure.

  • Develop directed tests, reference checks, or test vectors where useful to accelerate design validation and production-test development.

  • Support gate-level and post-layout verification, silicon bring-up, device evaluation, failure analysis, and root-cause investigation.

  • Develop and document practical workarounds where device errata or silicon limitations require them.

Technical Leadership & Reuse

  • Drive reusable RTL, design methodology, coding standards, review practices, and automation across projects.

  • Mentor junior and mid-level digital engineers and lead architecture, RTL, and implementation reviews.

  • Identify technical and schedule risks early and communicate clear options and recommendations to project leadership.

  • Collaborate effectively with analog, applications, test, layout, CAD, and product teams across global locations.

  • Bachelor or Masters degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • 10+ years of relevant experience in digital design, RTL development, and implementation for semiconductor products.

  • Deep hands-on experience in logic design, microarchitecture, Verilog/SystemVerilog RTL coding, synthesis, and static timing analysis.

  • Experience designing digital control logic embedded in PMICs, power-management, automotive, audio, or other mixed-signal integrated circuits.

  • Strong understanding of clocks, resets, low-power states, finite-state machines, register interfaces, fault handling, and hardware-software interaction.

  • Hands-on experience developing block-level and top-level timing constraints for STA and physical-design sign-off.

  • Working knowledge of DFT, scan insertion, ATPG, test modes, CDC/RDC analysis, lint, and gate-level verification.

  • Experience with scripting and automation using TCL, Python, Perl, shell, or similar languages.

  • Proven ability to own complex design blocks, influence chip-level decisions, mentor engineers, and lead technical reviews.

  • Self-driven, results-oriented, and able to deliver high-quality designs under tight schedules in a multisite and multicultural environment.

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

title: Café- och restaurangbiträde Stockholm | 155–185 kr/h | 🚀
description:
JOBBA SOM KONSULT - PÅ DINA VILLKOR

På FRAM tycker vi att du som jobbar i branschen förtjänar en bättre och roligare arbetsplats och en arbetsgivare som verkligen bryr sig om dig. Där du får möjligheten att utvecklas, både personligt och yrkesmässigt och där gemenskap, yrkesstolthet, high-fives, personalfester och lite familjekänsla är drivkraften.

Låter det bra? Vi tänkte väl det. Välkommen till FRAM ⭐️

VILKA ÄR FRAM?

På FRAM är vi övertygande om att arbeta på restaurang är världens roligaste jobb. Energin, kollegorna och gästerna. Att jobba med mat och dryck tycker vi slår slöa kontorsarbeten och trötta administrativa jobb i alla avseenden.

Vi är ett personligt bemanningsföretag som arbetar uteslutande inom hotell- och restaurangbranschen som ser på branschen och anställda lite annorlunda. Vi uppskattar våra kollegor och är i särklass bäst på det här.

Vi är flera hundra anställda, dussinet på kontoren - det går verkligen skitbra för oss.💪

Självklart är vi ett auktoriserat bemanningsföretag, medlemmar i Visita och anslutna till kollektivavtal.

Vi har framgångsrikt tagit över stora delar av marknaden i Göteborg, Malmö och nu har FRAM etablerat sig här i Stockholm på riktigt sedan 2023 med flera ruttade kollegor på kontoret som kan branschen i alla avseenden. Vi satsar stenhårt och har för avsikt att bli den i särklass bästa arbetsgivaren för oss branschfolk inom hotell- och restaurangbranschen. Allt vi gör är transparent, öppet, ärligt och vi skippar skitsnacket.

FRAM jobbar endast med seriösa ställen och vi väljer vilka vi jobbar med. Våra kunder är allt från schyssta kvarterskrogar, ledande hotellkedjor, bra företagsrestauranger och mötesanläggningar. Gemensamma nämnaren är att det är reko arbetsplaster, hela och rena matsalar med schysst nivå och god stämning.

HUR FUNKAR DET?

Du blir anställd av oss på FRAM och jobbar på lite olika ställen kors och tvärs över stan. Ibland kan du arbeta på några olika arbetsplaster i veckan eller så kör ett långtidsuppdrag på ett och samma ställe. Du får förslag på uppdrag i god tid, du åker ut och jobbar hos våra kunder och du får lön av oss. Ganska straight forward. Vi ser vårt jobb som ett hantverk, vi på FRAM är bäst på vad vi gör.

Du väljer helt och hållet hur du vill jobba. Endast dagtid vardagar? Inga problem. Vill du bara jobba kvällar? Absolut. Vill du alltid vara ledig vissa dagar i veckan? Vi löser det! Hos oss tar du ledigt eller semester NÄR DU VILL!

Vi anpassar oss efter dig, vart du bor, hur du vill köra och vilken typ av matlagning du vill arbeta med (inget bullshit). Allt annat är ungefär som du tror och vi djupdyker på hur allt funkar på vårt möte här på vårt kontor på Västmannagatan.

VEM ÄR DU?

FRAM söker dig som som är hel och ren, har några år under bältet som biträde, servis, jobbat i café och har koll på det mesta inom restaurang. Du behöver inte vara superuttad eller jobbat på stjärnkrog men har jobbat inom restaurang tidigare.

Hos oss sitter du aldrig i skiten men du fattar lite grann av vad som krävs av dig och hajja hur det funkar här i stan vare sig du vill kör frukost på ett fint hotell i stan, en bra lunchrestaurang där du gör lite allt möjligt, en flashig bankettmiddag med många andra kollegor på FRAM eller kör service något a la carté ställe med oss.

Alla som jobbar med oss här på FRAM är ganska vassa på sitt jobb och det viktigaste av allt - alla som jobbar med oss är bra folk. Vi har inga armar och ben, inga dryga översittare, folk som skriker eller tröttmössor hos oss. Vi tar inte in vem som helst och det är inte helt enkelt att få jobb här.

Du har social kompetens, är hel, ren, presentabel och möter kunders blick och oftast är på gott humör. Du fattar!

DET HÄR FÅR DU HOS FRAM

Låt oss skippa skitsnacket. Hos oss kommer du och ditt välmående alltid först. Vi lovar att vara raka, ärliga och göra vårt bästa för att ge dig ett riktigt bra arbetsliv.

💰 Bra lön – och möjlighet att få delar av lönen utbetald kort efter arbetade pass.

🕐 Extra- eller tillsvidareanställning – du väljer det som passar dig bäst.

🚫 Inget tjafs – vi lovar ärlighet, tydlig kommunikation och att inte bråka om sådant som borde vara självklart.

🚗 Betalda resor – till och från jobbet vid längre uppdrag.

💅 Jobba när du vill, som du vill – dag, kväll, vardag eller helg. Vi anpassar oss efter dig.

🍻 Fatöl på kontoret – alla seriösa restaurangföretag måste ju ha fatöl på kontoret.

FLEXIBEL LÖN.

Vi erbjuder våra anställda flexibel lön genom appen Cappy. En förmån som ger dig koll på hur mycket du jobbat och tjänat med möjlighet att ta ut din intjänade lön när som helst mellan lönedagarna. Din lön, du bestämmer. Bra va?

ANSÖKAN

Skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Vi håller intervjuer löpande under augusti. Om vi tror att du passar för tjänsten kommer vi att ringa dig.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och rekryteringen pågår tills tjänsterna är tillsatta.

Start: Så fort som möjligt eller NÄR DU VILL! Omfattning: 3–5 dagar i veckan eller enligt dina önskemål. Lön: Rätt så bra! Övriga villkor: Enligt gällande kollektivavtal.

Sökord: servis, matsal, servitör, restaurang, hotell, biträde, restaurangbiträde, bartender, hovmästare, a la carté, lunchrestaurang, konferens, service, runner

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
CSQ427R228

As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) you will work with customers to build and productionize solutions to their data & AI challenges using the Databricks platform. You will own the architecture, lead design decisions, and implement end-to-end systems spanning data engineering, AI, and application development. We work cross-functionally to shape long-term strategic priorities and initiatives alongside engineering, product, and developer relations. FDEs deliver with customer empathy, integrating with client systems, training, and other technical needs to help customers get most value out of their data.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing role for builders who thrive at the intersection of technology and business impact. The ideal candidate combines engineering expertise with adaptability, curiosity, and a passion for working with customers and teammates to solve complex problems that drive measurable outcomes. FDEs are billable and know how to complete projects according to specification with exceptional customer empathy.

The impact you will have:

  • Production Solution Delivery: Lead impactful customer technical projects by delivering production-grade systems, designing and building reference architectures, custom applications and data ingestion and ML/AI model integration
  • Transformational Impact: Guide strategic customers as they implement transformational big data projects including end-to-end design, build and deployment of industry-leading big data and AI applications. Work with engagement managers to scope technical delivery work with input from the customer
  • Empower Customers: Guide customers on architecture and design; bootstrap or implement customer projects which leads to a customers' successful understanding, evaluation and adoption of Databricks.
  • Own the Architecture: Lead architecture and design decisions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, and aligned with both customer needs and Databricks best practices.
  • Work with the Databricks technical team, Project Manager, Architect and Customer team to ensure the technical components of the engagement are delivered to meet customer's needs.
  • Work with Engineering and Databricks Customer Support to provide product and implementation feedback and to guide rapid resolution for engagement specific product and support issues.
  • Customer Immersion: Embed with customer teams, engaging with stakeholders from technical ICs to executives to deeply understand challenges and deliver impact.
  • Reusable Assets & Scale: Contribute accelerators, frameworks, and best practices that scale impact across accounts and influence the Databricks product roadmap.

What we look for:

    • 6+ years experience in data engineering, data platforms & analytics, or software engineering
    • Comfortable writing code in either Python, Scala, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks
    • Working knowledge of two or more common Cloud ecosystems (AWS, Azure, GCP) with expertise in at least one
    • Deep experience with distributed computing with Apache Spark™ and knowledge of Spark runtime internals
    • Familiarity with CI/CD for production deployments
    • Working knowledge of MLOps, ML/AI models and AI APIs
    • Design and deployment of performant production end-to-end data architectures and applications that combine data pipelines, ML/AI models, and user-facing interfaces.
    • Experience with technical project delivery - managing scope, timelines and measurable outcomes, translating complex concepts into actionable solutions.
    • Documentation and white-boarding skills.
    • Experience working with enterprise clients and managing conflicts across a broad stakeholder range
    • Build skills in technical areas, and demonstrate curiosity, adaptability, and eagerness to explore new technologies which support the deployment and integration of Databricks-based solutions to complete customer projects.
    • Travel to customers 20% of the time
    • Databricks Certification

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on LinkedIn, X, YouTube, and Instagram.

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click here.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

title: Menswear Design Lead, ASOS Design
description:
The Design Lead plays a critical role in strategically driving the success of multiple departments through effective trend building, strategic planning and range building. Working collaboratively with leaders across Merchandising, Buying, Sourcing, Technical, Global Commerce and Marketing, they are responsible for leading teams to achieve directional & commercially successful outcomes for the departments and wider business.
You will lead the product strategy for multiple departments, managing a team of Designers and working collaboratively with the wider Retail team to deliver a commercial and trend-led range that is loved by the MW ASOS Design customer, globally.

You will be collaborative, organised, and strategic with your finger on the pulse of fashion - always looking to push the range for our global markets forward.
Contribute to design direction and ensure that product design is aligned to the strategic vision & focused on delivering a compelling and commercial offer appropriate for our target customer. The Design Lead will contribute to MW ASOS Design success and growth by managing & developing a highly creative design team.

What you'll be doing:

  • Supporting the Design Director to contribute to the product and design vision for MW ASOS Design
  • Work collaboratively with colleagues across Menswear product departments including Leads and Heads of category, Buying, Merchandising and Technical management team to create the range
  • Overseeing range development, ensuring that the product reflects the Brand strategy, the range is without gaps or duplication, and that the season is logically and commercially thought through.
  • Shaping a strategy for the departments you are responsible for that is aligned to the wider Commercial and MW ASOS strategy, understanding how the range sits within the overall ASOS portfolio
  • Work collaboratively with other functions to deliver the MW ASOS strategy
  • Drive and embed a best-in-class proactive Team, which supports the delivery of MW ASOS Design Brand of the Future
  • Management of the MW ASOS Design teams
  • Identifying new product opportunities as they emerge in the market and actioning those in the range in a commercial manner
  • Manage the process of creating a balanced range, developing Big deals, key seasonal shapes, trends and items for the MW ASOS Design customer
  • Collaborate across departments and functions of the business including Marketing, to ensure the design vision is communicated clearly
  • Work collaboratively with WW colleagues across Design & Heads of Category management team when required to share processes and trend information
  • Shaping the product direction of multiple departments and strategy with key partners
  • Operating as a senior manager within the Commercial division, working in close partnership with ASOS Design Leads & Heads of category and the wider Retail team to deliver profitable departments, irrespective of market conditions and shifting trends
  • Anticipating the needs of the customer, using sales data, customer profile analytics and trend information to deliver commercial product ranges and shape the future of the division
  • Working with leaders in the Global team to understand global planning and trading strategy for departments, identifying new moments and opportunities to support global requirements
  • Building and leveraging relationships with a network of appropriate internal teams to drive evolution within the strategy
  • Shaping and driving lean, agile processes and ways of working for departments
  • Maintains and instils in the departments a strong understanding of global competitors' product offer to pivot team activity and manage risks, as required
  • Analysing trading patterns, advising teams and ensuring appropriate action is taken to unforeseen sales reactions.
  • Working with Merchandising & Buying Leads to ensure that product reviews are held at the appropriate time for product sign-off.
  • Guiding team on range building, taking into account Options, ALB strategy and global requirements
  • Maintaining a clear understanding of brand purpose and Fashion with Integrity and ensuring these principles are fully embedded within the team
  • Leading and driving business wide initiatives and projects, positively influencing and championing change
  • Agreeing styling and visual merchandising guidelines with Studios
  • Leading and building a strong team with a focus on growing future talent
  • Providing clear direction and development to the team, identifying individual training needs and encouraging collaborative ways of working
  • Motivating and engaging the team through recognition and regular feedback

    We'd love to meet, someone who:

    • Proven MW experience is a requirement
    • Shows strong awareness of current trends, Retail market conditions and opportunities within a Global context
    • Has a proven track record in Design within a fast-paced and rapidly changing global Retailer
    • Demonstrates the ability to drive the success of multiple departments through strategic and commercial thinking
    • Can successfully influence and gain buy in from the team and leaders to potentialize opportunities
    • Embraces and champions the benefits of change within the wider team while we continue to embark on our AI journey
    • Presents performance and strategy to the team and management with an engaging and confident style
    • Shows a deep understanding of the ASOS customer and customer segmentation and reflects this in decision making
    • Demonstrates a commercial and analytical mindset, using data and insights to leverage opportunities that successfully contribute to the department and wider ASOS strategy
    • Uses relevant market insights to aid decision making and achieve the best outcome for the business
    • Has a strong awareness of current trends, Retail market conditions and opportunities within a Global context
    • Builds great relationships with internal stakeholders Exec level and other functions
    • Has an effective and inclusive management style, role modelling positive behaviours and providing the team with clear direction and development
    • Shows a deep understanding of the ASOS customer and customer segmentation and reflects this in decision making

    What’s in it for you?

    • Employee discount (hello ASOS discount!)

    • ASOS Develops (personal development opportunities across the business)

    • Employee sample sales

    • Access to a huge range of LinkedIn learning materials

    • 25 days paid annual leave + an extra day for your birthday

    • Discretionary performance related bonus scheme

    • Private medical care scheme

    • Flexible benefits allowance - which you can choose to take as extra cash, or use towards other benefits

title: Senior Field Applications Engineer
description:
Renesas/Altium is seeking an enthusiastic and dynamic Field Application Engineer (FAE) for its Regional Sales team. In this role, the candidate will work closely with Sales Engineers and FAEs across Turkey and Eastern Europe to support key customers in Renesas Analog & Power product portfolio.

This position is with Altium Poland. The employment contract will be with Altium Poland.

As a Field Applications Engineer, you are the bridge between your customers and many internal business divisions. Your primary goal is to win new business through proactive in-depth design and development support that will solve your customers' challenges. This requires a profound knowledge of the customer development process. You need to be familiar with all the aspects of the product lifecycle, from development to mass production.

In this role, you will also be responsible for actively driving and managing the technology proposal and evaluation stages. As part of the Sales team, you act as the key technical advisor for a wide range of your customers' applications.

Responsibilities:

  • Work hand in hand with sales to drive relationship building with customers.
  • Promote the complete analog and power portfolio, including interfaces, power management, as well as sensors. Work closely with your Digital and Connectivity FAE counterparts, also addressing Renesas’ digital & connectivity solutions.
  • Provide technical expertise and support to develop Renesas revenues, in close cooperation with the Renesas Sales Team and Distribution Network.
  • Drive and support projects proactively from demand creation to mass production.
  • Grow solid technical understanding of our products and relevant solutions. Can demonstrate products and get involved with system-level design, or in-depth technical support as required.
  • Identify new sockets for Renesas by working closely with customers at project design level to achieve Design Win targets.
  • Create, organize, update, and track opportunities and designs.
  • Develop a good understanding of customer products and markets, as well as supply, and business requirements. Be able to communicate them clearly at all levels internally, and highlight critical product needs
  • Understand the competition for us within the customers and develop strategies to counter their activity.
  • Travel within the assigned territory to customers and distributors
  • Be entrepreneurial and take ownership to keep an eye on and drive the business opportunity.

Besides your demonstrated technical skills and experience, we are looking for a team player. You should have very good communication skills and interaction with people. You are curious by nature and eager to keep up with our technological advances, as well as your customers' development. Furthermore, you like to share your knowledge and experience with your customers and team. Additionally, it is required to act on your own initiative, evaluate chances and risks carefully.

  • 5+ years of experience in a similar role would be preferred, but personality and technical knowledge are key.
  • Degree in Electrical Engineering with experience in Analog and Power Management applications, and a good track record of building customer relationships.
  • Basic knowledge about MCU/MPU systems is not mandatory, but useful.
  • Strong problem-solving capability to interface customer needs and resources with energetic and proactive approaches.
  • Strategic and commercial thinking to perform and organize efficient design planning for target accounts. Have the capability to identify key projects and recommend possible solutions.
  • Ability to work independently with strong analytical skills, self-motivation, and excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Very good command of English and mobility are key elements required for the job.

Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, To Make Our Lives Easier. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future.

At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

Are you ready to join our team and shape the future with us?

Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. title: LIA till Hellenic Groups Designteam
description:
Om Hellenic Group

Sedan 1958 har Hellenic Group varit en ledande aktör när det gäller att förse europeiska företag med framgångsrika sourcinglösningar i Asien. Hellenic Group grundades i Sverige och har ett öga för europeisk estetik och en naturlig känsla för mode och kvalitet, som gör att vi inte bara förstår våra kunder utan även deras kunder. Det är detta som gör oss unika och det som har gjort att Hellenic Group inte bara överlevt utan också vuxit sig starkare under årtionden, trots konkurrens och digitalisering. Med många års erfarenhet, kunskap och engagemang ger våra kunder oss fortsatt förtroende år efter år vilket vi är stolta över.

Om LIA-rollen

Nu söker vi en LIA som vill vara en del av vårt designteam. Hos oss får du arbeta nära erfarna designers och följa hela designprocessen, från idé och trendanalys till färdig produkt. Du blir en del av ett kreativt team där du får bidra i det dagliga arbetet samtidigt som du utvecklar dina kunskaper inom design, textil och produktutveckling.

Du kommer vara delaktig i att

  • Assistera i design- och produktutvecklingsprocessen

  • Delta i arbetet med att ta fram och uppdatera moodboards, färgkartor och inspirationsmaterial

  • Bidra till framtagning av skisser och produktinstruktioner

  • Delta i trend- och omvärldsbevakning

  • Stötta designteamet i kollektionsarbetet

  • Arbeta med administration kopplad till designprocessen

Vi söker dig som

  • Studerar textildesign, modedesign eller annan motsvarande utbildning

  • Har erfarenhet av att arbeta i Adobe Illustrator och Photoshop

  • Har ett stort intresse för mode, textil och design

  • Är kreativ, nyfiken och har känsla för färg, form och detaljer

  • Är strukturerad och noggrann i ditt arbete

  • Trivs med att samarbeta i team

  • Är initiativtagande och vill utvecklas i en praktisk och lärorik miljö

Meriterande om du har

  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta med grafiska mönster

Praktisk information

Plats: Hovås

Period: Enligt överenskommelse

Omfattning: Praktikperiodens längd anpassas utifrån utbildningens upplägg och sker enligt överenskommelse mellan praktikant, utbildningsanordnare och Hellenic Group. Vi ser gärna att praktiken omfattar en längre sammanhängande period för att ge bästa möjliga förutsättningar för lärande och utveckling.

Har du frågor eller funderingar gällande LIA-rollen så är du välkommen att kontakta Marc Magnusson på 0707-972718 alt marc@searchr.se eller Felicia Hellström på 0707-972729 alt felicia@searchr.se.

Vi intervjuar och tillsätter löpande, så tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

title: Vacature Baliemedewerker Technische Dienst – Van Cranenbroek Dongen
description:
Weet jij waarom een accuboormachine het niet meer doet? En leg je dat net zo makkelijk uit aan een klant aan de balie? Dan is Van Cranenbroek op zoek naar jou als Baliemedewerker Technische Dienst in Dongen!

Wat ga je doen?

Van Cranenbroek is een familiebedrijf met vijf filialen in Nederland en België en circa 1000 medewerkers. In onze winkel in Dongen vinden klanten alles voor huis, tuin, dier en klus. Gaat er iets kapot of werkt een product niet zoals het hoort, dan komen ze bij jou aan de balie van de Technische Dienst. Jij zoekt uit wat er aan de hand is, regelt de reparatie of garantie en zorgt dat de klant weet waar hij aan toe is.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor klanten en collega's aan de TD-balie:

  • Intake en uitgifte van reparaties en (garantie)retouren;

  • Klanten adviseren over onderdelen, onderhoud en technische problemen;

  • Werkzaamheden inplannen met de TD-monteurs;

  • Onderdelen bestellen, ontvangen en uitgeven;

  • Contact onderhouden met leveranciers over reparaties en garanties;

  • De administratie rond reparaties, garanties en retouren bijhouden;

  • Telefoon en e-mail van de Technische Dienst beantwoorden;

  • Eenvoudige tests of checks uitvoeren;

  • Beheer van de balie: netjes, veilig en op orde.

Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?

  • Een tijdelijk contract voor 24 tot 40 uur per week, met kans op verlenging en uitzicht op een vaste aanstelling;

  • Een marktconform salaris waarbij iedere gewerkte minuut wordt uitbetaald, plus vakantiegeld;

  • Toeslag voor werken op feestdagen;

  • Reiskostenvergoeding van € 0,23 per kilometer (tot maximaal 40 km per dag);

  • Pensioen: 24,75% premie, waarvan maar liefst 18,675% door de werkgever wordt betaald;

  • Maaltijdvergoeding en gratis fruit op het werk;

  • 25 vakantiedagen + 1 extra vrije dag bij een fulltime dienstverband;

  • Aantrekkelijke personeelskorting op ons brede assortiment;

  • Ruime doorgroeimogelijkheden, zowel binnen de winkel als op het hoofdkantoor;

  • Gezellige extra's zoals een jaarlijkse nieuwjaarsborrel en zelfs een frietwagen op locatie.

Je hoeft geen monteur te zijn, maar techniek moet je liggen. We zoeken iemand die rustig blijft als een klant met een kapot product voor de balie staat en die zelf uitzoekt hoe het zit.

  • Mbo werk- en denkniveau, een technische achtergrond is een pre;

  • Affiniteit met gereedschap, machines en het assortiment van Van Cranenbroek;

  • Je lost problemen op in plaats van ze door te schuiven;

  • Klantvriendelijk, communicatief en servicegericht;

  • Zelfstandig, flexibel en proactief;

  • Je ziet kansen voor bijverkoop en benut ze;

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal in woord en geschrift; een tweede taal is een pre;

  • Je kunt op zaterdag werken en bent beschikbaar volgens het winkelrooster.

Zin in een nieuwe uitdaging binnen een betrokken organisatie? Reageer vandaag nog!

title: ES Workday Reporting Senior Analyst
description:
To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Employee Success

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Role Overview
The Workday Reporting Senior Analyst is a senior lead within the ES Data Operations team, based in Hyderabad. This role is critical for providing strategic, timely, and actionable data insights to stakeholders, business leaders and CoEs across the organization. Serving as the subject matter expert on all facets of Workday reporting, the Senior Analyst manages the full lifecycle of complex reporting requests—from requirement gathering, strategic consultation, and data architecture analysis to building, delivering, and governing reports. Beyond technical execution, this role drives process automation and reporting enhancements, provides consultative guidance on data strategy, enforces strict data privacy and compliance policies, and consistently adheres to team KPIs and SLAs to deliver a seamless, high-touch employee data experience.

Key Responsibilities:


The responsibilities of the Workday Reporting Senior Analyst include but are not limited to the following:

* Advanced Design and Development: Architect, build, test, and deploy complex Workday Custom Reports across all report types—including Advanced, Matrix, Composite, BIRT (Business Intelligence and Reporting Tools) tailored to strategic enterprise requirements.
* Calculated Fields Architecture: Design and troubleshoot highly complex Workday Calculated Fields and logic to power advanced analytics, multi-level reporting, and cross-functional metrics.
* Process Automation & Continuous Enhancement: Proactively identify opportunities to automate reporting workflows, optimize query execution, streamline distribution channels, and enhance overall data architecture to reduce manual overhead and improve operational scalability.
* Stakeholder Consultancy: Serve as a trusted advisor to business leaders. Translate ambiguous business questions into data solutions, offering strategic guidance on what data to report, how to interpret metrics, and how to leverage insights for decision-making.
* End-to-End Delivery & SLA Compliance: Oversee the complete reporting lifecycle from intake to delivery. Ensure strict adherence to service level agreements (SLAs), operational key performance indicators (KPIs), and queue management standards.
* Data Privacy, Governance & Compliance: Safeguard sensitive employee data by ensuring strict compliance with global data privacy regulations, data sharing nuances, and internal enterprise security policies. Advise stakeholders on appropriate data exposure and access boundaries.
* Report & Release Management: Proactively maintain and optimize existing reports. Own the evaluation, testing, and continuous alignment of reports during Workday's bi-annual feature releases and system updates.
* Complex Data & Root-Cause Analysis: Conduct deep-dive analysis on multi-dimensional HR datasets to uncover hidden trends, perform root-cause analyses on data anomalies, and ensure high-level data accuracy before delivery.
* Troubleshooting & Performance Tuning: Act as an escalation point for resolving complex report performance bottlenecks, access issues, and data discrepancies within the Workday reporting and security framework.
* Process Leadership & Mentorship: Lead team-wide reporting optimization initiatives, promote best practices in report design, and provide functional guidance and technical mentorship to junior team members.
* Comprehensive Documentation: Maintain clear, audit-ready process documentation for complex reports, automation workflows, data definitions, and governance protocols.


Required Skills and Experience

* 5+ years of professional experience in HR Data Operations, Business Intelligence, or Analytics, with at least 3+ years specializing directly in advanced Workday Reporting.
* Workday Reporting Expertise (Critical):
* Mastery across all Workday report types (Advanced, Matrix, Composite, BIRT, etc).
* Advanced capability in designing, nesting, and optimizing complex Workday Calculated Fields.
* Deep understanding of Workday Business Objects, Data Sources, and domain relationships across Workday HCM, Absence, Compensation, Talent, Payroll, Benefits, and Recruiting.
* Knowledge of Workday Security Groups and domain security policies as they relate to data privacy and report visibility.
* Stakeholder Management & Communication: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with a proven track record of effectively consulting with and influencing Stakeholders and non-technical business partners.
* Automation & Process Improvement: Strong track record of automating manual reporting processes, optimizing complex reports for speed and scalability, and driving operational efficiency.
* Data Governance & Privacy: Expert understanding of data governance principles, strict data confidentiality, global data privacy laws, and compliance frameworks governing enterprise employee data.
* Advanced Analytics & Tools: Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (complex formulas, macros, dynamic dashboards) and experience working with enterprise data visualization or BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
* Operational Discipline: Strong operational background with demonstrated experience managing ticket queues, balancing dynamic priorities, and consistently hitting tight SLAs/KPIs in a high-volume environment.
* High attention to detail, strong business acumen, and a solutions-oriented, consultative mindset.


Preferred

* Formal Workday Reporting Certification (e.g., Workday Pro - Reporting, Workday Pro - HCM, or equivalent).

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. title: Traffic Control Flagger
description:

title: Product Design Manager
description:

This role shapes and executes product design programs in alignment with brand vision, franchise priorities, and retailer business objectives, partnering closely with partners to execute market-ready products. title: #131505 - UX Researcher
description:
We are seeking a senior-level UX Researcher to support an enterprise employee-experience and internal-tooling research portfolio. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role for a researcher who can independently take ambiguous questions from initial scoping through study execution, synthesis, and decision-ready recommendations.

The work will span enterprise product, service, and operational workflows, with particular emphasis on understanding users' jobs, evaluating AI-enabled self-service experiences, and identifying opportunities to improve productivity and support experiences.

Enterprise experience strongly preferred.

## Key Responsibilities

* Independently plan and conduct mixed-method qualitative and quantitative research across priority enterprise initiatives.

* Translate ambiguous business and product questions into clear research plans, appropriate methodologies, and actionable study designs.

* Plan and moderate research evaluating AI-enabled self-service experiences and opportunities to improve employee support.

* Test AI-enabled concepts to understand jobs to be done, adoption barriers, trust, validation behavior, and readiness for broader rollout.

* Develop participant and recruitment strategies, research plans, discussion guides, study materials, and other research artifacts.

* Synthesize qualitative and quantitative findings into concise, decision-ready recommendations for product, service, and operational stakeholders.

* Maintain and extend a jobs-to-be-done framework across multiple initiatives and connect new research findings to broader strategic opportunities.

* Translate jobs-to-be-done insights into product and operational decisions.

* Partner cross-functionally with Product, Design, Engineering, Operations, and Service stakeholders.

* Produce clear research readouts, executive-ready storytelling, and documentation of findings, implications, decisions, and recommended next steps.

* Maintain traceable research artifacts and findings using collaboration, documentation, and research-repository systems.

* Partner with stakeholders to validate tooling and experience decisions before broader rollout.

* Connect individual studies to an ongoing strategic research framework and help identify opportunities to improve self-service, reduce confusion, and streamline workflows.

## Must-Have Skills

* 5+ years of hands-on UX research experience at a senior individual-contributor level.

* Demonstrated ability to independently scope, execute, analyze, and synthesize research studies.

* Strong qualitative research-method selection, execution, and analysis skills.

* Strong quantitative research-method selection, execution, and analysis skills.

* Experience researching enterprise internal tools, employee experience, or complex cross-functional workflows.

* Experience working within enterprise product, service, and operational workflows.

* Ability to translate research into clear, decision-ready recommendations for product and operational stakeholders.

* Demonstrated experience developing and applying a jobs-to-be-done framework or comparable strategic research framework across multiple initiatives.

* Demonstrated ability to translate strategic research frameworks into product and operational decisions.

* Strong stakeholder-management experience across Product, Design, Engineering, Operations, and Service teams.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including concise research readouts and executive-ready storytelling.

* Proficiency with research platforms supporting participant recruitment, moderated and unmoderated studies, surveys, and synthesis.

* Working knowledge of research repositories and documentation tools.

* Comfort using collaboration and documentation systems to maintain traceable research artifacts, findings, and decisions.

## Nice-to-Have Skills

* Experience researching AI-enabled products, assistants, automation, or emerging-technology adoption.

* Experience researching trust, validation behavior, user reliance, adoption barriers, or rollout readiness for AI-enabled experiences.

* Experience with employee experience, IT service management, self-service support, or digital workplace tools.

* Experience applying or evolving a jobs-to-be-done framework across multiple product or service areas.

* Track record of research influencing enterprise-tooling, AI-adoption, or service-experience decisions.

* Ability to connect individual studies to an ongoing strategic research framework.

* History of translating complex findings into actions that improve self-service, reduce confusion, or streamline workflows.

* Experience partnering with teams through launch and measurement rather than ending involvement at research delivery.

## Required Tools & Platforms

* Common research platforms for participant recruitment and study management.

* Platforms supporting moderated and unmoderated research.

* Survey and quantitative research tools.

* Research synthesis tools.

* Research repositories and documentation systems.

* Collaboration and documentation platforms used to maintain traceable research artifacts, findings, and decisions.

## Location, Time & Engagement

* Remote contract engagement.

* Candidates must be based in an approved LATAM location, excluding Mexico.

* Preference for availability aligned with Central Time working hours.

* Full-time allocation of approximately 40 hours per week.

* Current engagement end date: March 31, 2027.

title: Begeleider voor kinderen met een verstandelijke beperking - Kinderdienstencentrum - Amsterdam Nieuw-West
description:
Wil jij kinderen met een verstandelijke beperking helpen groeien en ontwikkelen? Ben jij op zoek naar een afwisselende functie waarin je zowel individueel als in groepsverband werkt? Dan is deze baan als Begeleider bij Kinderdienstencentrum De Schuit iets voor jou. Samen met collega's, ouders en behandelaren zorg jij ervoor dat ieder kind de ondersteuning krijgt die nodig is om zich optimaal te ontwikkelen.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Je krijgt een betekenisvolle baan binnen een kleurrijke organisatie die de ambitie heeft de beste zorgverlener én werkgever van Amsterdam te zijn. Voor deze functie zijn de arbeidsvoorwaarden conform de cao Gehandicaptenzorg:

    • Contract: een jaarcontract voor 24 tot 32 uur per week

    • Salaris: deze is conform cao Gehandicaptenzorg, FWG 40, dit is minimaal €2.893,- en maximaal €3.902,- bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur

    • Reizen: je krijgt reiskostenvergoeding en er is een fietsplan inclusief fietsreparatievergoeding

    • Pensioen: je bouwt je pensioen op via Pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn

    • Extra’s: je ontvangt vakantiegeld van 8% en een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% bovenop je salaris

    • Ontwikkeling: er is volop ruimte voor ontwikkeling en er worden trainingen aangeboden vanuit Cordaan zodat jij je functie goed kan vervullen

    • Aanbrengbonus: een nieuwe collega aandragen? Ontvang €500,- netto!

    Wat ga je doen?

    Als Begeleider bij Kinderdienstencentrum De Schuit begeleid je kinderen van 4 tot 12 jaar met een verstandelijke beperking, ontwikkelingsachterstand of bijkomende problematiek zoals autisme of ADHD. Je werkt zowel met groepen als individueel en hebt daarnaast een eigen caseload van mentorkinderen. Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

    • Je begeleidt kinderen in hun dagelijkse ontwikkeling en ondersteunt waar nodig bij ADL-taken

    • Je bent mentor van 3 tot 4 kinderen en onderhoudt contact met ouders en andere betrokkenen

    • Je schrijft zorgplannen, houdt dossiers bij en vraagt waar nodig therapieën aan

    • Je werkt nauw samen met persoonlijk begeleiders, gedragsdeskundigen en andere specialisten

    • Je observeert, rapporteert en bespreekt de ontwikkeling van kinderen tijdens multidisciplinaire overleggen

    • Je bedenkt en begeleidt samen met je collega’s creatieve, spel- en leeractiviteiten die passen bij de behoeften van de kinderen

    • Werken volgens de Triple-C visie: jij past de methodiek toe om consistent, coachend en coördinerend te handelen, zodat kinderen optimaal worden ondersteund

    Waar ga je werken?

    Kinderdienstencentrum De Schuit is een observatie- en behandelcentrum voor kinderen met een verstandelijke beperking en/of ontwikkelingsachterstand. Sinds de verhuizing naar onze nieuwe locatie in Amsterdam Nieuw-West werken De Schuit en De Driepunt samen vanuit één modern kinderdienstencentrum. Je komt terecht in een betrokken team waar samenwerking centraal staat. Er zijn verschillende overlegmomenten, zoals kindbesprekingen, teamoverleggen en werkbesprekingen. Ook krijg je volop mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen door trainingen en scholing vanuit Cordaan.

    Wie ben jij?

    Als Begeleider op Kinderdienstencentrum De Schuit ben je betrokken bij de kinderen, omdat zij een veilige, stabiele en stimulerende omgeving nodig hebben. Een betrokken houding helpt om vertrouwen op te bouwen en motiveert de kinderen om zich verder te ontwikkelen. Je bent flexibel en je een positieve teamspeler die goed kan samenwerken en openstaat voor feedback. Verder vragen wij:

    • Diploma: Je hebt een mbo niveau 4 diploma in zorg, welzijn of pedagogiek, zoals Maatschappelijke Zorg, Persoonlijk Begeleider Specifieke Doelgroepen, Onderwijsassistent, Sociaal Werk of Pedagogisch Medewerker.

    • Ervaring: Je hebt ervaring in het werken met kinderen, bij voorkeur in de Gehandicaptenzorg.

    Enthousiast?

    Ben jij de Begeleider bij Kinderdienstencentrum De Schuit die wij zoeken? Solliciteer dan snel. Na je sollicitatie ontvang je direct een bevestiging per e-mail (check ook je spam). Voor vragen kun je terecht bij:

    • Teamleider Nancy van der Spek via nvanderspek@cordaan.nl of via 06 - 28809746 voor functie-inhoudelijke vragen

    • Teamleider Renske Bos via rbos@cordaan.nl of via 06 - 34084713 voor functie-inhoudelijke vragen

    • Recruiter Nanuq Blankennagel via nblankennagel@cordaan.nl of via 06- 34054681 voor vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure.

    Wij werven doorlopend, wat betekent dat we de vacature zullen sluiten op het moment dat we onze nieuwe collega hebben gevonden. Wacht dus niet met solliciteren!

    Kleurrijk en betekenisvol met elkaar
    Cordaan vindt een inclusief werving- en selectiebeleid belangrijk. We omarmen eigenheid van collega’s en stimuleren ontwikkeling van talenten. Bij Cordaan willen we dat cliënten en collega's zichzelf herkennen in de organisatie. Dit vraagt om een goede representatie van medewerkers en leidinggevenden met verschillende achtergronden. Cordaan streeft ernaar om meer mensen aan te nemen, en te behouden, uit groepen die nog ondervertegenwoordigd zijn.

title: Chief Operations Officer
location: Cape Town, Western Cape, South Africa
description:
The Cape Town International Convention Centre Company (RF) SOC Limited is so much more than just another convention centre. An exceptional centre requires exceptional staff and the culture of the CTICC is one of teamwork, recognition, personal accountability, and service excellence. We understand that it is only our people who make us the success we are and, as a result, we make every effort to ensure that we recruit and retain talented, qualified, and enthusiastic individuals, who are team players, able to embrace our values, fit in with our culture and recognise the value of hard work in a dynamic exciting environment.

The main purpose: The Chief Operations Officer (COO) will formulate and implement long-term strategies for the CTICC’s Operations Departments ensuring growth, success, and alignment with organisational goals. The COO provides leadership and direction to the management team, ensuring departmental objectives are achieved.

Reporting to the: Chief Executive Officer

Key responsibilities will include but are not limited to:

1) Strategic and Visionary Leadership

  • Develop and direct long-term strategies aligned with CTICC’s mission and vision.

  • Provide vision, insight, and direction to the management team.

  • Deliver on the company’s strategic plan in a cost-efficient manner to optimise shareholder value.

  • Report progress on strategic implementation to the CEO.

  • Promote and embed company culture and values.

  • Identify trends shaping customer needs and lead exploration of new business opportunities.

  • Ensure that the Operations Department remains focused on long-term goals and vision.

2) Strategic Management and Business Planning

  • Lead the development and execution of annual business plans for Operations.

  • Cascade plans effectively throughout the department.

  • Align CTICC’s business plan with strategic focus areas of the City of Cape Town.

  • Oversee ICT (Information and Communication Technology), facilities management, safety and security, event logistics, and food and beverage operations, ensuring efficient service delivery, compliance, cost-effectiveness, and a high standard of operational excellence.

  • Establish and monitor standard operating procedures and policies.

  • Track monthly revenue, implement corrective actions, and ensure CAPEX budget is controlled.

  • Align departmental strategies with company goals to maximise shareholder value.

3) People Management

  • Translate strategic plans into workforce plans that meet business needs.

  • Ensure effective middle management and optimal organisational structures.

  • Align performance management systems with business objectives.

  • Manage direct reports to achieve world-class performance standards.

  • Manage Human Capital matters within the Operations portfolio, in alignment with the organisation’s Human Capital policies, procedures, and practices.

  • Foster a rewarding work environment that promotes growth and contribution.

4) Risk Management

  • Implement operational risk management strategies aligned with best practices and regulations.

  • Assess departmental risks and balance business benefits with exposure.

  • Ensure integrated risk management across CTICC.

5) Finance and Supply Chain Management

  • Identify opportunities and threats in financial results and act accordingly.

  • Ensure compliance with financial controls, policies, and standards.

  • Adhere to supply chain management policies and the Preferential Procurement Act to meet BBB-EE objectives.

  • Ensure procurement complies with MFMA provisions.

  • Ensure that a commercially driven procurement function is in place and that the provisions of the MFMA are adhered to by ensuring the optimal procurement policies and procedures are developed and implemented.

6) CTICC Capital Projects

  • Ensures that the capital projects required to maintain the CTICC as a venue of the highest international standard are budgeted for, approved, and implemented.

  • Assumes overall responsibility for the development of the CTICC Capital projects and advises the CEO and Board on issues and plans relating to the completion of the project.

  • Ensures that appropriate operational plans are in place to meet capital projects and expansion objectives.

  • Ensure that the CTICC Capital projects remain on track.

Minimum qualifications and experience

  • A relevant postgraduate qualification or honours degree in Business Administration, Business Management, Operations Management, Hospitality Management, Facilities Management, or a related field (NQF Level 8).

  • At least fifteen (15) years of hospitality general management experience.

  • At least five (5) years’ experience in an Executive Management role.

  • At least five (5) years’ experience working in operations (Facilities and Food & Beverage operations).

  • Experience overseeing or managing facility construction, expansion, or major renovations.

  • Experience overseeing or managing food and beverage operations.

  • Strong mastery of key business functions, including operations, business development, human capital, and financial administration.

  • Experience working with and / or reporting to a Board.

  • Ability to think strategically in a complex, evolving environment.

Skills and attributes

  • Business acumen and strategic thinking.

  • Leadership and people development.

  • Communication and negotiation.

  • Analytical and result orientated.

  • Project and time management.

The CTICC is committed to Employment Equity and take the approved EE Plan into account during the recruitment process. Remuneration will be discussed with the successful candidate.

title: Avdelingsdirektør  tvisteløsning
description:
Forbrukertilsynet søker en strategisk og utviklingsorientert leder til stillingen som avdelingsdirektør for Tvisteløsningsavdelingen. Rollen gir en unik mulighet til å påvirke utviklingen av et viktig samfunnsområde og bidra til et enklere og tryggere samfunn for forbrukerne.

Som avdelingsdirektør inngår du i Forbrukertilsynets toppledergruppe og får det overordnede ansvaret for en avdeling med 70 medarbeidere fordelt på fire lokasjoner.

Om Forbrukertilsynet

Forbrukertilsynet arbeider for et enklere og tryggere samfunn for forbrukerne. Vi fører tilsyn med sentrale deler av forbrukervernlovgivningen, håndhever åpenhetsloven og tilbyr nøytral mekling i tvister mellom forbrukere og næringsdrivende, i tillegg til saker mellom to privatpersoner.

Tvisteløsningsavdelingen er et ledende fagmiljø innen utenomrettslig tvisteløsning og forberedelse av saker for Forbrukerklageutvalget. Avdelingen har også ansvar for Forbruker Europa, som bistår norske forbrukere ved handel innen EU/EØS.

Du finner mer informasjon om oss på .

Om stillingen

Som avdelingsdirektør har du det overordnede ansvaret for avdelingens faglige retning, resultater og videre utvikling. Du leder gjennom avdelingens ledere og skal sikre høy kvalitet i tjenestene, god ressursutnyttelse og et sterkt fagmiljø. Samtidig vil du ha en viktig rolle i den strategiske utviklingen av Forbrukertilsynet som helhet, i tett samarbeid med direktør og øvrig toppledelse.

Stillingen har et betydelig nasjonalt og internasjonalt grensesnitt. Du vil representere Forbrukertilsynet i relevante fora, og bidra til å styrke virksomhetens rolle og synlighet. Du skal også følge opp utviklingen innen relevante regelverk og samfunnsutviklingens betydning for hvordan tvisteløsningstilbudet bør innrettes. Tvisteløsningsavdelingen har kontorer i Porsgrunn, Stavanger, Tromsø og i Longyearbyen og utstrakt reiseaktivitet må påregnes.

Sentrale ansvarsområder

  • Lede og videreutvikle Tvisteløsningsavdelingen med fire avdelingsdirektører, en kontorsjef og ca 70 medarbeidere, primært jurister.

  • Bidra til den strategiske utviklingen av Forbrukertilsynet som medlem av toppledergruppen

  • Sikre god måloppnåelse, kvalitet og effektiv ressursutnyttelse, ikke minst med å ta i bruk ny teknologi på en måte som sikrer effektivitet og kvalitet i arbeidet

  • Utvikle ledere og medarbeidere i avdelingen

  • Representere Forbrukertilsynet i relevante nasjonale og internasjonale fora

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi ser etter en erfaren leder som kombinerer strategisk forståelse med god gjennomføringsevne. Du motiverer og utvikler mennesker, bygger sterke fagmiljøer og skaper resultater gjennom andre. Samtidig evner du å løfte blikket og bidra til utviklingen av virksomheten som helhet.

Du må ha master i rettsvitenskap eller juridisk embetseksamen og minimum 5 års relevant ledererfaring med personal- og fagansvar. Erfaring fra offentlig sektor og kompetanse innen tvisteløsning, mekling eller prosessledelse vil være en fordel. Det kreves gode kunnskaper i norsk, og engelsk, både muntlig og skriftlig.

Personlige egenskaper vi særlig ser etter

Vi ser etter deg som:

  • Er en trygg og samlende leder

  • Evner å motivere og utvikle medarbeidere og ledere

  • Kombinerer strategisk forståelse med god gjennomføringsevne

  • Har gode kommunikasjons- og samarbeidsevner

  • Arbeider strukturert, målrettet og med høy integritet

Personlig egnethet vil bli tillagt stor vekt.

Hvorfor velge Forbrukertilsynet?

Hos oss får du en sentral lederrolle i en virksomhet med et viktig samfunnsoppdrag. Du blir del av en kompetent toppledergruppe og får muligheten til å påvirke utviklingen av både fagområdet og organisasjonen. Samtidig blir du en del av sterke fagmiljøer med høyt engasjement og stor betydning for forbrukerne i Norge. Vi har fleksibel arbeidstid og gode velferdsordninger. Hos oss får du også medlemskap i Statens pensjonskasse med gode pensjons-, låne- og forsikringsordninger.

Arbeidssted

Hovedkontoret i Porsgrunn er primært arbeidssted. I særskilte tilfeller kan arbeidssted vurderes til Stavanger eller Tromsø.

For mer informasjon om stillingen kan du kontakte:

  • Erik Aasmundtveit, tlf. 414 31 938

  • Monica Nordby, tlf. 458 53 755

  • Cathrine Svendsen, tlf. 926 06 610

Fram til søknadsfristens utløp kan du ta kontakt med oss på konfidensiell basis for en uforpliktende samtale om stillingen.

Alle vedlegg må lastes opp elektronisk sammen med søknaden.

Forbrukertilsynet ønsker å gjenspeile mangfoldet i samfunnet og utnytte potensialet i befolkningens samlede kompetanse. Vi oppfordrer derfor alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke jobb hos oss uavhengig av alder, kjønn, etnisitet eller nedsatt funksjonsevne.

I likhet med alle andre offentlige stillinger, vil det for denne stillingen bli utarbeidet en søkerliste som gir informasjon om navn, kjønn, kommune og alder på alle som søker på stillingen. Denne søkerlisten vil i utgangspunktet ikke sendes ut, men vil være offentlig, og derfor tilgjengelig, for alle som ber om innsyn.

Skagerak Consulting er et tverrfaglig miljø innen rekruttering og rådgivning. Vi jobber med å utvikle mennesker og organisasjoner for å skape varige forbedringer og verdier i offentlige og private virksomheter. Vårt arbeid er basert på en kombinasjon av dokumentert metodikk, praktisk erfaring og en god porsjon sunn fornuft.

Les mer om Skagerak Consulting AS her:

For å unngå bedrageriforsøk vil vi presisere at vi aldri ber om BankID-informasjon i søknadsprosessen.
