title: Vikarier till verksamheter för funktionsvarierade i Kävlinge kommun
description:
Om tjänsten

Vill du ha ett meningsfullt arbete där du bidrar till att människor med funktionsvariationer får en trygg, aktiv och glädjefylld vardag? Då är du varmt välkommen att söka som vikarie hos oss inom LSS!

Som vikarie inom LSS arbetar du med att stötta personer med olika funktionsnedsättningar i deras dagliga liv. Det kan innebära hjälp med personlig omvårdnad, aktiviteter, kommunikation, hushållssysslor och socialt stöd. Du arbetar på boende eller i daglig verksamhet – alltid med individen i fokus.

Är du den vi söker?

• Du har fyllt 18 år.

• Du har goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift (minst nivå B2).

• Du är flexibel och kan arbeta dag, kväll och natt (vaken och/eller journatt).

Om anställningen

När du söker jobb hos oss kommer vi be dig att visa upp ett utdrag ur Polisens belastningsregister. Utdraget vi efterfrågar är "Utdrag för arbete i hemmet med äldre och personer med funktionsnedsättning" och du behöver själv begära ut utdraget via en blankett som du hittar på polisens hemsida: Länk till belastningsregistret . Söker man för arbete med barn inom LSS kommer vi även att be dig visa upp ett utdrag från Polisens belastningsregister som heter "Utdrag för arbete med barn med funktionsnedsättning". Länk till belastningsregistret.

Observera att du behöver visa upp pass eller nationellt ID-kort utfärdat av polis på intervjun.

Du som har läst vård- och omsorgsprogrammet och/eller annan likvärdig utbildning. För att styrka att du är utbildad undersköterska måste du ladda upp betyg från din utbildning som en bilaga till din ansökan.

I Sektor omsorg arbetar cirka 650 engagerade medarbetare med äldreomsorg, omsorg om personer med funktionsvariation och måltidsservice. Vårt arbete genomsyras av goda och trygga relationer där omtanke om varandra står i centrum. Tillsammans har vi alltid fokus på att ge bästa möjliga stöd och omsorg till kommunens invånare.

Vi bryr oss!

Välkommen till en arbetsplats där du får utvecklas och göra skillnad varje dag. Med stort engagemang och omtanke om varandra, gör vi allt för att skapa en bättre vardag för alla i vår kommun. Vårt fokus på utveckling och kvalitet märks hos våra många nöjda invånare.

Till Kävlinge kommun tar du dig snabbt och enkelt, oavsett var du bor. Den goda stämningen och de många utvecklingsmöjligheterna är andra anledningar till att våra medarbetare trivs så bra. Vill du bli en av oss?

Vill du veta mer om hur det är att arbeta hos oss i Kävlinge? Gå in på jobb.kavlinge.se för att läsa vad våra medarbetare tycker om att jobba hos oss, våra förmåner och se alla våra lediga jobb.

title: Managing Principal - Data
description:
Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consultancy specializing in driving digital transformation in the financial services industry. With a growing client portfolio comprising of over 100 global organizations, Capco operates at the intersection of business and technology by combining innovative thinking with unrivalled industry knowledge to deliver end-to-end data-driven solutions and fast-track digital initiatives for banking and payments, capital markets, wealth and asset management, insurance, and the energy sector. Capco’s cutting-edge ingenuity is brought to life through its Innovation Labs and award-winning Be Yourself At Work culture and diverse talent.

  • We are experts in Banking, Capital Markets, and Wealth and Asset Management.
  • We are rapidly expanding our Insurance sector capability.
  • We specialise in Digital Transformation, Data Management & Data Analytics, Business & Finance Transformation engagements, and IT Transformation and Change programmes.
  • We are committed to growing our business and hiring the best talent in the market.
  • Our focus is on maintaining our agile and entrepreneurial culture.

About the Job

Capco’s Data Team helps our clients transform every aspect of their business. We are highly skilled at formulating data strategy, defining business and technology initiatives across the data management lifecycle and aligning multi-year strategic roadmaps with clients’ business goals. As digital technologies advance and regulations tighten, today’s consumers and today’s businesses are becoming more aware of the importance of good quality data. We work to establish holistic ways to effectively manage data through the modern data supply chain and facilitate consumption through analytics, modelling, AI, machine learning, dashboarding, and reporting.

What You'll Get to Do

  • Design, implement, and enhance enterprise Data Governance and Data Management Frameworks across banking and financial services clients.
  • Develop and maintain data governance artifacts including data dictionaries, business glossaries, metadata catalogues, data lineage, critical data elements, and data classification standards.
  • Support enterprise Data Architecture, Data Quality, Master Data Management (MDM), and Metadata Management initiatives.
  • Drive Data Sovereignty, Data Residency, and Regulatory Compliance programs aligned with banking and financial services requirements.
  • Partner with business, technology, risk, compliance, and executive stakeholders to embed governance across the data lifecycle.
  • Deliver data transformation initiatives using Agile methodologies and support executive-level reporting and governance forums.
  • Leverage governance tools such as Collibra, Informatica, Microsoft Purview, Ab Initio, or similar platforms to improve data transparency, control, and quality.

What You'll Bring With You

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, Mathematics, Operations Research, or a related discipline.
  • 10+ years' leading experience and delivering Data Governance, Data Management, Data Architecture, Data Quality, or Enterprise Data Transformation programs.
  • Strong financial services experience across Banking, Wealth Management, Insurance, or Capital Markets.
  • Knowledge of industry frameworks such as DCAM, Data Governance Operating Models, Control Frameworks, and Data Lifecycle Management.
  • Experience with Data Lineage, Metadata Management, Master Data Management, Data Quality, and Data Architecture.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage senior executives, regulators, and cross-functional teams.
  • Hands-on experience with Collibra (preferred) or other enterprise data governance and metadata management tools.
  • Experience delivering projects using Agile or hybrid methodologies.
  • Fluent English communication skills; Arabic language skills advantageous for regional engagements.

Nice to Have

  • Experience delivering data governance programs aligned to BCBS 239, CCAR, GDPR, PIPL, MAS TRM, or related financial services regulations.
  • Knowledge of Data Sovereignty, Cross-Border Data Management, and Data Privacy frameworks.
  • Experience with cloud-based data transformation and enterprise data platforms.
  • Relevant certifications such as DCAM, CDMP, DAMA, AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Proven programme delivery and change management experience, including large-scale data transformation initiatives.

Eligibility to Work in Singapore

Applicants must have unrestricted working rights in Singapore. Only Singapore Citizens and Singapore Permanent Residents (PRs) will be considered. Employment Pass sponsorship is not available for this role.

WHY CAPCO?

We are expanding our business rapidly across Singapore and Asia. You will work on engaging projects with some of the largest banking and insurance clients in the world, projects that will deliver significant transformation and change.

We offer:

You will join a company that supports and encourages an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. Capco is not about organizational charts and layers – we operate with little hierarchy because we want all employees to feel that Capco is their firm. We warmly value diversity and inclusion and embrace our collective uniqueness – our culture is a strong, fresh, and invigorating difference from our competitors.

We offer highly competitive benefits, including medical and dental insurance and a work culture focused on innovation and creation of lasting value for our clients and employees.

title: Regional DRY & WET Technology Engineer F/M/X
description:
Job Description:

The role of the of EUROPE Regional DRY/WET Technology Engineer is to support the implementation of new raw material, new process and new product across our European factory network

The Regional DRY/WET Technology Engineer shares R&D specifications needed to manufacturing DRY & WET product to achieve process specifications conformance and finished product specifications conformance.

His/her functional perimeter is Regional, including ROYAL CANIN and PETNUTRITION manufacturing network.

R&D specifications stands for product specifications and process specifications including:

  • Specifications related to raw material processing,
  • Specifications related to products (Quality Attributes, Key Quality Attributes)
  • Specifications related to process flow, process sequence and equipment parameters settings,
  • Specifications related to application of food safety standard and quality control.

The Regional DRY & WET Technology Engineer supports the deployment of the DRY & WET technology expertise of Royal Canin with the EUROPE region PPI (Process & Product Implementation engineers) community.

What are we looking for?

  • B.S. or M.S. in Science, Engineering (Mechanical, Chemical, Food) or related technology program
  • Demonstrated industry experience as R&D engineer or Quality & Food Safety Engineer
  • Green belt or Black belt for Lean 6-Sigma is a plus
  • >5 years relevant experiences in food technology development, process & product scale-up and/or implementation
  • Demonstrated Factory experience
  • Working in a company with multicultural and international features

What will be your key responsibilities?

  • Support DRY/WET INDUSTRIALIZATION pillar in EUROPE region,

The Regional DRY/WET Technology Engineer supports the Industrialization process in the region by delivering DRY and WET Technology expertise.

More precisely, the Regional DRY/WET Technology Engineer will be a key R&D support to deal with product and process topics. She/he is part of following activities:

  • Support execution of Industrial test runs needed for innovation plan deployment or portfolio transfer from a factory to another. Deliver guidance on SRC definition and support troubleshooting.
  • Support any regional must do projects like product quality improvement, Do It Best (DIB) project, Business continuity project or Sustainability project.
  • Support definition of regional Industrial Risk Assessment (IRA) for successful Implementation of new raw material, new process and new product.
  • Support factories on any technology capability performance issues

  • Support DRY & WET PRODUCT and DRY & WET PROCESS CONFORMANCE in EUROPE region,

The Regional DRY & WET Technology Engineer supports the assessment of conformance of R&D specifications related to Royal Canin DRY & WET manufacturing standard and align practices/specifications across factory network.

More precisely, the Regional DRY & WET Technology Engineer will be part of following activities:

  • Support transfer of process specifications related to DRY/WET manufacturing standard in place and monitor conformance.

- Execute technical audits to assess implementation and conformance of R&D process specifications on factory

- Support PPI on process capability assessment and protocol execution.

- Gather and analyse data.

- Report performance per site (i.e Dosing capability, mixing capability, Cross contamination capability, ….).

  • Support transfer of product specifications related to DRY/WET manufacturing standard in place and monitor conformance.

- Execute technical audits to assess implementation and conformance of R&D product specifications on factory

- Analyse product capability performance per site

  • Support DRY/WET Process Validation and DRY/ WET product Validation for new equipment and new line commissioning

- Deliver training on process principles (process flow, theory, equipment added value, raw material specifications, process specifications, ….) and product quality and performance (product specifications, quality attributes checks, production sequences rules, …).

- Support CVS team and PPI on protocol execution on site

- On start-up phase she / he supports Standard Running Conditions (SRC) implementation, product ramp-up, portfolio implementation (raw material & product),

  • Support Complex problem-solving projects

- Is team contributor on complex problem solving related to raw material, product and process.

- Ensure application of robust methodology to support complex problem solving management


What can you expect from Mars?
Work with diverse and talented Associates, all guided by the Five Principles.
Join a purpose driven company, where we’re striving to build the world we want tomorrow, today.
A strong focus on learning and development support from day one, including access to our in-house Mars University.
An industry competitive salary and benefits package, including company bonus.

title: Software Engineer – Autonomous & Electric Mobility

Working as a Software Engineer at our client

Our client is a technology company working with digital, electric and autonomous solutions for the future of road freight. You will be joining the Control Tower team, which is responsible for the system used by operators to monitor and assist autonomous vehicles remotely.

As a Software Engineer, you will work closely with the Team Lead and Product Manager, as well as with other teams across the organization. The team works end-to-end, which means that you will be involved in several parts of the development process and have the opportunity to take ownership of what you build. Your work will include software development, testing, system design and data streaming, with a strong focus on safety and reliability.

You will be part of a collaborative team where people are happy to help each other, share knowledge and solve problems together. The company also has a strong social culture, with different activities, happenings and employee-led clubs throughout the year.

The position is hybrid and based in Gothenburg.

Being a consultant at Nexer Tech Talent

Nexer Tech Talent specializes in giving tech talents the opportunity to build their careers at leading technology companies. For this role, you will be employed by Nexer Tech Talent and work as a consultant at our client in Gothenburg.

You will be part of the team from day one and work with real products and technical challenges alongside experienced colleagues. You will also have a consultant manager at Nexer Tech Talent who will support you throughout the assignment.

The intention is that, after the agreed consulting period, you will be offered direct employment with our client, provided that the collaboration works well for both parties.

Desired qualifications:

  • Newly graduated or up to 3 years of professional experience as a Software Engineer

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a similar field

  • Good foundation in software design, version control, automated software testing, data structures and algorithms

  • Experience working with Linux-based operating systems

  • Understanding of network protocols such as IPv4, IPv6, UDP, TCP, TLS and HTTP

  • Fluent in English, spoken and written

We are looking for someone who is curious, driven and enjoys working with others. You take responsibility for your work and like getting involved in different parts of a solution. Since the team works end-to-end, it is important that you enjoy working broadly and contributing where needed. For a newly graduated candidate, personality and drive are particularly important. You take initiative, want to develop and are comfortable becoming an active part of the team from the start.

It is a plus if you have experience with:

  • Rust and/or Golang

  • Cloud infrastructure, such as Google Cloud Platform or another cloud provider

  • gRPC or similar RPC frameworks

  • Safety-critical and/or real-time systems

Application

Does this sound like you? We are constantly screening resumes, and applications are considered on a rolling basis, so we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. Selection and interviews are held continuously.

If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact Tech Recruiter Jennie Kähäri, jennie.kahari@nexergroup.com

We are looking forward to hearing from you!

About Nexer Tech Talent

Nexer Tech Talent is part of the Nexer Group – a tech company with deep roots in Swedish entrepreneurship and innovation. Together, we are over 2500 employees in 16 countries who, for more than 35 years, have helped our clients stay ahead strategically, technologically, and communicatively. Uppdraget är främst inriktat på avrop av konsulter från befintliga ramavtal inom projektering, teknik och IT, men även upphandlingar och inköp inom andra kategorier kan förekomma.

Du ansvarar för hela avrops- och upphandlingsprocessen, från framtagning av underlag och kravställning till utvärdering, tilldelning och avtal. Du vägleder interna beställare och säkerställer att processerna genomförs effektivt och korrekt enligt LUF, interna riktlinjer och ramavtalsvillkor.

Rollen innebär många kontaktytor med beställare, kollegor och externa leverantörer. Vi söker därför dig som är affärsmässig, kommunikativ, strukturerad och drivande. Du behöver även vara van vid administrativa processer och ha lätt för att sätta dig in i olika system och arbetssätt.

Upphandlingar genomförs enligt LUF och ramavtal samt kontrakt baseras ofta på ABK 09. Arbetet hanteras bland annat i ServiceNow och e-Avrop.

Arbetsuppgifter:

  • Ta fram uppdragsbeskrivningar, krav och avropsunderlag tillsammans med verksamhetens beställare.

  • Sammanställa och kvalitetssäkra anbudsunderlag samt skicka avropsförfrågningar via e-Avrop.

  • Hantera frågor från leverantörer och stötta verksamheten i frågor kring avrop och avtal.

  • Ta fram utvärderings- och beslutsunderlag samt stötta beställare genom utvärderingsprocessen.

  • Genomföra tilldelningar samt upprätta avtal och inköpsordrar.

  • Förvalta och följa upp avropsavtal och leverantörer, inklusive förlängningar, budgetjusteringar, indexregleringar och viss fakturahantering.

  • Samverka med säkerhetsfunktionen i frågor kring bland annat säkerhetsklassning och avtal.

  • Driva upphandlingar enligt olika förfaranden inom LUF.

  • Arbeta proaktivt med att effektivisera avropsprocessen och minska ledtider.

  • Bidra till utveckling av arbetssätt, rutiner, mallar och processer inom inköp.

  • Hantera viss masterdata, rapportering och statusuppföljning.

  • Upphandla ramavtal och kontrakt, främst inom konsultområdet och ofta med ABK 09 som grund.

Obligatoriska krav

Konsulten ska uppfylla följande krav:

  • Ha relevant eftergymnasial utbildning inom ekonomi, teknik, juridik eller beteendevetenskap från högskola eller universitet, alternativt en KY-/YH-examen med inriktning mot inköp.

  • Ha minst 8 års dokumenterad erfarenhet av inköp, upphandling och/eller avropsarbete.

  • Ha minst 5 års erfarenhet av att genomföra avrop eller upphandlingar enligt LOU och/eller LUF.

  • Ha minst 5 års yrkeserfarenhet från IT-, bygg-, energi- eller elkraftsbranschen.

  • Ha minst 5 års erfarenhet av strategiskt inköpsarbete.

  • Ha genomfört minst två ramavtalsupphandlingar där ABK 09 har utgjort avtalsgrund.

  • Ha minst 2 års erfarenhet av konsultinköp, där avrop och/eller upphandling av konsulter har varit en huvudsaklig del av rollen och motsvarat minst 50 % av en heltidstjänst. Erfarenheten ska omfatta hela processen, från framtagning av avrops- eller upphandlingsunderlag fram till kontraktering.

  • Du behöver uppfylla minst ett av följande krav: högskole- eller universitetsexamen inom ekonomi, teknik, juridik eller beteendevetenskap, KY- eller YH-examen inom inköp, eller minst 10 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet som kunden bedömer som likvärdig med ovanstående utbildning.

Meriterande krav

  • Konsulten bör ha minst 3 års erfarenhet under de senaste 5 åren av avrop och/eller upphandling av tekniska konsulter, projekteringskonsulter eller IT-konsulter.

  • Konsulten bör ha minst 3 års erfarenhet under de senaste 5 åren av avrop och/eller upphandling inom områden som projektering, markåtkomst, tillstånd eller teamleveranser.

  • Konsulten bör ha ansvarat för och genomfört minst tre upphandlingar enligt förhandlat förfarande.

  • Konsulten bör ha minst 3 års erfarenhet av strategiskt utvecklingsarbete inom inköp, med dokumenterat goda resultat. Detta kommer att bedömas och verifieras genom intervju och referenstagning.

Tillträde och ansökan:

Startdatum: 2026-11-01

Slutdatum: 2028-10-31. Möjlighet till 1+1 års förlängning, t.o.m. 2030-10-31

Sista ansökningsdagen: 2026-08-27

Hybridarbete: Ja, i samråd med kunden. Cirka 30-40% av arbetstiden

Ort: Sundbyberg

Placeringsort: Sundbyberg, Distansarbete kan förekomma upp till.

Omfattning: 100%. Uppdragets omfattning fastställs tillsammans med kunden utifrån verksamhetens aktuella behov och kan förändras under uppdragets gång. Konsulten förväntas kunna arbeta på plats i Sundbyberg minst tre dagar per vecka. Vilka dagar som gäller kan variera från vecka till vecka, vilket ställer krav på flexibilitet och förmåga att anpassa sig efter verksamhetens behov.

Säkerhetsprövning: Säkerhetsprövning och registerkontroll krävs.

Kontaktperson: 0790 062 711

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande!

Sway Sourcing är en innovativ rekryteringspartner som specialiserar sig på att matcha rätt talang med rätt företag – snabbt och effektivt. Vårt huvudfokus ligger inom Ekonomi, Administration, HR, Marknad och IT, men vi har även den breda expertis och flexibilitet som krävs för att leverera skräddarsydda rekryteringslösningar inom alla branscher.

Trots att vi är en relativt ny aktör har vi redan byggt förtroende hos många av Sveriges största företag och arbetar både nationellt och internationellt. Med baser i Sverige och Spanien erbjuder vi en unik kombination av lokal expertis och global räckvidd. Vårt starka nätverk och djupa branschinsikter gör oss till en självklar partner för företag som vill ligga steget före i sin rekrytering.

title: ERP System Specialist
description:
Mihin osaamistasi tarvitaan?

Tietohallintomme vastaa liiketoimintakriittisten järjestelmiemme jatkuvista palveluista, kehittämisestä, integraatioista, tietoturvasta ja tiedonhallinnasta. NetSuite ERP on keskeinen osa yhtiön järjestelmäkokonaisuutta.

Etsimme Järjestelmäasiantuntijaa vastaamaan Oracle NetSuite ERP -järjestelmän ylläpidosta, kehittämisestä ja käytettävyyden jatkuvasta parantamisesta siten, että järjestelmä tukee yhtiön strategiaa, liiketoimintaprosesseja ja kasvutavoitteita. Tehtävässä toimit liiketoiminnan, prosessiomistajien, pääkäyttäjien ja järjestelmätoimittajien välisenä asiantuntijana sekä edistät ERP-ratkaisun tehokasta hyödyntämistä, automaatiota ja tiedon laadun kehittämistä.

Vastaat liiketoiminnan kehityshankkeiden edistämisestä NetSuite-järjestelmäasiantuntijan roolissa, vastaat NetSuite ERP -ympäristön jatkuvasta kehittämisestä, ylläpidosta ja muutoshallinnasta, varmistat järjestelmän käytettävyyden, tietojen laadun ja ylläpidettävyyden sekä teet yhteistyötä ulkoisten kumppaneiden ja järjestelmätoimittajien kanssa.

Keskeiset tehtäväsi ovat

· Järjestelmäkehitys ja muutoshallinta
Järjestelmämuutosten määrittely ja testaus yhteistyössä prosessiomistajien, pääkäyttäjien ja implementointikumppaneiden kanssa. Ratkaisujen tekninen arviointi ja hyväksyntä, kehitysjonon ja muutospyyntöjen koordinointi sekä toteutus. NetSuite-julkaisujen ja versiopäivitysten arviointi, käyttöönoton koordinointi yhdessä tuoteomistajan kanssa sekä järjestelmien tekninen dokumentointi ja ylläpito.

· Käytettävyys ja tukipalvelut
Virhetilanteiden analysointi ja juurisyiden tunnistaminen, korjaavien toimenpiteiden koordinointi ja toteutus. Käyttäjien ja pääkäyttäjien tukeminen sekä käyttöoikeuksien, roolien ja järjestelmäasetusten ylläpito.

Tehtävän palkkahaitari on 4000-5000€/kk. Palkkaus määräytyy tehtävään valitun henkilön osaamisen ja kokemuksen perusteella.

Raportoit tietohallintomme vetäjälle.

Toimipisteesi voi olla valintasi mukaan mikä tahansa Aurilon toimistoista Turussa, Espoossa, Salossa, Tampereella, Mikkelissä, Porissa, Raumalla, Seinäjoella, Kouvolassa, Jyväskylässä, Kuopiossa, Vaasassa, Ylivieskassa tai Oulussa. Työskentelemme monipaikkakuntaisessa tiimissämme hybridimallissa, joten voit työskennellä paljon myös etänä. Tehtävä vaatii satunnaisesti matkustamista.

Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää sinulta

  • soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa tai vastaava työkokemuksella hankittua osaamista

  • kokemusta ERP-järjestelmien ylläpidosta, kehittämisestä tai käyttöönotoista

  • ymmärrystä liiketoimintaprosesseista, erityisesti talous-, hankinta-, myynti- tai logistiikkaprosesseista

  • kokemusta järjestelmien määrittelystä, testauksesta ja muutoshallinnasta

  • kykyä mallintaa prosesseja ja muuntaa liiketoiminnan tarpeet teknisiksi ratkaisuiksi

  • ratkaisukeskeistä ja itsenäistä työskentelytapaa

  • kykyä priorisoida ja hallita useita samanaikaisia tehtäviä

  • hyvää yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoa

  • analyyttistä ja kehittämisorientoitunutta ajattelutapaa

  • sujuvaa suomen ja hyvää englannin kielen suullista ja kirjallista taitoa

Miksi juuri tämä tehtävä ja Aurilo?

Tämä tehtävä antaa sinulle mahdollisuuden päästä työskentelemään laajasti eri liiketoiminta-alueiden kanssa ja vaikuttamaan keskeisten prosessien, tietojen laadun sekä automaation kehittämiseen. Pääset työskentelemään osaavaan, kehitysmyönteiseen ja kunnianhimoiseen kasvuyritykseen, jossa pääset kehittämään omaa osaamistasi.

Sijoitut Tietohallinnon asiantuntijatiimiin, joka vastaa yhtiön tietohallinnosta, ERP-järjestelmän, datan ja integraatioiden liiketoimintajärjestelmien kehittämisestä ja jatkuvista palveluista. Tiimimme toimii liiketoiminnan ja teknologian rajapinnassa, kehittäen prosesseja, automaatiota ja tiedonhallintaa yhdessä eri liiketoimintayksiköiden kanssa. Saat tueksesi osaavan asiantuntijatiimin, kokeneet pääkäyttäjät sekä sitoutuneen esihenkilön.

Perehdytämme sinut huolellisesti NetSuite-ympäristöön, liiketoimintaprosesseihin ja keskeisiin sidosryhmiin, jotta pääset ottamaan vastuuta järjestelmän kehittämisestä ja jatkuvista palveluista vaiheittain. Arjessa et jää yksin, vaan käytössäsi on sekä sisäinen asiantuntijaverkosto että ulkoiset ERP-kumppanit.

Meillä pääset mukaan yhteisöön, jossa rakennetaan huomista yhdessä!

· Arvomme yhdessä paras, ilolla ja välittäen sekä rohkeasti eteenpäin kuvastavat toimintaperiaatteitamme. Meillä paras työ ei synny yksin, vaan rakentuu yhteisestä innostuksesta, jaetusta vastuusta ja arjen oivalluksista. Pääset mukaan yhteisöön, jonka tekemisen kulttuuria ohjaa ilo ja välittäminen.

· Uskomme tavoitteellisuuteen, innostavaan ilmapiiriin
ja vapauteen löytää oma tapa onnistua – niin yksilönä kuin yrityksenä. Esihenkilömme tukevat tiimiläisiään valmentavalla otteella, rohkaisten sinua löytämään sinulle sopiva tapa työskennellä, kehittyä ja onnistua. Hybridityö ja joustavat työaikakäytäntömme auttavat sovittamaan yhteen työsi ja muun elämäsi.

· Panostamme määrätietoisesti uuden oppimiseen, osaamisen kehittämiseen sekä kouluttautumiseen. Saat mahdollisuuden kehittyä yhteisössä, joka uskaltaa kokeilla ja kasvaa jatkuvasti.

· Työsuhde-eduista meillä on käytössä puhelin-, pyörä- ja lounasedut sekä liikunta- kulttuuri- ja hyvinvointiedut. Tuemme hyvinvointiasi myös erittäin monipuolisin laajennetuin työterveyspalveluin.

Haluatko kysyä lisää?

Lisätietoja voit kysyä rekrytoivalta esihenkilöltä Marko Pietilältä, jonka tavoitat numerosta 050 433 8561 soittoaikoina 25.8. klo 12-16 tai 28.8. klo 9-12 tai 31.8. klo 13-16.

Onko tämä sinun paikkasi?

Laita meille hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, viimeistään 9.9.2026.
Huom. osaamiseltaan mahdollisesti soveltuville hakijoille saatamme lähettää osaamiseen liittyviä lisäkysymyksiä jo hakuaikana eli hae tehtävää mahdollisimman pian.

Emme käytä tekoälyä hakijoiden osaamisen arvioinnissa ja valitessamme haastateltavia. Rekrytointimme käy rekrytoivan esihenkilön kanssa kaikki hakemukset ja hakulomakkeeseen juuri tähän rekrytointiin tehtyjen kysymysten vastaukset huolellisesti läpi.

Rekrytointiprosessiimme kuuluu ensimmäisen kierroksen haastattelujen jälkeen toiselle haastattelukierrokselle etenevien soveltuvuuden testaus sekä lopuksi tehtävään harkittavan henkilön suositusten ja luottotietojen tarkastus.

Lisätietoja rekrytoinnin etenemisestä saat pian hakemuksen lähetettyäsi!

Tervetuloa mukaan rakentamaan tulevaisuuden Auriloa!

Aurilo – huominen ei tule yksin

Aurilo on kotimainen IT-palvelutalo, joka syntyi Tietokeskuksen ja Enfon yhdistyessä. Yhdessä olemme tuoneet yhteen parhaat osaajat ja monipuolisen asiantuntijuuden, joka kattaa koko Suomen. Aurilolla työskentelee lähes 800 IT-alan ammattilaista 14 paikkakunnalla, ja konsernin liikevaihto on 191 miljoonaa euroa.

Aurilo tarjoaa kattavat IT-palvelut niin pk-yrityksille, suurille organisaatioille kuin julkiselle sektorille. Palveluvalikoimamme kattaa muun muassa IT-ulkoistukset, pilvi- ja tietoturvaratkaisut, laite- ja elinkaaripalvelut sekä ylläpito-, tukipalvelut ja konsultoinnin.

Aurilossa yhdistyvät Tietokeskuksen paikallinen läsnäolo ja asiakaslähtöisyys sekä Enfon syvällinen teknologia- ja pilviosaaminen. Uskomme, että huominen ei tule yksin – vaan yhdessä asiakkaidemme kanssa rakennettuna.

title: Montör till Rottne Industri
description:
*

Har du erfarenhet av montering och vill arbeta på ett attraktivt företag? Då har vi uppdraget för dig! Vår kund Rottne Industri AB söker nu en ny medarbetare till deras team! Rottne Industri - toppleverantör och tillverkare Sedan starten 1955 har företaget utvecklats från en enkel vajerkran till att bli en av världens ledande tillverkare av hjulburna skördare och skotare. Rottne Industri är i dag världens fjärde största tillverkare. Alla maskiner byggs i Sverige, i fabriker belägna i Rottne och Lenhovda. Det är vi stolta över. Med ambition att växa står vi väl rustade inför framtiden tack vare engagerad personal och ett av världens bästa skogsmaskinprogram. Vårt återförsäljarnät finns både i Sverige och utomlands. Varje år levereras omkring 150 moderna och robusta skogsmaskiner till kunder på flera kontinenter — ett bevis på företagets globala räckvidd. För Rottne handlar design och produktion inte bara om maskiner, utan om att skapa en trygg, bekväm och effektiv arbetsplats för föraren. Kvalitet, innovation och förarkomfort är centrala värderingar som genomsyrar varje del av verksamheten.

Arbetsbeskrivning

Arbetsuppgifterna består av att montera skogsmaskiner från grunden. Det är ett omväxlande arbete då du kommer att montera många olika modeller. Du blir en viktig del i att utveckla och effektivisera arbetet i monteringen. Arbetstiden är dagtid med flex.

Vi söker dig som

- Har erfarenhet av montering samt ritningsläsning - Behärskar svenska språket i tal och skrift Vi ser gärna att du har fordonsutbildning samt truck- och traverskort. Vidare är du händig, tekniskt intresserad och har öga för kvalitet och finish. Du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och du har lätt för att samarbeta. Du delar Monticos värdegrund, vilken består i respektfullt bemötande, samt att alltid leverera minst vad kunden efterfrågar. Känner du att du passar in på ovanstående och vill anta utmaningen? Tveka inte att skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

title: Assistant Supervisor Outbound - Tech 2
description:
Venlo, Limburg | €2,607 – €3,349 | Fulltime | TFT | Shifts

Ready for the next step in your logistics career? Want more responsibility and real impact within a dynamic logistics operation?

As an Assistant Supervisor in Venlo, Limburg, you’ll play an important role in ensuring the daily warehouse operation runs smoothly. You’ll work in an international logistics environment where technology, structure, teamwork and continuous improvement are key.

You won’t just focus on today’s operation. You’ll also identify opportunities to improve processes, support your team and help the operation perform at its best. If you’re ready to grow, take ownership and make an impact on the warehouse floor, we’d love to have a conversation with you.

YOUR ROLE

As an Assistant Supervisor, you are co-responsible for the daily warehouse operation. You ensure processes run smoothly and that your team clearly understands the daily goals and priorities.

You will manage a team of 20 to 30 warehouse employees, including pickers, packers and line leads, and report directly to the Supervisor.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Coordinating daily warehouse activities on the floor

  • Coaching, guiding and motivating team members and line leads

  • Creating daily workforce planning based on volumes and staffing

  • Monitoring KPIs such as productivity and quality

  • Identifying bottlenecks and taking action when needed

  • Contributing to continuous improvement of warehouse processes

  • Ensuring a safe, structured and efficient working environment

title: Operations Senior Analyst - User Operations
description:
Hey there!
We’re Fever, the world’s leading tech platform for culture and live entertainment.

Our mission? To democratize access to culture and entertainment. With our proprietary cutting-edge technology and data-driven approach, we’re revolutionizing the way people engage with live entertainment.

Every month, our platform inspires over 300 million people in +55 countries (and counting) to discover unforgettable experiences while also empowering event creators with our data and technology, helping them scale, innovate, and enhance their events to reach new audiences.

Our results? We’ve teamed up with major industry leaders like Netflix, F.C. Barcelona, and Primavera Sound, presented international award-winning experiences, and are backed by several leading global investors! Impressive, right?

To achieve our mission, we are looking for bar-raisers with a hands-on mindset who are eager to help shape the future of entertainment!

Ready to be part of the experience?

Now, let’s discuss this role and what you will do to help achieve Fever’s mission.

Team context

User Operations sits within Fever's broader User Support organization. User Operations is the strategic/enablement layer behind the operating User support structure, organized around three areas: AI integration, Systems, and Data.

Within Data, we focus on continuous improvement. We don't just maintain information that's useful and relevant to stakeholders inside and outside the department, we translate that data into concrete initiatives that let us keep questioning and improving how we work.

The role

We're looking for a Project Manager with a strong analytics backbone. This isn't a "build the dashboard and move on", we need someone who can go from constructing the data (dashboards, reporting, automations) to understanding what it actually means for the business, so they can help management make consistently data-driven decisions.

Projects will range from a variety of stakeholders, such as, providing user support with operating actionable metrics, giving partners visibility into how their events are performing or helping on app developments that directly shape the user experience.

What we're looking for

Analytics (70% weight)

  • 2-4 years of experience in data/analytics (analyst, data PM, BI, ops analytics). A relevant Master's or further training in the field is a plus.
  • Comfortable building and maintaining dashboards in tools like Metabase, Looker, or similar.
  • Scripting/automation experience.

Project management & structure (30% weight)

  • Demonstrated ability to run a project end-to-end.
  • Organized, structured, and comfortable prioritizing your own workload.
  • You default to improving things, not just maintaining them. When you spot something inefficient, you fix it or raise it, you don't leave it for later.
  • Comfortable communicating with both technical (central Data team) and non-technical (support ops) stakeholders.
  • Not required today, but a plus: some early signs of enjoying explaining things to others or helping people grow. This role is expected to evolve into managing a team member over time, no prior people-management experience needed.

Languages & location

  • Full professional fluency in both English and Spanish, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Based in Madrid or willing to relocate to Madrid

Why you'd love it: Benefits & Perks

  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance
  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Work in a location in the heart of Madrid
  • Home-office friendly
  • Health insurance
  • Gympass membership
  • English Lessons
  • Other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee and the possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow.
  • Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
  • Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | |TechCrunch

Fever is committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workspace where everyone's background and ideas count. Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. We encourage everyone to apply!

title: Senior HR Specialist, Employee Relations and Transitions - EMEA
description:
About Remote

Remote is solving modern organizations’ biggest challenge – navigating global employment compliantly with ease. We make it possible for businesses of all sizes to recruit, pay, and manage international teams. With our core values at heart and future focused work culture, our team works tirelessly on ambitious problems, asynchronously, around the world. You can find Remoters working from 6 different continents (Antarctica left to go!) and all of our positions are fully remote.

With Innovation as one of the core values, we have built Automation and AI capabilities into the requirements for every role.

We encourage every member of the Remote team to bring their talents, experiences and culture to the table to help us build the best-in-class HR platform.
If you are energetic, curious, motivated and ambitious, be part of our world. Apply now and define the future of work!

What this job can offer you

As a critical extension of our clients’ HR teams, we navigate and advise on the intricate paths of global employment with unmatched speed, expertise, and precision. The vision of the Lifecycle team at Remote is not just about maintaining the gold standard in HR practices; it’s about elevating it, integrating cutting-edge technology solutions, and enriching customer experiences in over 80+ countries. On this team, your work directly influences our ability to sustain and extend our compliance coverage, continuously enhance our customer journeys, and significantly increase our operational capacity. You’re not just part of a team; you’re at the forefront of shaping the future of work, ensuring every interaction is fast, intuitive, and profoundly impactful. Dive into a role where your passion for innovation, commitment to excellence, and drive to make a global difference aligns with our mission to empower organizations worldwide to employ anyone, anywhere — compliantly.

The Lifecycle Specialist, Employee Relations & Transitions manages employee exits for Remote's external employees with a focus on legal compliance and providing delightful customer service. Additionally, the specialist provides first-level Employee Relations support, guiding clients through workplace concerns and coordinating appropriate resources when needed.

As part of a larger employee Lifecycle team, the Specialist is also expected to contribute to process improvements and initiatives in line with Remote's strategic goals and values.

Key Responsibilities

Offboarding

  • Manage and resolve end-to-end employee exits across multiple international jurisdictions, prioritizing a superior offboarding experience for Remote's clients and their employees.
  • Provide sound guidance and manage clients' requests on various HR matters, including but not limited to termination, resignation and transfer procedures, employment contracts, and redundancy processes, ensuring legal compliance and best practices.
  • Lead and facilitate meetings with clients and external employees, including but not limited to workforce reduction consultation meetings, administrative hearings, negotiations in separations and settlements, providing guidance on terminations, and delivering termination outcomes.
  • Influence and negotiate positive outcomes in complex terminations, balancing multiple stakeholders with competing interests.
  • Liaise with and coordinate various internal and external stakeholders to ensure compliance in offboarding activities and audits, including but not limited to payroll, legal counsel, government bodies, and trade unions.
  • Draft, tailor and administer all termination and supplementary documents with accuracy and attention to detail, ensuring employee records are maintained with strict adherence to privacy and confidentiality regulations.
  • Process offboarding on Remote's internal HRIS platform, collaborating with various internal stakeholders, such as Customer Success, Legal, Payroll, Benefits, Time and Attendance, amongst other verticals, to ensure all aspects of the employee exit are administered correctly and promptly.
  • Be the subject-matter expert and respond to internal and external queries on all offboarding matters in conjunction with Lifecycle's internal stakeholders.
  • Navigate clients through Remote's Employee Relations resources and guides, helping them understand applicable policies and processes.
  • Conduct preliminary assessment of workplace concerns, identifying key facts and applicable local regulations.
  • Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure appropriate handling of employee relations matters.
  • Support clients in understanding progressive disciplinary approaches and documentation requirements.
  • Monitor ongoing employee relations cases, ensuring timely follow-up and coordination with relevant stakeholders.
  • Actively identify opportunities for and contribute to process improvements, automation, product development and overall customer and employee experience through the offboarding and employee relations processes.

Key Requirements and Charactristics

  • Experience as a HR Advisor or HR Business Partner, with generalist HR competencies and exposure across the employee lifecycle.
  • Proven experience with a strong background in managing voluntary and involuntary exits (terminations) with care, sensitivity and legal compliance; and providing comprehensive HR support and guidance on employment laws and regulations, spanning various jurisdictions.
  • Ability to interpret and apply industrial instruments, analyze complex HR issues, undertake research, provide practical solutions and effectively communicate recommendations to clients and internal stakeholders when operating in ambiguous and unfamiliar environments.
  • Basic understanding of employee relations principles, progressive discipline approaches, and workplace investigation fundamentals.
  • Excellent communication, influencing, conflict management, and negotiation skills, with the ability to confidently lead difficult conversations to a positive outcome, often where parties have conflicting interests, maintaining professionalism and strict confidentiality.
  • Business-level (advanced) proficiency in written and spoken English, with additional languages considered a plus.
  • Aptitude and appetite to innovate and optimize processes, continuously identifying and implementing opportunities for automation and championing best practices.
  • Efficiency in operations, with an awareness of the importance of thorough record-keeping and data integrity.
  • Tech-savvy, with the ability to successfully collaborate asynchronously on various tools, and adapt to new and evolving systems.
  • Ability to work autonomously and cohesively in an international team in a fast-paced, asynchronous, remote environment with multiple priorities. Willingness to work flexible hours as needed.
  • Proactive and self-motivated with a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
  • Demonstrates strong automation and AI capabilities and AI fluency.

Practicals

  • You'll report to: Manager Employee Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions
  • Team: Lifecycle, Employee Relations & Transitions
  • Location: EMEA

Application process

  1. Interview with recruiter
  2. Take Home Exercise
  3. Interview with future manager
  4. Interview with team members (no managers present)
  5. Interview with Senior Manager
  6. Bar Raiser
  7. Prior employment verification check

Remote's Total Rewards philosophy is to ensure fair, unbiased compensation and fair equity pay along with competitive benefits in all locations in which we operate. We do not agree to or encourage cheap-labor practices and therefore we ensure to pay above in-location rates. We hope to inspire other companies to support global talent-hiring and bring local wealth to developing countries.

At first glance our salary bands seem quite wide - here is some context. At Remote we have international operations and a globally distributed workforce. We use geo ranges to consider geographic pay differentials as part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive in various markets while we hiring globally.

Our salary ranges are determined by role, level and location, and our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay for the successful candidate in this role is dependent upon many factors such as location, transferable or job-related skills, work experience, relevant training, business needs, and market demands. The base salary range may be subject to change.

At Remote, we foster internal mobility as a key element of our culture of employee growth and development, supported by a compensation philosophy that guarantees pay equity and fairness. Therefore, all compensation changes associated with an internal move will be reviewed by the Total Rewards & People Enablement team on a case by case basis.

The annual salary range for this full-time position is
$46,500—$104,650 USD

Benefits

Our full benefits & perks are explained in our handbook at . As a global company, each country works differently, but some benefits/perks are for all Remoters:
  • work from anywhere
  • flexible paid time off
  • flexible working hours (we are async)

How you’ll plan your day (and life)

We work async at Remote which means you can plan your schedule around your life (and not around meetings). Read more at .

You will be empowered to take ownership and be proactive. When in doubt you will default to action instead of waiting. Your life-work balance is important and you will be encouraged to put yourself and your family first, and fit work around your needs.

If that sounds like something you want, apply now!

How to apply

During your interviews and beyond, we ask & encourage anybody who needs an accommodation to request one from their recruiter.

We will ask you to voluntarily tell us your pronouns at interview stage, and you will have the option to answer our anonymous demographic questionnaire when you apply below. As an equal employment opportunity employer it’s important to us that our workforce reflects people of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and this data will help us to stay accountable. We thank you for providing this data, if you chose to.

title: Begeleider - Flex - Kinderen met verstandelijke beperking - Amsterdam
description:
Wil jij werken met kinderen en jongeren met een verstandelijke en/of lichamelijke beperking en heb je een afgeronde zorg-, pedagogische of sociale opleiding? Dan is deze functie bij Cordaan Jeugd iets voor jou. Als Begeleider in de flexpool maak je dagelijks het verschil in het leven van kinderen. Je ondersteunt vaste teams op verschillende locaties in Amsterdam en werkt samen met diverse disciplines. Geen dag is hetzelfde en je ontwikkelt je continue in de praktijk.

Wat krijg je van ons?

Een afwisselende en betekenisvolle baan in een warme, professionele organisatie. Met de volgende arbeidsvoorwaarden:

  • Salaris volgens cao Gehandicaptenzorg:

    • FWG 25 bij een niveau 2 diploma, dit ligt tussen de €2.337,- en €3.212,- bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur per week. Het gemiddelde uurloon is €17,80 bruto.

    • FWG 35 bij een niveau 3 of niveau 4 diploma, dit ligt tussen de €2.597,- en €3.635, - bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur per week. Het gemiddelde uurloon is €20,- bruto.

  • Contract: 7 maanden met daarna kans op verlenging. We vragen een beschikbaarheid van minimaal 1 dag per week.

  • Vakantiegeld: 8%

  • Eindejaarsuitkering: 8,33%

  • Pensioen: via Pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn

  • Reiskostenvergoeding

  • Fietsplan en collectiviteitskorting zorgverzekering

  • Ontwikkelmogelijkheden: online trainingen en cursussen

  • Aanbrengbonus: draag een collega aan en ontvang €500,- netto!

    Reis je met de auto? Dan is het helaas niet mogelijk om de parkeerkosten vergoed te krijgen vanuit Cordaan.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Flexer bij Cordaan Jeugd ondersteun je de teams op momenten dat extra hulp nodig is. Je:

  • Begeleidt kinderen en jongeren van 0 tot 18 jaar met een beperking en/of ontwikkelingsachterstand

  • Ondersteunt bij dagelijkse activiteiten en verzorgende taken (ADL)

  • Helpt bij spel, ontwikkeling en structuur bieden

  • Creëert een veilige, stimulerende en positieve omgeving voor de kinderen

  • Werkt samen met verschillende disciplines binnen Cordaan Jeugd

  • Springt flexibel bij op verschillende locaties

Het mooie aan deze baan is dat je je werk flexibel kunt indelen. Zo bepaal je grotendeels zelf hoeveel je werkt, zowel doordeweeks als in het weekend.

Hoe ziet een werkdag eruit?

Als Flexer bij Cordaan Jeugd werk je op verschillende jeugdlocaties van Cordaan in Amsterdam. Geen dag is hetzelfde.

De ene dag help je bij een zorgonderwijsgroep, waar kinderen zorg krijgen in een schoolse setting. Soms wordt hier ook onderwijs geboden. De andere dag werk je op een kinderdienstencentrum waar de kinderen behandeling krijgen en op spelenderwijs werken aan hun ontwikkeling, samen met de begeleiders. Ook kun je worden ingezet op een onderwijszorggroep, kinderopvangzorggroep of binnen de specialistische jeugdhulp in het speciaal onderwijs. Je kunt werken met het jonge kind van 0 tot 4 jaar, of van 12 tot 18 jaar. Ook hebben we locaties waar je komt te werken met jongeren tussen de 12 en 18 jaar.

Je werkdag kan er bijvoorbeeld zo uitzien:

  • Je begint de dag met het team en bespreekt hoe het met de kinderen gaat

  • Je helpt een kind bij de ochtendroutine of ondersteunt bij ADL-zorg

  • Samen met een begeleider of zelfstandig organiseer je een activiteit zoals knutselen, bewegen of buitenspelen

  • Je biedt structuur en veiligheid wanneer een kind spanning ervaart

  • Je ondersteunt het team zodat ieder kind de aandacht krijgt die nodig is

Je werkt altijd samen met begeleiders, behandelaren, therapeuten en leerkrachten

Wie ben jij?

Jij bent iemand die stevig in zijn/haar schoenen staat en energie krijgt van afwisseling. Je bent flexibel en weet snel je plek te vinden in een nieuw team. Verder:

  • Ervaring: ervaring in het werken met kinderen, bij voorkeur in de Gehandicaptenzorg.

  • Beschikbaarheid: je bent minimaal 1 dag per week beschikbaar om te werken.

  • Diploma: je beschikt over een van de volgende diploma’s:

    • Mbo niveau 2: Helpende of Ondersteuner

    • Mbo niveau 3: Verzorgende IG, Begeleider Maatschappelijke Zorg of Begeleider Specifieke Doelgroepen

    • Mbo niveau 4: Sociaal Werk, Pedagogisch Medewerker, Onderwijsassistent of Persoonlijk Begeleider Specifieke Doelgroepen

    • Hbo: Social Work of Toegepaste Psychologie

    • Wo: Psychologie of Pedagogische Wetenschappen

    Staat jouw opleiding er niet tussen, en twijfel je of deze in aanmerking komt? Solliciteer gerust! Onze recruiter Nanuq denkt graag met je mee.

Enthousiast?

title: Afstudeeropdracht HBO – Digitale Bouwplaats & AI

Wat breng jij mee?

👍 HBO opleding in Software Development of Engineering, ICT, Technische Informatica, Business IT & Management, AI & Data Science of Applied Data Science

👍 Analytisch sterk met een ondernemende instelling;

👍 Interesse in AI, SaaS en cloud

👍 Affiniteit met softwareontwikkeling;

👍 Kunnen vertalen van klantproblemen naar digitale oplossingen;

👍 Zelfstandig onderzoek kunnen uitvoeren;

👍 Bereidheid om een prototype daadwerkelijk te bouwen.

👍 Goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal.

Bij RECO willen we jou blij maken met:

✅ Een goede stagevergoeding.

✅ Begeleiding door ervaren professionals, dicht bij de business.

✅ Ruimte voor eigen initiatief en onderzoek.

✅ Werken in een hechte organisatie, iedereen kent elkaar bij naam, korte lijnen en een werksfeer waar je zo binnenloopt. Klik hier voor een kijkje in onze RECO Cultuur.

Over RECO

RECO is dé specialist in het verhuren van bouwplaats materialen voor uiteenlopende projecten in de bouw, infra, renovatie, overheid en evenementen. Met een aanpakkers mentaliteit en betrokken collega’s werken we samen aan slimme materieeloplossingen.

Ik ben enthousiast! Wat nu?

title: Python Developer Internship
description:
The Investment Data Science team is part of the Generali Asset Management Investment Function. The team develops and coordinates projects and initiatives that leverage data science techniques to enhance investment strategies.

As an IT Developer within the Front Office, the candidate will work, within the Investment Data Science team, on refactoring and potentially improving the code of a quantitative investment strategy currently applied to tactical asset allocation and equity sector allocation.

The current implementation could theoretically be deployed on numerous mark-to-market portfolios, but its complexity, along with high computational and memory demands, limits this potential. The primary task over the next six months is to understand and enhance the code, making it more versatile, faster, and intuitive.

  • Structurally reorganize the code to ensure that the two main workflows (monthly outputs and annual reviews) are testable and free from obsolete implementations
  • Automate the generation of output slides using updated market data
  • Automate the storage and backup of data and historical results
  • Conduct testing campaigns of the methodology on various multi-asset portfolios

Requirements

Our ideal candidate will meet the following requirements:

  • Bachelor's Degree (1stlevel, 3 years) in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics or a related field
  • Proficiency in Python, with proven capabilities in back-end development
  • Genuine passion for scientific coding and a keen interest in quantitative finance
  • Previous hands-on experience with financial topics is a plus

Skills:

  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively in an international team/environment
  • Proven ability to communicate complex analytical concepts to a general audience
  • Flexibility and ability to manage changing deadlines

Company Profile

Generali is a major player in the global insurance industry - a strategic and highly important sector for the growth, development and welfare of modern societies. Over almost 200 years, we have built a multinational Group that is present in more than 60 countries, with 470 companies and nearly 80,000 employees. Our Group aims to become the standard bearer and industry leader in the European retail insurance market, building on our existing base of 50 million retail clients, out of an overall total of 72 million.

Generali Asset Management is a European investment specialist, offering a wide range of active funds and bespoke solutions across both public and private markets. Our investment experience is grounded in a solid heritage, with skills that have been developed and honed over time by managing Generali Group and external clients' assets.

Generali Asset Management S.p.A. guarantees a solid framework of services designed to support various asset management activities. Key elements include the provisioning of IT services over all applications underpinning the investment and asset management value chain (Front Office, Trading Desk, Investment Compliance, Middle and Back Office, Analytics and Reporting, etc.). The company also acts as a holding company, retaining share capital in the boutiques and Generali Investments' companies.

title: Kvalitetsleder Q-Meieriet Gausdal
description:
Brenner du for mattrygghet, kvalitet og forbedring? Bli vår nye kvalitetsleder i Gausdal

Q-Meieriene søker en engasjert og utviklingsorientert kvalitetsleder til vårt meieri i Gausdal. Vi ser etter en faglig sterk og handlekraftig leder som vil ha en sentral rolle i å videreutvikle vårt kvalitetsarbeid og sikre høy standard innen mattrygghet, kvalitet og kontinuerlig forbedring.

Som kvalitetsleder får du det overordnede ansvaret for kvalitets- og mattrygghetsarbeidet ved meieriet, og du blir en viktig sparringspartner for både ledelse og organisasjon. Du kombinerer solid fagkompetanse med evnen til å skape engasjement, bygge gode relasjoner og få gjennomslag i organisasjonen.

Har du høyere utdanning innen relevante fagområder, erfaring med HACCP og kvalitetsledelse i næringsmiddelindustrien, og motiveres av å skape forbedringer som gir varige resultater? Da vil vi gjerne høre fra deg.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Overordnet ansvar for mattrygghet og kvalitet ved anlegget

  • Budsjettansvar

  • Personalansvar for 4 personer ved laboratoriet. Laboratoriet utfører analyser av produkter, trendanalyser og bidrar faglig inn til produksjonen.

  • Lede HACCP-teamet og sikre gjennomføring av risikoanalyser, validering og verifisering

  • Videreutvikle og standardisere prosesser med fokus på mattrygghet, kvalitet og sikker drift

  • Implementering, drift, vedlikehold og videreutvikling av kvalitetssystemet

  • Oppfølging og dialog med relevante myndigheter

  • Oppfølging av avvik, reklamasjoner og sporbarhet

  • Delta i og følge opp interne og eksterne revisjoner

  • Kvalitetsoppfølging av råvare- og emballasjeleverandører

  • Bidra i innovasjons- og utviklingsprosjekter med ansvar for kvalitet og mattrygghet

  • Være en synlig forbedringsagent for forbruker, kunde og bedriften

Ønskede kvalifikasjoner

  • Høyere utdanning innen mikrobiologi, næringsmiddelteknologi, bioingeniørfag eller tilsvarende

  • Erfaring fra kvalitetsarbeid i næringsmiddelindustrien

  • God kompetanse innen HACCP og mattrygghetsarbeid

  • Ledererfaring er en fordel

  • Erfaring med forbedringsarbeid, gjerne Lean, TPM eller tilsvarende metodikk

  • Gode skriftlige og muntlige ferdigheter i norsk og engelsk

Hvem er du?

Vi tror du lykkes godt i rollen dersom du:

  • Ser sammenhenger og balanserer forretningsmessige hensyn med forbrukerens forventninger

  • Kommuniserer tydelig og evner å skape engasjement rundt kvalitet og forbedring

  • Har gjennomføringsevne og evner å omsette planer til resultater

  • Er strukturert, løsningsorientert og målbevisst

  • Utviser høy faglig integritet og tar ansvar når det gjelder

For å sikre en grundig og objektiv vurdering av aktuelle kandidater benytter vi testverktøyene Matrigma og MAP. Vi legger stor vekt på personlige egenskaper og oppfordrer deg til å beskrive hvordan dine styrker og erfaringer gjør deg godt rustet for rollen.

Vi tilbyr

  • En nøkkelrolle i et selskap med sterke merkevarer og store ambisjoner

  • Muligheten til å påvirke og videreutvikle kvalitetsarbeidet i en virksomhet med høye standarder

  • Gode utviklingsmuligheter, både faglig og personlig

  • Konkurransedyktige lønns-, pensjons- og forsikringsordninger

  • Et sterkt fagmiljø og engasjerte kollegaer som sammen vil, våger og vinner

Kavli Norge

Kavli Norge er en dynamisk utfordrer i det norske dagligvaremarkedet. Vi omsetter for ca. 3 mrd. Vi er i sterk vekst med merkevarene Q®, Skyr® og Kavli®. Vi tror at de beste resultatene skapes av mennesker som sammen vil, våger og vinner.

Vår viktigste oppgave er å begeistre forbruker, og på den måten skaper vi verdier til gode formål. I Kavli og Q-Meieriene jobber vi alltid for å finne nye måter å gjøre tingene på og utforsker nye muligheter. Vi er opptatt av å utvikle våre dyktige medarbeidere og tiltrekke oss nye lagspillere som vil, våger og vinner sammen med oss.

Kavli og Q-Meieriene er den del av Kavlikonsernet som i tillegg har virksomhet i Sverige, England og Finland. Vi har en unik eierform gjennom Kavlifondet. I 2025 delte vi ut hele 100 millioner kroner til gode formål innenfor forskning, humanitært arbeid og kultur. Dette blir du en viktig del av når du arbeider hos oss. Derfor sier vi at «Det du gjør hver dag, er med på å gi andre en bedre hverdag».

title: Strategy & Operations Associate - Customer Identity
description:
About the opportunity

We are seeking a highly driven Strategy & Operations Associate for our Grow & Engage domain, specifically focusing on the Customer Identity team. This role requires strong alignment across our internal Risk, MLRO and LYC Operations teams.

You will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between strategy and execution, helping N26 grow and run better by translating ambitious goals into clear KPIs and tangible results.In this role, you will be part of a high-impact team that acts as a strategic partner to leadership, driving customer value and business growth across our core revenue lines.

In this role, you will:

  • Own and refine segment strategy, enabling data-driven trade-offs across Engagement and Subscriptions.
  • Act as a subject matter expert, developing a deep understanding of business drivers, infrastructure, and processes.
  • Drive KPI discipline, leading regular performance reviews and ensuring progress against core company targets.
  • Identify and prioritize growth opportunities, proactively assessing performance and uncovering areas for innovation and efficiency.
  • Build robust business cases, evaluating ROI and guiding investment toward the highest-impact initiatives.
  • Lead and coordinate cross-functional initiatives end-to-end, ensuring strong project management, clear ownership, timely delivery, and continuous optimization.
  • Monitor performance and optimize outcomes, including product KPIs, unit economics, and external partner delivery against SLAs.
  • Act as the central connector across teams and partners, aligning stakeholders (Product, Tech, Data, Growth, Finance, etc.), resolving blockers, and driving execution on complex, high-impact topics.

What you need to be successful:

Background:

  • Minimum of 3 years, preferably in fintech, banking, consulting, or B2C startup environments working with some of these topics: growth, funnel optimization, subscription models, customer engagement, product-led growth.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Management, Mathematics, or related field from a top-tier institution.
  • You have experience putting together business cases and making data-driven recommendations.
  • You have experience leading cross-functional projects end-to-end (from ideation to execution) and collaborating with diverse teams to drive strategic outcomes.
  • Strong problem-solving ability to structure and define analyses to draw innovative conclusions.

Skills:

  • Proficiency in SQL, with the ability to independently source data and derive insights.
  • Effective visualization and storytelling skills for presenting insights.
  • Interest and curiosity for the banking/fintech industry.
  • Fluent in English.

What’s in it for you:

  • Accelerate your career growth by joining one of Europe’s most talked about disruptors 🚀.
  • Employee benefits that range from a competitive personal development budget, work from home budget, language apps and public transportation.
  • As an N26 employee you will have access to a Premium subscription on your personal N26 bank account. As well as subscriptions for friends and family members.
  • Vacation days vary depending on your location of work. Additional day of annual leave for each year of service.
  • A high degree of autonomy and access to cutting edge technologies - all while working with a friendly team of peers of diverse nationalities, life experiences and family statuses.
  • A relocation package with visa support for those who need it.

Who we are:

N26 has reimagined banking for today’s digital world. Technology and design empower everything we do and it’s how we are building the global banking platform the world loves to use.

We've eliminated physical branches, paperwork, and hidden fees for an elegant digital experience and supreme savings. Giving people the power to live and bank their way is what gets us out of bed in the morning and inspires the work that we do.

We are headquartered in Berlin with offices in multiple cities across Europe, including Vienna and Barcelona, and a 1,500-strong team of more than 80 nationalities.

Sounds good? Apply now for this position.

Equal Opportunities:

We recognize that our strength lies in our people and the varied perspectives they bring to our workforce. We strive to build talented and diverse teams to drive our business success and empower our people to reach their full potential.

We genuinely welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, cultures, genders, sexual orientations, abilities, neurodiversities, and ages. We're committed to creating an inclusive workspace where everyone feels valued and respected, free from harassment and discrimination. If there's anything you need to make the application process work for you, please let us know by reaching out to candidate.exp@n26.com.

Visit our website to learn more about Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion at N26.

title: Junior Creative AI Operator / Developer
description:
About Justera Group
Justera Group AB is a leading Swedish IT consulting firm with great experience specializing in building high-performing technology teams and delivering end-to-end IT solutions. Led by dynamic female executives, Justera Group focuses on helping businesses harness the power of digital technologies to continuously evolve in today’s rapidly changing economy. The company has deep expertise in IT consultancy, software development, and recruitment services, providing clients with purpose-driven, well-trained consultants who consistently deliver efficient and effective results. Justera Group manages the entire talent lifecycle, from hiring to ongoing management, ensuring the right fit for each project on time and within budget. With their strong commitment to quality, collaboration, and client success, Justera Group is a trusted partner for technology innovation across Sweden.
About the Role:
We are looking for a Junior Creative AI Operator / Developer to support an internal Design team by operating, developing, and optimizing AI-driven creative solutions.

The role combines AI development, image generation, 3D content creation, synthetic data generation, and automation, with a strong focus on producing high-quality, photorealistic visual outputs for automotive design applications.

You will work in a fast-paced, research-oriented environment where creativity, technical problem-solving, and the ability to rapidly turn ideas into practical solutions are highly valued.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Operate and develop AI-based solutions supporting internal automotive Design workflows.

  • Build and optimize image-generation and 3D-generation pipelines.

  • Work with image-generation tools and node-based workflows, including Flux, Krea, Qwen Image, Z-Image, and ComfyUI.

  • Develop and maintain Python-based automation and data-processing workflows.

  • Create, prepare, structure, and manage large-scale 3D datasets for automotive applications.

  • Support the development and fine-tuning of generative AI models for automotive use cases.

  • Perform LoRA training and image-model fine-tuning.

  • Develop and optimize synthetic data pipelines for high-quality automotive datasets.

  • Implement multiprocessing and automation solutions to improve rendering and data-collection efficiency.

  • Work with Blender for 3D content creation, processing, rendering, and dataset generation.

  • Establish efficient dataset structures and support collaborative data-collection workflows.

  • Troubleshoot technical and creative challenges and iterate quickly based on feedback.

  • Deliver high-quality results within tight project deadlines.

Requirements:

  • Strong proficiency in Python.

  • Hands-on experience with Blender and 3D workflows.

  • Practical experience with modern AI image-generation tools, preferably including Flux, Krea, Qwen Image, Z-Image, and ComfyUI.

  • Experience with LoRA training and fine-tuning of image-generation models.

  • Experience collecting, preparing, and managing large 3D datasets.

  • Understanding of 3D generative models and experience adapting or fine-tuning them for automotive or comparable applications.

  • Proven experience building or optimizing synthetic data pipelines.

  • Strong understanding of multiprocessing, automation, rendering, and efficient data collection.

  • Knowledge of effective dataset structures and collaborative data-management practices.

  • Ability to work effectively in research-heavy, project-based environments.

  • Ability to quickly learn new AI tools, models, and workflows.

What We Offer:

  • A dynamic and innovative workplace driving advancements in cutting-edge robotic technologies

  • The opportunity to collaborate with talented cross-functional teams on meaningful and impactful projects

  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package

  • A supportive culture that fosters continuous learning, growth, and professional development

  • Flexible hybrid working model for an optimal work-life balance

  • 25 days of annual leave to recharge and relax

  • An annual wellness allowance of 3,500 SEK to support your health and wellbeing

title: Data Scientist
description:
Data Scientist – Permanent - £69,000 - £74,000

Join us and be part of a mission-driven, independent publisher. You’ll work with a diverse group of people who share a passion for empowering researchers, educators, and institutions to shape the future.

About Sage:

Sage is a global academic publisher of books, journals, and library resources with a growing range of technologies to enable discovery, access, and engagement. Believing that research and education are critical in shaping society, Sara Miller McCune founded Sage in 1965. Today, we are controlled by a group of trustees charged with maintaining our independence and mission indefinitely.

Our guaranteed independence means we’re free to:

  • Do more – supporting an equitable academic future, furthering disciplines that drive social change, and helping social and behavioural science make an impact

  • Work together – building lasting relationships, championing diverse perspectives, and co-creating resources to transform teaching and learning

  • Think long-term – experimenting, taking risks, and investing in new ideas

About our Team:

We are driven and dedicated to employing brand-new technology to push the boundaries of what's possible in data science. We play a crucial role in driving business outcomes by collaborating closely with departments across the company. We pride ourselves on high standards, ensuring that our models and solutions are both modern and effective. Our team is known for its collaborative spirit and dedication to excellence, and we encourage new perspectives that help us deliver at the highest level.

Could you be our new Data Scientist? Are you?

  • A Data Scientist with a strong record of delivering AI/ML solutions that drive commercial and customer impact?

  • Experienced in applying advanced models like XGBoost, Random Forests, LSTM, and transformers to solve real-world problems?

  • Skilled in Natural Language Processing or Computer Vision and recommender systems, including the latest generation of LLMs?

  • Fluent in Python, R, and SQL, with hands-on experience working across large structured and unstructured datasets?

  • Confident using Git-based platforms (GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps) to collaborate and manage code effectively?

  • A data wrangler who can quickly extract key insights from disparate customer data sources?

  • A compelling data storyteller who can visualise and communicate insights using tools like PowerBI and Looker?

  • A proactive multi-tasker who thrives in fast-paced environments, managing multiple projects and stakeholders with precision?

Your new role:

As a Data Scientist, you will play a key role in shaping, crafting, and implementing innovative AI/ML solutions. Your role will include:

  • Employing advanced AI/ML and statistical methods to address a variety of business problems, includingNLP, Computer Vision, and recommender systems.

  • Applying Azure services to deliver scalable, cloud-based solutions.

  • Functioning as a subject matter expert in data science to provide counsel on various initiatives within the company.

  • Representing the data science function in senior-level discussions and driving a culture of evidence-based decision-making.

  • Collaborating with data engineers to prepare high-quality datasets and with ML engineers to deploy and optimise models.

  • Ensuring models meet technical, ethical, and regulatory standards.

  • Resolving complex model performance issues and guiding junior team members.

  • Remaining at the forefront of data science and NLP through assessing emerging methods and conveying insights clearly to the business.

Overview of benefits:

  • 25 days annual leave (plus bank holidays) with 2 additional floating personal days.

  • Hybrid working up to 2 days per week in office and a home working allowance.

  • Life assurance, income protection, and travel insurance.

  • Private medical cover and access to the company doctor.

  • Tuition scheme and support for pursuing professional qualifications, including access to Sage books and journals.

  • Variety of snacks and beverages available in the office.

  • Healthy lifestyle reimbursement and anniversary trips.

  • Access to Company loans (season ticket loan, rental deposit loan, cycle loan).

We’re a Disability Confident Employer (Level 1). If you’d like to apply under this scheme, please let us know in your application.

We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and inclusive. If you’d like to request reasonable adjustments, please email humanresources@sagepub.co.uk. Please note we only accept applications via email if an adjustment has been agreed.

Closing date for applications: 6th September 2026

To ensure we can give each application the attention it deserves, we may consider bringing the closing date forward. Therefore, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible to ensure it is considered.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Sage, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team and to sustaining a culture that celebrates diversity, encourages authenticity, and builds a deep sense of belonging. We encourage applications from all members of society irrespective of age, disability, sex or gender identity, sexual orientation, colour, race, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion, or belief as crafting value through diversity is what makes us strong.

description:
