title: Systemtekniker
description:
Senior Systemtekniker inom virtualisering till långsiktigt konsultuppdrag i Örebro

Vill du arbeta med verksamhetskritisk IT-infrastruktur i en komplex och tekniskt avancerad miljö? Nu söker vi två seniora systemtekniker med specialistkompetens inom virtualisering till ett långsiktigt konsultuppdrag hos vår kund i Örebro.

Om rollen

Som senior systemtekniker blir du en viktig del av en komplex IT-infrastruktur med höga krav på tillgänglighet, prestanda och kontinuitet. Du kommer att arbeta med drift, administration, förvaltning och vidareutveckling av verksamhetskritiska virtualiseringsplattformar.

Rollen passar dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av VMware-miljöer och trivs med att arbeta i enterprise-miljöer där stabilitet, säkerhet och teknisk kvalitet är avgörande.

Du kommer att arbeta nära andra infrastrukturspecialister och bidra med din expertis inom virtualisering, felsökning och automatisering.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

I rollen kommer du bland annat att:

  • Arbeta med drift, administration och förvaltning av verksamhetskritiska virtualiseringsplattformar.

  • Administrera och vidareutveckla miljöer baserade på VMware vSphere, ESXi och vCenter.

  • Arbeta med VMware Cloud Foundation och tillhörande infrastrukturlösningar.

  • Felsöka, analysera och lösa komplexa tekniska problem i enterprise-miljöer.

  • Säkerställa hög tillgänglighet, prestanda och kontinuitet i IT-infrastrukturen.

  • Arbeta med scripting och automatisering för att effektivisera drift, administration och förvaltning.

  • Delta i tekniska förbättrings- och utvecklingsinitiativ inom virtualisering och infrastruktur.

  • Samarbeta med andra tekniska specialister för att utveckla och säkerställa en stabil och framtidssäkrad IT-miljö.

Vi söker dig som

Vi söker dig som har en gedigen bakgrund inom IT-infrastruktur och systemförvaltning med särskild specialistkompetens inom virtualisering.

För att vara aktuell för rollen behöver du ha:

  • Minst 5 års erfarenhet av arbete med virtualiseringsplattformar i verksamhetskritiska miljöer med höga krav på tillgänglighet.

  • Minst 4 års praktisk erfarenhet av VMware vSphere, ESXi, vCenter och VMware Cloud Foundation (VCF).

  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av felsökning, analys och problemlösning i komplexa enterprise-miljöer.

  • Erfarenhet av scripting och automatisering för effektivisering av drift, administration och förvaltning av IT-infrastruktur.

  • God förmåga att kommunicera på svenska, både i tal och skrift.

Du är van att arbeta självständigt i komplexa miljöer och har förmågan att snabbt analysera tekniska problem och hitta långsiktigt hållbara lösningar.

Meriterande

Det är meriterande om du har minst tre års erfarenhet av drift, administration och konfigurering av:

  • VMware Cloud Foundation Automation

  • VMware Cloud Foundation NSX

  • VMware Cloud Foundation Operations

  • VCF Private AI

Personliga egenskaper

För att trivas i rollen tror vi att du är analytisk, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad. Du har ett stort tekniskt intresse och trivs med att arbeta i avancerade IT-miljöer där höga krav ställs på kvalitet och tillgänglighet.

Du är ansvarstagande och noggrann, samtidigt som du har lätt för att samarbeta och dela med dig av din kompetens till andra.

Om konsultuppdraget

Uppdraget är ett långsiktigt konsultuppdrag på heltid med start enligt överenskommelse och löper till och med 31 oktober 2028.

Placering är Örebro, och arbetet bedrivs på plats hos kund.

Tjänsten omfattas av säkerhetskrav och säkerhetsprövning kan därför bli aktuell innan uppdragets start.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande, så skicka gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

title: Operational Excellence Analyst – Remote-First
description:
🚀 Be part of a movement to change the way Europe pays

In today’s digital Europe, payments still feel too complicated. The European Payments Initiative is changing that with Wero, a proudly European digital wallet that makes payments easier, clearer and more secure. Join us in building a new, proudly European payment system.

🔎 What's in it for you

  • Help shape operational excellence and performance management in a fast-growing European payments company.

  • Work on initiatives that improve service quality, resilience and collaboration across EPI, its members and vendors.

  • Grow your experience in a multicultural, remote-first environment with exposure to senior stakeholders and board-level reporting.

🐝 About the team

You’ll join the Operations team, which covers operational excellence, monitoring and customer support, member quality assurance, and fraud and security operations. You’ll report directly to the Head of Operational Excellence and collaborate with teams across EPI and its members.

💥 Your impact

  • Support the implementation and maintenance of an operational performance framework, including clear KPIs, reporting mechanisms and service-level objectives.

  • Track EPI, member and vendor performance and resilience data, identifying risks, deviations and opportunities for improvement.

  • Prepare clear materials for regular service reviews, quarterly Member Advisory Group meetings, board reporting and other internal or external stakeholders.

  • Lead documentary reviews by inventorying existing documentation and processes, supporting teams in closing gaps, and reorganising the document library.

  • Follow up on internal audits and improvement initiatives, coordinating action items, monitoring deadlines and reporting progress.

  • Support escalations by gathering the relevant information and helping stakeholders identify practical resolution options.

  • Strengthen collaboration across the Operations department, EPI organisation and EPI’s members to support high performance and goal achievement.

💻 Technology stack

Primary:

  • Microsoft Office or Google Workspace, especially spreadsheets and presentation tools

  • Confluence, Jira or similar documentation and project-tracking tools

  • KPI dashboards, service reporting and data visualisation tools

Secondary:

  • Service management and quality frameworks, such as SLA/SLO practices, CMMI, Kanban or similar

  • Knowledge of documentation repositories, process-mapping tools and operational risk tracking

🕵🏻‍♀️ To succeed, you should meet at least 70% of these requirements

Must have

  • At least 2 years of experience in project management, service delivery, operations, consulting or a related field.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience; a project management certification is a plus.

  • Fluent in English (CEFR C1 or C2); French, German, Dutch or another European language is a plus.

  • Ability to work remotely with a high degree of autonomy, while collaborating effectively in a multicultural environment.

  • Experience tracking KPIs, performance, action plans or project progress and turning findings into clear reporting.

  • Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to prepare concise materials for senior internal and external stakeholders.

  • Highly organised approach to project follow-up, documentation and process improvement, with the persistence to coordinate actions through to completion.

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with service-level or quality-improvement frameworks such as SLA/SLO, CMMI, Kanban or similar.

  • Interest in fintech and payments, including awareness of regulatory and compliance topics such as DORA and PSD2.

🪜 If this looks like you, the recruitment steps are:

  1. A 45-minute first call with one of our recruiters, focused on skills, attitude and motivation.

  2. A 60-minute job-specific skills interview with the hiring manager, focused on your technical and functional expertise.

  3. A 30-minute culture interview with the N+2, our COO.

  4. Hopefully, an offer you can’t refuse.

⛔ Turn back if …

  • You’re looking for a highly structured environment with little ambiguity or change.

  • You prefer working independently without frequent collaboration across teams and with external stakeholders.

  • You’re not comfortable with occasional travel to meet colleagues in Paris, Brussels or Amsterdam.

🎁 What we can offer

  • Remote-first culture with quarterly and annual all-staff in-person meetups.

  • Possibility to work from another EU country for up to 3 months per year.

  • Competitive compensation package, including salary, performance-based bonus and a high-quality benefits programme.

  • The opportunity to be part of a multicultural European company.

  • Learning and development budget: €5,000 training budget per year.

Otherwise apply!

🫶 Our commitment to equal employment opportunities

EPI offers the same job opportunities to all, without distinction of gender, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, social status, disability or age. EPI promotes the development of an inclusive work environment that mirrors the diversity of the clients our product is serving.

title: Sustainability Strategist
description:
Are you interested in driving and developing Swedbank’s sustainability agenda and contribute to further integration of sustainability into the bank’s processes? We are looking for a Sustainability Strategist who will contribute to the acceleration of Swedbank’s sustainability transition.

In Swedbank you have the opportunity to:

• Develop and contribute to the integration of Swedbank’s climate and other sustainability commitments into the bank’s business and operating model in close cooperation with all relevant units (i.e. business areas, risk units).

• Provide expertise knowledge and guidance to various stakeholders on subject matters.

• Perform analysis and contribute to development of climate-related sector specific tools, methodologies and policies that support business and risk management processes.

• Maintain and develop sustainability targets and metrics in line with Swedbank’s external commitments, strategic priorities, regulatory requirements and other stakeholder expectations.

• Contribute to external communication on Swedbank’s sustainability agenda.

• Assess sustainability aspects of customers and transactions.

• Drive and/or contribute to various projects within Group Sustainability that support and accelerate Swedbank’s sustainability transition.


What is needed in this role:

• Master’s degree in relevant field.

• A minimum of 1-3 years of work experience within the financial sector.

• Understanding of how the sustainability transition affects the banking industry.

• Knowledge and experience of the main carbon accounting and climate target setting frameworks within the financial industry.

• Solid understanding of the sustainability drivers within different sectors.

• Knowledge of both existing and upcoming EU sustainable finance regulations.

• Excellent analytical capability.

• Great communication, presentation and cooperation skills, both with internal and external stakeholders and cross-border.

• Self-sufficient with a doer mentality and with excellent planning & prioritising as well as project management skills.

• Solution orientated, structured and efficient with a positive attitude.

With us, you can experience:

  • Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.

  • Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society.

  • An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities.

  • A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role.

  • Enjoy country-specific benefits, including banking offers, a pension plan, our share-based reward program, health insurance in the Baltics and a health allowance in Sweden.

"Join our team and...

be a part of a diverse team of professionals, who are jointly delivering challenging projects together with the whole bank, enabling Swedbank’s sustainable business strategy.” Karolina Skog, your future leader

We look forward to receiving your application by 04.09.2026.

Location: Sundbyberg

Recruiting manager: Karolina Skog

We may start the selection during the application period and welcome your application as soon as possible.

We would like to let you know that a background check and a drug test may be a part of the process for this role.

We have done our medium for recruitment and therefore decline contact with advertising sellers or sellers of other recruitment services.

Swedbank does not discriminate anybody based on gender, age, sexual orientation or sexual identity, ethnicity, religion or disability – everybody is welcome.

title: Mainframe Consultant(Network)
description:
At Allstate, great things happen when our people work together to protect families and their belongings from life’s uncertainties. And for more than 90 years, our innovative drive has kept us a step ahead of our customers’ evolving needs. From advocating for seat belts, air bags and graduated driving laws, to being an industry leader in pricing sophistication, telematics, and, more recently, device and identity protection.

Job Description

The IT Infrastructure Senior Consultant I is responsible for infrastructure design, selection and implementation by leading incident support and resolution efforts. The position helps on tasks related to automated monitoring and alerting solutions, metrics creation and reporting, applications integration and problem management. The role helps manage, prioritize, and respond to inquiries by helpdesk, specialists and others, as well as maintains governance documentation, implements major configuration changes, and supports infrastructure-related communications and training.

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Entry-Level z/OS Network Engineer to join our infrastructure engineering team. In this role, you will support the design, implementation, monitoring, and maintenance of networking services that enable critical z/OS mainframe environments. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will gain hands-on experience with enterprise networking technologies, TCP/IP configuration, connectivity troubleshooting, and mainframe communication services that support business-critical applications. This position is ideal for recent graduates or early-career professionals with an interest in networking, operating systems, and enterprise infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in the administration and support of z/OS network environments.
  • Monitor network performance, availability, and connectivity across mainframe systems.
  • Support TCP/IP configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting activities.
  • Participate in incident response and root-cause analysis of network-related issues.
  • Collaborate with application, systems, security, and infrastructure teams to resolve connectivity challenges.
  • Assist with implementing network changes, upgrades, and maintenance activities.
  • Create and maintain technical documentation, procedures, and operational runbooks.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and scheduled maintenance activities as skills develop.
  • Learn and apply network security and compliance standards in a mainframe environment.
  • Support disaster recovery and business continuity testing activities.

Experience (Preferred)

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Cybersecurity, or related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Basic understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing and switching.
  • Exposure to IBM z/OS or mainframe technologies.
  • Familiarity with network monitoring tools.
  • Understanding of cybersecurity fundamentals.
  • Experience with Python, REXX, PowerShell, or Shell scripting.
  • Basic understanding of cloud networking concepts.
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills.

Supervisory Responsibilities

• This job does not have supervisory duties.


Education & Experience (in lieu)

• In lieu of the above education requirements, an equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Primary Skills

Information Technology (IT) Infrastructure

Shift Time

Recruiter Info

Yateesh B G

ybgaa@allstate.com

About Allstate

Joining our team isn’t just a job — it’s an opportunity. One that takes your skills and pushes them to the next level. One that encourages you to challenge the status quo. One where you can shape the future of protection while supporting causes that mean the most to you. Joining our team means being part of something bigger – a winning team making a meaningful impact.

The Allstate Corporation is one of the largest publicly held insurance providers in the United States. Ranked No. 84 in the 2023 Fortune 500 list of the largest United States corporations by total revenue, The Allstate Corporation owns and operates 18 companies in the United States, Canada, Northern Ireland, and India. Allstate India Private Limited, also known as Allstate India, is a subsidiary of The Allstate Corporation. The India talent center was set up in 2012 and operates under the corporation's Good Hands promise. As it innovates operations and technology, Allstate India has evolved beyond its technology functions to be the critical strategic business services arm of the corporation. With offices in Bengaluru and Pune, the company offers expertise to the parent organization’s business areas including technology and innovation, accounting and imaging services, policy administration, transformation solution design and support services, transformation of property liability service design, global operations and integration, and training and transition.

title: Machine Learning Engineer III, Metadata Extraction
description:
What is Box?

Box (NYSE:BOX) is the leader in Intelligent Content Management. Our platform enables organizations to fuel collaboration, manage the entire content lifecycle, secure critical content, and transform business workflows with enterprise AI. We help companies thrive in the new AI-first era of business. Founded in 2005, Box simplifies work for leading global organizations, including JLL, Morgan Stanley, and Nationwide. Box is headquartered in Redwood City, CA, with offices across the United States, Europe, and Asia.

By joining Box, you will have the unique opportunity to continue driving our platform forward. Content powers how we work. It’s the billions of files and information flowing across teams, departments, and key business processes every single day: contracts, invoices, employee records, financials, product specs, marketing assets, and more. Our mission is to bring intelligence to the world of content management and empower our customers to completely transform workflows across their organizations. With the combination of AI and enterprise content, the opportunity has never been greater to transform how the world works together and at Box you will be on the front lines of this massive shift.

Why Box needs you:

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to design, build, and operate reliable machine learning systems that deliver meaningful product impact at enterprise scale. In this role, you will combine strong software engineering and applied machine learning skills to take solutions from idea through production. You will work closely with engineering, product, data, and infrastructure partners to develop scalable ML and agentic capabilities, improve model quality, and ensure that systems are secure, observable, and dependable for Box customers.

The Metadata Extraction team builds AI-powered capabilities that transform unstructured enterprise content into structured, usable metadata. The team works on the platform and machine learning layer of document understanding, developing and operationalizing technologies such as OCR and LLM-based extraction agents. These capabilities help understand document layout, tables, handwriting, semantic content, and other complex information within enterprise documents. As a Machine Learning Engineer, you will build reliable, scalable systems that support the development, evaluation, deployment, and operation of these AI capabilities. You will collaborate with engineers, product partners, and adjacent platform teams to bring document intelligence features to Box customers at enterprise scale.

What you'll do:

  • Design, build, deploy, and maintain production LLM agents, machine learning models and services.
  • Develop robust data preparation pipelines, prompt and tool design, and agentic workflows.
  • Write high-quality, maintainable, and well-tested Python code for production systems.
  • Partner with Product, Software Engineering, Data, and Infrastructure teams to translate customer and business needs into ML-powered capabilities.
  • Evaluate and improve agents quality using appropriate offline and online metrics, eval sets, experiments, and feedback loops.
  • Monitor production ML systems for quality, reliability, latency, cost, and data or model drift; investigate and resolve issues as needed.
  • Contribute to the architecture of scalable services and pipelines that support real-time and batch ML workloads.
  • Create clear technical designs, documentation, tests, and operational runbooks.
  • Share knowledge, contribute to engineering best practices, and help raise the bar for code quality and operational excellence.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation and help triage production issues when on call.

Who you are:

We are an AI-first company. This means you approach your work with a growth mindset and find ways to leverage AI to help make faster, smarter decisions that will 10X your impact at Box.

  • You have 3+ years of experience building, deploying, or operating production software, data, or machine learning systems.
  • You have strong programming skills in Python and are comfortable writing production-grade, readable, testable, and maintainable code.
  • You have practical experience with the LLM based agents lifecycle: data and eval-set preparation, prompting and tool schemas, RAG, evaluation, deployment and monitoring.
  • You have experience with LLM application frameworks and libraries, such as LangChain, LangGraph, PyTorch, Pydantic, Pandas, or NumPy, and are comfortable calling LLM APIs (e.g. Gemini, Claude, OpenAI).
  • You understand core machine learning concepts and can make pragmatic trade-offs between model performance, reliability, latency, scalability, and cost.
  • You have experience building APIs, services, pipelines, or distributed systems in a cloud environment.
  • You are familiar with CI/CD, observability, testing, and production support practices.
  • You communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical partners.
  • You have an ownership mindset, enjoy solving ambiguous problems, and work collaboratively across teams.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with MLOps tooling, model monitoring, feature stores, workflow orchestration, or experiment tracking.
  • Experience with generative AI in production: multi-provider gateways, semantic search, or structured extraction.
  • Experience with multimodal intelligent document processing workflows.
  • Experience with a major cloud platform, including GCP, AWS, or Azure, and technologies such as Kubernetes and Terraform.
  • Experience with SQL and large-scale analytics (e.g. BigQuery) for quality, cost, and incident investigation.
  • Experience in enterprise software, security, search and retrieval, or content intelligence.
  • Experience mentoring engineers or contributing to technical direction.

Methodology

  • Agile management - Scrum
  • Issue tracking tool -Jira
  • Knowledge repository - GitHubEnterprise
  • Code reviews - GitHubEntreprise
  • Version control system - GIT

title: Vacature Magazijnmedewerker – lossen containers | Van Cranenbroek Overpelt
description:
Draai jij je hand niet om voor een container die leeg moet? En werk je liever met je handen dan achter een scherm? Dan is Van Cranenbroek op zoek naar jou als magazijnmedewerker in Overpelt!

Wat ga je doen?

Van Cranenbroek is een familiebedrijf met vijf filialen in Nederland en België en circa 1000 medewerkers. Vanuit ons magazijn in Overpelt komen de goederen binnen die daarna de winkels in gaan. Jij staat aan het begin van die keten: samen met je collega's los je de trailers en containers die bij ons aankomen, en zorg je dat alles op de juiste drager en op de juiste plek terechtkomt. Je werkt 38 uur per week en rapporteert aan de meewerkend voorman van de expeditie.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Als magazijnmedewerker in Overpelt ben je verantwoordelijk voor het lossen van producten uit trailers en containers, en voor de registratie daarvan.

  • Lossen van producten op de juiste Van Cranenbroek wijze;

  • Registreren volgens de werkvoorschriften en de aanwijzingen van de meewerkend voorman;

  • Werken met de EPT (elektrische palletwagen);

  • Producten stapelen op de juiste dragers, op aangeven van de control tower of je leidinggevende;

  • Meedraaien op meerdere plekken in het logistieke centrum;

  • Zorgen voor een veilige en nette werkomgeving;

  • Naleven van de bedrijfsprocedures en richtlijnen rond veiligheid, hygiëne en werkprocessen.

Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?

  • Een contract voor 38 uur per week;

  • Loon volgens PC 140.03, uitbetaald per maand;

  • Werken in een familiebedrijf waar de lijnen kort zijn;

  • De mogelijkheid om je EPT-, hef- en reachtruckcertificaat te halen op onze kosten;

  • Personeelskorting op het volledige assortiment van Van Cranenbroek;

  • Collega's die het werk samen aanpakken.

  • Maaltijdcheques a 10 euro per dag

  • Eco-cheques a 250 per jaar op basis van een fulltime dienstverband

  • Gratis fruit op het werk

  • Reiskostenvergoeding

We zoeken iemand die aanpakt, veilig werkt en het niet erg vindt om fysiek bezig te zijn. Ervaring als magazijnier, lader-losser of logistiek medewerker is mooi meegenomen, maar niet verplicht: we leren je het werk aan.

  • Werk- en denkniveau beroepsonderwijs;

  • Affiniteit met de producten van Van Cranenbroek;

  • In het bezit van een EPT-certificaat, of bereid dit te halen;

  • Een hef- of reachtruckcertificaat is een pre, of je wilt dit halen;

  • Je werkt nauwkeurig en zelfstandig;

  • Je bent flexibel, proactief en stressbestendig;

  • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal; Engels is een pre;

  • Veiligheid staat bij jou voorop, voor jezelf en voor je collega's.

Zin in een nieuwe uitdaging binnen een betrokken organisatie? Reageer vandaag nog!

title: Junior Product & Legal/Compliance Specialist (Gap Cover)

title: Financial Data Systems Specialist
description:

Yes, you can! That's our attitude towards our work, ambitions, ideas, and relationships. We at Luminor believe that anyone has the potential to achieve big things and encourage everyone to achieve them, professionally and personally.

  • Culture. You’ll be joining a team where things move fast, ideas flow freely, and change is part of the everyday. It’s a dynamic environment that keeps you learning, growing, and never bored

  • Wellbeing. Access to tools and resources that help you feel good and be productive at work and in life

  • Professional growth. Internal and external training programs, LinkedIn learning, workshops, conferences, online training, etc

We are looking for a candidate primarily already located within the Baltics.

Please apply until the 15th of August with your CV in English and PDF format!

title: Purchase Ledger Accounts Assistant (6 Month FTC)
description:
At 1st Central, everything starts with our people.

As one of the UK’s leading motor and home insurers, we use smart technology, data and great service to make insurance fast, fair and simple for over 1.4 million customers. We’re proud to create an environment where people feel supported, trusted and able to grow - whether that’s developing new skills, taking on fresh challenges or making a real impact every day. If you’re looking for a role where you can make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.

If you're someone who’s great with numbers, detail-obsessed, and enjoys making systems tick, this could be right up your street.

We’re looking for a Purchase Ledger Accounts Assistant to join our Finance Team on a 6-month fixed term contract based in our Haywards Heath, West Sussex office. You’ll be helping us stay on top of payments, processing, and all things bookkeeping for our group’s payable ledgers and subsidiaries. You’ll be making sure everything lines up across our finance systems - keeping records accurate, up to date, and in line with internal policies. From managing the daily purchase ledger to handling key reconciliations, you’ll play an important part in keeping things running smoothly.

Core skills we’re looking for:

  • Communication: you're confident chatting with managers, colleagues, and suppliers
  • Ledger and reconciliation experience: you’ve handled complex data before and know how to present it clearly (desirable but not essential for early-career applicants)
  • Analytical: you enjoy spotting patterns and using data to improve how things work
  • Time management: you know how to prioritise, stay focused under pressure, and stay calm when things get busy

Working flexibly, you'll spend most of your time working from home, with one day a week in the office. If you prefer to be in the office more, that's good with us too.

What's Involved:

  • You’ll maintain the accounts payable in a timely fashion. Ensuring accurate recording and processing of transactions
  • You’ll ensure the prompt processing and payment of supplier invoices across the business
  • You’ll maintain the credit card programme and ensure prompt submission of credit card expenses monthly
  • You’ll facilitate the processing of colleagues’ expense, ensuring these align to the group’s policies and procedures
  • You’ll support a monthly reporting process for key accounts on the payable ledgers
  • You’ll handle supplier queries and disputes with appropriate business engagement in a timely and professional manner
  • You’ll assist the business with purchase order queries and ensure these are raised timely and accurately
  • You’ll support the reconciliation team with processing supplier payments and resolve unreconciled items promptly
  • You’ll attend meetings across the organisation to ensure operational functions are aware of purchase ledger issues and promote timing resolution and safeguarding against future issues
  • You’ll ensure proportionate reporting and oversight is supported for accounts payable activities that are operated both within and outside of finance
  • You’ll provide analysis of outstanding items showing monthly ageing and supporting business ownership for resolution, ensure SLAs are met
  • You’ll identify and recommend process and system changes for first line control failures leading to outstanding items being created
  • You’ll support in preparation of the Group’s audit by providing backups as requested, supporting the year-end audit process runs smoothly
  • You’ll adhere to the Group accounting policies and procedures
  • You’ll support activities in other finance teams as required
  • You’ll ensure compliance with company and other relevant standards / regulations at all times. Maintain department risk registers (as applicable), providing evidence and commentary for controls, updates for Mitigation Actions and maintaining control matrices and attestations.

Experience, Knowledge & Skills

  • AAT qualified or equivalent, or significant relevant experience
  • Experience in purchase or sales ledger, ideally within a shared services function and a high-growth, fast-changing environment
  • Strong communication skills – able to work effectively with managers, colleagues, and external suppliers, both verbally and in writing
  • Skilled in reconciling complex data, with the ability to analyse, summarise, and clearly present key findings to stakeholders
  • Proficient in Microsoft applications and confident using data to drive process improvements
  • Able to manage pressure and think clearly and logically in challenging situations
  • Preferably, knowledge of the UK financial services or regulated industry, with an awareness of internal and external fraud risks in finance

Behaviours

  • Collaborative and engaging, able to get the best out of a wide range of stakeholders
  • Proactive and resilient - driven to deliver change and overcome obstacles quickly
  • Agile and adaptable - able to pivot in response to shifting priorities and seize new opportunities

title: School Administrator
description:
IES Österåker opened in August 2024. We are a F-9 school, 2 parallel classes with up to 610 students. We are committed to our ethos which is a school with a calm and safe learning environment, bilingual teaching and high academic expectations. IESÖ follows the Swedish national curriculum while embracing bilingualism and the command of the English language . After grade 3 up to 50% of the lessons are taught in English. The school is located in central Åkersberga, about 30 minutes from Stockholm and a 5 minute walk from Roslagsbanan. Our campus combines newly built and renovated facilities and is close to sports facilities, nature, and the Stockholm archipelago. We are looking for a positive, creative, and service-minded person who will play an important role in creating a welcoming and engaging atmosphere at our school. You will have an integral role in key events and celebrations both from an organisational perspective as well as the practical. Many things that make IES Österåker special is that which is above and beyond the ordinary. It is important that you are comfortable with the creative and innovative side of things and that you interact well with children of all ages. You will assist students, parents, staff, and visitors, answer questions, manage day-to-day reception tasks, and help create a positive first impression of the school. This includes welcoming and assisting visitors, ensuring no one enters the school without authorisation and vetting , helping maintain a safe and secure school environment, handling general office administration such as deliveries, managing incoming and outgoing post and supporting the practical organisation of the school among other things.We are looking for someone who: - Has excellent communication and interpersonal skills. - Is confident, welcoming, and professional when interacting with students, parents, staff, and visitors. - Enjoys working in a busy school environment where no two days are exactly the same. - Is highly organised and able to coordinate several tasks and events at the same time. - Is creative and enjoys coming up with ideas for events, activities, and communication. - Has an interest in social media, photography, content creation, or digital communication. - Is flexible, solution-oriented, and happy to help wherever needed. - Has excellent English and Swedish communication skills, both written and spoken. - Swedish drivers licence is a plus What we offer - A varied and creative role at a growing international school. - A role where your ideas and initiative can make a real difference. - A dynamic working environment where you will meet students, staff, parents, and visitors every day. - Supportive and dedicated colleagues. - The opportunity to help build and develop a growing school. - A culture focused on learning, respect, community, and academic success. The position is 100% We apply a 6-month probationary period. Interviews will be conducted continuously during the application period, and the position may be filled before the application deadline. To apply, you need a valid extract from the criminal records register for work in schools.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.

title: ST-läkare till Vårdcentralen Molkom
description:
Är du intresserad av allmänmedicin och vill utvecklas i din yrkesroll? Vi söker dig som planerar att påbörja eller redan har påbörjat din ST inom allmänmedicin. Välkommen till Vårdcentralen Molkom!

Din arbetsplats

Vårdcentralen Molkom är en mindre glesbygdsvårdcentral med 4000 listade patienter. Här arbetar distriktsläkare, distriktssköterskor, sjuksköterskor, undersköterska, kurator, vårdadministratörer, fyisoterapeut och fotterapeut. Vårdcentralen är belägen tre mil utanför Karlstad och det finns goda förutsättningar att åka kollektivt. På vårdcentralen får våra patienter bedömning, utredning, behandling, uppföljning och rehabilitering beroende på sjukdom och symtom. Vi är ett gött gäng som trivs på jobbet och som tillsammans vill utveckla vårt arbete med och för våra patienter. Vi är stolta över vårt driv och engagemang som vi vet leder oss till att bli bättre och nå längre.

Vi arbetar utifrån ett arbetsmiljömässigt hälsofrämjande perspektiv, men erbjudande om friskvårdsbidrag och planerad friskvårdstid när verksamheten tillåter. Vi lägger stor vikt vid en god arbetsmiljö där stabilitet, dialog och kollegialt stöd är viktigt i vår vardag.

Dina arbetsuppgifter

I arbetsuppgifterna som ST-läkare ingår både akut och planerad mottagningsverksamhet. Vi bemannar även Säbo och hemsjukvård.

Arbetet är omväxlande och stimulerande, då vi har patienter i alla åldrar med varierande sjukdomsbakgrund. Du får handledning och stöd av erfarna kollegor med specialisering inom allmänmedicin för att du skall utvecklas och få erfarenhet inför ditt framtida arbete som specialist.

Vi följer det ST-upplägg som finns i Värmland för att få till kvalité och hållbarhet i ST-utbildningen. Vi tycker att det är viktigt med ett hållbart arbetsliv och månar därför om att ST-utbildningen hos oss blir en utbildning som ska generera trygghet och kompetens i det kommande yrket som specialist i allmänmedicin.

Som ST-läkare får du ett avgränsat uppdrag och ingår i ett team tillsammans med din handledare och andra yrkeskategorier. Du har avsatt tid för studier och handledning enligt en gemensam planering.

Dina kunskaper och kompetenser

Vi söker dig som är legitimerad läkare med ett intresse för allmänmedicins bredd och variation. Oavsett om du funderar på att påbörja din ST inom allmänmedicin eller redan har gjort det, ser vi fram emot din ansökan.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid att du har god samarbetsförmåga, ett strukturerat arbetssätt och tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och uppdrag. Vi värdesätter dina personliga egenskaper och söker dig som är empatisk, stabil och trygg i din yrkesroll. Du känner dig bekväm med att fatta välgrundade beslut, även i situationer som kräver snabba ställningstaganden, och ser värdet av ett nära samarbete mellan olika yrkeskategorier.

Intervjuer sker löpande under rekryteringsprocessen.

Om Region Värmland

Vi är till för att alla som bor här ska må bra och för att vår region ska vara attraktiv och konkurrenskraftig. Vi gör skillnad inom hälso- och sjukvård, tandvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och kultur och bildning. Vi möter människor i livets största stunder och i alla de där vardagsögonblicken där emellan. Vår vision är livskvalitet i världsklass. Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss och våra förmåner och följ oss på sociala medier.

Vill du också jobba för alla i Värmland? Välkommen med din ansökan.

Övrigt

Från 7 juni 2026 gäller EU:s lönetransparensdirektiv - för ökad öppenhet och rättvisa löner. Information om kollektivavtal finns på SKR:s webbplats, Kollektivavtal -SKR

I samband med eventuell anställning kan vi komma att be dig som sökande att lämna ett utdrag ur polisens belastningsregister. Inför anställning inom psykiatrisk vård, vård av funktionshindrade, vård av barn eller ungdomar gör arbetsgivaren en kontroll i polisens misstanke och belastningsregister. Ett utslag i detta register kan komma att påverka din möjlighet till anställning.

Har du skyddad identitet och vill göra en ansökan ber vi dig att kontakta Kompetensförsörjningsenhet HR via Regionens växel 010-831 50 00. Då får du hjälp att lämna in din ansökan utan att den hanteras i Varbi. Tänk på att endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen.

Inför rekryteringsarbetet har Region Värmland tagit ställning till rekryteringskanaler och marknadsföring. Vi undanber oss därför alla erbjudanden om annonserings- och rekryteringshjälp i samband med denna annons.

title: Interim Merchandise Planner
location: Capelle aan den IJssel, Zuid-Holland, Nederland
description:
Ben jij sterk in data, commercie én het creëren van impact op customer performance? Spot jij opportunities voordat anderen ze zien en weet je deze te vertalen naar concrete actions die écht resultaat opleveren?

Voor Profuomo zoeken wij een ervaren Interim Merchandise Planner die gedurende zes maanden verantwoordelijk is voor de merchandise planning van onze consignment-partners. Als Merchandise Planner speel je een cruciale rol in het sturen van de performance bij onze klanten. Je combineert scherpe analyses met commercieel inzicht, signaleert kansen en vertaalt deze naar concrete acties om de omzet en voorraadprestaties te optimaliseren. Vanuit ons kantoor in Capelle aan den IJssel werk je intensief samen met de betrokken commerciële en operationele teams.

Wat je gaat doen:

  • Data-analyse & forecasting: Je analyseert verkoopcijfers en voorraadniveaus bij onze klanten en maakt nauwkeurige forecasts om ervoor te zorgen dat het juiste product op het juiste moment op de juiste plek is. Hiervoor bewaak je de budgetten, sellthrough en beschikbaarheid per verkooppunt.

  • Performance-optimalisatie: Je monitort en stuurt de prestaties van onze klanten door middel van data-gedreven inzichten en proactieve aanbevelingen.

  • Communicatie met klanten: Je onderhoudt een sterke relatie met onze retail-partners, adviseert hen op basis van analyses en denkt mee over hoe we samen de beste resultaten kunnen behalen.

  • Tijdens het inkoopseizoen werk je samen met onze partners aan de selectie en indeling van de seasonal collectie.

  • Samenwerking intern: Je werkt nauw samen met de afdelingen Sales, Product Development, IT en Logistiek.

  • Rapportage: Je ontwikkelt en presenteert rapportages over verkoopprestaties, voorraadbeheer en marktdynamiek.

Wat wij jou aanbieden:

  • Een uitdagende en verantwoordelijke interim opdracht met directe impact op de commerciële prestaties;

  • Een dynamische omgeving met korte lijnen en veel ruimte voor eigen initiatieven en ideeën;

  • Een aantrekkelijk en marktconform salaris;

  • Goede secundaire voorwaarden zoals bedrijfsfitness, reiskostenvergoeding, een royale personeelskorting, extra veel vakantiedagen en elke dag een geheel verzorgde lunch;

  • Elke vrijdagmiddag een gezellige borrel;

  • Legendarische Profuomo feestjes.

Jouw competenties:

  • Je hebt hbo-werk- en -denkniveau en relevante ervaring als Merchandise Planner, bij voorkeur binnen retail, fashion of een vergelijkbare commerciële omgeving; ervaring met consignment is een pré;

  • Je bent sterk in forecasting, voorraadsturing, budgetbewaking en commerciële analyse;

  • Je hebt een uitgebreide kennis van Excel; ervaring met planning-, ERP- en BI-systemen is een pré;

  • Je bent analytisch, nauwkeurig, pragmatisch en resultaatgericht;

  • Je communiceert helder en weet verschillende stakeholders mee te nemen in je advies;

  • Ervaring in implementatietrajecten voor ERP- en allocatiesystemen is een pré.

  • Je hebt perfecte beheersing van de Nederlandse/Engelse taal in zowel woord als geschrift.

Wie zijn wij?

Profuomo staat voor “Timeless comfort, contemporary menswear made with a sustainable approach”. Wij zijn hét eigentijdse modemerk voor authentieke mannen die kwaliteit waarderen en genieten van het leven. Timeless comfort kenmerkt onze filosofie én staat centraal in de collecties die we maken: comfortabele kleding geschikt voor werk en vrijetijd. Bij het creëren van onze collecties combineren we vakmanschap met de beste stoffen en innovatieve hightech garens. Als derde generatie familiebedrijf zijn wij ons bewust van onze verantwoordelijkheid naar de volgende generaties. Bij de productie van onze kleding hebben wij aandacht voor de belangen van mens en milieu, nu en in de toekomst.

Het merk groeit hard via een omnichannel distributiestrategie in binnen- en buitenland. Samen met de collega's van het hoofdkantoor, de winkels in Nederland en België en vele enthousiaste retailers werk je aan het succes van ons merk. Binnen Profuomo geloven we in unieke persoonlijkheden, waarbij er altijd ruimte is voor groei en ontwikkeling.

Ben je enthousiast geworden?

Graag ontvangen wij een motivatie en jouw CV. Voor verdere vragen over de vacature kan contact worden opgenomen via jobs@profuomo.com.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature is niet gewenst.

title: Student sökes för orderadministration i Malmö!
description:
Är du student och letar efter ett givande deltidsjobb, kolla hit! Är du en person som gillar att arbeta i ett högre tempo, ta dig an nya utmaningar och arbeta nära dina kollegor? Tveka inte på att söka redan idag, vi jobbar med löpande urval!

Om tjänsten

I över 80 år har företaget varit en trogen samarbetspartner till optiker världen över. Genom att se världen genom deras ögon har de förändrat hur människor upplever sin vardag och hjälpt kunder att förverkliga visionen om ett bättre liv. Du får chansen att växa i en professionell och engagerande miljö där ditt arbete direkt bidrar till att skapa en klarare framtid för kunder.

Arbetsuppgifter

Som orderhanterare blir du en nyckelperson för att ge förstklassig service. Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar:

  • Scanning av bågar
  • Registrering och packning av ordrar

Vi söker dig som

  • Har en pågående eftergymnasial utbildning med minst ett år kvar av studerna
  • Talar och skriver obehindrat på svenska
  • Är en prestigelös lagspelare som trivs i ett högt tempo

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du besitter följande egenskaper:

  • Serviceinriktad
  • Noggrann
  • Självgående

Tidigare erfarenhet från optikbranschen är väldigt meriterande, men din inställning och vilja är viktigast!

Vår rekryteringsprocess

Denna rekryteringsprocess hanteras av Academic Work och vår kunds önskemål är att alla frågor rörande tjänsten skickas till Academic Work.

Vi tillämpar löpande urval och kommer plocka ner annonsen när tillräckligt många kandidater har nått slutskedet i rekryteringsprocessen. Vid ansökan efterfrågas ett CV. Personligt brev använder vi inte som urvalsmetod och behöver därför inte bifogas. Du som kandidat bär huvudansvaret för att din ansökan är komplett när den skickas in. Rekryteringsprocessen innehåller två urvalstest: ett personlighetstest och ett test i kognitiv förmåga. Testerna är ett verktyg för att kunna hitta den kandidat med högst potential för tjänsten samt främja jämlikhet, mångfald och en rättvis rekryteringsprocess.

För våra deltidstjänster behöver du som sökande en annan huvudsaklig sysselsättning på minst 50 %. Exempel på detta är studier, annan anställning, eget företagande, föräldraledighet eller liknande.

description:
Renesas is seeking an enthusiastic and dynamic Field Application Engineer (FAE) for its Regional Sales team. In this role, the candidate will work closely with Sales Engineers and FAEs across Turkey and Eastern Europe to support key customers in Renesas Analog & Power product portfolio.

As a Field Applications Engineer, you are the bridge between your customers and many internal business divisions. Your primary goal is to win new business through proactive in-depth design and development support that will solve your customers' challenges. This requires a profound knowledge of the customer development process. You need to be familiar with all the aspects of the product lifecycle, from development to mass production.

In this role, you will also be responsible for actively driving and managing the technology proposal and evaluation stages. As part of the Sales team, you act as the key technical advisor for a wide range of your customers' applications.

Responsibilities:

  • Work hand in hand with sales to drive relationship building with customers.
  • Promote the complete analog and power portfolio, including interfaces, power management, as well as sensors. Work closely with your Digital and Connectivity FAE counterparts, also addressing Renesas’ digital & connectivity solutions.
  • Provide technical expertise and support to develop Renesas revenues, in close cooperation with the Renesas Sales Team and Distribution Network.
  • Drive and support projects proactively from demand creation to mass production.
  • Grow solid technical understanding of our products and relevant solutions. Can demonstrate products and get involved with system-level design, or in-depth technical support as required.
  • Identify new sockets for Renesas by working closely with customers at project design level to achieve Design Win targets.
  • Create, organize, update, and track opportunities and designs.
  • Develop a good understanding of customer products and markets, as well as supply, and business requirements. Be able to communicate them clearly at all levels internally, and highlight critical product needs
  • Understand the competition for us within the customers and develop strategies to counter their activity.
  • Travel within the assigned territory to customers and distributors
  • Be entrepreneurial and take ownership to keep an eye on and drive the business opportunity.

Besides your demonstrated technical skills and experience, we are looking for a team player. You should have very good communication skills and interaction with people. You are curious by nature and eager to keep up with our technological advances, as well as your customers' development. Furthermore, you like to share your knowledge and experience with your customers and team. Additionally, it is required to act on your own initiative, evaluate chances and risks carefully.

  • 5+ years of experience in a similar role would be preferred, but personality and technical knowledge are key.
  • Degree in Electrical Engineering with experience in Analog and Power Management applications, and a good track record of building customer relationships.

  • Strong problem-solving capability to interface customer needs and resources with energetic and proactive approaches.

title: Senior Full-Stack, Backend & Cloud Infrastructure
description:
This is a technically strong freelance opportunity that combines backend ownership with modern AWS infrastructure and real-time communication technologies.

Project description:

About the Product:

Our client is developing an innovative design-to-code platform that converts Figma designs into production-ready QML code for Qt Desktop and Qt for MCUs, with a live preview that renders the generated QML directly in the browser through a real Qt engine compiled to WebAssembly.

The solution includes a Figma plugin, a React-based live preview application, backend services, and a WebRTC signaling layer enabling fully peer-to-peer preview sessions.

Design data never touches our servers; getting that architecture right is part of what makes this role interesting.

The Role:

You will own the server side of the product: two NestJS services and a React frontend, all deployed to AWS through CDK and GitHub Actions. The services recently moved from Heroku to AWS (ECS Fargate, ALB, RDS, ElastiCache, S3, Amplify), and you will inherit, run, and evolve that infrastructure.

Beyond infrastructure, this is a hands-on product engineering role: you will build backend features, improve the real-time WebRTC layer, and contribute to the viewer and plugin when features cut across service boundaries, which they often do.

Tech stack:

  • TypeScript, Node.js 24, NestJS (Fastify), React 18
  • PostgreSQL 17
  • Vite
  • Prisma
  • Redis
  • Socket.IO
  • WebRTC
  • AWS (ECS Fargate, ALB, RDS, ElastiCache, S3, Amplify), AWS CDK
  • GitHub Actions, Docker
  • Sentry
  • Tailwind CSS
  • C++17
  • Qt 6 / QML
  • WebAssembly (Emscripten)
  • Strong commercial experience with TypeScript and Node.js development
  • Proven experience building and maintaining backend services using NestJS
  • Experience with WebRTC data channels and peer-to-peer architectures
  • Hands-on expertise with PostgreSQL, Redis, and modern API architectures
  • Solid AWS experience, including ECS Fargate, RDS, ElastiCache, S3, and load balancers
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code, preferably AWS CDK in TypeScript
  • Strong CI/CD knowledge, including GitHub Actions and multi-environment deployment pipelines, and cloud authentication mechanisms such as OIDC role assumption
  • Production-focused mindset, including experience implementing observability and monitoring solutions, with a strong focus on scalability, security, and reliability.
  • Experience writing automated tests and maintaining high-quality CI pipelines
  • Good communication skills and ability to work across backend, infrastructure, and frontend domains
  • Fluent English - C1 level

Nice to have:

  • Experience with Playwright or similar end-to-end testing frameworks
  • Knowledge of browser automation and CI stability improvements
  • Familiarity with OAuth2, JWT authentication, refresh token rotation, and reuse detection
  • C++ and Qt/QML familiarity, especially with Emscripten and CMake. Our viewer embeds a Qt engine compiled to WebAssembly, and an owner for that build pipeline is a big plus

title: Gender Equality, Disability and Social Inclusion (GEDSI) Advisor
description:
The GEDSI Advisor is responsible for the effective integration of Gender Equality, Disability, and Social Inclusion (GEDSI) across all components of the TRVC project. GEDSI is one of stand-alone objectives of TRVC; aiming to drive systemic and sustainable change by systematically mainstreaming GEDSI principles into project design, implementation, monitoring, and partnerships, particularly within private sector engagement and value chain development.

The Advisor will support the project to enhance inclusive participation and equitable benefits for women, people with disabilities, and other vulnerable groups, while strengthening the capacity of project teams and partners to apply GEDSI in a practical and results-oriented manner. Through evidence-based approaches and cross-sector collaboration, the position will contribute to achieving transformative and inclusive development outcomes aligned with project and donor priorities.

TRVC project has already set up the GEDSI Action plan and indicator framework. The Advisor will be the key liaison with all project stakeholders and counterparts to ensure the compliance and effective activity plan implementation.

Key Responsibilities

Gender Equality, Disability, and Social Inclusion (GEDSI) is a core pillar for ensuring the effectiveness, inclusiveness, and sustainability of the TRVC project. GEDSI Advisor plays a critical role in guiding the systematic integration of GEDSI across all stages of the project, from design to implementation and learning. This includes guiding GEDSI mainstreaming in program design and implementation, supporting enterprises and partners in adopting inclusive practices, strengthening the capacity of project stakeholders, and ensuring the effective integration of GEDSI within monitoring, evaluation, and learning systems. The Advisor will also facilitate collaboration with key stakeholders, contribute to knowledge and learning management, and promote the use of evidence-based approaches to achieve inclusive and tangible outcomes.

Under the overall leadership of the Team Leader with the technical and implementation support of the Gender and Disability Specialists; and in collaboration with Project Coordinator and Project team, GEDSI Advisor will be responsible for the following activities:

1. Provide strategic leadership for GEDSI integration

  • Provide strategic and technical leadership to guide the integration of GEDSI across company engagement, ensuring alignment with project objectives and SNV best practices.
  • Oversee and provide quality assurance for technical support activities, including coordinating GEDSI consultants and liaising with relevant stakeholders, to support Companies in developing and implementing seasonal and project-cycle GEDSI Action Plans.
  • Monitor the application and implementation of GEDSI criteria, technical guidelines, and related frameworks across Companies, ensuring consistency and quality of implementation.
  • Assess the relevance and effectiveness of GEDSI tools and criteria; recommend strategic adjustments to enhance impact and scalability. practical needs and project objectives.

2. Lead GEDSI capacity building and knowledge development

  • Design and lead a comprehensive capacity-building strategy on GEDSI for project staff, companies, and key stakeholders.
  • Provide strategic oversight and technical inputs into the development and refinement of training materials, toolkits, and technical guidance notes.
  • Oversee post-training application and recommend follow-up capacity strengthening interventions where needed.

3. Coordinate the implementation of provincial GEDSI Coordination Program

  • Take leading role in providing technical support and coordination for the development and implementation of annual workplan of provincial GEDSI Coordination program.
  • Engage with PMUs and relevant stakeholders to strengthen alignment, ownership, and quality of the program implementation.
  • Monitor overall progress and performance and provide recommendations and solutions to ensure quality delivery of the project.

4. Lead GEDSI integration in Monitoring, reporting, and learning (MEL) Framework

  • Lead the development and refinement of GEDSI-related tools, methodologies, and approaches for data collection, measurement, and reporting in alignment with the project’s MEL framework.
  • Provide technical leadership to ensure GEDSI indicators is effectively integrated into the project’s MEL framework, indicators, and data systems.
  • Oversee implementation progress of GEDSI component, outcomes, and indicators in line with TRVC workplan and MEL framework
  • Work closely with the MEL team to ensure data quality, consistency, and integrity, and that GEDSI-related data is systematically collected, validated, and analyzed.
  • Consolidate, analyze, and prepare periodic reports, technical reports, and thematic updates on GEDSI implementation with recommendations and lesson learnt

5. Knowledge management, learning and communications

  • Coordinate to collect, consolidate, and document case studies, success stories, lessons learned, and good practices on GEDSI to promote successful GEDSI models and lessons learned among partners and provincial stakeholders.
  • Ensure knowledge products contribute to learning, scaling, and influencing broader program and partner practices.
  • Collaborate with the Communication team to develop communication products, learning briefs, and knowledge-sharing materials for both internal and external audiences.
  • Contribute to SNV GESI standards and learning for the country office and for global learning
  • Other duties as assigned by line manager
  • Vietnamese
  • Advanced degree in Gender Studies, Development Studies, Social Sciences, or a related field.
  • At least 7 years of relevant experience in gender equality, disability, and social inclusion within development programs, with strong experience in mainstreaming GEDSI across the full project cycle.
  • Demonstrated experience working on DFAT-funded programs or applying DFAT’s GEDSI framework, including integrating GEDSI into program design, implementation, and MEL systems.
  • Strong experience in developing GEDSI strategies, tools, and methodologies, and in leading capacity building, coaching, and technical advisory for diverse stakeholders.
  • Solid expertise in integrating GEDSI into Monitoring, Evaluation, and Learning (MEL), including indicator development, gender analysis, and assessment.
  • Experience in integrating GEDSI principles into climate-smart agriculture, carbon-related initiatives, or sustainable value chains is an advantage.
  • Experience working with the private sector on integrating GEDSI
  • Excellent communication and report writing skills in English.
  • Good written and spoken English and Vietnamese.
  • Willingness to travel to project sites as required.

Competency

  • Problem Analysis
  • Communication
  • Coaching
  • Focus on quality
  • Result Orientation
  • Persuasiveness

Contract Type: Employment contract

Contract Duration: 12 months, full-time, with possibility of extension

Expected Start Date: ASAP

Duty Station: Hanoi

Travel to Projects: Travel within Mekong Delta is expected

Reports to: Team Leader

How to Apply?

Working at SNV
SNV offers a challenging work environment, opportunities to lead and innovate, and a commitment to growing your skills in a fulfilling and diverse environment. Our staff benefit from and contribute to, an internal and global network of experts.

At SNV, inclusivity is at the heart of our ethos. We celebrate the diversity of our workforce and uphold a policy of non-discrimination based on factors such as disability status, religion, ethnic origin, gender, sexual orientation, and more.

title: Undersköterskor och vårdbiträden till växande hemtjänst i Norrköping
description:
Vi växer snabbt och söker nu flera nya kollegor till vår hemtjänst i Norrköping!

Omsorgsgruppens hemtjänst är i en expansiv fas med allt fler kunder och ett större verksamhetsområde. Vi behöver därför förstärka vårt team med flera nya medarbetare med start så snart som möjligt.

Vi söker framför allt utbildade undersköterskor, men även dig som har erfarenhet av vård och omsorg och vill arbeta som vårdbiträde.

Det finns goda möjligheter till hög sysselsättningsgrad och vi har flera tjänster på heltid.

Om jobbet

Som medarbetare i vår hemtjänst hjälper du våra kunder att få en trygg och fungerande vardag i sitt eget hem.

Du utgår från vårt kontor på Svärmaregatan och tar dig till våra kunder med cykel eller bil, beroende på område och planering.

Arbetsuppgifterna varierar utifrån kundens behov och kan bland annat innebära:

  • Personlig omvårdnad
  • Läkemedelshantering efter delegering
  • Dusch och hygien
  • Måltider och enklare matlagning
  • Städning och andra serviceinsatser
  • Promenader och socialt stöd

Vi arbetar dag och kväll mellan kl. 07.00–22.00, både vardagar och helger.

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som är trygg, ansvarstagande och tycker om att arbeta med människor. Du behöver kunna arbeta självständigt, ta ansvar och samtidigt vara en bra kollega.

Vi söker i första hand dig som är utbildad undersköterska, men du är också välkommen att söka som vårdbiträde. Erfarenhet från hemtjänst eller annan vård och omsorg är meriterande.

Eftersom vi använder både cykel och bil i verksamheten behöver du kunna cykla. B-körkort är meriterande.

Vi erbjuder

  • Flera lediga tjänster med möjlighet till heltid
  • Möjlighet att börja så snart som möjligt
  • Ett varierande och självständigt arbete
  • Ett nära team med stöd från kollegor och arbetsledning
  • En verksamhet som växer och där du får möjlighet att vara med på vår fortsatta resa
  • Kollektivavtal och trygga anställningsvillkor

Om Omsorgsgruppen

Omsorgsgruppen har arbetat med vård och omsorg sedan 1996. Vi kombinerar det mindre företagets personliga närhet med ett professionellt arbetssätt och bedriver idag hemtjänst, personlig assistans, gruppbostäder och daglig verksamhet.

Våra värdeord är glädje, respekt, omtanke och helhet – och de ska märkas både i hur vi möter våra kunder och hur vi arbetar tillsammans.

Sök redan idag!

Vi har behov av flera nya kollegor omgående och intervjuar och anställer löpande.

Skicka ditt CV och några korta rader om dig själv – du behöver inte skriva något långt personligt brev.

Märk ansökan: Arbete Hemtjänst

Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

title: Weekend Chauffeur Bezorging in Almere
description:
Let op: Op dit moment solliciteren er veel mensen op deze vacature. Dit betekent dat we voor nu alleen je gegevens in onze talentpool opslaan. Zodra er een plekje voor jou vrijkomt, nemen we meteen contact met je op. Beloofd.

‘Goedemorgen!' Je komt binnen op het depot. Na een lekker bakkie en wat bijpraten, spring je samen met een collega in onze mooie blauwe bus. Vandaag staan er 9 wasmachines, 5 drogers, 4 koelkasten en één trampoline op je routelijst. Jullie komen op tijd aan bij de eerste klant en sluiten in mum van tijd de wasmachine aan. Het oude apparaat nemen jullie uiteraard mee terug. Zo, de klant is blij, dus jij ook! Dit is écht een mooie start voor de rest van de dag!

    • Als weekend Chauffeur/Bijrijder werk je standaard op zaterdag en zondag. Je bent flexibel inzetbaar tussen 07.00 en 23.00 uur. Ook op doordeweekse dagen werken? Misschien is de parttime-vacature een mooie optie voor je!
    • Je hebt spierballen. Een wasmachine naar 4 hoog tillen is voor jou geen probleem.
    • Je hebt een goed humeur. Je vindt het leuk om bij klanten op bezoek te gaan en bent klantvriendelijk.
    • Je hebt al minimaal één jaar een geldig Europees (schakel) rijbewijs B.
    • Je beheerst de Nederlandse taal goed.
    • Je kan een VOG aanleveren en hebt geen punten op jouw rijbewijs.
    • Je bent zelf in de gelegenheid om naar onze locatie te komen.
    • Een vast salaris van € 11,54 per uur als je langer dan 2 jaar je rijbewijs hebt. Inclusief 8% vakantiegeld (dat in mei wordt uitbetaald) is dat € 12,46 per uur.
    • Een vast salaris van € 11,02 per uur als je tussen de 1 en 2 jaar je rijbewijs hebt, want dan ben je bijrijder. Inclusief 8% vakantiegeld (dat in mei wordt uitbetaald) is dat € 11,90 per uur.
    • Nog meer geld: € 2,50 netto aan buiten-de-deur-eetgeld voor elke dag dat je werkt, plus fooi, reiskosten en pensioen.
    • Doe je het goed, dan groei je na 6 maanden al in salaris. Zo krijg je er als chauffeur bijvoorbeeld 1 euro per uur bij.
    • Korting op alle spullen die we verkopen en vele sportscholen door heel Nederland, om je spierballen te onderhouden.
    • 29 vakantiedagen op basis van een 40-urige werkweek, als je belooft dat je terugkomt.
    • Je kunt doorleren voor Inbouw Installateur, Zonnepanelen Installateur of Teamleider. Zodat je zelf groeit en je salaris ook.
    • Leuke werksfeer, epische feesten en sportevenementen zoals Mud Masters.
    • Je kan snel starten op het depot bij jou in de buurt.

title: Multimedia Producer
description:
About CoLab
At CoLab, we want to help mechanical engineering teams bring life-changing products to market years sooner.

We believe the fastest moving engineering teams in the world will soon automate all of the tedious aspects of design reviews—and CoLab is how they’ll do it. Our cloud-based platform enables collaborative, effective design conversations directly in the context of CAD.

Now, we’re building ReviewAI. By capturing expert knowledge and organizing feedback data, we’ve made it possible for AI to AutoReview drawings and 3D models. Now, engineers can spend less time on simple drawing checks and more time on tough technical problems.

About the Role
We’re hiring a Multimedia Producer to bring CoLab's story to life through product animations and motion-driven video content.

You’ll bring video projects to life once the core concept is defined. That means collaborating on the storyboard (which may originate from product marketing, field marketing, demand gen, or content), reviewing and challenging the creative direction, and then owning the execution from finalized storyboard through to the finished product.

Your work will fall into 3 core categories:

  1. Product Marketing Animations: You’ll design and animate videos that show how CoLab works, with a focus on visual clarity and compelling storytelling. These are multi-step engineering workflows that don’t come across in static images or screen recordings. You’ll help bring them to life through UI simulation, motion design, and animations that focus the viewer’s attention exactly where it needs to be.
  2. Demand Generation & Social Video: These videos will have faster turnaround times and higher volume. You might be editing clips of the CEO giving a talk or a customer providing a testimonial—shorter video edits that highlight real voices and social proof. These can be 30–60 seconds in length and published multiple times per month.
  3. Bringing the CoLab Brand to Life: You’ll craft distinctive, highly polished brand centric videos that strengthen CoLab’s visual identity and tell our story with clarity and impact.

What Success Looks Like
By the end of your first quarter, success means:

  • Publishing one thoughtful, animated product marketing video per month
  • Shipping at least three short-form, live-action or social-ready video clips
  • Building a deep knowledge of CoLab, how the platform works, the problems it solves, and the audiences it serves.

Longer term, the goal is to ramp up to:

  • Producing two product marketing animations per month, working toward one per week as processes mature
  • Sustaining a consistent cadence of short-form video content across campaigns and platforms

This mix of polished brand videos, high-velocity social clips, and in-depth product explainers will give CoLab a consistent video presence, tailored to each stage of the buyer journey.

Our Ideal Candidate

  • You’re creatively driven, but deeply practical. You love the craft of motion design and want your work to make a real impact.
  • You have strong knowledge of brand design and are able to work creatively within strict brand guidelines and established design systems, so that every video feels like a “CoLab video” from the moment it starts.
  • You have high standards and treat feedback as a way to sharpen your work—not a personal critique. You’ll revise something 12 times if that’s what it takes to make it excellent.
  • You know how to show—not just tell—how a technical product works. You bring a technical curiosity that helps you translate complex concepts into clean, sharp visuals.
  • You’re equal parts animator, motion designer, and editor. You know how to stage product moments, simulate UI interactions, and add visual polish that elevates the viewer experience.
  • You understand audio and know how to balance music, voiceover, and sound design to set the tone and elevate the content.
  • You’re motivated by visibility. You want to see your work out in the world, shared by teams and seen by future customers.

What you’ll do:

  • Take finalized storyboards and scripts and turn them into polished, engaging video assets
  • Work with CMO, product marketing, and design to review, challenge, and refine storyboards
  • Design and animate product marketing videos that enhance clarity and showcase CoLab’s capabilities
  • Create high-volume, short-form demand-gen and social videos that drive visibility and engagement
  • Animate or enhance product workflows using motion design techniques to direct viewer focus and improve comprehension
  • Curate audio, voiceover, and visual assets to align with CoLab’s brand and tone
  • Manage projects from storyboard handoff through final delivery on a fast, iterative schedule with minimal oversight

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in a motion design, animation, or multimedia production role, ideally in a B2B tech or SaaS environment
  • Mastery of Adobe Creative Suite, primarily After Effects and Premiere Pro, with working knowledge of Photoshop and Illustrator
  • Familiarity with tools like Figma, Blender and screen-recording software
  • A compelling motion design and video editing portfolio that demonstrates expertise in creating product explainers, UI animations, and highly polished brand-focused content.
  • Ability to translate technical workflows into digestible, visually compelling animated formats
  • Bonus: experience with 3D animation, Lottie, or engineering-related software

Extra Details

  • This is a full-time, permanent position with a competitive compensation package that includes stock options.
  • Extended health and benefits package, unlimited paid vacation, and RRSP matching.
  • Remote-friendly: you can work from anywhere in North America, with access to our HQ in St. John’s, NL.

Equity Note
Frequently cited statistics show that people who identify with historically marginalized groups are likely to apply to jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. We encourage you to help us break that statistic and apply even if you don’t meet every single qualification—your potential is what matters most to us.

title: Senior/Principal Consultant - Data
description:
Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consultancy specializing in driving digital transformation in the financial services industry. With a growing client portfolio comprising of over 100 global organizations, Capco operates at the intersection of business and technology by combining innovative thinking with unrivalled industry knowledge to deliver end-to-end data-driven solutions and fast-track digital initiatives for banking and payments, capital markets, wealth and asset management, insurance, and the energy sector. Capco’s cutting-edge ingenuity is brought to life through its Innovation Labs and award-winning Be Yourself At Work culture and diverse talent.

  • We are experts in Banking, Capital Markets, and Wealth and Asset Management.
  • We are rapidly expanding our Insurance sector capability.
  • We specialise in Digital Transformation, Data Management & Data Analytics, Business & Finance Transformation engagements, and IT Transformation and Change programmes.
  • We are committed to growing our business and hiring the best talent in the market.
  • Our focus is on maintaining our agile and entrepreneurial culture.

About the Job

Capco’s Data Team helps our clients transform every aspect of their business. We are highly skilled at formulating data strategy, defining business and technology initiatives across the data management lifecycle and aligning multi-year strategic roadmaps with clients’ business goals. As digital technologies advance and regulations tighten, today’s consumers and today’s businesses are becoming more aware of the importance of good quality data. We work to establish holistic ways to effectively manage data through the modern data supply chain and facilitate consumption through analytics, modelling, AI, machine learning, dashboarding, and reporting.

What You'll Get to Do

  • Design, implement, and enhance enterprise Data Governance and Data Management Frameworks across banking and financial services clients.
  • Develop and maintain data governance artifacts including data dictionaries, business glossaries, metadata catalogues, data lineage, critical data elements, and data classification standards.
  • Support enterprise Data Architecture, Data Quality, Master Data Management (MDM), and Metadata Management initiatives.
  • Drive Data Sovereignty, Data Residency, and Regulatory Compliance programs aligned with banking and financial services requirements.
  • Partner with business, technology, risk, compliance, and executive stakeholders to embed governance across the data lifecycle.
  • Deliver data transformation initiatives using Agile methodologies and support executive-level reporting and governance forums.
  • Leverage governance tools such as Collibra, Informatica, Microsoft Purview, Ab Initio, or similar platforms to improve data transparency, control, and quality.

What You'll Bring With You

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, Mathematics, Operations Research, or a related discipline.
  • 6-10 years' proven experience delivering Data Governance, Data Management, Data Architecture, Data Quality, or Enterprise Data Transformation programs.
  • Strong financial services experience across Banking, Wealth Management, Insurance, or Capital Markets.
  • Knowledge of industry frameworks such as DCAM, Data Governance Operating Models, Control Frameworks, and Data Lifecycle Management.
  • Experience with Data Lineage, Metadata Management, Master Data Management, Data Quality, and Data Architecture.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage senior executives, regulators, and cross-functional teams.
  • Hands-on experience with Collibra (preferred) or other enterprise data governance and metadata management tools.
  • Experience delivering projects using Agile or hybrid methodologies.
  • Fluent English communication skills; Arabic language skills advantageous for regional engagements.

Nice to Have

  • Experience delivering data governance programs aligned to BCBS 239, CCAR, GDPR, PIPL, MAS TRM, or related financial services regulations.
  • Knowledge of Data Sovereignty, Cross-Border Data Management, and Data Privacy frameworks.
  • Experience with cloud-based data transformation and enterprise data platforms.
  • Relevant certifications such as DCAM, CDMP, DAMA, AWS, Azure, or GCP.
  • Proven programme delivery and change management experience, including large-scale data transformation initiatives.

Eligibility to Work in Singapore

Applicants must have unrestricted working rights in Singapore. Only Singapore Citizens and Singapore Permanent Residents (PRs) will be considered. Employment Pass sponsorship is not available for this role.

WHY CAPCO?

We are expanding our business rapidly across Singapore and Asia. You will work on engaging projects with some of the largest banking and insurance clients in the world, projects that will deliver significant transformation and change.

We offer:

You will join a company that supports and encourages an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. Capco is not about organizational charts and layers – we operate with little hierarchy because we want all employees to feel that Capco is their firm. We warmly value diversity and inclusion and embrace our collective uniqueness – our culture is a strong, fresh, and invigorating difference from our competitors.

We offer highly competitive benefits, including medical and dental insurance and a work culture focused on innovation and creation of lasting value for our clients and employees.
