title: Teammanager Zorgadministratie
description:
Voor de stafdienst Informatisering & Zorgadministratie zijn we op zoek naar een ondernemende en verbindende Teammanager Zorgadministratie (min. 32 - 36 uur) die ons team komt versterken!

Heb jij affiniteit met het leidinggeven aan professionals, het aanjagen van innovatie en procesverbetering, en geloof jij in de kracht van de Zorgadministratie als volwaardige businesspartner van het primaire zorgproces? Dan zijn we op zoek naar jou!

Wat ga je doen?

Als Teammanager Zorgadministratie (ZA) geef je coachend, inspirerend en faciliterend leiding aan meerdere ZA-teams (tot in totaal ca. 30 fte). Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen van de koers en visie van de Zorgadministratie naar de dagelijkse werkpraktijk van jouw teams.
Je bent in deze rol integraal verantwoordelijk voor vier centrale resultaatgebieden:

  • Passende, goede zorgadministratieve en cliëntlogistieke processen: Je borgt kwalitatieve en bedrijfsmatig verantwoorde processen. Je stuurt actief op standaardisatie: 'standaard waar het kan, maatwerk waar het moet' en helpt administratieve lasten voor behandelaren te minimaliseren.

  • Bevlogen en betrokken medewerkers: Je stimuleert eigenaarschap, samenwerking, talentontwikkeling en een open, veilige werksfeer. Je geeft uitvoering aan het personeelsbeleid (waaronder werving, inzetbaarheid en ontwikkeling).

  • Gezonde bedrijfsvoering: Je draagt de verantwoordelijkheid voor het behalen van teamdoelen en het beheren van de toegewezen budgetten. Je zet in op datagedreven sturing door gebruik te maken van dashboards en voorspellende modellen voor o.a. capaciteitsplanning en rechtmatigheid.

  • Optimale samenwerking met de zorgafdelingen en stafdiensten: Je positioneert de ZA als gelijkwaardige en proactieve gesprekspartner in het primaire proces. Je doorbreekt 'eilandjes-denken' en bouwt aan een cultuur van continu verbeteren.

Daarnaast speel je een sleutelrol in de lopende transformatie van de ZA. Je treedt op als aanjager van technologische innovatie (zoals het benutten van AI en Gemini) en digivaardigheid, en vertaalt de meerwaarde hiervan naar efficiëntie en werkplezier op de werkvloer.

Wat hebben we jou te bieden?

Bij Altrecht krijg je de ruimte om écht impact te maken. Als Teammanager Zorgadministratie speel je een cruciale rol in het toekomstbestendig maken van onze organisatie en de overgang naar een datagedreven, ondersteunende en adviserende dienstverlening. Je werkt in een professionele en dynamische omgeving met bevlogen collega's.

Daarnaast krijg je van ons:

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen € 4.544,- en € 5.901,- (FWG 60 in de CAO GGZ) op basis van een 36-urige werkweek.

  • Een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% (volledige dertiende maand) en 8,33% vakantiegeld.

  • 166 vakantie-uren en 35 levensfase-uren per jaar op basis van 36 uur per week. Wil je nog extra tijd voor jezelf? Dan kun je extra verlof bijkopen, tot een maximum van 36 uur, afhankelijk van de omvang van je dienstverband.

  • Een jaarlijks balansbudget dat je kunt laten uitbetalen, inzetten voor verlof of verhogen tot € 1.400,- voor een vrijetijdscursus.

  • Een pensioenregeling bij Pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn, een collectieve inkomensverzekering bij arbeidsongeschiktheid en korting op aanvullende ziektekostenverzekering bij IZZ of Zilveren Kruis Achmea.

  • Alflex. Ons meerkeuzesysteem voor extra arbeidsvoorwaarden. Hiermee kun je jouw salaris fiscaalvriendelijk inzetten voor bijvoorbeeld een fiets, een sportschoolabonnement of aanvullende reiskostenvergoeding.

  • Bij Altrecht heeft je werk betekenis: samen met bevlogen collega’s en een sterk netwerk van zorg- en kennispartners maak je écht verschil in de ggz. Je krijgt de ruimte om jezelf te zijn, mee te denken en te groeien, als professional én als mens.

Je komt te werken in een organisatie vol mogelijkheden, met diverse (TopGGZ) specialismen en meerdere werklocaties in en rondom Utrecht.

Wie ben jij?

Je bent een verbindende, doortastende en ondernemende manager die daadkracht combineert met een mensgerichte, coachende stijl van leidinggeven. Je schakelt makkelijk tussen strategisch denken en de dagelijkse praktijk, stelt heldere kaders en weet hoe je teams meeneemt in veranderingen.

En je hebt:

  • Een bedrijfskundige of managementopleiding op minimaal HBO-niveau, bij voorkeur aangevuld met een relevante leiderschapstraining.

  • Minimaal 2 jaar ervaring in een leidinggevende functie op HBO-niveau (ervaring binnen de zorg of GGZ is een pré).

  • Kennis van relevantie wet- en regelgeving, actuele ontwikkelingen in de GGZ en aantoonbare kennis van het managen van bedrijfsprocessen.

  • Affiniteit met digitalisering en technologische vernieuwing (o.a. AI en geautomatiseerde werkprocessen).

  • Uitstekende sociale en communicatieve vaardigheden, overtuigingskracht en onderhandelingsvaardigheid.

Daarnaast herken jij jezelf in onze kernwaarden: passend, vertrouwen, verbindend en (veer-)krachtig.

Wie zijn wij?

Je gaat aan de slag binnen de Zorgadministratie en maakt deel uit van een betrokken managementteam bestaande uit teammanagers, directeur en beleidsmedewerker.

De Zorgadministratie van Altrecht bevindt zich in een uitdagende en inspirerende transformatiefase. Met ons Transformatieplan werken we stapsgewijs aan het versterken van onze rol als gewaardeerde businesspartner voor de behandelteams en RVE's binnen Altrecht. Samen met jouw collega-teammanagers stuur je op continue verbetering, uniformiteit van processen, datagedreven werken en een optimaal leerklimaat voor de medewerkers.

Enthousiast en nu?

Solliciteer eenvoudig via de sollicitatiebutton! Wil je eerst meer weten over de functie of de transformatie van de Zorgadministratie? Bel gerust met Eric Heij, directeur Informatisering & Zorgadministratie, via 06-12824678.

Je bent ook van harte welkom voor een oriënterend gesprek, zodat je de sfeer bij ons kunt ervaren. We kijken ernaar uit om van je te horen!

Goed om te weten

  • Een dagdeel meelopen kan onderdeel uitmaken van de sollicitatieprocedure. Zo leren wij elkaar beter kennen.

  • Acquisitie op basis van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Health System Partnerships Associate Director # 4931 (Western U.S.)
description:
Our mission is to detect cancer early, when it can be cured. We are working to change the trajectory of cancer mortality and bring stakeholders together to adopt innovative, safe, and effective technologies that can transform cancer care.
We are a healthcare company, pioneering new technologies to advance early cancer detection. We have built a multi-disciplinary organization of scientists, engineers, and physicians and we are using the power of next-generation sequencing (NGS), population-scale clinical studies, and state-of-the-art computer science and data science to overcome one of medicine’s greatest challenges.
GRAIL is headquartered in the bay area of California, with locations in Washington, D.C., North Carolina, and the United Kingdom. It is supported by leading global investors and pharmaceutical, technology, and healthcare companies.
For more information, please visit

GRAIL is seeking a Health System Partnerships Associate Director to lead the integration and expansion of GRAIL products and services within selected health systems and key strategic partners.

In this role, you will own the strategic vision and growth of partnerships across assigned healthcare institutions, representing GRAIL’s product portfolio. You will engage with executive and operational leaders within health systems to implement high-value programs, identify opportunities to broaden access across patient populations and care settings, and drive execution against shared goals. This role will shape account-level strategy and growth plans in close partnership with Director-level leadership, ensuring alignment with broader market access priorities.

The ideal candidate brings strong account management experience and deep healthcare ecosystem knowledge, an ability to influence executive-level cross-functional stakeholders, and a demonstrated track record of executing complex initiatives within healthcare systems. Success in this role requires balancing long-term partnership objectives with near-term performance goals while navigating the healthcare ecosystem effectively.

You will be accountable for the growth of Galleri across assigned accounts. You will lead system negotiations and contracting efforts, forecasting, and develop comprehensive pull-through strategies while working closely with internal stakeholders across field, market access, and marketing teams. You will also collaborate with payer and employer partnership teams to help identify and advance access opportunities.

Candidates will be selected based on their ability to contribute to a high-performing team culture grounded in trust, accountability, and a shared mission to expand access to breakthrough cancer early detection technology across the U.S.

This is a remote based role and covers institutions in the Western U.S. You will be approved to work from your City and State within the US. While your primary workplace is your home, you must be able to travel a minimum of 30% of the time to a GRAIL office, customer location, or other locations to perform your work or attend team-related events.

Responsibilities:

    • Lead day-to-day partnership activities for assigned healthcare systems, including academic centers and population health organizations, to expand adoption of GRAIL products.
    • Establish and cultivate executive-level (CEO, CMO, CIO, CTO, Cancer Center Directors, Medical Directors, and Lab Leadership) stakeholder relationships that result in system launches, market expansion, and new business initiatives.
    • Develop a strong understanding of each partner’s structure, economic drivers, strategic priorities, and operational workflows to inform account planning and opportunity development.
    • Own negotiation and execution of contracts in collaboration with senior leadership and legal partners.Lead MCED system-level workflow adoption, technology integrations, and broad provider awareness in partnership with medical and field teams.
    • Lead executive business reviews and ongoing governance meetings; prepare materials and performance analyses for leadership discussions.
    • Identify payer/employer access expansion opportunities, including presentation of cost-benefit analysis, in partnership with payer and HEOR supporting teams.
    • Develop and execute integrated account plans in collaboration with cross-functional teams interacting across clinical, operational, and administrative stakeholders.
    • Identify opportunities for evidence generation, pilot programs, or operational improvements, partnering with medical and clinical development teams as appropriate.
    • Develop and lead comprehensive launch playbooks to ensure launch excellence and pull-through with provider field teams to ensure coordinated engagement and strong customer experience delivery.
    • Collaborate with payer access and marketing teams to incorporate customer insights into value proposition development and pull-through initiatives.
    • Monitor healthcare system trends (e.g., reimbursement changes, care pathway evolution, EMR integration considerations) and share insights with internal stakeholders.
    • Ensure all partnership activities and customer engagements are conducted in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.
    These responsibilities summarize the role’s primary responsibilities and are not an exhaustive list. They may change at the company’s discretion.

Required Qualifications:

  • BS/BA degree (science or healthcare preferred); advanced degree in business, public health, or healthcare-related field a plus.
  • 10+ years of experience in health system partnerships, account management, or related healthcare roles. Internal candidates with 2+ years of relevant GRAIL experience may also be considered based on demonstrated experience and capabilities aligned with the role.

Preferred Qualifications:

    • 12+ years of experience in health system partnerships, account management, or related healthcare roles with 7+ years of demonstrated success managing complex health systems partnerships, with measurable outcomes.
    • Experience collaborating cross-functionally to implement product or service solutions within health systems.
    • Strong analytical skills, including forecasting and performance reporting.
    • Ability to develop and deliver clear, data-driven presentations to a range of stakeholders.
    • Working knowledge of compliance frameworks governing healthcare marketing and partnership activities.
    • Ability to communicate complex scientific and public health concepts clearly and credibly.
    • Track record of achieving performance objectives in a goal-oriented environment.
    • Experience working with healthcare system stakeholders, including clinical, operational, and executive leaders.
    • Strong understanding of healthcare reimbursement dynamics, delivery models, and institutional decision-making processes.
    • Oncology, diagnostics, or early detection experience are preferred.

Physical Demands & Working Environment:

  • Hours and days may vary depending on operational needs.
  • Working with dry ice may be necessary.
  • Standing or sitting for long periods of time may be necessary.
  • May be exposed to hazardous materials, blood specimens and instruments with moving parts, heating or freezing elements, and high speed centrifugation.
  • Some lifting (up to 25 pounds) may be necessary
  • Ability to travel a minimum of 30% of the time
The expected, full-time, annual base pay scale for this position is $146K-$194K.

This role may be eligible for other forms of compensation, including an annual bonus and/or incentives, subject to the terms of the applicable plans and Company discretion. This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the range that the Company reasonably expects to pay for the position upon hire; the actual compensation offered may vary depending on factors such as the candidate’s qualifications. Employees in this role are also eligible for GRAIL’s comprehensive and competitive benefits package, offered in accordance with our applicable plans and policies. This package currently includes flexible time-off or vacation; a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match; medical, dental, and vision coverage; and carefully selected mindfulness programs.

GRAIL is an equal employment opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a workplace where every individual can thrive, contribute, and grow. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, , or any other class or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws. Additionally, GRAIL will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in a manner consistent with applicable law and provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please contact us at rc@grailbio.com if you require an accommodation to apply for an open position.

GRAIL maintains a drug-free workplace. We welcome job-seekers from all backgrounds to join us!

description:

title: Senior Product Designer (f,m,x)
description:
We’re on the lookout for an ambitious Senior Product Designer to join our Design Team at our office in Berlin. Join us in building the largest AI enabled fintech for healthcare!

About Nelly

We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.

Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.

What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI isn't a nice-to-have at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

Joining us, you will:

  • Own end-to-end UX for a specific product area once team/pod assignments are finalized — from discovery through shipped feature

  • Contribute meaningfully to evolving Nelly's design system/design language for consistency across the product

  • Help move core product metrics (conversion, task completion) through better UX in owned flows

  • Support the design team's process and structure as it scales

What you'll bring:

  • End-to-end product design craft: UX flows, interaction design, and polished UI, from discovery through implementation

  • Comfortable owning ambiguity and driving decisions with limited guidance in a fast-moving startup environment

  • Strong collaboration with PMs and engineers — can work directly from problem statement to shipped feature

  • Contributes to and helps evolve a design system/design language, not just uses one

  • Experience Scope (Seniority): 3+ years in product design roles, including some in a scale-up/high-growth environment

  • Comfortable in a small team with high individual ownership (little hand-holding, few layers of review)

Our Interview Process:

  • First call with TA

  • Second online call with Head of Design

  • Case Study and meet the team

What we offer:

  • Deutschlandticket (public transport pass covering all of Germany) or Swapfiets membership, so you get around the city fast

  • Urban Sports Club membership, for sport and balance

  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid setup

  • Up to 4 weeks of workation

  • 500€ L&D Budget

  • A dog-friendly office with great vibes and a team that's fun to work with

  • Snacks and a fridge full of cold drinks

We welcome applications from people of all genders and backgrounds, regardless of origin or age. If you're convinced you're the right fit for this role - even if your CV doesn't match the requirements 100% - tell us why.

title: Health System Partnerships Associate Director # 4932 (Eastern U.S.)
description:
Our mission is to detect cancer early, when it can be cured. We are working to change the trajectory of cancer mortality and bring stakeholders together to adopt innovative, safe, and effective technologies that can transform cancer care.
We are a healthcare company, pioneering new technologies to advance early cancer detection. We have built a multi-disciplinary organization of scientists, engineers, and physicians and we are using the power of next-generation sequencing (NGS), population-scale clinical studies, and state-of-the-art computer science and data science to overcome one of medicine’s greatest challenges.
GRAIL is headquartered in the bay area of California, with locations in Washington, D.C., North Carolina, and the United Kingdom. It is supported by leading global investors and pharmaceutical, technology, and healthcare companies.
For more information, please visit

GRAIL is seeking a Health System Partnerships Associate Director to lead the integration and expansion of GRAIL products and services within selected health systems and key strategic partners.

In this role, you will own the strategic vision and growth of partnerships across assigned healthcare institutions, representing GRAIL’s product portfolio. You will engage with executive and operational leaders within health systems to implement high-value programs, identify opportunities to broaden access across patient populations and care settings, and drive execution against shared goals. This role will shape account-level strategy and growth plans in close partnership with Director-level leadership, ensuring alignment with broader market access priorities.

The ideal candidate brings strong account management experience and deep healthcare ecosystem knowledge, an ability to influence executive-level cross-functional stakeholders, and a demonstrated track record of executing complex initiatives within healthcare systems. Success in this role requires balancing long-term partnership objectives with near-term performance goals while navigating the healthcare ecosystem effectively.

You will be accountable for the growth of Galleri across assigned accounts. You will lead system negotiations and contracting efforts, forecasting, and develop comprehensive pull-through strategies while working closely with internal stakeholders across field, market access, and marketing teams. You will also collaborate with payer and employer partnership teams to help identify and advance access opportunities.

Candidates will be selected based on their ability to contribute to a high-performing team culture grounded in trust, accountability, and a shared mission to expand access to breakthrough cancer early detection technology across the U.S.

This is a remote based role and covers institutions in the Eastern U.S. You will be approved to work from your City and State within the US. While your primary workplace is your home, you must be able to travel a minimum of 30% of the time to a GRAIL office, customer location, or other locations to perform your work or attend team-related events.

Responsibilities:

    • Lead day-to-day partnership activities for assigned healthcare systems, including academic centers and population health organizations, to expand adoption of GRAIL products.
    • Establish and cultivate executive-level (CEO, CMO, CIO, CTO, Cancer Center Directors, Medical Directors, and Lab Leadership) stakeholder relationships that result in system launches, market expansion, and new business initiatives.
    • Develop a strong understanding of each partner’s structure, economic drivers, strategic priorities, and operational workflows to inform account planning and opportunity development.
    • Own negotiation and execution of contracts in collaboration with senior leadership and legal partners.Lead MCED system-level workflow adoption, technology integrations, and broad provider awareness in partnership with medical and field teams.
    • Lead executive business reviews and ongoing governance meetings; prepare materials and performance analyses for leadership discussions.
    • Identify payer/employer access expansion opportunities, including presentation of cost-benefit analysis, in partnership with payer and HEOR supporting teams.
    • Develop and execute integrated account plans in collaboration with cross-functional teams interacting across clinical, operational, and administrative stakeholders.
    • Identify opportunities for evidence generation, pilot programs, or operational improvements, partnering with medical and clinical development teams as appropriate.
    • Develop and lead comprehensive launch playbooks to ensure launch excellence and pull-through with provider field teams to ensure coordinated engagement and strong customer experience delivery.
    • Collaborate with payer access and marketing teams to incorporate customer insights into value proposition development and pull-through initiatives.
    • Monitor healthcare system trends (e.g., reimbursement changes, care pathway evolution, EMR integration considerations) and share insights with internal stakeholders.
    • Ensure all partnership activities and customer engagements are conducted in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and company policies.
    These responsibilities summarize the role’s primary responsibilities and are not an exhaustive list. They may change at the company’s discretion.

Required Qualifications:

    • BS/BA degree (science or healthcare preferred); advanced degree in business, public health, or healthcare-related field a plus.
    • 10+ years of experience in health system partnerships, account management, or related healthcare roles. Internal candidates with 2+ years of relevant GRAIL experience may also be considered based on demonstrated experience and capabilities aligned with the role.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 12+ years of experience in health system partnerships, account management, or related healthcare roles with 7+ years of demonstrated success managing complex health systems partnerships, with measurable outcomes.
  • Experience collaborating cross-functionally to implement product or service solutions within health systems.
  • Strong analytical skills, including forecasting and performance reporting.
  • Ability to develop and deliver clear, data-driven presentations to a range of stakeholders.
  • Working knowledge of compliance frameworks governing healthcare marketing and partnership activities.
  • Ability to communicate complex scientific and public health concepts clearly and credibly.
  • Track record of achieving performance objectives in a goal-oriented environment.
  • Experience working with healthcare system stakeholders, including clinical, operational, and executive leaders.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare reimbursement dynamics, delivery models, and institutional decision-making processes.
  • Oncology, diagnostics, or early detection experience are preferred.

Physical Demands & Working Environment:

  • Hours and days may vary depending on operational needs.
  • Working with dry ice may be necessary.
  • Standing or sitting for long periods of time may be necessary.
  • May be exposed to hazardous materials, blood specimens and instruments with moving parts, heating or freezing elements, and high speed centrifugation.
  • Some lifting (up to 25 pounds) may be necessary
  • Ability to travel a minimum of 30% of the time
The expected, full-time, annual base pay scale for this position is $146K-$194K.

This role may be eligible for other forms of compensation, including an annual bonus and/or incentives, subject to the terms of the applicable plans and Company discretion. This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the range that the Company reasonably expects to pay for the position upon hire; the actual compensation offered may vary depending on factors such as the candidate’s qualifications. Employees in this role are also eligible for GRAIL’s comprehensive and competitive benefits package, offered in accordance with our applicable plans and policies. This package currently includes flexible time-off or vacation; a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match; medical, dental, and vision coverage; and carefully selected mindfulness programs.

GRAIL is an equal employment opportunity employer, and we are committed to building a workplace where every individual can thrive, contribute, and grow. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, status as a protected veteran, , or any other class or characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, and local laws. Additionally, GRAIL will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in a manner consistent with applicable law and provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. Please contact us at rc@grailbio.com if you require an accommodation to apply for an open position.

GRAIL maintains a drug-free workplace. We welcome job-seekers from all backgrounds to join us!

title: Director of Data, Payments
description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us.

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

📍London or UK Remote | 💰 £150,000 - £200, 000 + Equity + Benefits


About our Data Discipline

We have a strong culture of data-driven decision making across the whole company. Data is central to how we understand our customers, shape our products, manage risk and grow Monzo sustainably. We believe in empowering teams with high-quality, trusted data and self-serve analytics, while creating space for Data practitioners to focus on the highest-impact questions, opportunities and decisions.

Our Data discipline is centralised, but deeply embedded in Monzo’s product areas. Data Scientists, Analytics Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers and Analysts work in cross-functional squads alongside Engineers, Designers, Product Managers, Marketers and other specialists. This means Data is not a downstream service: we help shape strategy, challenge thinking, build the data foundations teams need to move quickly, and share accountability for customer and commercial outcomes.

Our Payments team ⭐

At Monzo, payments are more than just moving money from A to B. They are a core part of how customers experience trust, speed, and financial control every day. As a Data Director in Payments, you would help shape seamless local payment experiences, ensuring customers can pay and get paid reliably while continuing to modernise the infrastructure that powers millions of transactions behind the scenes.

The role also sits at the intersection of Monzo’s broader ambition to build truly borderless banking and expand into new markets. That means designing products and payment capabilities that work effortlessly across geographies, currencies, and customer needs, while helping Monzo scale into new markets with the same simplicity and transparency that defines the brand today.

You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Design to help shape Monzo’s payments strategy to make Monzo's global ambitions a reality, enabling revenue and customer growth with a resilient, self-serve banking platform.

To succeed, you should be excited about solving tough, ambiguous business problems with analytical rigour, commercial viability and execution effectiveness

Your day-to-day

  • Establish yourself as a trusted member of the Payments Leadership team, enabling better decisions across Payments and the wider Data Discipline
  • Co-drive Payments strategy and product decisions with Product and Engineering, bringing Data into discovery early to shape priorities and challenge thinking
  • Identify untapped opportunities for commercial optimisation, including across pricing, commercialisation, investment and customer growth
  • Set the data strategy for Payments, including the operating model, team priorities, architecture, technical debt and key metrics and drivers
  • Translate between technical, product and commercial perspectives to help teams make clear, high-impact decisions
  • Develop and scale a high-performing team of data professionals sharing accountability for product and business outcomes.

You should apply if:

What we’re doing here at Monzo excites you!

  • You have experience driving payments innovation and product strategy forward in a fast-growing business
  • You combine deep Data expertise with strong product and commercial judgement.
  • You can move comfortably from detailed metrics or architecture discussions to customer strategy, pricing and business outcomes
  • You are an empathetic people leader who can build trust quickly, raise the performance bar and retain excellent talent
  • You have experience growing and leading a full stack data team, including individual contributors and managers across Data Science, Analytics Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering and Analytics
  • You have experience collaborating with senior cross-functional stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Design, Marketing and risk/control functions

The Interview Process

After an informal ~30 min recruiter call, our interview process involves 2 main stages. We promise not to ask you any brain teasers or trick questions!

  1. Initial Call (1 hour) You'll meet with one of our senior data leaders.
  2. Loop Stage - This is one stage with 4 interviews (totalling 4 hours) split between a collaboration with one of our engineers on a technical exercise, as well as behavioural and leadership interviews. You can have this all in one day or split these across multiple days, whichever your prefer.

Our average process takes around 3-4 weeks but we will always work around your availability. You will have the chance to speak to our recruitment team at various points during your process but if you do have any specific questions ahead of this please contact us on tech-hiring@monzo.com

How we work 💻:

Locations & Flexible Working :

Our main tech hub is in London, but our engineers live everywhere in the UK— from Brighton to the Western Isles.

We value meeting in person but there’s no pressure to come into the office, even if you're nearby. We believe you'll do your best work if you are where you want to be. If you live outside of London and we ask you to come into the office, Monzo will support you with the costs. ✨

Our offices are naturally social, especially Tuesdays, Wednesdays and Thursdays, which happen to line up with our twice-weekly Monzo lunches & treat Thursdays 🍽️. Teams also schedule time together often for work and play – in or around the office, or online.

Set up a work schedule that delivers impact and fits your life.

At Monzo, we value connections, flexibility, and wellbeing. We keep our meetings during core hours to stay connected and believe in maintaining work/life balance.

You’ll be empowered to manage your work in a way that suits you and your team, giving you the freedom for children drop-offs and pick-ups, walking your dog or adventurous cat, avoiding peak commuting times or gym slots, appointments, or supporting your family in an emergency. 🕒✨

Work the way that works for you with Monzo! 💼

What’s in it for you

💰Base salary £150, 000 - £200, 000 + Equity + Benefits

✈️ We can help you relocate to the UK

✅ We can sponsor visas

📍This role can be based in our London office, but we're open to distributed working within the UK (with ad hoc meetings in London).

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, at times that suit you and your team.

📚Learning budget of £1,000 a year for books, training courses and conferences

#LI-AL1 #LI-REMOTE





Equal opportunities for everyone

Diversity and inclusion are a priority for us and we’re making sure we have lots of support for all of our people to grow at Monzo. At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to age, ethnicity, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, national origin, or veteran, neurodiversity or disability status.

If you have a preferred name, please use it to apply. We don't need full or birth names at application stage 😊

title: Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter) based in United Arab Emirates.

This is an opportunity to join an established digital product and contribute to a mobile experience used by a global community.
You’ll work on core product journeys including registration, discovery, profiles, messaging, engagement, and monetization.
The role combines hands-on Flutter development with a strong focus on analytics, performance, and measurable product outcomes.
You’ll help evolve a production mobile application across both iOS and Android while supporting multiple brands and configurations.
The environment is remote-first and internationally distributed, with experienced professionals collaborating across cultures and time zones.
You’ll work with modern Flutter architecture and tooling while contributing to a product where mobile quality and user engagement directly matter.
This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership, technical depth, and building scalable mobile experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and maintain core mobile product experiences across authentication and registration, search and discovery, profiles, photos, messaging, matching, and user engagement.
  • Analyze and improve key product funnels, including registration, upgrades, monetization, messaging engagement, and match or interest conversion.
  • Own and contribute to analytics for core mobile journeys, helping teams understand user behavior and identify opportunities for product improvement.
  • Monitor and improve platform-specific capabilities such as push notifications, deep links, and real-time features.
  • Analyze mobile advertising and in-app purchase revenue metrics and support initiatives designed to improve monetization performance.
  • Support compliance-related analytics and functionality, including consent management, age verification, and user verification.
  • Build and evolve production Flutter applications for both iOS and Android using maintainable, scalable architecture.
  • Contribute to multi-flavor and white-label application delivery, including brand-specific configurations, assets, store identifiers, and Firebase environments.
  • Develop automated tests across unit and widget levels and help maintain high standards of reliability and code quality.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, analytics, and other cross-functional stakeholders in a fully remote international environment.

    • Requirements

    • Strong professional experience with Flutter and Dart 3.x, including experience delivering and maintaining production applications for both iOS and Android.
    • Solid understanding of layered mobile architecture, including separation between UI, domain/use cases and repositories, and framework layers.
    • Hands-on experience with BLoC and Provider, as well as GetIt for dependency injection and GoRouter for navigation.
    • Experience working with Dio for networking and immutable data models using code generation tools such as built_value or similar technologies.
    • Experience building and shipping multi-flavor or white-label mobile applications, including per-brand configurations, assets, store IDs, and Firebase setups.
    • Practical experience writing automated tests, particularly unit and widget tests; familiarity with bloc_test or BDD-style testing is an advantage.
    • Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, performance, maintainability, and production development practices.
    • Analytical mindset with an interest in using product data and user behavior to improve mobile experiences and business outcomes.
    • Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a distributed team.
    • Fluent Russian and B2-level English communication skills.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote, full-time working opportunity.
      • Competitive compensation, with the initial salary level or range shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before employment begins.
      • 28 calendar days of vacation per year.
      • 7 wellness days annually for personal needs, recovery, or household matters without requiring sick leave.
      • Employee referral bonuses of up to $5,000 for successful recommendations.
      • 50% reimbursement for professional training, international conferences, and industry events.
      • Corporate discounts for English language lessons.
      • Health support of up to $1,000 gross per year per employee where corporate medical insurance is unavailable, which can be used toward private health insurance or eligible medical expenses for employees and close relatives.
      • Workplace support, including equipment and coworking resources; employees working outside company-supported locations can receive up to $1,000 gross every three years toward home-office or coworking expenses.
      • Internal gamified recognition program where colleagues can award bonuses redeemable for merchandise, team-building activities, massage certificates, and other rewards.
      • International, remote-first working environment with opportunities to collaborate with professionals across different countries and cultures.

title: Adolf Lindgrens stiftelse söker vik. Fastighetsskötare till Centralpalatset
description:
Centralpalatset som idag är ett byggnadsminne är ett av Örebros mest välkända landmärken. Huset byggdes av Adolf Lindgren 1913 och ägs idag av Adolf Lindgrens stiftelse som förutom att vara hyresvärd också arbetar med att dela ut bidrag till jordbrukare, studerande, behövande och allmännyttig verksamhet samt driver en konferensverksamhet. Huset har 61 bostadslägenheter och 23 lokaler.

Dina uppgifter

Hos oss är du en viktig del av vårt team där vi tillsammans arbetar med att förvalta hyresfastigheten och stiftelseverksamheten på bästa sätt.

Som fastighetsskötare kommer dina arbetsuppgifter att innefatta;

· Städning av gemensamma utrymmen som gård, källare, vindsutrymmen, personalrum, verkstad och cykelrum. Ej trapphusstäd.

· Inköp till förråd

· Hantera felanmälningar samt följa upp och åtgärda dessa.

· Regelbunden rondering av gården, entréer, trapphus, hissar, tvättstugor samt övriga gemensamma utrymmen.

· Mindre reparationer och felsökning

· Vara behjälplig vid renoveringar och underhållsarbete

· Möblering, städning, inköp och service till vår konferensverksamhet.

· Nyckelhantering

· Vara behjälplig att svara på frågor från hyresgäster. Ge

service till hyresgäster vid behov.

· Vara behjälplig med övriga arbetsuppgifter efter behov

Vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du ett jobb där du både rör på dig, möter människor och ser resultat av ditt arbete varje dag. Du blir en del av ett team som kännetecknas av professionalitet, omsorg, ärlighet, respekt och ansvar. Tjänsten är ett vikariat på 6 månader och arbetstiden är mellan 7-12 dvs 62,5 %. Eventuellt kan tjänsten komma att förlängas och utökas för rätt person.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som är praktiskt lagd och serviceinriktad. Du är en positiv, social och ansvarstagande person som gillar ordning och reda. Vi ser gärna att du kan vara flexibel och rycka in och hjälpa till med det som är viktigast för dagen.

Mycket av arbetet sker under eget ansvar och det är viktigt att du är en problemlösare med stor initiativförmåga. Du träffar hyresgäster och andra som besöker oss och därför behöver du ha en mycket god känsla för service.

title: Cyberenheten söker chefsarkitekt till Försvarsmaktens konnektivitetsförmåga
description:
Vill du bidra till att göra Sverige och världen säkrare? Värdesätter du ömsesidigt förtroende, eget ansvar och goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling? Försvarsstabens cyberenhet söker nu en medarbetare inom konnektivitet- och transmissionområdet med driv, helhetssyn, samarbetsförmåga och säkerhetstänk.

Försvarsstaben

Försvarsstaben stödjer överbefälhavaren med att handlägga och bereda ärenden på militärstrategisk nivå, samt säkerställer att beslut som fattas av myndighetens ledning genomförs, följs upp och återredovisas. Försvarsstaben ansvarar även för att omsätta regeringens styrning av Försvarsmakten till strategiska planer och för att inrikta verksamheten.

Cyberenheten är en del av Försvarsstaben och leder arbetet med att omsätta Försvarsmaktens strategiska inriktning inom informations- och kommunikations- och teknologiområdet. Enhetens mål är att säkerställa myndighetssamordnad, robust och effektiv ledningsförmåga. Försvarsmakten bedriver ett omfattande förändringsarbete med att digitalisera verksamheten. Du kommer vara en del av ett team på ICT-styrningssektionen i Cyberenheten som består av erfarna, professionella medarbetare som fokuserar på att ur olika perspektiv skapa förutsättningar för ökad digitalisering av verksamheten på alla nivåer.

Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter

Som chefsarkitekt inom konnektikvitet och transmission har du en viktig roll i att stödja uppbyggnaden av konnektivitetsförmåga för såväl myndigheten som totalförsvaret och alliansen. Du säkerställer att krav på bland annat tillgänglighet och säkerhet uppfylls och du bidrar till att utarbeta principer för arkitektur och teknisk design samt bidrar till framdriften av digitaliseringen med moderna lösningar för informations- och kommunikationstjänster.

Arbetet innebär även att du aktivt deltar i framtagandet av målbilden för Försvarsmaktens IT-arkitektur, samverkar med Försvarets materielverk och andra externa aktörer, samt representerar myndigheten i nationella och internationella fora, till exempel inom Nato. Rollen innebär både strategisk och operativ koordinering, stöd till utvecklingsteam och samarbete kring drift, säkerhet och infrastruktur. Genom ditt arbete bidrar du till kompetenshöjning och ett mer innovativt arbetssätt inom myndigheten.

KRAV

Kvalifikationer

  • Relevant akademisk utbildning inom telekom, data- eller systemvetenskap, informations- och kommunikationsteknik, eller annan utbildning som Försvarsmakten bedömer som likvärdig
  • Flerårig aktuell och relevant arbetslivserfarenhet inom område telekom omfattande arbete med utveckling och förvaltning av system och tjänster för information och kommunikation, gärna från större organisation
  • God teknisk kunskap om telekomtjänster inklusive nät och infrastruktur
  • God kunskap om robusthet och säkerhet i telekomtjänster inklusive nät och infrastruktur
  • Dokumenterad erfarenhet av att självständigt driva komplexa projekt samt att hantera analys- och utredningsuppgifter inklusive att presentera resultat och slutsatser för ansvarig ledning
  • Goda kunskaper i Office365
  • Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska
  • Körkort B

Personliga egenskaper

God förmåga att ta initiativ och driva ditt arbete självständigt. Du är en lagspelare och bidrar till en god stämning i arbetslaget. God förmåga att hantera flera olika uppgifter samtidigt, prioritera och arbeta strukturerat. Du är bra på att föra dialog och skapa samsyn även i större och komplexa sammanhang, med såväl interna som externa parter. Du är prestigelös, vilket innebär att du är lyhörd för andras åsikter. Du har en god analytisk förmåga och omsätter erfarenheter och lärdomar till handling samt är resultat- och lösningsorienterad. Du bidrar till nytänkande och innovation och trivs i en arbetsmiljö i förändring. Stor vikt kommer att läggas vid personlig lämplighet.

MERITERANDE

  • Erfarenhet av arbete i statlig verksamhet eller större organisation med flera ingående organisationsenheter
  • God kunskap och kompetens om modern IT så som molnlösningar
  • God kunskap och kompetens om informations-, IT- och cybersäkerhet
  • Erfarenhet av spektrumfrågor
  • Erfarenhet av gällande regelverk inom området
  • Erfarenhet av att leda andra personer utan att vara chef

Övrigt

Anställningsform: Tillsvidareanställning, inleds med 6 månaders provanställning (för dig som inte är anställd inom Försvarsmakten)

Sysselsättningsgrad: Heltid

Arbetsort: Stockholm

Tillträdesdatum: snarast, enligt överenskommelse.

För frågor om tjänsten, välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef Carl-Henrik Olofsson.

Fackliga representanter:

SACO: Stefan Ungerth

SEKO: Åsa Karlsson

Försvarsförbundet, OFRS: Kjell Tetzlaff

OFRO: Roger Ericsson

Samtliga nås på telefon: 08-788 75 00.

Ansökan

Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-09-13. Din ansökan bör innehålla CV samt ansökningsbrev där du motiverar varför du är lämpad för denna befattning.

Ansökningar till denna befattning kommer endast tas emot via Försvarsmaktens webbplats.

Information om det rekryterande förbandet: I Högkvarteret finns överbefälhavaren och generaldirektören. Högkvarteret har ungefär 1 000 medarbetare – både yrkesofficerare och civila experter. Högkvarteret utgörs från 2023-01-01 av försvarsstaben, operationsledningen, militära underrättelse- och säkerhetstjänsten, samt Högkvarterets stabsavdelning och fristående enheter för tillsyn. En anställning hos oss innebär placering i säkerhetsklass. Vanligtvis krävs svenskt medborgarskap. Säkerhetsprövning med registerkontroll kommer att genomföras före anställning enligt 3 kap i säkerhetsskyddslagen. Med anställning följer en skyldighet att krigsplaceras. I anställningen ingår även en skyldighet att tjänstgöra utomlands. Innebörden av detta varierar beroende på typ av befattning. Till ansökan om anställning ska CV och personligt brev bifogas. Om du går vidare i anställningsprocessen ska alltid vidimerade kopior av betyg och intyg uppvisas. Samtal från externa rekryteringsföretag och säljare undanbedes.

title: Senior Product Analyst
description:
Join our Product Analytics function and play a key role in shaping the next wave of customer-facing experiences at ASOS. As a Senior Product Analyst, you’ll go beyond analysis — leading how data informs product strategy, influencing senior stakeholders, and driving measurable impact across the platform.

In this role you'll own core KPIs and suggest and experiment changes that can be made on site and to commercial propositions to drive growth. You’ll lead experimentation design and analysis, delivering insight that directly shapes roadmaps and priorities. You’ll partner closely with Product Managers, UX and cross-functional teams to understand how customers use the ASOS platform, identify the highest-impact opportunities, and ensure decisions are grounded in robust, insight-led thinking. You’ll also act as a thought partner to product leadership, helping to embed a culture of experimentation, data-driven decision making, and continuous optimisation.

The Role:

  • Lead deep-dive analysis across customer funnels and journeys, identifying high-impact opportunities to improve conversion, engagement, and retention
  • Own the design, execution, and evaluation of A/B tests and experimentation frameworks, ensuring statistical rigour and clear business impact
  • Proactively identify growth opportunities and influence prioritisation through data-led recommendations and experiments you design
  • Translate complex data into clear, compelling narratives tailored to both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership
  • Partner with Product Managers and senior stakeholders to define product strategy through data, setting clear success metrics and evaluating performance
  • Build and evolve dashboards, reporting, and self-serve analytics capabilities to scale insight across product teams
  • Mentor and support more junior analysts, contributing to best practice and raising the bar for analytical quality across the team

About you:

  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and translate data into actionable insight
  • Solid grounding in statistics, including hypothesis testing and experimental design, with the ability to apply these in real-world product environments
  • Advanced SQL skills and strong experience with Python (pandas, NumPy) for large-scale data analysis
  • Proven experience leading A/B testing programmes and influencing product decisions through experimentation
  • Significant experience analysing customer behaviour within digital products or e-commerce platforms, with a focus on driving measurable improvements
  • Strong experience with data visualisation tools (e.g. Power BI, Tableau, Looker), with an emphasis on storytelling and stakeholder impact
  • Experience working closely with Product and influencing senior stakeholders or leadership teams

BeneFITS’

  • Employee discount (hello ASOS discount!)
  • Employee sample sales
  • 25 days paid annual leave + an extra celebration day for a special moment
  • Discretionary bonus scheme
  • Private medical care scheme
  • Flexible benefits allowance - which you can choose to take as extra cash, or use towards other benefits
  • Opportunity for personalised learning and in-the-moment experiences that enable you to thrive and excel in your role

title: Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter) based in Switzerland.

This is an opportunity to join an established digital product and contribute to a mobile experience used by a global community.
You’ll work on core product journeys including registration, discovery, profiles, messaging, engagement, and monetization.
The role combines hands-on Flutter development with a strong focus on analytics, performance, and measurable product outcomes.
You’ll help evolve a production mobile application across both iOS and Android while supporting multiple brands and configurations.
The environment is remote-first and internationally distributed, with experienced professionals collaborating across cultures and time zones.
You’ll work with modern Flutter architecture and tooling while contributing to a product where mobile quality and user engagement directly matter.
This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership, technical depth, and building scalable mobile experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and maintain core mobile product experiences across authentication and registration, search and discovery, profiles, photos, messaging, matching, and user engagement.
  • Analyze and improve key product funnels, including registration, upgrades, monetization, messaging engagement, and match or interest conversion.
  • Own and contribute to analytics for core mobile journeys, helping teams understand user behavior and identify opportunities for product improvement.
  • Monitor and improve platform-specific capabilities such as push notifications, deep links, and real-time features.
  • Analyze mobile advertising and in-app purchase revenue metrics and support initiatives designed to improve monetization performance.
  • Support compliance-related analytics and functionality, including consent management, age verification, and user verification.
  • Build and evolve production Flutter applications for both iOS and Android using maintainable, scalable architecture.
  • Contribute to multi-flavor and white-label application delivery, including brand-specific configurations, assets, store identifiers, and Firebase environments.
  • Develop automated tests across unit and widget levels and help maintain high standards of reliability and code quality.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, analytics, and other cross-functional stakeholders in a fully remote international environment.

    • Requirements

    • Strong professional experience with Flutter and Dart 3.x, including experience delivering and maintaining production applications for both iOS and Android.
    • Solid understanding of layered mobile architecture, including separation between UI, domain/use cases and repositories, and framework layers.
    • Hands-on experience with BLoC and Provider, as well as GetIt for dependency injection and GoRouter for navigation.
    • Experience working with Dio for networking and immutable data models using code generation tools such as built_value or similar technologies.
    • Experience building and shipping multi-flavor or white-label mobile applications, including per-brand configurations, assets, store IDs, and Firebase setups.
    • Practical experience writing automated tests, particularly unit and widget tests; familiarity with bloc_test or BDD-style testing is an advantage.
    • Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, performance, maintainability, and production development practices.
    • Analytical mindset with an interest in using product data and user behavior to improve mobile experiences and business outcomes.
    • Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a distributed team.
    • Fluent Russian and B2-level English communication skills.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote, full-time working opportunity.
      • Competitive compensation, with the initial salary level or range shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before employment begins.
      • 28 calendar days of vacation per year.
      • 7 wellness days annually for personal needs, recovery, or household matters without requiring sick leave.
      • Employee referral bonuses of up to $5,000 for successful recommendations.
      • 50% reimbursement for professional training, international conferences, and industry events.
      • Corporate discounts for English language lessons.
      • Health support of up to $1,000 gross per year per employee where corporate medical insurance is unavailable, which can be used toward private health insurance or eligible medical expenses for employees and close relatives.
      • Workplace support, including equipment and coworking resources; employees working outside company-supported locations can receive up to $1,000 gross every three years toward home-office or coworking expenses.
      • Internal gamified recognition program where colleagues can award bonuses redeemable for merchandise, team-building activities, massage certificates, and other rewards.
      • International, remote-first working environment with opportunities to collaborate with professionals across different countries and cultures.

title: Business Analyst B2B
description:
Hoe maak jij onze klanten blij?


Als Business Analyst B2B werk je voor onze Digital platforms en tools en maak je direct impact op de dagelijkse ervaring van onze zakelijke klanten. Jouw eerste focus is het succesvol uitrollen van Portoview als een strategische groeipilaar van Alliance Automotive group. Portoview is een B2B SaaS-oplossing waarmee schade aan leaseauto’s eenvoudig gemeld, beoordeeld en hersteld kan worden.

Jij bent de praktische schakel tussen gebruikers, operatie en development. Je duikt in de dagelijkse praktijk: waar lopen klanten, schadeherstellers, leasemaatschappijen of interne teams tegenaan? Vervolgens vertaal je deze inzichten naar duidelijke, uitvoerbare verbeteringen in ons platform en onze processen.

Je bent niet alleen bezig met analyseren en adviseren, maar steekt vooral graag de handen uit de mouwen. Je werkt mee aan het scherp krijgen van requirements, test nieuwe functionaliteiten, ondersteunt bij de implementatie en volgt verbeteringen op totdat ze aantoonbaar werken.

De grootste uitdaging

Onze ambitie is om Portoview breder beschikbaar te maken voor diverse klanten in Nederland, België en zelfs Europa. De uitdaging is om complexe operationele processen rondom schadeafhandeling te vertalen naar gebruiksvriendelijke en schaalbare oplossingen. Dit willen we niet alleen voor Portoview, maar al onze B2B digital platforms. Daarbij houd je oog voor de belangen van alle betrokken partijen én voor wat er technisch en operationeel haalbaar is.

Je weet hoofd- en bijzaken van elkaar te onderscheiden, maakt processen concreet en helpt het team om snel de juiste keuzes te maken. Je wacht niet af, maar zoekt actief de samenwerking op en zorgt dat verbeteringen daadwerkelijk worden gerealiseerd.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Business Analyst B2B werk je nauw samen met business stakeholders en het (externe) development team. Je bent betrokken van vraagstuk tot en met implementatie en evaluatie. Je gaat onder andere:

  • Behoeften van klanten, gebruikers en interne teams ophalen en vertalen naar heldere requirements en user stories;

  • Dagelijkse processen rondom schademelding en -herstel analyseren en verbetermogelijkheden signaleren;

  • Prioriteren van wensen en verbeteringen samen met stakeholders en het product- en developmentteam;

  • Requirements uitwerken, verduidelijken en tijdens de realisatie beschikbaar zijn voor vragen vanuit het team;

  • Nieuwe functionaliteiten testen, valideren met gebruikers en de kwaliteit bewaken;

  • Incidenten, klantfeedback en operationele knelpunten analyseren en omzetten naar concrete acties;

  • Meewerken aan implementaties, proceswijzigingen en adoptie van nieuwe functionaliteiten;

  • Processen, werkwijzen en beslissingen helder documenteren;

  • Actief samenwerken in een multidisciplinair team en zorgen dat verbeteringen meetbaar resultaat opleveren.

Waarom jij het verschil maakt

Jij bent een pragmatische Business Analyst die graag dicht op de operatie en het product werkt. Je combineert analytisch vermogen met een hands-on mentaliteit: je brengt een vraagstuk niet alleen in kaart, maar helpt ook mee om het op te lossen.

Je communiceert duidelijk met verschillende doelgroepen, stelt de juiste vragen en durft kritisch te zijn wanneer dat nodig is. Je houdt van structuur, maar blijft flexibel wanneer de praktijk daarom vraagt.

Daarnaast breng je mee:

  • Ervaring als (Technisch) Business Analyst, Functioneel Analist, Product Owner of in een vergelijkbare rol;

  • Ervaring met het analyseren en verbeteren van operationele processen;

  • Het vermogen om businessbehoeften te vertalen naar concrete requirements, user stories en acceptatiecriteria;

  • Ervaring met Agile werken en tooling zoals Jira is een pre;

  • Affiniteit met SaaS-platformen, digitale klantreizen en/of mobiliteit, lease of schadeafhandeling is een pre;

  • Ervaring met testen en acceptatie van nieuwe functionaliteiten;

  • Een proactieve, zelfstandige en resultaatgerichte werkhouding;

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden in woord en geschrift;

  • Hbo- of wo-werk- en denkniveau.

Wat bieden wij jou?

Een sleutelrol in onze ambitie om vanuit Alliance Automotive Group en samen met specialisten van Winparts de b2b groei te verstevigen. Met veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en experimenten. Je komt te werken in een ambitieus en data-gedreven team van specialisten. Binnen Winparts/ Alliance Automotive Group is er volop ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen. en verder:

  • Een uitdagende functie binnen één van de snelst groeiende e-commercebedrijven van Nederland.

  • Veel ruimte voor eigen initiatief en het verbeteren van processen.

  • Werken met innovatieve AI-oplossingen en moderne technologie.

  • Een enthousiast en ambitieus team waar samenwerking centraal staat.

  • Hybride werken en veel flexibiliteit.

  • Goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, passend bij jouw ervaring.

  • Persoonlijke ontwikkeling en volop doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen Winparts en Alliance Automotive Group.

Ready? Buckle up!

Neem voor meer info contact op met Wout Dijkstra via 06-36025968 of reageer via de knop ‘Solliciteren’. We leren je graag kennen!


*We werven ons personeel zelf! Acquisitie vanuit bureaus wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Socialpedagog till Alsike skola
description:
I Knivsta går framtidsandan att ta på. Läget mellan Stockholm och Uppsala, bara ett stenkast från Arlanda, är attraktivt och Knivsta växer så det knakar. Varje dag bygger vi aktivt det hållbara samhället med närhet till både storstad och vilsam natur. Vill du arbeta i en innovativ framtidskommun där du utvecklas och kan göra skillnad? Och sympatiserar du med våra gemensamma värderingar delaktighet, engagemang och tydlighet? 
Välkommen till oss!

Alsike skola är en F-6 skola i Knivsta kommun. Skolan har i dagsläget cirka 350 elever och på skolan arbetar cirka 50 personal. På skolan finns ett elevhälsoteam bestående av skolledning, specialpedagog, speciallärare, kurator, skolsköterska och skolpsykolog.

1 plats(er). 

ARBETSUPPGIFTER
Vi söker nu en socialpedagog på 80 procent till ett utvecklingsprojekt med fokus på ökad skolnärvaro, trygghet och social hållbarhet. Tjänsten är en projektanställning från dagens datum till och med 2027-06-30, med möjlighet till förlängning.

Som socialpedagog blir du en viktig del av skolans främjande och förebyggande arbete. Du kommer att arbeta nära elever, vårdnadshavare, pedagoger och elevhälsoteam för att stärka elevernas förutsättningar att lyckas både socialt och kunskapsmässigt.

Dina arbetsuppgifter omfattar bland annat att:

	• arbeta relationsskapande och närvarande i elevernas vardag
	• stödja elever som riskerar problematisk skolfrånvaro
	• bidra till ökad trygghet, studiero och trivsel på skolan
	• genomföra individuella samtal och gruppinsatser
	• samverka med vårdnadshavare och externa aktörer när så krävs
	• medverka i skolans elevhälsoarbete och trygghetsskapande insatser
	• stötta pedagoger i det sociala och förebyggande arbetet kring elever och elevgrupper
	• planera, genomföra och följa upp insatser inom projektets målområden.

title: Produktionsmedarbetare!

title: Product Designer - Core UX
description:
At Hudl, we build great teams. We hire the best of the best to ensure you’re working with people you can constantly learn from. You’re trusted to get your work done your way while testing the limits of what’s possible and what’s next. We work hard to provide a culture where everyone feels supported, and our employees feel it—their votes helped us become one of Newsweek's Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces.

We think of ourselves as the team behind the team, supporting the lifelong impact sports can have: the lessons in teamwork and dedication; the influence of inspiring coaches; and the opportunities to reach new heights. That’s why we help teams from all over the world see their game differently. Our products make it easier for coaches and athletes at any level to capture video, analyze data, share highlights and more.

Ready to join us?

Your Role

We're looking for a Product Designer to help shape the shared experiences and systems that connect Hudl's products.

Hudl is bringing together products used across sports, teams and organizations into a more connected platform. That creates design problems that don't always fit neatly within a single feature or product: how information is structured, how common workflows behave across products, how video and data work together, and how emerging technologies like AI change the way people interact with Hudl.

You'll work within Core UX, the team responsible for the design foundations that help Hudl's products feel clear, consistent and connected. Our work includes shared patterns and experiences, information architecture, video and data, and the systems that help product teams build at scale.

In this role, you'll:

  • Solve connected problems. You'll work on experiences that cross features, products and workflows, considering how individual design decisions fit into the broader Hudl platform.
  • Make complexity easier to understand. You'll turn complicated workflows, information and technical constraints into experiences that feel clear and intuitive.
  • Work across teams. You'll partner with product, engineering and other designers to understand problems, explore solutions and help create experiences that can work at scale.
  • Design from evidence. You'll learn directly from customers, use research and product data to inform your work, and test and iterate on ideas as you go.
  • Own your work through delivery. You'll independently run scoped design projects, working from early exploration through implementation and measuring how well the solution works once it's shipped.

For this role, we're currently considering candidates who are within commuting distance of our offices in London, but we're also open to remote candidates in the U.K.

Must-Haves

  • Strong product design craft. You can turn complex requirements into clear, intuitive experiences through strong interaction and visual design. You know how to choose the right methods and level of fidelity for the problem, moving between exploration, prototyping and delivery.
  • Systems thinking. You're comfortable working through ambiguity, naturally look for connections, and consider how a solution might affect other workflows, users or parts of a product.
  • Collaborative communication. You can explain your thinking, seek out feedback and work through different perspectives with product, engineering and design partners.
  • Customer and evidence focus. You're comfortable talking with customers and using research, product data and other evidence to make and evaluate design decisions.
  • AI fluency. You actively use AI tools in your design process and are curious about how AI changes the products we design. You're comfortable experimenting with emerging interaction patterns and thinking critically about where AI can improve an experience.
  • A strong portfolio. You can show how you've worked through product problems, including your reasoning, collaboration and iteration rather than only the final solution.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with complex or connected products. You’ve designed experiences that span multiple workflows, surfaces or parts of a larger product, and understand how individual design decisions contribute to a cohesive experience.
  • Experience with data-rich or technical products. You’ve designed products involving complex data, analytics, video or other technically challenging workflows.
  • Experience with design systems or information architecture. You’ve worked with shared patterns, design systems, information architecture or other foundations that help experiences scale across a product.
  • AI product design experience. You’ve designed conversational, agentic or other AI-powered experiences and have explored emerging interaction patterns beyond traditional interfaces.

Our Role

  • Champion work-life harmony. We’ll give you the flexibility you need in your work life (e.g., flexible vacation time, company-wide holidays and timeout (meeting-free) days, remote work options and more) so you can enjoy your personal life too.
  • Guarantee autonomy. We have an open, honest culture and we trust our people from day one. Your team will support you, but you’ll own your work and have the agency to try new ideas.
  • Encourage career growth. We’re lifelong learners who encourage professional development. We’ll give you tons of resources and opportunities to keep growing.
  • Provide an environment to help you succeed. We've invested in our offices, designing incredible spaces with our employees in mind. But whether you’re at the office or working remotely, we’ll provide you the tech stack and hardware to do your best work.
  • Support your mental and physical health. We care about our employees’ wellbeing. Our Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups and fitness partner Peerfit have you covered.
  • Cover your medical insurance. We have multiple plans to pick from to ensure you’ll have the coverage you (and your dependents) want, including vision, dental, fertility healthcare and family forming benefits.
  • Contribute to your 401(K). Yep, that’s free money. We’ll match up to 4% of your own contribution.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is displayed below—starting salaries will typically fall near the middle of this range.

We make compensation decisions based on an individual's experience, skills and education in line with our internal pay equity practices.

Base Salary Range
£51,000—£86,000 GBP

Inclusion at Hudl

Hudl is an equal opportunity employer. Through our actions, behaviors and attitude, we’ll create an environment where everyone, no matter their differences, feels like they belong.

We offer resources to ensure our employees feel safe bringing their authentic selves to work, including employee resource groups and communities. But we recognize there’s ongoing work to be done, which is why we track our efforts and commitments in annual inclusion reports.

We also know imposter syndrome is real and the confidence gap can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply—we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Data Center Operations Engineer
description:
We are looking for an experienced Data Center Operations Engineer to join our growing team in Milan and help shape the future of our flagship project, Colosseum, one of Europe’s most powerful AI supercomputers, currently in development.

Designed to run our proprietary AI models at scale, it forms the compute backbone behind the intelligence we deliver to the world’s most demanding industries.

To achieve the highest level of performance, datacenter infrastructure has become a tightly integrated part of supercomputers where power, cooling and the building management systems provide critical consumable resources that should be optimized like any other resource in the system to extract maximum performance in a reliable way. We also strive towards optimal responsible embedding in the local environment. Tuning the heat recovery systems to optimize for the community district heating systems and tuning the power systems to support and stabilize the local grid are critically important to deliver on our societal responsibilities.

In this role, you will maintain the infrastructure and ensure its reliability and performance. You will respond to incidents and support troubleshooting and resolution activities when issues arise.

You will also contribute to the architecture and design of next-generation systems, helping shape future infrastructure evolution. A key part of the role involves automating processes, integrating systems, and implementing ongoing improvements and optimizations.

As a part of the team, you will stay up to date with the latest technologies and industry trends, actively bringing new ideas. You will collaborate closely with other team members to evaluate and implement these improvements effectively.

What You Have

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • At least 6 years of experience as a Data Center Operations Engineer or in similar roles.

  • Certification to work with MV/LV electrical systems (Medium Voltage / Low Voltage)

  • Certifications (PES / PAV / PEI or equivalent, DCIS or equivalent)

  • Strong understanding of data center operations and critical infrastructure environments

  • Solid knowledge of industry standards, including ISO 50001 (Energy Management Systems)

  • Hands-on experience with data center monitoring, control, and integration systems, including BMC for the IT hardware and related tools

  • Experience with infrastructure monitoring and management protocols such as Redfish, SNMP, and MQTT

  • Working knowledge of Python for automation and integration tasks

  • Experience with modern system integration frameworks and APIs (e.g. MCP or similar technologies)

Who You Are

  • A versatile engineer, comfortable operating in complex and fast-paced environments.

  • Driven and fearless, you proactively tackle challenges and overcome obstacles with determination.

  • A systems thinker, capable of understanding the broader architecture and identifying dependencies across platforms and technologies.

  • A collaborative team player who is enthusiastic, curious, and passionate about problem-solving, thriving both independently and within cross-functional teams.

  • An effective communicator with strong interpersonal skills, able to engage with diverse stakeholders and foster collaboration.

  • Fluent in English and eager to contribute in a multicultural and international environment.

Benefits

Perks

  • Learning Friday. If our team members know more, so do we. That’s why we give everyone a training budget that they can spend on books, online courses or other training materials.

  • Smart Working. Trains can be a drag, you can save some commuting time by working from home.

  • Salary is based on experience and topped up with other bonuses.

We offer a competitive salary, as well as an opportunity to receive company equity. The typical salary for this role ranges between € 50.000 and € 70.000. As you gain experience and make more significant contributions to the business, your compensation will be reviewed to match your impact. Additionally, depending on your seniority and your performance, you’ll have the opportunity to receive stock options, with a variable value calculated from your base salary, giving you the chance to directly participate in the company’s success.

About Domyn

Domyn is a company specializing in the research and development of Responsible AI for regulated industries, including financial services, government, and heavy industry. It supports enterprises with proprietary, fully governable solutions based on a composable AI architecture — including LLMs, AI agents, and one of the world’s largest supercomputers. At the core of Domyn’s product offer is a chip-to-frontend architecture that allows organizations to control the entire AI stack — from hardware to application — ensuring isolation, security, and governance throughout the AI lifecycle. Its foundational LLMs, Domyn Large and Domyn Small, are designed for advanced reasoning and optimized to understand each business’s specific language, logic, and context. Provided under an open-enterprise license, these models can be fully transferred and owned by clients. Once deployed, they enable customizable agents that operate on proprietary data to solve complex, domain-specific problems. All solutions are managed via a unified platform with native tools for access management, traceability, and security. Powering it all, Colosseum — a supercomputer in development using NVIDIA Grace Blackwell Superchips — will train next-gen models exceeding 1T parameters. Domyn partners with Microsoft, NVIDIA, and G42. Clients include Allianz, Intesa Sanpaolo, and Fincantieri.
