title: Embeddedutvecklare till AFRY i Jönköping
description:
Är du en passionerad utvecklare med intresse för inbyggda system och redo för nya utmaningar? Vill du arbeta med spännande teknik i framkant och vara en del av innovation för framtiden? Då kan AFRY vara din nästa arbetsplats!

Vi söker nu flera erfarna Embedded Software Developers till vårt team i Jönköping. Hos oss får du chansen att utveckla och implementera högkvalitativa mjukvarulösningar för olika applikationer och plattformar inom flera spännande branscher som försvar, energi, telekom, fordon och konsumentprodukter.

Som en del av AFRYs team får du möjlighet att arbeta med innovativa projekt, både internt i vår produktutvecklingsavdelning och ute hos våra kunder. Vi erbjuder en varierad arbetsmiljö där du får utvecklas tekniskt samtidigt som du arbetar i ett inkluderande team som sätter trivsel och personlig utveckling i fokus.

I din roll som Embedded mjuvaruutvecklare på AFRY kommer du att:

  • Utveckla och implementera mjukvarulösningar för inbyggda system
  • Arbeta i tvärfunktionella team med både mjukvara och hårdvara
  • Vara involverad i hela utvecklingsprocessen, från design till implementering och testning
  • Delta i innovativa projekt både inhouse och ute hos våra kunder beroende på uppdragets karaktär

Vi söker dig som är en engagerad lagspelare med ett stort intresse och kompetens inom inbyggda system.

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen har du minst 2 års arbetslivserfarenhet av programmering i C eller C++ inom embeddedutveckling, samt god kännedom om realtidssystem – gärna i kombination med erfarenhet av Embedded Linux.

Du har också:

  • Kunskaper i Python

  • Vana vid agila metoder, exempelvis Scrum

  • Förmåga att snabbt sätta dig in i nya tekniska utmaningar och projektmiljöer

  • Erfarenhet av att arbeta nära både kollegor och kunder

Det är meriterande om du dessutom har erfarenhet av:

  • Firmwareutveckling

  • Drivrutinsutveckling

  • Verktyg som Jenkins, Docker och CI/CD

För denna tjänst är det ett krav att du behärskar både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift, då våra uppdrag ofta innefattar kontakt med svenska kunder. Vissa uppdrag kan också vara säkerhetsklassade, vilket innebär att du i så fall kommer bli säkerhetsprövad med stöd av säkerhetsskyddslagen.

Det som verkligen avgör om du kommer att trivas hos oss är din personlighet. Som medarbetare hos AFRY är det viktigt att du uppskattar variation och har förmågan att snabbt anpassa dig till olika projekt och människor. Vi tror att du är en nätverkare som gillar att skapa relationer, både internt och med kunder. Du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och uppskattar utmaningen i att arbeta med olika typer av uppdrag.

Teknisk kompetens är en grundförutsättning för att lyckas i rollen, men vi vet att det är din personlighet som gör att du trivs och utvecklas tillsammans med oss.

Hos AFRY får du möjlighet att utvecklas i en inspirerande och innovativ miljö där du kan växa både professionellt och personligt. Vi värdesätter våra medarbetares trivsel och erbjuder en trygg anställning med bra förmåner. AFRY har ett starkt fokus på kompetensutveckling och vi erbjuder både interna och externa utbildningar för att du ska kunna fortsätta utvecklas inom ditt område.

Sista ansökningsdag är 2026-09-30 men vi träffar kandidater löpande så tveka inte att visa ditt intresse redan idag!

För samtliga rekryteringar på AFRY genomförs som grund alltid en ID-kontroll, referenstagning samt verifiering av utbildning. Läs gärna mer om vår rekryteringsprocess här.

Kontaktperson för frågor:

Marcus André, marcus.andre@afry.com - Rekryterande chef

Vi tackar för visad hänsyn om att inte bli kontaktade av externa leverantörer för rekryteringslösningar och liknande då dessa sköts enligt avtal på bolagsnivå.

På AFRY driver vi förändring i allt vi gör. Vi anser att förändring sker när modiga idéer möts, när vi samarbetar, skapar innovation och omfamnar kreativa lösningar, det är så vi skapar framtiden. Vi söker konstant kvalificerade kandidater som vill ansluta sig till våra inkluderande team runt om i världen. Bli en del av oss och påskynda den gröna omställningen

title: Lähihoitaja tai hoiva-avustaja (keikkatyö), Mainiokoti Rantakoivu, Kuusamo
description:
Lähihoitajia tai hoiva-avustajia (keikkatyö), Mainiokoti Rantakoivu, Kuusamo

Tule mukaan rakentamaan kodin tuntua Mainiokoti Rantakoivuun!


Haemme nyt lähihoitajia tai hoiva-avustajia keikkatyöhön mainioon kotiimme.

Mihin tulet töihin?

25 paikkaisessa Mainiokoti Rantakoivussa asuu ympärivuorokautisen avun tarpeessa olevia ikäihmisiä.


Mitä pääset tekemään?
Hoitajana pääset tekemään jokapäiväistä hoitotyötä yhteistyössä muiden tiimiläisten kanssa. Arkemme on toiminnallista ja järjestämme aktiviteetteja asukkaillemme.

Kuka sinä olet?
Olet koulutukseltasi lähihoitaja, opintojesi loppusuoralle ennättänyt opiskelija tai hyvinvointialueen sääntökirjan mukainen hoiva-avustaja, jolla on kolme tutkinnon osaa (asiakkaan kohtaaminen ja ohjaaminen, hyvinvoinnin ja toimintakyvyn edistäminen ja asiakkaan toimintakyvyn vahvistaminen) suoritettuna. Joukossamme viihtyy parhaiten positiivisesti asioihin suhtautuva ja oma-aloitteinen henkilö, joka on aidosti kiinnostunut vanhustyöstä. Kokemus muistisairaiden kanssa työskentelystä katsotaan eduksi.

Miksi tulisit meille töihin?
Mainiokoti Rantakoivussa olet osa yhteen hiileen puhaltavaa työyhteisöä, jossa töitä tehdään hymy huulilla ja saamme apua toisiltamme. Asukkaan hyvinvointi on meillä keskiössä.

Työ on keikkatyötä ja tehtävän palkkaus on yksityisen sosiaalialan TES:n mukainen.

Hoitotyön tehtävien hoitaminen edellyttää vähintään B1 ja avustavien tehtävien hoitaminen edellyttää vähintään A2 tai vastaavaa suomen kielen kielitaitotasoa, sekä sitoutumista kielitaidon ylläpitämiseen.

Sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti tehtävään valittavien ikääntyvien tai vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelevien on esitettävä nähtäväksi rikosrekisterilain 6 §:n 2 momentissa tarkoitettu rikosrekisteriote.

Hae tehtävää rekrytointijärjestelmämme kautta mahdollisimman pian. Toimithan nopeasti, sillä täytämme paikkoja heti sopivien henkilöiden löytyessä. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan.

Kerron mielelläni lisää:

Yksikönjohtaja Satu Lämsä

satu.lamsa@mainiokodit.fi

Sen tuntee, kun tulee kotiin. ​


Mainiokotien missiona on luoda parempaa hoitoa Suomeen mahdollistamalla jokaiselle asukkaalle yksilöllinen ja hyvä elämä. Panostamme Mainiokodeissa laadukkaaseen hoivaan, hoitoon ja ohjaukseen, maukkaaseen ruokaan, turvallisuuteen, yhteisöllisyyteen sekä siihen, että jokaisella asiakkaalla on oma viihtyisä koti. Mainiokotien brändin symboli, räsymatto, kuvaa koko elämän kirjoa iloineen ja suruineen.

Mainiokodit on osa Mehiläistä. Mehiläisen sosiaali- ja terveyspalveluiden ammattilaiset työskentelevät joka päivä tinkimättömästi yksityis-, yritys- ja hyvinvointialueasiakkaidemme hyväksi. Tervetuloa mukaan vahvistamaan ammattilaistemme joukkoa!

You’ll help evolve a production mobile application across both iOS and Android while supporting multiple brands and configurations.
The environment is remote-first and internationally distributed, with experienced professionals collaborating across cultures and time zones.
You’ll work with modern Flutter architecture and tooling while contributing to a product where mobile quality and user engagement directly matter.
This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership, technical depth, and building scalable mobile experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and maintain core mobile product experiences across authentication and registration, search and discovery, profiles, photos, messaging, matching, and user engagement.
  • Analyze and improve key product funnels, including registration, upgrades, monetization, messaging engagement, and match or interest conversion.
  • Own and contribute to analytics for core mobile journeys, helping teams understand user behavior and identify opportunities for product improvement.
  • Monitor and improve platform-specific capabilities such as push notifications, deep links, and real-time features.
  • Analyze mobile advertising and in-app purchase revenue metrics and support initiatives designed to improve monetization performance.
  • Support compliance-related analytics and functionality, including consent management, age verification, and user verification.
  • Build and evolve production Flutter applications for both iOS and Android using maintainable, scalable architecture.
  • Contribute to multi-flavor and white-label application delivery, including brand-specific configurations, assets, store identifiers, and Firebase environments.
  • Develop automated tests across unit and widget levels and help maintain high standards of reliability and code quality.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, analytics, and other cross-functional stakeholders in a fully remote international environment.

    • Requirements

    • Strong professional experience with Flutter and Dart 3.x, including experience delivering and maintaining production applications for both iOS and Android.
    • Solid understanding of layered mobile architecture, including separation between UI, domain/use cases and repositories, and framework layers.
    • Hands-on experience with BLoC and Provider, as well as GetIt for dependency injection and GoRouter for navigation.
    • Experience working with Dio for networking and immutable data models using code generation tools such as built_value or similar technologies.
    • Experience building and shipping multi-flavor or white-label mobile applications, including per-brand configurations, assets, store IDs, and Firebase setups.
    • Practical experience writing automated tests, particularly unit and widget tests; familiarity with bloc_test or BDD-style testing is an advantage.
    • Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, performance, maintainability, and production development practices.
    • Analytical mindset with an interest in using product data and user behavior to improve mobile experiences and business outcomes.

Team context

User Operations sits within Fever's broader User Support organization. User Operations is the strategic/enablement layer behind the operating User support structure, organized around three areas: AI integration, Systems, and Data.

Within Data, we focus on continuous improvement. We don't just maintain information that's useful and relevant to stakeholders inside and outside the department, we translate that data into concrete initiatives that let us keep questioning and improving how we work.

The role

We're looking for a Project Manager with a strong analytics backbone. This isn't a "build the dashboard and move on", we need someone who can go from constructing the data (dashboards, reporting, automations) to understanding what it actually means for the business, so they can help management make consistently data-driven decisions.

Projects will range from a variety of stakeholders, such as, providing user support with operating actionable metrics, giving partners visibility into how their events are performing or helping on app developments that directly shape the user experience.

What we're looking for

Analytics (70% weight)

  • 2-4 years of experience in data/analytics (analyst, data PM, BI, ops analytics). A relevant Master's or further training in the field is a plus.
  • Comfortable building and maintaining dashboards in tools like Metabase, Looker, or similar.
  • Scripting/automation experience.

Project management & structure (30% weight)

  • Demonstrated ability to run a project end-to-end.
  • Organized, structured, and comfortable prioritizing your own workload.
  • You default to improving things, not just maintaining them. When you spot something inefficient, you fix it or raise it, you don't leave it for later.
  • Comfortable communicating with both technical (central Data team) and non-technical (support ops) stakeholders.
  • Not required today, but a plus: some early signs of enjoying explaining things to others or helping people grow. This role is expected to evolve into managing a team member over time, no prior people-management experience needed.

Languages & location

  • Full professional fluency in both English and Spanish, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Based in Madrid or willing to relocate to Madrid

Why you'd love it: Benefits & Perks

  • Attractive compensation package consisting of base salary and the potential to earn a significant bonus for top performance
  • Opportunity to have a real impact in a high-growth global category leader
  • 40% discount on all Fever events and experiences
  • Work in a location in the heart of Madrid
  • Home-office friendly
  • Health insurance
  • Gympass membership
  • English Lessons
  • Other benefits such as Flexible remuneration with a 100% tax exemption through Cobee and the possibility to receive in advance part of your salary by Payflow.
  • Responsibility from day one and professional and personal growth
  • Great work environment with a young, international team of talented people to work with!

Thank you for considering joining Fever. We cannot wait to learn more about you!

If you want to learn more about us: Fever's Blog | |TechCrunch

Our main goal is to find the best possible talent regardless of place of birth, racial or ethnic origin, gender, gender identity, religion, opinion, sexual orientation, disability, pregnancy, marital status, age or caring responsibilities. title: Process Engineer – Production, Assembly and Packaging
description:
Whether it's the unique breadth of our integrated offering that covers Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology products; or our commitment to recognizing and rewarding people for the contribution they make - working here isn't like anywhere else.

At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact.

Vill du leda tekniska förbättringar som stärker framtidens läkemedelsproduktion?

På Galderma arbetar vi för att avancera dermatologi för varje hudhistoria. Vår framgång bygger på innovation, hög teknisk kompetens och en vilja att ständigt utveckla våra processer och arbetssätt. Nu söker vi en Senior Process Engineer som vill ta en nyckelroll i att driva teknisk utveckling, optimera tillverkningsprocesser och bidra till en säker, effektiv och hållbar produktion.

Det här är en möjlighet för dig som vill kombinera tekniskt djup med ett brett verksamhetsperspektiv och vara med och påverka både dagens och morgondagens produktionslösningar.

Ditt team

Du blir en del av vårt team där vi tillsammans arbetar för att utveckla och förbättra våra produktionsprocesser, system och tekniska lösningar. Teamet präglas av hög kompetens, stort engagemang och ett nära samarbete med produktion, kvalitet, supply chain, validering och andra specialistfunktioner.

I rollen får du möjlighet att arbeta tvärfunktionellt, driva komplexa initiativ och bidra med teknisk expertis i projekt som har stor betydelse för verksamhetens fortsatta utveckling. Du blir en viktig partner till både kollegor och ledare i organisationen och får möjlighet att påverka strategiska beslut inom ditt område.

Ditt uppdrag

Som Senior Process Engineer ansvarar du för att driva och implementera tekniska förbättringar inom våra processer och produktionssystem. Du leder avancerade aktiviteter och projekt genom hela livscykeln, från analys och konceptutveckling till implementering, verifiering och uppföljning.

Du säkerställer att våra lösningar uppfyller höga krav på kvalitet, säkerhet, effektivitet och regulatorisk efterlevnad samtidigt som du identifierar nya möjligheter att utveckla verksamheten.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden inkluderar att:

  • Driva och implementera förbättringsinitiativ inom produktion, processer och teknik.
  • Leda eller koordinera tekniska projekt och tvärfunktionella aktiviteter.
  • Utveckla och optimera befintliga processer samt stödja introduktion av nya produkter och processer.
  • Utföra tekniska analyser, utredningar och riskbedömningar för komplexa frågeställningar.
  • Säkerställa att tekniska lösningar uppfyller krav på kvalitet, säkerhet, tillförlitlighet och prestanda.
  • Bidra med teknisk vägledning och stöd till kollegor och intressenter inom organisationen.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som är en erfaren ingenjör med ett starkt driv att utveckla verksamheter genom teknik och ständiga förbättringar. Du är analytisk, lösningsorienterad och har förmågan att se både helheten och detaljerna i komplexa processer. Samtidigt är du en skicklig samarbetspartner som bygger förtroende och engagerar människor omkring dig.

Vi tror att du har:

  • En universitets- eller högskoleexamen inom teknik, kemiteknik, bioteknik, industriell teknik eller annat relevant område.
  • Flera års erfarenhet av processutveckling, produktionsteknik eller engineering inom läkemedel, bioteknik eller annan reglerad tillverkningsindustri.
  • Erfarenhet av att leda tekniska projekt, driva förbättringsarbete och arbeta tvärfunktionellt med olika intressenter.
  • Flytande svenska i tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av GMP-reglerad verksamhet, validering, processoptimering samt implementering av ny teknik i produktionsmiljö.

Placering

Denna tjänst är placerad I Uppsala, Sweden.

Why Galderma

At Galderma, you'll have the opportunity to work in a science-driven, innovative, and collaborative environment where quality and patient impact are at the center of everything we do. You'll join a team of talented colleagues and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our biologics and protein-based portfolio.

title: Join Us: Java Software Developer to Build Digital Solutions
description:
Target Reply Milano-Torino


“Join Us: Java Software Developer to build digital solutions””


Are you a passionate and talented recent graduate, eager to shape the strategies of the future through innovative technologies?

At Target Reply, you’ll have the opportunity to put your academic knowledge into practice, gain hands-on experience, and work with the technologies and paradigms that are transforming the world of data and technology.


WHO WE ARE

Target Reply is the company of the Reply Group specialized in Analytics, Big Data, Data Science, Cloud Architecture and Artificial Intelligence.

With a diverse portfolio of clients across key industries, you’ll work in a dynamic and collaborative environment, designing and implementing innovative solutions based on modern data architectures and emerging technologies.


DESCRIPTION OF THE ROLE

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a Junior Software Developer motivated to grow in a innovative environment, developing solid expertise in enterprise application development and microservices architectures.


MAIN RESPONSABILITIES

  • Collaborate with design and development teams to translate requirements into robust, and high-impact solutions.
  • Develop scalable and high-performance microservices-based applications using modern technologies (e.g., SpringBoot).
  • Design, develop, and optimize REST APIs to enable seamless communication between distributed services and client applications.
  • Contribute to innovation by proposing solutions aligned with the latest trends in Data & Analytics.


ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS

  • A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or other data-centric disciplines is required (minimum grade: 100⁄110).
  • Knowledge of the fundamental concepts of Object-Oriented Programming.
  • Familiarity with Java.
  • Basic knowledge of the fundamentals of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, MySQL) and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, DynamoDB).
  • Team-oriented mindset.


NICE TO HAVE

  • No prior work experience is required. Relevant internships or projects will be considered a plus.
  • Familiarity with JavaScript and/or Angular.
  • Knowledge of version control systems (e.g., Git) will be considered a plus.
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (e.g., GCP, AWS, etc.) will be considered a plus.


WHAT WE OFFER

  • A concrete recognition of your achievement – The applicable Collective Labour Agreement (CCNL) is the Italian Metalworking Industry Agreement. The starting gross annual salary (RAL) will range from €25,000 to €36,000, depending on your academic achievements, technical skills, and any previous professional experience.
  • A dynamic and innovative environment – Join a young, collaborative, and highly qualified team, working on challenging projects and innovative technologies.
  • Mentoring & continuous learning – You’ll become part of a community of talented professionals. We don’t expect you to know everything from day one. That’s why we provide continuous training, mentoring, and concrete opportunities for professional growth, helping you develop and strengthen your skills.
  • The benefits of being a Replyer – You’ll also have access to the benefits, initiatives, and opportunities dedicated to the Reply community.
  • Hybrid working policy, requiring 1–2 days per week on site (Milan/Turin).

WHAT ARE THE NEXT STEPS

At the beginning of the recruitment process, we may contact you to ask for some additional information about your application.

Then recruitment process mainly consists of two steps:

  • Technical Interview – an interview with one of our Data Specialists to discuss your technical background, skills, and approach to problem-solving;
  • Interview with HR – an interview with our HR team to get to know you better and discuss your motivations, expectations, and career goals.


Feel interested? Submit your application and join our team.

Reply is committed to embracing diversity and creating an inclusive work environment by valuing the uniqueness of people regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality or disabilities as protected by Italian Law (L.68⁄99).

Reply is committed to ensuring that our candidate selection methods are fair and just. To help you during the recruitment process, please let us know of any Reasonable Adjustments you may need.

title: Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Mobile Engineer (Flutter) based in Saudi Arabia.

This is an opportunity to join an established digital product and contribute to a mobile experience used by a global community.
You’ll work on core product journeys including registration, discovery, profiles, messaging, engagement, and monetization.
The role combines hands-on Flutter development with a strong focus on analytics, performance, and measurable product outcomes.
You’ll help evolve a production mobile application across both iOS and Android while supporting multiple brands and configurations.
The environment is remote-first and internationally distributed, with experienced professionals collaborating across cultures and time zones.
You’ll work with modern Flutter architecture and tooling while contributing to a product where mobile quality and user engagement directly matter.
This role is well suited to an engineer who enjoys ownership, technical depth, and building scalable mobile experiences.

Accountabilities

  • Develop and maintain core mobile product experiences across authentication and registration, search and discovery, profiles, photos, messaging, matching, and user engagement.
  • Analyze and improve key product funnels, including registration, upgrades, monetization, messaging engagement, and match or interest conversion.
  • Own and contribute to analytics for core mobile journeys, helping teams understand user behavior and identify opportunities for product improvement.
  • Monitor and improve platform-specific capabilities such as push notifications, deep links, and real-time features.
  • Analyze mobile advertising and in-app purchase revenue metrics and support initiatives designed to improve monetization performance.
  • Support compliance-related analytics and functionality, including consent management, age verification, and user verification.
  • Build and evolve production Flutter applications for both iOS and Android using maintainable, scalable architecture.
  • Contribute to multi-flavor and white-label application delivery, including brand-specific configurations, assets, store identifiers, and Firebase environments.
  • Develop automated tests across unit and widget levels and help maintain high standards of reliability and code quality.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, analytics, and other cross-functional stakeholders in a fully remote international environment.

    • Requirements

    • Strong professional experience with Flutter and Dart 3.x, including experience delivering and maintaining production applications for both iOS and Android.
    • Solid understanding of layered mobile architecture, including separation between UI, domain/use cases and repositories, and framework layers.
    • Hands-on experience with BLoC and Provider, as well as GetIt for dependency injection and GoRouter for navigation.
    • Experience working with Dio for networking and immutable data models using code generation tools such as built_value or similar technologies.
    • Experience building and shipping multi-flavor or white-label mobile applications, including per-brand configurations, assets, store IDs, and Firebase setups.
    • Practical experience writing automated tests, particularly unit and widget tests; familiarity with bloc_test or BDD-style testing is an advantage.
    • Strong understanding of mobile application architecture, performance, maintainability, and production development practices.
    • Analytical mindset with an interest in using product data and user behavior to improve mobile experiences and business outcomes.
    • Ability to work independently, take ownership of technical responsibilities, and collaborate effectively within a distributed team.
    • Fluent Russian and B2-level English communication skills.

      • Benefits

      • Fully remote, full-time working opportunity.
      • Competitive compensation, with the initial salary level or range shared with candidates during the recruitment process and before employment begins.
      • 28 calendar days of vacation per year.
      • 7 wellness days annually for personal needs, recovery, or household matters without requiring sick leave.
      • Employee referral bonuses of up to $5,000 for successful recommendations.
      • 50% reimbursement for professional training, international conferences, and industry events.
      • Corporate discounts for English language lessons.
      • Health support of up to $1,000 gross per year per employee where corporate medical insurance is unavailable, which can be used toward private health insurance or eligible medical expenses for employees and close relatives.
      • Workplace support, including equipment and coworking resources; employees working outside company-supported locations can receive up to $1,000 gross every three years toward home-office or coworking expenses.
      • Internal gamified recognition program where colleagues can award bonuses redeemable for merchandise, team-building activities, massage certificates, and other rewards.
      • International, remote-first working environment with opportunities to collaborate with professionals across different countries and cultures.

Finance/Ukraine/Kyiv Office

21/08/2026

N/A

Typical decisions the holder of the positions makes

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Systematic and organized in approach, including accuracy, consistency, and attention to detail, tenacity, and the ability to work under pressure.

title: Interim - Accountmanager binnendienst
description:
Wat je over ons moet weten?

Wij zijn Athora Netherlands, een verzekeringsbedrijf met de bekende merken Zwitserleven en Reaal. Wij houden ons voornamelijk bezig met pensioenen en levensverzekeringen op de Nederlandse markt. Dat doen wij als onderdeel van een Europese groep met vestigingen in Ierland, het Verenigd Koninkrijk, België, Duitsland en Italië. Wij zijn een sterk bedrijf met ruim één miljoen klanten en wij willen de komende jaren doorgroeien tot een van de belangrijkste spelers in de snel veranderende pensioenmarkt.

Wat ga je doen?

Als Accountmanager Binnendienst (Internal Accountmanager Pensioning) maak je onderdeel uit van het Personal Solutions Sales team, wat bestaat uit 21 specialisten dat gezamenlijk verantwoordelijk is voor al het klantcontact met deelnemers in de uitkeringsfase. Het team is specifiek verantwoordelijk voor de uitkeringsfase van pensioen- en vermogensproducten.

Als medewerker én als team zijn jullie verantwoordelijk voor zowel een hoge klanttevredenheid als voor de commerciële resultaten van de genoemde producten. In deze rol onderhoud je intensief contact met zowel de deelnemer als diens adviseur. Dit klantcontact vindt plaats via diverse kanalen, waaronder telefonie, e-mail, chat en social media. Je zorgt voor tijdige, correcte en klantgerichte output, zoals offertes, mutatieformulieren, afkoopvoorstellen en polissen, en draagt tevens zorg voor een correcte administratieve verwerking. Het team begeleidt deelnemers bij het volledige pensioneringsproces richting een Defined Benefit (DB) rente-uitkering, het Direct Ingang Pensioen (DIP) en/of het Direct Ingaand Variabel Pensioen (DIVP), aangevuld met de Inkomen voor Later-oplossing in de vorm van de Direct Ingaande Lijfrente (DIL).

#LI-DNI

Wat vragen we van jou?

- HBO werk- en denkniveau, achtergrond in de financiële sector is mooi meegenomen!
- In bezit van WFT basis, WFT Pensioen en WFT Vermogen of bereid deze te halen.
- Kennis van en ervaring met continu verbeteren, kijkt met een kritisch analytische blik.
- Ervaring met het administratiesysteem Lifetime is een pré.
- Commercieel en resultaatgericht.
- Professioneel en betrouwbaar in houding en communicatie.

Startdatum: 18-05-2026

title: Senior Sales Engineer - Paris
description:
As an Enterprise Sales Engineer, you'll partner with Sales to help customers understand the value of Datadog and how it solves their most important technical and business challenges. You'll lead technical evaluations, deliver compelling demos, and guide customers through the journey from discovery to successful adoption.

You'll act as a trusted advisor, bridging business goals with technical solutions, and play a key role in winning new business and expanding existing accounts.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the sales process in partnership with Account Executives by leading and shaping the technical strategy across opportunities from PG to Closed Won
  • Lead customer discovery to uncover technical challenges, business goals, and success criteria, then translate those needs into tailored Datadog solutions
  • Deliver engaging product demos, technical presentations, and workshops that connect platform capabilities to customer outcomes
  • Project manage technical evaluations (POVs) end-to-end: scoping use cases and requirements, defining success criteria, building a project plan with clear timelines, and holding all participants accountable to the process
  • Identify and cultivate technical champions within customer accounts, empowering them to advocate for Datadog adoption and drive consensus internally
  • Participat e actively in structured product and engineering field feedback sessions, serving as the technical voice of the customer to help shape product direction
  • Maintain operational excellence by ensuring activity, deal progress, and customer interactions are accurately documented and up to date in related systems
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Support, and GTM teams to address customer needs and resolve technical blockers

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years of experience in Sales Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a technical customer-facing role within an enterprise environment
  • Skilled at navigating multi-stakeholder environments and adapting communication style to technical, business, and executive audiences
  • Proficient background in public cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP), Kubernetes, APM/tracing, security, developer experience, observability
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to a range of audiences
  • A consultative approach to problem-solving and customer engagement
  • Ability to manage multiple opportunities and priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Growth mindset by embracing change and AI tools
  • Willingness to travel as needed to support customer engagements

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you’re passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth:

  • Best-in-breed onboarding
